Query_Text_cn: (ⅰ)初次检验应包括消防安全系统和设备、救生设备和装置(无线电设备除外)船载导航设备、引航员登船设施以及其他设备在内的全面检查。对此适用第II-1、II-2、III和V章，以保证其符合本公约的各项要求并处于合格状况，且适合该船预定的用途。
Translation: The initial survey shall include a comprehensive inspection of fire safety systems and equipment, life-saving appliances and apparatus (excluding radio equipment), shipborne navigational equipment, pilot embarkation facilities and other equipment. Chapters II-1, II-2, III and V shall apply to ensure compliance with the requirements of this Convention, that such equipment is in a serviceable condition and suitable for the vessel's intended purpose.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅲ)年度检验应包括(b)(ⅰ)所述设备的一般检查，以保证设备已按第11(a)条进行了维护保养，并保持在合格状况，适合该船预定的用途。
Translation: (iii) The annual survey shall include a general inspection of the equipment referred to in (b)(i) to ensure that the equipment has been maintained in accordance with paragraph 11(a) and remains in a serviceable condition suitable for the intended purpose of the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 参见认可的货船安全设备记录(SLS.14/Circ.1)。
Translation: Refer to the recognized cargo ship safety equipment record (SLS.14/Circ.1).

Query_Text_cn: (c)本条(a)(ⅲ)和(a)(ⅳ)所述的定期检验和年度检验应在货船设备安全证书上签署。
Translation: (c) The periodic surveys and annual surveys referred to in paragraphs (a)(iii) and (a)(iv) of this paragraph shall be endorsed on the Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅳ)第7(b)(ⅲ)条对客船所规定的附加检验。
Translation: (iv) the additional survey required for passenger ships under Article 7(b)(iii).

Query_Text_cn: (ⅱ)换证检验和定期检验应包括货船无线电设备，包括在救生设备上使用的无线电设备的检查，以保证设备符合本公约的各项要求。
Translation: (ii) Revalidation surveys and periodic surveys shall include inspections of radio installations on cargo ships, including those used on lifesaving appliances, to ensure compliance with the requirements of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (c)本条(a)(ⅲ)所述的定期检验应在货船无线电安全证书上签署。
Translation: (c) The periodic inspections referred to in this paragraph (a)(iii) shall be endorsed on the Cargo Ship Radio Safety Certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 参见关于船底外部检验的通函(PSLS.2/Circ.5)。
Translation: See Circular PSLS.2/Circ.5 regarding underwater external survey.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅴ)在任何5年期内，船底外部应至少进行2次检查，但如适用第14(e)或(f)条时除外。
Translation: (v) Within any 5-year period, the underwater hull external shall be inspected at least twice, except when paragraphs 14(e) or (f) apply.

Query_Text_cn: 如第14(e)或(f)条适用时，此5年期限可展期至与证书有效期展期期限相一致。
Translation: Where Article 14(e) or (f) applies, the five-year period may be extended to align with the extension period of the certificate's validity.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅵ)第7(b)(ⅲ)条对客船所规定的附加检验。
Translation: (VI) the additional survey prescribed for passenger ships as specified in Article 7(b)(iii).

Query_Text_cn: (ⅰ)初次检验应包括船体、机器和设备在内的全面检查。
Translation: (ⅰ)Initial inspection shall include a thorough examination of the hull, machinery, and equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 此项检验应能保证包括船舶的布置、材料、结构尺寸和工艺，锅炉和其他受压容器及其附件，主辅机包括舵机及与其相关的控制系统，电气设备以及其他设备符合本公约的各项要求，且处于合格状况，适合该船预定的用途，并备有要求的稳性资料。
Translation: This examination shall ensure that the arrangement of the ship, materials, structural dimensions, and construction practices; boilers and other pressure vessels with their appurtenances; main and auxiliary machinery including steering gear and their associated control systems; electrical equipment and other fittings comply with the requirements of this Convention, are in a satisfactory condition, suitable for the intended purpose of the ship, and have the required stability data available.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅲ)中间检验应包括船体、锅炉和其他受压容器、机器和设备、舵机及与其相关的控制系统和电气设备的检查，以保证其保持在合格的状况，适合该船预定的用途。
Translation: (ⅲ) The intermediate survey shall include inspection of the hull, boilers, other pressure vessels, machinery and equipment, steering gear, their associated control systems and electrical installations to ensure that they remain in a satisfactory condition suitable for the intended purpose of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅴ)对船底外部的检查以及与此同时对有关检查项目的检验，以保证其保持在合格状况，适合该船预定的用途。
Translation: (v) Inspection of the external hull and concurrent examination of relevant inspection items to ensure they remain in a satisfactory condition and are suitable for the vessel's intended purpose.

Query_Text_cn: (c)本条(a)(ⅲ)、(a)(ⅳ)和(a)(ⅴ)所述的中间检验、年度检验和船底外部的检查均应在货船构造安全证书上签署。
Translation: The intermediate surveys, annual surveys, and inspections of the underwater parts referred to in paragraphs (a)(iii), (a)(iv), and (a)(v) of this paragraph shall be endorsed on the Cargo Ship Safety Construction Certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (a)应保持船舶及其设备状况符合本公约的各项规定，以保证该船在各方面保持适合于出海航行而不致对船舶及船上人员产生危险。
Translation: (a) Maintain the condition of the ship and its equipment in conformity with the provisions of this Convention, to ensure that the ship is seaworthy in all respects so as not to constitute a danger to the ship or its crew.

Query_Text_cn: (b)根据第7、8、9条或第10条的规定，对船舶所进行的任何检验完成以后，非经主管机关认可，已检验过的结构布置、机器、设备及其他项目，概不得变动。
Translation: (b) Pursuant to the provisions of Articles 7, 8, 9 or 10, after completion of any inspection of the ship, the structural arrangements, machinery, equipment or other items that have been inspected shall not be altered without the approval of the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: (c)当船舶发生事故或发现缺陷，且不管是影响该船的安全，还是影响该船救生设备或其他设备的有效性或完整性时，该船的船长或船东应尽快向负责发给有关证书的主管机关、指定的验船师或认可的组织报告。主管机关、指定的验船师或认可的组织在收到报告以后，应即进行调查研究，以确定是否有必要进行第7、8、9条或第10条所要求的检验。
Translation: (c) When a vessel is involved in an incident or a defect is discovered, whether affecting the safety of the vessel or the effectiveness or integrity of its lifesaving appliances or other equipment, the master or owner of the vessel shall immediately report to the competent authority responsible for issuing the relevant certificates, the designated surveyor, or the recognized organization. Upon receipt of the report, the competent authority, designated surveyor, or recognized organization shall immediately conduct an investigation to determine whether it is necessary to carry out the inspections required by Articles 7, 8, 9, or 10.

Query_Text_cn: 如该船系在另一缔约国的港口内，船长或船东亦应立即向该港口国的有关当局报告。而指定的验船师或认可的组织则应弄清楚此项报告是否业已递交。
Translation: If the ship is located in a port of another Contracting State, the master or the shipowner shall also immediately report to the relevant authorities of that port State. The designated surveyor or recognized organization shall also ascertain whether such report has been submitted.

Query_Text_cn: (a)(ⅰ)客船经过初次检验或换证检验，符合第II-1、II-2、III、IV和V章的要求及本公约其他有关要求后，应发给客船安全证书。
Translation: (a)(i) After undergoing an initial or renewal survey and complying with the requirements of Chapters II-1, II-2, III, IV and V and other relevant requirements of this Convention, a passenger ship safety certificate shall be issued.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅱ)货船经过初次检验或换证检验，符合除有关消防安全系统和防火控制图以外的第II-1章和第II-2章中有关的要求以及本公约其他有关要求后，应发给货船构造安全证书②。
Translation: (ii) A cargo ship shall be issued with a Cargo Ship Safety Construction Certificate② provided that it has undergone initial or intermediate survey and complies with the relevant requirements of Chapters II-1 and II-2 of the present Convention except those relating to fire safety systems and fire control plans, as well as other relevant requirements of the present Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅲ)货船经过初次检验或换证检验，符合第II-1、II-2、III和V章的有关要求及本公约其他有关要求，应发给货船设备安全证书②。
Translation: (iii) Upon passing the initial or renewal survey, a cargo ship that complies with the relevant requirements of Chapters II-1,II-2,III and V and other relevant requirements of this Convention shall be issued with a Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate②.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅳ)货船经过初次检验或换证检验，符合第IV章的有关要求及本公约其他有关要求后，应发给货船无线电安全证书。
Translation: After passing the initial survey or intermediate survey and complying with the relevant requirements of Chapter IV and other relevant requirements of this Convention, a Cargo Ship Safety Radio Certificate shall be issued.

Query_Text_cn: (2)如货船安全证书用以取代货船构造安全证书、货船设备安全证书或货船无线电安全证书时，则无论何时，在本章涉及有关这些证书的事项时，亦应适用于货船安全证书。
Translation: When the Cargo Ship Safety Certificate is issued to replace the Cargo Ship Safety Construction Certificate, Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate or Cargo Ship Safety Radio Certificate, such Cargo Ship Safety Certificate shall apply to any matter referred to these certificates in this Chapter at any time.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅵ)(ⅰ)、(ⅲ)、(ⅳ)和(ⅴ)所述的客船安全证书、货船设备安全证书、货船无线电安全证书和货船安全证书均应备有一份设备记录。
Translation: The passenger ship safety certificate referred to in (ⅵ)(ⅰ), (ⅲ), (ⅳ) and (ⅴ), as well as the cargo ship equipment safety certificate, cargo ship radio safety certificate and cargo ship safety certificate, shall each have an equipment record.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅶ)对于根据和按照本公约的规定受到某项免除的船舶，除发给本条所述的证书以外，还应发给免除证书。
Translation: (ⅶ) For vessels granted an exemption in accordance with the provisions of this Convention, in addition to the certificate specified in this Article, an exemption certificate shall also be issued.

Query_Text_cn: 参见本组织A.791(19)决议《1969国际吨位丈量公约对现有船舶的应用》。
Translation: See Resolution A.791(19) of this Organization, *"Application of the 1969 International Tonnage Convention to Existing Ships"*.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见关于签发补录和附录的通函(PSLS.2/Circ.1)。
Translation: See Circular PSLS.2/Circ.1 on the issuance of supplementary records and appendices.

Query_Text_cn: (b)在缔约国政府对本公约的接受生效之日后，不应再根据和按照1960、1948或1929年国际海上人命安全公约的规定签发证书。
Translation: (b) No certificates shall be issued in accordance with and under the provisions of the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea, 1960, 1948 or 1929, after the date on which this Convention enters into force for the Contracting Government.

Query_Text_cn: 缔约国政府可应主管机关请求对船舶进行检验，如认为该船符合本公约的要求，应按照本公约规定发给或授权发给该船证书，或如适用，对船上证书进行签署或授权签署。
Translation: Contracting Governments may, at the request of the competent authority, carry out inspections of the ship. If the Contracting Government considers that the ship meets the requirements of this Convention, it shall issue or authorize the issue of the certificate to the ship in accordance with the provisions of this Convention, or, where applicable, endorse or authorize the endorsement of the certificate on board the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 如此签发的任何证书必须载明是受船旗国政府的委托而签发的。此证书与根据第12条所发的证书具有同等效力，并受同样的承认。
Translation: Any certificate issued in this manner must state that it is issued on behalf of the flag State government. Such certificates shall have equal validity with those issued pursuant to paragraph 12 and shall be subject to the same recognition.

Query_Text_cn: (a)签发客船安全证书的有效期限不应超过12个月。
Translation: (a) The validity period of passenger ship safety certificates shall not exceed 12 months.

Query_Text_cn: 签发货船构造安全证书、货船设备全证书和货船无线电安全证书的有效期限应由主管机关规定，但不得超过5年。
Translation: The validity period of the Cargo Ship Safety Construction Certificate, Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate, and Cargo Ship Safety Radio Certificate shall be determined by the competent authority, but shall not exceed five years.

Query_Text_cn: 免除证书的有效期限不应长于其有关证书的有效期限。
Translation: The validity period of the exemption certificate should not exceed that of the relevant certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (2)对货船，自换证检验完成之日起不超过5年的日期内有效。
Translation: For cargo ships, the certificate shall be valid for no more than five years from the date of completion of the certificate renewal survey.

Query_Text_cn: (c)除客船安全证书外，如果所发证书的有效期限少于5年，主管机关可延长证书的有效期自证书期满日至本条(a)规定的最长期限，条件是在签发5年期的证书时进行了第8、9和10条所述的相应的检验。
Translation: (c) Except for passenger ship safety certificates, the competent authority may extend the validity period of a certificate with a validity period of less than five years from the expiry date of the certificate to the maximum period specified in paragraph (a) of this regulation, provided that the corresponding surveys specified in Articles 8,9 and 10 were conducted when the five-year certificate was issued.

Query_Text_cn: (d)如果换证检验已完成，而新证书在现有证书期满之日前不能签发或不能存放在船上，主管机关授权的人员或组织可在现有证书上签署，签署后的证书自期满之日起不超过5个月的期限内应视为有效。
Translation: (d) If the revalidation survey has been completed but the new certificate cannot be issued or placed on board before the expiry date of the existing certificate, authorized personnel or organizations designated by the competent authority may endorse the existing certificate. The endorsed certificate shall be considered valid for a period not exceeding five months from the expiry date.

Query_Text_cn: (e)如果证书期满时船舶不在应进行检验的港口，主管机关可延长该证书的有效期，但此项展期仅以能使船舶完成其驶抵应进行检验的港口的航次为限，并且仅在正当和合理的情况下才能如此办理。
Translation: (e) If the certificate expires while the vessel is not at the port where the inspection is required, the competent authority may extend the validity of the certificate, but such extension shall only be granted to allow the vessel to complete the voyage to that port and shall only be permitted under just and reasonable circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 展期不得超过3个月。经展期的船舶在抵达应进行检验的港口后，不得因有此项展期而在未获得新证书前驶离该港口。
Translation: The extension shall not exceed three months. A vessel granted an extension shall not be permitted to depart the port where inspection is required prior to obtaining the new certificate due to the extension.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅱ)对货船，自现有证书展期前的期满日起不超过5年。
Translation: (ii) For cargo ships, the period from the expiry date of the existing certificate prior to its extension shall not exceed five years.

Query_Text_cn: (f)发给短程航行船舶的证书未按本条前述之规定展期，主管机关可给予自该证书期满之日起至多1个月的宽限期。
Translation: (f) Where a certificate issued to ships engaged in short international voyages has not been extended in accordance with the provisions of this paragraph, the competent authority may grant a grace period of up to one month from the expiry date of the certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (g)在特殊情况下(由主管机关确定)，新证书无需按(b)(ⅱ)、(e)或(f)的要求从现有证书期满日起计算日期。
Translation: (g) In special circumstances (determined by the competent authority), the new certificate shall not be required to comply with the requirements of (b)(ii), (e) or (f) in calculating the period from the expiry date of the existing certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅱ)对货船，自换证检验完成之日起不超过5年。
Translation: (ii) For cargo ships, the period shall not exceed five years from the date of completion of the certificate renewal survey.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅲ)若进行一次或多次相宜的年度检验、中间检验或定期检验，而使有关规则规定的检验最长间隔期不超过，该期满日可保持不变。
Translation: (iii) If one or more appropriate annual, intermediate, or periodic surveys are carried out such that the maximum interval between surveys prescribed by the relevant regulations is not exceeded, the expiry date may remain unchanged.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅲ)船舶变更船旗国时。
Translation: (iii) When a vessel changes its flag state.

Query_Text_cn: 只有当换发新证书的政府确认该船业已满足第11(a)及(b)条的要求时，才换发新证书。
Translation: The new certificate shall only be issued when the government issuing it has confirmed that the vessel has met the requirements of paragraphs 11(a) and (b).

Query_Text_cn: 如果变更船旗系在两个缔约国之间进行，则在变更船旗后的3个月内，前一个船旗国政府如接到申请，应尽快将变更船旗前该船所携证书的副本以及有关的检验报告(如备有时)，送交该船的新主管机关。
Translation: If the change of flag occurs between two Contracting States, the previous flag State's government shall, upon receipt of a request within three months following the change of flag, promptly forward copies of the certificates carried by the ship prior to the change of flag, as well as relevant inspection reports (if available), to the ship's new competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 各种证书和设备记录应按本公约附则的附录中给出的相应格式制定。
Translation: Various certificates and equipment records shall be prepared in accordance with the corresponding formats specified in the appendices to the Annex to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 如果使用的文字既非英文又非法文，则文本应包含其中一种文字的译本。
Translation: Hello, my name is Zhang San.

Query_Text_cn: 根据第12和13条签发的船上各种证书应随时可用，以供检查。
Translation: All certificates issued on board pursuant to Articles 12 and 13 shall be readily available for inspection.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应视为这种证书与由其本国政府所签发的证书同样有效。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall consider such certificates as valid as those issued by their own governments.

Query_Text_cn: (a)如船舶在某一特定航次中所载人数少于客船安全证书中所载的总数，从而按照本规则规定可配置少于证书中所载的救生艇和其他救生设备，本章第12条或第13条所指的政府、个人或组织可签发一份证书附件。
Translation: (a) Where the number of persons carried on a particular voyage of a ship is less than the total number specified in the passenger ship safety certificate, such that, in accordance with the provisions of this Code, fewer lifeboats and other lifesaving appliances than those specified in the certificate may be provided, the Government, person, or organization referred to in paragraph 12 or 13 of this Chapter may issue a certificate endorsement.

Query_Text_cn: (b)在此项附件上应载明在当时情况下并无违反本规则规定之处。
Translation: (b) This attachment shall state that there was no violation of the provisions of these Rules under the circumstances at that time.

Query_Text_cn: 上述附件应附于证书之后，并仅在救生设备方面代替该证书。
Translation: The annexes mentioned above should be appended after the certificate and may only substitute for the certificate in matters related to life-saving equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 这种附件仅对该特定航次有效。
Translation: Such attachments are valid only for the specific voyage.

Query_Text_cn: (a)每艘船舶当其在另一缔约国政府的港口时，应受该国政府正式授权官员的控制。这种控制的目的，仅在于查明该船根据第12条或第13条所签发的各种证书是否有效。
Translation: (a) Every ship when in the port of another Contracting State Government shall be subject to inspection by officials duly authorized by that Government. The purpose of such inspection shall be solely to ascertain whether the certificates issued under Article 12 or 13 in respect of the ship are valid.

Query_Text_cn: (b)除有明显理由确信该船或其设备的情况实质上与任一证书所载情况不符，或该船及其设备不符合第11(a)及(b)条的规定外，这些证书，如属有效，即应被承认。
Translation: (b) Unless there are clear grounds to believe that the condition of the ship or its equipment materially differs from that stated in any such certificate, or that the ship and its equipment do not comply with the provisions of Article 11(a) and (b), such certificates shall be recognized as valid if they are in force.

Query_Text_cn: (d)如因这种控制而引起任何干涉，执行控制的官员应将认为必须进行干涉的一切情况，立即书面通知船旗国的领事，或当领事不在时，则通知其最近的外交代表。
Translation: (d) If any interference arises from such control, the official executing the control shall immediately provide written notification to the consul of the flag State regarding all circumstances deemed necessary for the interference, or notify the nearest diplomatic representative when the consul is not present.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，还应通知负责发证的指定验船师或认可组织。
Translation: In addition, the designated surveyor or recognized organization authorized to issue the certificate should be notified.

Query_Text_cn: 有关干涉的事实应向本组织报告。
Translation: Facts pertaining to interference should be reported to this organization.

Query_Text_cn: (e)如未能按本条(c)及(d)的规定采取措施，或如已允许该船驶往下一停靠港时，港口国的有关当局应将所有有关该船的情况，除通知本条(d)所述有关方面外，还要通知下一停靠港当局。
Translation: (e) Where the relevant authorities of the port State fail to take measures in accordance with subparagraphs (c) and (d) of this paragraph, or where the ship is permitted to proceed to the next port of call, the port State's relevant authorities shall communicate all relevant information regarding the ship to the authorities of the next port of call in addition to notifying the parties referred to in subparagraph (d) of this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: (f)根据本条规定执行控制时，应尽一切努力避免对船舶作不当扣留或延误。
Translation: (f) In exercising control in accordance with this provision, every effort shall be made to avoid unwarranted detention or delay of the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 如船舶被不当扣留或延误，应有权对所受的任何损失或损害要求赔偿。
Translation: If a vessel is subject to unjustified detention or delay, it shall have the right to claim compensation for any loss or damage suffered.

Query_Text_cn: 任何船舶除持有相应的有效证书外，不可要求本公约所赋予的各项特权。
Translation: Any vessel shall not be entitled to claim the privileges granted by this Convention unless it holds the corresponding valid certificates.

Query_Text_cn: 参见本组织A.787(19)决议通过的，经A.882(21)决议修正的《港口国控制程序》。
Translation: Refer to the Port State Control Procedures adopted by Resolution A.787(19) of this Organization as amended by Resolution A.882(21).

Query_Text_cn: (a)各主管机关对其所属的受本公约规定约束的任何船舶所发生的任何事故，当其认为调查该项事故有助于确定本规则可能所需要的何种修改时，即应承担义务进行调查。
Translation: Each administrative authority shall bear the obligation to investigate any accident occurring on any vessel subject to the provisions of this Convention, provided that when they deem such an investigation would assist in determining the type of amendments potentially required to these Rules.

Query_Text_cn: (b)各缔约国政府有义务将有关此项调查所获得的适当资料提供给本组织。
Translation: (b) Contracting Governments are obligated to provide the Organization with appropriate information pertaining to this investigation.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织根据此项资料所作的报告或建议，一律不得泄露有关船舶的辨认特征或国籍，或以任何方式确定或暗示任何船舶或个人承担的责任。
Translation: This Organization shall not disclose any identifying characteristics or nationality of the vessel, nor determine or imply in any way the liability of any vessel or individual, in any reports or recommendations prepared based on this information.

Query_Text_cn: 经A.884(21)决议修正的A.849(20)决议：海难与事故调查规则。
Translation: Resolution A.849(20), as amended by Resolution A.884(21): Rules for the Investigation of Marine Casualties and Accidents.

Query_Text_cn: 还参见：MSC/Circ.953海安会通函：关于海难与事故的报告。
Translation: See also: MSC/Circ.953 – MSC Circular: Report on Marine Casualties and Accidents.

Query_Text_cn: 经修订的协调报告程序-SOLAS公约第I/21条和MARPOL73/78公约第8条和第12条所要求的报告。
Translation: The Revised Coordinated Reporting Procedure required by Article I/21 of the SOLAS Convention and Articles 8 and 12 of the MARPOL 73/78 Convention.

Query_Text_cn: (ⅷ)本条所述的各种证书均应由主管机关或主管机关授权的任何个人或组织签发或签署，但无论由谁签发或签署，主管机关都应对证书完全负责。
Translation: The certificates referred to in this provision shall be issued or signed by the competent authority or any individual or organization authorized by the competent authority. However, regardless of who issues or signs them, the competent authority shall bear full responsibility for the certificates.

Query_Text_cn: (c)在本条(b)所述情况下或当证书过期或失效时，执行控制的官员应采取措施，以保证该船在未具备对船舶或船上人员都无危险的条件前，不得开航出海或离港驶往适当的修船厂。
Translation: (c) In the circumstances referred to in paragraph (b) of this Article or when the certificate has expired or become invalid, the competent authorities shall take necessary measures to ensure that the vessel shall not sail or depart from port towards a suitable repair yard until such conditions are met that there is no danger to the vessel or its crew.

Query_Text_cn: 1本部分的要求适用于船长（Ls）超过100m的货船，但不包括表明是符合本组织制定的其他文件②中分舱和破损稳性规则的那些船舶。
Translation: The requirements of this Section apply to cargo ships with a length between perpendiculars (Ls) exceeding 100 meters, except for those vessels certified as complying with the compartmentation and damage stability rules specified in other publications② of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 本部分要求也适用于1998年7月1日或以后建造的船长（Ls）为80m及以上但不超过100m的货船。
Translation: The requirements of this section also apply to cargo ships constructed on or after 1 July 1998 with a length overall (Ls) of 80 meters or more but not exceeding 100 meters.

Query_Text_cn: 2下文提到的规则系指本部分所包含的整套规则。
Translation: 2. The rules referred to hereinafter mean the entire set of rules contained in this Section.

Query_Text_cn: 3对某一特定船舶或一组船舶，如果主管机关确信至少能达到与本规则同等的安全程度，可以接受变通的布置。
Translation: For a specific ship or group of ships, the competent authority may accept alternative arrangements if it is satisfied that such arrangements would achieve at least an equivalent level of safety to that required by this Code.

Query_Text_cn: 凡允许采取此类变通布置的任何主管机关均应将其详细情况通报本组织。
Translation: Any competent authorities that permit such flexible arrangements shall notify the Organization of the detailed circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 1.1分舱载重线系指用以确定船舶分舱的水线。
Translation: 1.1 Subdivision load line means the waterline used to determine the subdivision of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 1.2最深分舱载重线系指相应于核定的船舶夏季吃水的分舱载重线。
Translation: 1.2 The maximum subdivision load line means the subdivision load line corresponding to the certified summer draft of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 1.3部分载重线系指空船吃水加上空船吃水与最深分舱载重线之间差值的60%。
Translation: Partial load line refers to the light ship draft plus 60% of the difference between the light ship draft and the maximum subdivision load line.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1船舶分舱长度（Ls）系指船舶处于最深分舱载重线时限制垂向浸水范围的甲板及其以下部分最大投影型长度。
Translation: The ship's subdivision length (Ls) is defined as the maximum projected length of the deck that limits the vertical flooding range and the portions below it when the ship is at the maximum subdivision load line.

Query_Text_cn: ①在采用包含在B-1部分的规则时，海上安全委员会提请各主管机关注意，这些规则应与本组织A.684(17)决议通过的《关于SOLAS公约中对100m及以上货船的分舱和破损稳性规则的解释》一起使用，以确保应用的一致性。
Translation: When adopting the rules contained in section B-1, the Maritime Safety Committee draws the attention of the competent authorities to the need to use these rules in conjunction with the explanatory note for the subdivision and damage stability requirements for cargo ships of 100 meters in length and upwards, as adopted by Resolution A.684(17) of this Organization, to ensure consistency in application.

Query_Text_cn: 还参见MSC.76(69)决议《关于SOLAS公约中对100m及以上货船的分舱和破损稳性规则的解释的扩展应用（A.684(17)决议）》。
Translation: Also see Resolution MSC.76(69), entitled "Extended Application of the Interpretation of the Compartmentation and Damage Stability Regulations in SOLAS Convention for Cargo Ships of 100m and Above (Resolution A.684(17))".

Query_Text_cn: 6采用《1966载重线公约》第27条的破损稳性要求且同时符合A.320(IX)和A.514(13)决议的规定，但是对适用该公约第27(9)条的船舶而言，被认为有效的主水密横舱壁应按A.320(IX)决议中(12)(f)规定的间距设置。
Translation: Ships adopting the damage stability requirements of Article 27 of the 1966 Load Line Convention and simultaneously complying with the provisions of Resolutions A.320(IX) and A.514(13), however, for ships subject to paragraph 27(9) of the said Convention, the primary watertight transverse bulkheads considered valid shall be arranged in accordance with the spacing specified in paragraph (12)(f) of Resolution A.320(IX).

Query_Text_cn: 2.2船长中点系指船舶分舱长度的中点。
Translation: 2.2 The midship point is defined as the midpoint of the ship's compartmentalized length.

Query_Text_cn: 2.3后端点系指分舱长度的最后一点。
Translation: 2.3 The aft end point is defined as the final point of the compartment length.

Query_Text_cn: 2.4前端点系指分舱长度的最前一点。
Translation: 2.4 The forward reference point is the foremost point of the compartment length.

Query_Text_cn: 3船宽（B）系指在最深分舱载重线或其下的船舶最大型宽。
Translation: Beam (B) is defined as the maximum molded breadth of the ship at or below the deepest subdivision load line.

Query_Text_cn: 4吃水（d）系指在船长中点处从船型基线至所述水线间的垂直距离。
Translation: The draft (d) is defined as the vertical distance from the ship's baseline to the relevant waterline at the midship point.

Query_Text_cn: 5某一处所的渗透率（μ）系指该处所浸水容积与浸没容积之比。
Translation: The permeability (μ) of a space is defined as the ratio of the flooded volume to the submerged volume of that space.

Query_Text_cn: 1本规则旨在给船舶规定一个最低的分舱标准。
Translation: This rule is intended to prescribe a minimum standard of compartmentation for ships.

Query_Text_cn: 式中：R0为上述.1公式算出的R值。
Translation: In the equation, R0 is the value of R calculated using the preceding.1 formula.

Query_Text_cn: 1按本条计算所得的达到的分舱指数A应不小于按第25-3.2条计算所得的要求的分舱指数R。
Translation: The achieved compartment index A calculated in accordance with this clause should not be less than the required compartment index R calculated in accordance with Clause 25-3.2.

Query_Text_cn: si表示所考虑的舱或舱组浸水后生存概率，包括任何水平分隔的影响。
Translation: si represents the survival probability of the considered compartment(s) or compartment group(s) after flooding, including the effects of any horizontal divisions.

Query_Text_cn: 3在计算A时应采用水平纵倾。
Translation: When calculating A, the horizontal longitudinal adjustment should be adopted.

Query_Text_cn: 4该总和仅包括那些有助于增加达到的分舱指数A值的浸水情况。
Translation: The total includes only those flooding cases that contribute to increasing the attained compartmentation index A value.

Query_Text_cn: 5上述公式所表示的总和应计及整船长范围内单个舱或两个或更多相邻舱浸水的所有情况。
Translation: The sum represented by the above formula shall take into account all scenarios involving flooding of a single compartment or two or more adjacent compartments within the entire length of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，边舱或舱组和其相邻的内侧舱或舱组间同时浸水的所有情况也应加入总和，此时假定一矩形穿透扩展至船中心线但不包括中心线处舱壁的破损。
Translation: In addition, all cases where side compartments or compartment groups and their adjacent inner compartments or compartment groups are simultaneously flooded should be included in the total sum. At this time, it is assumed that a rectangular breach extends to the ship's centerline but excludes damage to the bulkhead at the centerline.

Query_Text_cn: 7破损的垂向范围假定为从基线向上扩展至水线以上或更高的任一水密水平分隔。
Translation: The vertical extent of Compartment 7 is assumed to extend upward from the baseline to and including any watertight horizontal bulkhead above the waterline or at a higher level.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果一个较小范围的破损会产生更为严重的后果，则须假定为该范围。
Translation: However, if a smaller scope of damage results in more severe consequences, it shall be deemed to be that scope.

Query_Text_cn: 8如在假定浸水舱范围内设有管子、管弄或隧道，其布置必须保证累进浸水不会扩展到那些假定浸水的舱室以外的其他舱室。
Translation: If there are pipes, ducts, or tunnels within the assumed flooded compartments, their arrangement must ensure that progressive flooding does not spread beyond those compartments to other compartments not assumed to be flooded.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果证实累进浸水的影响能被容易地控制并且不损害船舶的安全，则主管机关可允许较小的累进浸水。
Translation: However, if it is demonstrated that the effects of progressive flooding can be easily controlled and do not jeopardize the safety of the ship, the competent authority may permit smaller progressive flooding.

Query_Text_cn: 9在根据规则进行浸水计算时，只需假定船壳有一个破洞。
Translation: 9. When performing a flooding calculation according to the rules, it is only necessary to assume that the ship's hull has a single breach.

Query_Text_cn: 48最大无因次破损长度Jmax=Ls，但不大于0.24。
Translation: The maximum dimensionless damage length Jmax equals Ls, but not exceeding 0.24.

Query_Text_cn: 破损位置沿船长的假定分布密度a=1.2+0.8E，但不大于1.2。
Translation: The assumed distribution density of the damage position along the ship's length is a = 1.2 + 0.8E, but does not exceed 1.2.

Query_Text_cn: Fy2y12=-+其他情况。
Translation: Fy2y12 = -+ otherwise.

Query_Text_cn: 1.1.5在应用本条1.1.2、1.1.3和1.1.4公式时，当所考虑的舱室跨越“船长中点”时，这些公式的值应减去一个按公式求得的q值，在此公式中取y=J'/Jmax计算F2。
Translation: When applying the formulas in 1.1.2, 1.1.3, and 1.1.4, the values of these formulas shall be reduced by a q value calculated by the formula, where \( y = \frac{J'}{J_{\text{max}}} \) is used to compute \( F_2 \), when the compartment under consideration spans the "mid-length of the ship."

Query_Text_cn: 2若设有边舱，某一边舱的pi值应以按本条3得到的值乘以本条2.2表示内侧处所不浸水的概率的缩减因数r求得。
Translation: If a side compartment is provided, the pi value of such a compartment shall be determined by multiplying the value obtained in accordance with paragraph 3 of this clause by the reduction factor r representing the probability that the inner compartment does not flood as indicated in paragraph 2.2 of this clause.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1某一边舱和其相邻的内侧舱室同时浸水的情况，其pi值应以本条3各公式所得的值乘以因数（1-r）求得。
Translation: When a side compartment and its adjacent inner compartment are simultaneously flooded, the pi value shall be determined by multiplying the values obtained from the formulas specified in paragraph 3 of this clause by a factor of (1 - r).

Query_Text_cn: 当J＜0.2b/B时，缩减因数r应在J=0时的r=1，和J=0.2b/B时，r按上述公式所得值之间用线性内插法求得。
Translation: When J < 0.2b/B, the reduction factor r should be determined by linear interpolation between r=1 at J=0 and the value of r obtained from the above formula at J=0.2b/B.

Query_Text_cn: b计算因数pi所用的纵向限界之间的平均横向距离（m）。该距离在最深分舱载重线处由船壳板至通过纵舱壁最外部分并与其平行的平面之间向中心线垂直量计。
Translation: The average transverse distance (m) between the longitudinal boundaries used for calculating the factor pi. This distance is measured perpendicularly towards the ship’s centerline at the deepest subdivision load line from the shell plating to the plane parallel to the outermost parts of the transverse bulkheads.

Query_Text_cn: 3对几个舱作为一个舱的pi值，可直接应用本条1和2的公式计算。
Translation: The pi value for a compartment formed by combining several compartments from three pairs can be directly calculated using the formulas in clauses 1 and 2 of this article.

Query_Text_cn: pi=p23-p2-p3，等。
应按本条1和2对单个舱的公式计算，其无因次长度J取p的下标所标明的舱组的无因次长度。
Translation: The calculation should be performed using the formula for individual compartments as specified in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this clause, where the dimensionless length J shall take the dimensionless length of the compartment group indicated by the subscript of p.

Query_Text_cn: 3.2对三个或更多相邻舱室为一组的舱组，如果该舱组的无因次长度减去该舱组最前和最后舱室的无因次长度大于Jmax，则其因数pi等于零。
Translation: For a compartment group composed of three or more adjacent compartments, if the dimensionless length of the group minus the dimensionless lengths of its first and last compartments exceeds Jmax, its factor pi equals zero.

Query_Text_cn: range超出平衡角的正复原力臂的范围（°），但不大于20°；但是此范围应在不能被风雨密关闭的开口被淹没的角度处终止。
Translation: The range exceeding the angle of vanishing stability for the positive righting arm (°), but not exceeding 20°; however, this range should terminate at the angle where openings that cannot be风雨密关闭 are submerged.

Query_Text_cn: θe=最终横倾平衡角（°）。
Translation: θe = final equilibrium heel angle (°).

Query_Text_cn: 1.2如考虑下沉、横倾和纵倾后的最终水线浸没某些开口的下缘,且通过该开口可能发生累进浸水时，取s=0。
Translation: When considering sinkage, lateral inclination, and longitudinal inclination, if the final waterline submerges the lower edge of certain openings and progressive flooding through these openings is possible, then s is taken as 0.

Query_Text_cn: 这些开口应包括空气管、通风筒和用风雨密门或舱口盖关闭的开口，但可以不包括那些用水密人孔盖和平面舱盖，保持甲板高度完整性的小型水密舱口盖，遥控操作的水密滑动门，通常在海上关闭的水密完整的出入门和舱口盖，以及非打开型的舷窗关闭的开口。
Translation: These openings shall include air pipes, ventilators, and openings closed by watertight and weatherproof doors or hatch covers, excluding those closed by watertight manhole covers and flat hatch covers maintaining deck integrity, small watertight hatch covers, remotely operated watertight sliding doors, watertight entrance and exit doors and hatch covers with watertight integrity typically kept closed at sea, and openings closed by non-opening portlights.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，如果在计算中计及那些累进浸水的舱室，则本条的要求也应适用。
Translation: However, if in the calculation account is taken of those compartments that are progressively flooding, the requirements of this provision shall also apply.

Query_Text_cn: sp在部分载重线处的s因数。
Translation: The S factor of SP at certain load lines.

Query_Text_cn: 2对于防撞舱壁前面的所有舱室计算所得的s值应等于1，此时假定船舶位于最深分舱载重线并且不限制垂向破损范围。
Translation: The calculated s value for all compartments forward of the collision bulkhead shall be taken as 1 when the ship is assumed to be at the maximum subdivision load line and the vertical extent of damage is not restricted.

Query_Text_cn: 3.1对水平分隔以下的舱或舱组，其s值应以本条1.1所得的值乘以按本条3.3表示该水平分隔以上处所不浸水的概率的缩减因数v求得。
Translation: For compartments or groups of compartments located below a horizontal separation, their S value shall be determined by multiplying the value obtained in paragraph 1.1 of this clause by the reduction factor v, which represents the probability that the area above the horizontal separation remains unsaturated as specified in paragraph 3.3 of this clause.

Query_Text_cn: 3.2如果由于水平分隔以上处所同时浸水能使指数A增加一个正值，则该舱室或舱组的s值应由按本条3.1所得的值增加一个因同时浸水按本条1.1得到的s值乘以因数（1-v）求得的值。
Translation: If simultaneous flooding of spaces above horizontal divisions would cause the A index to increase by a positive value, the s value for such a compartment or group of compartments shall be determined by adding the product of the s value obtained under paragraph 1.1 for simultaneous flooding and the factor (1 - v) to the value obtained under paragraph 3.1 of this Section.

Query_Text_cn: 取其较小者。
Translation: Take the smaller one.

Query_Text_cn: 1应向船长提供必要的可靠资料，以使船长能在各种营运情况下通过迅速而简便的方法得到有关船舶稳性的准确指导。
Translation: The necessary reliable information shall be provided to the master so that he can obtain accurate guidance on ship stability through a rapid and straightforward method under all operational conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 3破损后维持稳性所必需的所有其他数据和辅助措施。
Translation: All other data and auxiliary measures necessary for maintaining stability after damage.

Query_Text_cn: 参见MCS/Circ.651通函《对SOLAS公约第II-1章B-1部分规则的解释》。
Translation: See MCS/Circ.651 Circular 'The Interpretation of the Rules of Chapter II-1, Part B-1 of the SOLAS Convention'.

Query_Text_cn: ②视何者导致较严重的后果而定。
Translation: Depending on which results in more severe consequences.

Query_Text_cn: 2为了指导高级船员，在驾驶室内应有固定显示的或随时可用的控制图，该图应清晰标明各层甲板及货舱的水密舱室的限界，限界上的开口及其关闭装置和控制位置，以及扶正由于浸水产生的横倾的装置。
Translation: To guide the senior crew, a permanently displayed or readily available control diagram shall be provided in the wheelhouse. This diagram shall clearly indicate the boundaries of water-tight compartments on each deck and in cargo holds, the openings in such boundaries with their closing devices and control positions, as well as the devices to correct the list caused by flooding.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，还应给船上高级船员提供包含上述资料的小册子。
Translation: Additionally, a booklet containing the aforementioned materials should be provided to the senior crew members on board the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 3为了提供本条1.1所指的资料，如果所用的极限GM（或KG）值从有关分舱指数的计算中求得，则此极限GM应在最深分舱载重线和部分载重线之间呈线性变化。
Translation: To provide the information referred to in Clause 1.1, if the limiting GM (or KG) value used is derived from the calculation of the relevant subdivision index, such limiting GM shall vary linearly between the deepest subdivision load line and the partial load line.

Query_Text_cn: ②在此情况下，如部分载重线吃水的最小GM值由分舱指数的计算求得，则此GM值应假定为在低于部分载重线的各较小吃水时的GM值，除非应用完整稳性的要求。
Translation: In such cases, if the minimum GM value for a partial load line draft is determined through the calculation of the compartment index, this GM value shall be considered as the GM value applicable to all smaller drafts lower than the assigned load line, unless the requirements for intact stability are applied.

Query_Text_cn: 1为适应船舶设计和船舶正常作业，水密分隔上的开口数量应保持最少。
Translation: To accommodate ship design and normal operations, the number of openings on watertight divisions should be kept to a minimum.

Query_Text_cn: 凡是为了出入、管路、通风、电缆等需要而穿过水密舱壁和内部甲板时，须设有保持水密完整性的装置。
Translation: When it is necessary to penetrate watertight bulkheads and internal decks for entry, piping, ventilation, electrical cabling, etc., devices must be provided to maintain watertight integrity.

Query_Text_cn: 如果表明任何累进浸水能易于控制并且不损害船舶安全，则主管机关可以允许放宽对干舷甲板以上的开口的水密性要求。
Translation: If it is demonstrated that progressive flooding can be easily controllable and does not compromise ship safety, the competent authority may permit relaxation of the water-tight integrity requirements for openings above the freeboard deck.

Query_Text_cn: 2为确保在海上使用的内部开口的水密完整性而设置的门须是滑动水密门，该门能从驾驶室遥控关闭，也能从舱壁的每一边就地操纵。
Translation: Doors provided to ensure the watertight integrity of internal openings used at sea shall be sliding watertight doors, which can be remotely closed from the bridge and also locally operated from each side of the bulkhead.

Query_Text_cn: 在控制位置应装设显示门是开启或关闭的指示器，并且在门关闭时发出声响报警。
Translation: An indicator shall be installed at the control location to indicate whether the door is open or closed, and an audible alarm shall be emitted when the door is closed.

Query_Text_cn: 在主动力失灵时，动力、控制和指示器应能工作。
Translation: When the primary power source fails, the power, control, and indicators should remain operational.

Query_Text_cn: 特别应注意减少控制系统失灵的影响。
Translation: Particular attention should be paid to reducing the impact of control system malfunctions.

Query_Text_cn: 每一个动力操纵的滑动水密门应有一个独立的手动机械操纵装置。
Translation: Each power-operated sliding watertight door shall have an independent manual mechanical operating device.

Query_Text_cn: 该装置应能从门的任一边用手开启和关闭该门。
Translation: The device shall be capable of being opened and closed by hand from either side of the door.

Query_Text_cn: 3用以保证内部开口的水密完整性且通常在航行时关闭的出入门和舱盖，应在该处和驾驶室装设显示这些门或舱盖是开启还是关闭的设施。
Translation: 3 Doors and hatches used to ensure watertight integrity of internal openings and normally closed during navigation shall be fitted with indicators at their locations and on the bridge to show whether such doors or hatches are open or closed.

Query_Text_cn: 每一个此类门或舱盖必须附贴一个通告牌，其大意是不能让它开着。
Translation: Each such door or hatch must be affixed with a notice indicating that it must not be left open.

Query_Text_cn: 这类门或舱盖的使用应经值班驾驶员批准。
Translation: The use of such doors or hatches shall be approved by the duty officer.

Query_Text_cn: 4可以装设结构良好的水密门或坡道用作大型货物处所的内部分隔，条件是主管机关确信此种门或坡道是必要的。
Translation: 4 may be fitted with structurally sound watertight doors or ramps to serve as internal partitioning for large cargo spaces, provided that the competent authority is satisfied that such doors or ramps are necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 这些门或坡道可以是绞链的，滚动的或滑动的门或坡道，但不应是遥控操纵的。
Translation: These doors or ramps may be hinged, rolling, or sliding doors or ramps, but shall not be remotely operated.

Query_Text_cn: ②此类门或坡道应在开航前关妥，并应在航行中保持关闭；此类门或坡道在港内开启的时间和船舶离港前关闭的时间应记入航海日志中。
Translation: Such doors or ramps shall be properly secured prior to departure and shall remain closed throughout the voyage; the time when such doors or ramps are opened in port and the time when they are closed before the vessel's departure shall be recorded in the ship's logbook.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在航程中需要通过任何此类门或坡道，则应设有适当装置以防未经授权的开启。
Translation: If any such doors or ramps are required for passage during the voyage, appropriate devices shall be provided to prevent unauthorized opening.

Query_Text_cn: 5为保证内部开口的水密完整性，在海上保持永久关闭的其他关闭装置，应有一个通告牌贴于其上，其大意是必须保持关闭。
Translation: All other closing devices that are to remain permanently closed at sea to maintain watertight integrity shall have a notice plate affixed to them stating that they must remain closed.

Query_Text_cn: 用螺栓紧固盖子的人孔不必设此通告牌。
Translation: Manholes with bolted covers do not require the installation of this notice.

Query_Text_cn: 参见MSC/Circ.919通函《破损控制图指南》。
Translation: Refer to MSC/Circ.919 Circular 'Guidance on Damage Control Plans'.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见MSC/Circ.651通函《对SOLAS公约第II-1章B-1部分规则的解释》。
Translation: ② See MSC/Circ.651 Circular 'Explanation of the Provisions of SOLAS Convention Chapter II-1, Part B-1'.

Query_Text_cn: 1所有通向在破损分析中假定为完整的且位于最终水线以下的舱室的外部开口，应要求水密。
Translation: All external openings leading to compartments assumed intact in damage stability analysis and located below the final waterline shall be watertight.

Query_Text_cn: 2根据本条1要求水密的外部开口应有足够的强度，除货舱盖外，在驾驶室应设有指示器。
Translation: External openings required to be watertight under paragraph 1 shall have sufficient strength. Except for hatch covers, an indicator shall be provided in the wheelhouse.

Query_Text_cn: 3在限制垂向破损范围的甲板以下的船壳外板上的开口，在海上应保持永久关闭。
Translation: 3. Openings in the hull shell plating below the deck limiting the vertical damage range shall remain permanently closed at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在航程中需要通过任何这类开口，则应设有适当装置以防未经受授权的开启。
Translation: If any such openings need to be passed through during the voyage, appropriate devices shall be provided to prevent unauthorized opening.

Query_Text_cn: 4尽管有本条3的要求，如为了船舶的操纵需要并且不损害船舶的安全，主管机关仍可授权船长根据需要打开某些特殊的门。
Translation: 4. Notwithstanding the requirements of paragraph 3 of this Article, the competent authority may still authorize the master to open certain special doors as necessary for the operational needs of the vessel, provided that such action does not compromise the safety of the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 5为保证外部开口的水密完整性，在海上保持永久关闭的其他关闭装置，应有一个通告牌贴于其上，其大意是必须保持关闭。
Translation: To ensure the watertight integrity of external openings, other closing devices that remain permanently closed at sea shall have a notice affixed to them stating that they must remain closed.

Query_Text_cn: 1机器、锅炉和其他受压容器、有关的管系和附件，其设计和构造应适合于它们的用途；并在充分考虑到运动部件、热表面和其他危险的情况下，其安装和保护应使其对船上人员伤害的危险性降至最低程度。
Translation: Machines, boilers, and other pressure vessels, along with their related piping systems and accessories, shall be designed and constructed to be suitable for their intended purposes; and their installation and safeguards shall minimize the risk of injury to persons on board, taking into full account moving parts, hot surfaces, and other hazards.

Query_Text_cn: 其设计应考虑到结构所用的材料、设备用途以及可能遇到的工作条件和船上环境条件。
Translation: Its design should take into account the materials used in the structure, the purpose of the equipment, as well as the operational conditions and onboard environmental conditions that may be encountered.

Query_Text_cn: 2主管机关应特别注意单个重要推进部件的可靠性；而且可以要求设有一个独立推进动力源，足以使船舶保持一个可航行速度，特别是在非常规布置的情况下。
Translation: The competent authorities shall pay particular attention to the reliability of individual critical propulsion components and may require the installation of an independent propulsion power source capable of maintaining a navigable speed for the vessel, especially in cases of non-conventional arrangements.

Query_Text_cn: 3应设有措施，在任一重要辅机不能工作时，使推进机械的正常运转能够维持或恢复。
Translation: 3 shall have measures in place to ensure that the normal operation of the propulsion machinery can be maintained or restored if any important auxiliary machinery fails.

Query_Text_cn: 10主推进装置（包括可调螺距螺旋桨）的液压、气动或电气的控制装置。
Translation: The hydraulic, pneumatic, or electrical control systems of the main propulsion system (including controllable pitch propellers).

Query_Text_cn: 但是，当主管机关对整体安全性作考虑后，可以接受将正常运行的推进能力作部分降低。
Translation: However, the competent authorities may accept a partial reduction of the normal operational propulsion capability after taking into account overall safety considerations.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见MSC/Circ.834通函《机舱的设置、设计和布置指南》。
Translation: ① See MSC/Circ.834, Guidelines for the Arrangement, Design, and Layout of the Engine Room.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见MSC/Circ.647通函《关于最大限度减少可燃液体系统泄漏的指南》，该通函经MSC/Circ.851通函《关于机舱燃油系统的指南》补充。
Translation: See also MSC/Circ.647 Circular '*Guidelines for Minimizing Leakage from Flammable Liquid Systems*', which has been supplemented by MSC/Circ.851 Circular '*Guidelines for Engine Room Fuel Systems*'.

Query_Text_cn: 4应设有措施保证在没有外来帮助的情况下能使机器从瘫船状态运转起来。
Translation: 4 shall have measures in place to ensure that without external assistance, the machinery can be brought back into operation from a dead ship condition.

Query_Text_cn: 5所有锅炉、机器的所有部件，所有蒸汽、液压、气动和其他系统，以及有关的承受内部压力的附件，在首次投入使用前，应经受包括压力试验在内的相应试验。
Translation: All components of boilers and machinery, all steam, hydraulic, pneumatic and other systems, as well as related accessories subject to internal pressure, shall undergo appropriate tests including pressure tests prior to their first operation.

Query_Text_cn: 6主推进装置和船舶推进与安全必需的所有辅机，均应设计成安装于船上后，在船舶正浮时以及向任一舷横倾至15°和向任一舷横摇至22.5°，并同时首或尾纵摇7.5°时能正常工作。
Translation: The main propulsion machinery and all auxiliary machinery necessary for propulsion and safety shall be designed to operate normally when installed on board, in an upright condition, heeled to 15° on either side, rolled to 22.5° on either side, and simultaneously trimmed to 7.5° forward or aft.

Query_Text_cn: 考虑到船舶的类型、尺度和营运条件，主管机关可允许偏离这些角度。
Translation: Taking into account the types, dimensions, and operational conditions of ships, the competent authority may permit deviations from these angles.

Query_Text_cn: 7应有便于对主推进装置和辅机，包括锅炉和受压容器，进行清洁、检查和维修保养的措施。
Translation: 7. There shall be measures to facilitate the cleaning, inspection, and maintenance of the main propulsion systems and auxiliary machinery, including boilers and pressure vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 8应特别注意推进装置系统的设计、构造和安装，以使在正常运转范围内机器的任何振动模态不会引起其过度的应力。
Translation: Particular attention should be paid to the design, construction, and installation of the propulsion system to ensure that any vibration modes of the machinery within the normal operating range do not cause excessive stresses.

Query_Text_cn: 9管系中的非金属膨胀接头如安装于贯穿船侧的管系中，且贯穿位置和非金属膨胀接头均位于最深载重线以下，则应作为按第I/10(a)条规定检验的一部分进行检查，并在必要时或按制造商建议的间隔期予以更换。
Translation: Non-metallic expansion joints installed in piping systems that penetrate the ship's side shall be included as part of the examination specified in Regulation I/10(a). They should be inspected, and replaced when necessary or at intervals recommended by the manufacturer, if both the penetration position and the non-metallic expansion joints are located below the lowest loaded waterline.

Query_Text_cn: 10操作和保养须知以及保证船舶机器和设备安全操作的图纸文件应用高级船员和船员明白的语言文字书写，以使其在执行自已的职责时能够看懂这些资料。
Translation: Operational and maintenance instructions, as well as diagrams and documents ensuring the safe operation of ship machinery and equipment, should be written in a language and script that can be understood by senior crew members and crew, so that they can comprehend these materials when performing their duties.

Query_Text_cn: 11用于燃油舱、沉淀柜及润滑油舱的透气管的安装和布置应使透气管在破损时不会直接导致海水或雨水溅入。
Translation: The installation and arrangement of vent pipes for fuel tanks, settling tanks, and lubricating oil tanks shall be such that in the event of damage, seawater or rainwater will not be directly admitted into the tanks.

Query_Text_cn: 每艘新建船舶应对推进及主系统必需的每一种燃油配备两个燃油柜或等效布置，其容量必须至少能供船舶推进装置在最大持续功率下，以及发电机装置在海上正常负荷下工作8h。
Translation: Every new ship shall be provided with two fuel oil tanks or equivalent arrangements for each type of fuel required for propulsion and main systems, whose combined capacity must be sufficient to enable the propulsion machinery to operate at maximum continuous rating (MCR) and the generating set(s) at normal sea service loads for a period of 8 hours.

Query_Text_cn: ①本节规定只适用于1998年7月1日或以后建造的船舶。
Translation: The provisions of this Section apply only to ships constructed on or after July 1, 1998.

Query_Text_cn: 1当机器存在超速的危险时，应有措施以保证不超过安全速度。
Translation: When there is a risk of overspeeding in the machine, measures should be in place to ensure that the speed does not exceed the maximum safe speed.

Query_Text_cn: 2当主机或辅机（包括受压容器或这类机器的任何部件）经受内部压力并可能受到危险的超压时，应有措施切实防止这种过度的压力。
Translation: When prime movers or auxiliary machinery (including pressure vessels or any parts of such machinery), when subjected to internal pressure and possibly exposed to dangerous overpressure, there shall be measures to effectively prevent such excessive pressure.

Query_Text_cn: 3对船舶推进、船舶安全或船上人员安全必要的机器，其动力传递用的所有齿轮装置和每根轴与每个联轴器的设计和构造应能承受一切运行情况下可能产生的最大工作应力，并应适当考虑到驱动它们的或由它们作为组成部分的机器的型式。
Translation: The design and construction of all gear assemblies for power transmission, every shaft, and each coupling related to ship propulsion, ship safety, or the safety of personnel on board shall be capable of withstanding the maximum working stresses that may arise under all operating conditions, taking into account the type of the driving machinery or the machinery of which they form part.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见SOLAS公约第II-2/4.2条“燃油、润滑油和其他易燃油类的布置”。
Translation: See SOLAS Convention Chapter II-2, Regulation 4.2 "Arrangements for Fuel Oil, Lubricating Oil, and Other Combustible Oils".

Query_Text_cn: 4缸径为200mm或曲柄箱容积为0.6m3及以上的内燃机，应设有适当型式和足够释压面积的曲柄箱防爆安全阀。
Translation: Four-cylinder internal combustion engines with a bore of 200 mm or a crankcase capacity of 0.6 m³ or above shall be equipped with a crankcase explosion-proof safety valve of appropriate type and sufficient relief area.

Query_Text_cn: 安全阀的布置或提供的措施，应保证阀排出的气体对人员伤害的可能性降至最低程度。
Translation: The arrangement of safety valves or the measures provided shall ensure that the possibility of injury to personnel from the gas discharged by the valve is minimized to the lowest extent possible.

Query_Text_cn: 5主涡轮推进机械和（如适用时）主内燃推进机械及辅机，应设有发生诸如滑油供应故障等可能导致机器的迅速破坏、严重损伤或爆炸的故障时能自动停车的装置。
Translation: Main turbine propulsion machinery and, where applicable, main internal combustion propulsion machinery and their auxiliaries shall be provided with devices that can automatically stop the machinery in the event of failures such as lubricating oil supply failure which may lead to rapid destruction, serious damage, or explosion of the machinery.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关可允许采用自动停车装置的越控装置。
Translation: The competent authorities may permit the use of an override device for automatic parking systems.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶应具有足够的后退动力，以保证在所有正常情况下均能控制船舶。
Translation: 1 Vessels shall have sufficient astern propulsion to ensure control of the vessel under all normal circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 2对机器在足够的时间内使推进器换向，并在合理的距离内使船舶从最大营运前进航速到停止的能力应进行验证并记录。
Translation: The ability to reverse the propeller within sufficient time and to bring the ship from maximum operational ahead speed to a stop within a reasonable distance shall be verified and documented.

Query_Text_cn: 3对航行试验记录的停船时间、船首航向和距离，连同多螺旋桨船舶在一个或几个螺旋桨不工作的情况下所进行的航行和操纵以测定其能力的试验结果应备于船上供船长或指定的人员随时可用。
Translation: The records of navigation tests, including stopping time and distance, bow heading and distance, along with the test results of navigation and maneuvering conducted on multi-propeller vessels with one or more propellers non-operational to determine their capabilities, shall be kept on board and readily available for the master or designated personnel at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 4如船舶设有操纵或停船的补充措施，则应按本条2和3的要求，对这些措施的有效性进行验证并记录。
Translation: Where a vessel is equipped with supplementary measures for maneuvering or stopping, the effectiveness of such measures shall be verified and documented in accordance with the requirements of paragraphs 2 and 3 of this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 1除另有明文规定外，每艘船舶应配备使主管机关满意的主操舵装置和辅助操舵装置。
Translation: Except as otherwise expressly provided, every ship shall be provided with main steering gear and auxiliary steering gear satisfactory to the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 主操舵装置和辅助操舵装置的布置应使两者中之一在发生故障时，不会导致另一装置不能工作。
Translation: The arrangement of the main steering gear and auxiliary steering gear should be such that the failure of one does not impair the functioning of the other.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1所有操舵装置的部件和舵杆应为主管机关满意的坚固和可靠的构造。
Translation: 2.1 All components of the steering gear and the rudder stock shall be of a construction strong and reliable approved by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 对于非双套的必要部件的适用性应特别注意。
Translation: Particular attention should be paid to the applicability of non-dual-set essential components.

Query_Text_cn: 任何这类必要部件，如合适时，应采用耐磨轴承，如球轴承、滚子轴承或者能持久润滑或设有润滑装置的套筒轴承。
Translation: Any such necessary components should adopt wear-resistant bearings, such as ball bearings, roller bearings, or bushings with long-lasting lubrication or equipped with lubrication devices, where appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: 2.2对于承受内部液压的管系和其他操舵装置的部件，确定其尺寸计算所用的设计压力应至少为本条3.2所指运行状况下可能出现的最大工作压力的1.25倍，同时应考虑在该系统低压一侧可能存在的压力。
Translation: For pipework and other components of steering gear subjected to internal hydraulic pressure, the design pressure used for dimensioning calculations shall be determined to be at least 1.25 times the maximum working pressure that may occur under the operational conditions specified in paragraph 3.2 of this Section, and shall also take into account any potential pressures that may exist on the low-pressure side of the system.

Query_Text_cn: 根据主管机关的意见，管系和部件的设计应采用疲劳衡准，同时考虑动力负荷所产生的脉动压力。
Translation: In accordance with the requirements of the competent authority, the design of piping systems and components shall adopt fatigue criteria while taking into account the pulsating pressures generated by dynamic loads.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见《关于操纵资料在船上存放和显示的建议》(A.601(15)决议)、《船舶操纵性标准》(MSC.137(76)决议)和《船舶操纵性标准的解释性说明》(MSC/Circ.1053通函)。
Translation: See the Recommendation on the Storage and Display of Maneuvering Data on Board (Resolution A.601(15)), the Ship Maneuverability Standards (Resolution MSC.137(76)), and the Explanatory Notes on Ship Maneuverability Standards (Circular MSC/Circ.1053).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见A.415(XI)决议《关于改进的客货船操舵装置标准》和A.416(XI)决议《关于现有液货船操舵装置的检查》。
Translation: See resolution A.415(XI), 'Amended Standards for Steering Gear of Passenger and Cargo Ships', and resolution A.416(XI), 'Inspection of Steering Gear of Existing Liquid Cargo Ships'.

Query_Text_cn: 2.3凡在液压系统中能被隔断的和由于动力源或外力作用能产生压力的任何部件，应设置安全阀。
Translation: 2.3 Any component in a hydraulic system that can be isolated and is capable of generating pressure due to the power source or external force shall be equipped with a safety valve.

Query_Text_cn: 安全阀的调定应不超过设计压力。
Translation: The set pressure of safety valves shall not exceed the design pressure.

Query_Text_cn: 安全阀应有足够尺寸并布置成能够避免过度升高的压力超过设计压力。
Translation: Safety valves shall be of sufficient size and arranged in such a manner as to prevent overpressure from exceeding the design pressure.

Query_Text_cn: 4设计成在最大后退航速时不致损坏；但是这个设计要求不需要用最大后退航速和最大舵角的试航来验证。
Translation: The design shall be such that it will not be damaged at maximum astern speed; however, this design requirement does not require verification through sea trials involving both maximum astern speed and maximum rudder angle.

Query_Text_cn: 3动力操纵，以必要时满足本条4.2的要求，以及在任何情况下主管机关要求舵柄处舵杆直径超过230mm时（不包括冰区加强）的要求。
Translation: Power-operated steering to meet the requirements of Clause 4.2 when necessary, and as required by the competent authority in any case where the diameter of the steering gear tiller at the tiller handle exceeds 230 mm (excluding ice-class reinforcement).

Query_Text_cn: 2能从驾驶室某一位置投入工作。
Translation: System 2 can be activated from a specific location within the cab.

Query_Text_cn: 操舵装置的任何一台动力设备失电时，应在驾驶室里发出听觉和视觉报警。
Translation: When any power unit of the steering gear loses power supply, an audible and visual alarm shall be activated in the wheelhouse.

Query_Text_cn: 3主操舵装置布置成当其管系或1台动力设备发生单项故障时，此故障能被隔离，使操舵能力能够保持或迅速恢复。
Translation: The main steering gear is arranged such that when a single failure occurs in its piping system or one power unit, the fault can be isolated, maintaining or rapidly restoring steering capability.

Query_Text_cn: 6.2直至1986年9月1日止，主管机关可以接受设置经证实具有可靠性记录但不符合本条6.1.3对液压系统要求的操舵装置。
Translation: Until September 1, 1986, the competent authority may accept steering gear which have been demonstrated to have a reliable record but do not comply with the requirements for hydraulic systems specified in paragraph 6.1.3 of this clause.

Query_Text_cn: 6.3非液压型式的操舵装置应达到等效的标准，并使主管机关满意。
Translation: 6.3 Non-hydraulic steering gear shall meet equivalent standards and be satisfactory to the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 但不必设置两套操舵手轮或操舵手柄。
Translation: However, there is no need to install two sets of steering wheels or steering levers.

Query_Text_cn: 3对于位于舵机舱的辅助操舵装置，如系动力操纵，也应能在驾驶室进行操作，并应独立于主操舵装置的控制系统。
Translation: For the auxiliary steering gear located in the steering gear compartment, if powered, it should also be operable from the bridge and should be independent of the control system of the main steering gear.

Query_Text_cn: 5应仅对操舵装置控制供电线路设有短路保护。
Translation: Clause 5 shall only be equipped with short-circuit protection for the control power circuits of the steering gear.

Query_Text_cn: 9本条和第30条要求的电力线路和操舵装置系统以及相关的部件、电缆和管子应在它们的整个长度范围内尽可能地分离。
Translation: The power circuits and steering gear systems, together with their associated components, cables, and pipes, shall be arranged as separated as possible throughout their entire lengths in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 9 and paragraph 30.

Query_Text_cn: 10驾驶室与舵机舱之间应设有通信设施。
Translation: 10. Communication facilities shall be provided between the bridge and the engine room.

Query_Text_cn: 1当主操舵装置系动力操纵时，在驾驶室显示。
Translation: When the main steering gear is power-operated, its operation shall be indicated in the navigating bridge.

Query_Text_cn: 2能在舵机舱内辨认出来。
Translation: 2 can be identified within the steering gear compartment.

Query_Text_cn: 2每个液体贮存器设低位警报器，以便确切和尽早地指示液体泄漏。
Translation: Each liquid storage tank is equipped with a low-level alarm so as to accurately and promptly detect liquid leaks.

Query_Text_cn: 3当主操舵装置要求动力操纵时，设置一个固定储存柜，其容量足以至少为一个动力执行系统(包括贮存器)进行再充液。
Translation: When the main steering gear requires power operation,a fixed storage cabinet shall be provided,its capacity sufficient to replenish at least one power-operated system (including the reservoir) with hydraulic fluid.

Query_Text_cn: 储存柜应用管系固定联结以使能从舵机舱内容易地再次为液压系统充液，并应设有液位指示器。
Translation: The reservoir shall be connected via a fixed piping system to enable easy recharging of the hydraulic system from within the steering gear compartment and shall be fitted with a level indicator.

Query_Text_cn: 2有适当的布置以保证有到达操舵装置和控制器的工作通道。
Translation: Item 2 is appropriately arranged to ensure working access to the steering gear and controllers.

Query_Text_cn: 这些布置应包括扶手栏杆和格子板或其他防滑地板以保证液体泄漏时有适宜的工作条件。
Translation: These arrangements should include handrails,gratings,or other non-slip flooring to ensure suitable working conditions in the event of liquid leaks.

Query_Text_cn: 14如果要求舵柄处舵杆直径超过230mm（不包括冰区加强），应设有由应急电源或位于舵机舱内的独立动力源在45s内自动供电的替代动力源，其容量至少满足供应符合本条4.2要求的操舵装置动力设备及其有关的控制系统和舵角指示器。
Translation: If the diameter of the steering gear tiller exceeds 230 mm (excluding ice-strengthening), an alternative power source shall be provided, which is supplied automatically within 45 seconds by the emergency source or an independent power source located in the steering gear compartment. Its capacity shall be sufficient to supply the power equipment of the steering gear complying with the requirements of paragraph 4.2 of this Section, along with its associated control systems and rudder angle indicators.

Query_Text_cn: 此独立动力源应只用于上述目的。
Translation: This independent power source shall be used solely for the aforementioned purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 每艘10,000总吨及以上的船舶，替代动力源应具有至少连续运转30min的能力，在任何其他船舶上则至少为10min。
Translation: For any ship of 10,000 gross tons and above, the alternative power source shall have the capacity to operate continuously for at least 30 minutes, while any other ship shall require at least 10 minutes.

Query_Text_cn: 1510,000总吨及以上的每艘油船、化学品船或气体运输船和70,000总吨及以上的每艘其他船舶，主操舵装置应由符合本条6规定的两台或两台以上相同的动力设备组成。
Translation: For oil tankers, chemical tankers, or gas carriers of 151,000 gross tonnage and above, and other ships of 70,000 gross tonnage and above, the main steering gear shall be composed of two or more identical power units complying with the provisions of paragraph 6 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 2.2至少两个相同的动力执行系统，在正常运转中同时工作时，应能满足本条3.2的要求。
Translation: 2.2 At least two identical power actuation systems shall meet the requirements of paragraph 3.2 of this clause when operating normally and simultaneously.

Query_Text_cn: 当需要符合此要求时，液压动力执行系统应设有交叉联结。
Translation: When it is necessary to meet this requirement, the hydraulic power actuation system shall be equipped with cross connections.

Query_Text_cn: 一个系统中液体的流失应能发现，有缺陷的系统应能自动隔离，以使另一个或几个执行系统能保持全面运转。
Translation: The leakage of fluid in a system should be detectable, defective systems should be capable of automatic isolation, to ensure that another or multiple execution systems can maintain full operation.

Query_Text_cn: 3非液压型式的操舵装置应能达到等效标准。
Translation: 3 Non-hydraulic steering gear shall meet equivalent standards.

Query_Text_cn: 2如果操舵装置只包括单个舵执行器，则应特别注意在设计中对所使用的材料、密封装置的安装、试验检查和有效维护的要求进行包括疲劳分析和断裂力学分析（如适用）在内的应力分析。
Translation: If the steering gear includes only a single steering actuator, particular attention shall be paid in the design to the requirements for materials used, installation of sealing devices, testing inspections, and effective maintenance, including stress analysis with fatigue analysis and fracture mechanics analysis (where applicable).

Query_Text_cn: 在考虑上述情况时，主管机关应采用包括本组织通过的《10,000总吨及以上但小于100,000载重吨的油船、化学品船和气体运输船非双套舵执行器验收指南》的各项规定。
Translation: When considering the aforementioned circumstances, the competent authorities shall incorporate the provisions including those of the *Acceptance Guidelines for Non-Duplicated Rudder Actuators Applicable to Oil Tankers, Chemical Tankers, and Gas Carriers with a Gross Tonnage of 10,000 or Above but Less Than 100,000 Deadweight Tons* adopted by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 18对于10,000总吨及以上但小于70,000载重吨的油船、化学品船或气体运输船，至1986年9月1日止，主管机关可接受具有可靠性记录但不符合本条16中对液压系统要求的单项故障衡准的操舵装置系统。
Translation: For oil tankers, chemical tankers, or gas carriers of 10,000 gross tonnage and above but less than 70,000 deadweight tons, until September 1, 1986, the competent authority may accept steering gear systems that have a record of reliability but do not meet the single failure criterion for hydraulic systems as specified in paragraph 16 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 2应设有两个独立操舵装置控制系统，每个系统均能从驾驶室操作。
Translation: 2 shall be equipped with two independent steering gear control systems, each of which can be operated from the bridge.

Query_Text_cn: 4每个操舵装置控制系统，如系电动者，应由操舵装置电力线路设独立电路供电，或从向操舵装置电力线路供电的电路板上邻近该电力线路处的一点直接供电。
Translation: Each steering gear control system, if electric, shall be supplied by an independent circuit from the steering gear electrical circuit or directly from a point on the circuit board supplying that electrical circuit near the circuit itself.

Query_Text_cn: 20除本条19的要求外，1984年9月1日以前建造的40,000总吨及以上的每艘油船、化学品船或气体运输船，其操舵装置应在不迟于1988年9月1日布置成当管系或其中1台动力设备发生单项故障时，能够保持操舵能力，或舵的运动能加以限制，以使操舵能力迅速重新获得。
Translation: Except for the requirements of paragraph 19 of this regulation, each oil tanker, chemical tanker or gas carrier of 40,000 gross tons and above constructed before 1 September 1984 shall have its steering gear arranged by no later than 9 September 1988 so that steering capability can be maintained, or the movement of the rudder limited, in the event of a single failure in the piping system or one of the power units, to enable steering capability to be rapidly regained.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织通过的A.467(XII)决议。
Translation: This organization’s Resolution A.467(XII).

Query_Text_cn: 3如各液压动力系统是交叉联结的，则应作适当布置以保证一个系统中液体的流失能被发现，有缺陷的系统能自动地或从驾驶室加以隔离，以使其他系统能保持全面运转。
Translation: If the hydraulic power systems are cross-linked, they should be properly arranged to ensure that leakage of fluid in one system can be detected, defective systems can be automatically isolated or isolated from the cab, so that other systems can remain fully operational.

Query_Text_cn: 1对于电动和电动液压操舵装置，应在驾驶室和适当的主机控制位置装设指示其电动机正在运转的设备。
Translation: For electric and electro-hydraulic steering gear, devices indicating that the motors are in operation shall be installed on the bridge and appropriate main engine control positions.

Query_Text_cn: 2由1台或几台动力设备组成的每一电动或电动液压操舵装置至少应由两个自主配电板直接供电的专用电路来供电；但是，其中之一可以由应急配电板供电。
Translation: Each electric or electro-hydraulic steering gear composed of one or more power units shall be supplied by at least two dedicated circuits directly powered by independent distribution boards; however, one of them may be powered by the emergency distribution board.

Query_Text_cn: 与电动或电动液压主操舵装置相联系的电动或电动液压辅助操舵装置可与向此主操舵装置供电的电路之一连接。
Translation: An electric or electro-hydraulic auxiliary steering gear associated with the main steering gear may be connected to one of the circuits supplying power to the main steering gear.

Query_Text_cn: 向电动或电动液压操舵装置供电的电路应有足够容量，以便能同时向与它连接且可能需要同时工作的所有电动机供电。
Translation: The circuits supplying power to electric or electro-hydraulic steering gear shall have sufficient capacity to supply all connected motors that may need to operate simultaneously.

Query_Text_cn: 3这类电路和电动机应设有短路保护和过载报警装置。
Translation: 3. Such circuits and motors shall be equipped with short-circuit protection and overload alarm devices.

Query_Text_cn: 包括起动电流在内的过电流保护装置（如有时），应不小于所保护电路或电动机全负荷电流的两倍，并应布置成能允许适当的起动电流通过。
Translation: Overcurrent protective devices, including starting current (if provided), shall be not less than twice the full-load current of the circuits or motors being protected and shall be arranged to allow an appropriate starting current to pass.

Query_Text_cn: 如采用三相供电，应设有能指示任一相所发生故障的报警装置。
Translation: If three-phase power supply is adopted, an alarm device capable of indicating a fault in any phase shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 本节所要求的警报应为听觉和视觉报警，并应位于正常控制主机的主机处所或控制室内明显位置上，并应符合第51条适用的要求。
Translation: The alarms required by this section shall be audible and visual alarms and shall be located at conspicuous positions in the machinery spaces or control rooms housing the normal control station, and shall comply with the applicable requirements of paragraph 51.

Query_Text_cn: 4在小于1,600总吨的船上，按第29.4.3条要求为动力操作的辅助操舵装置，如不是电动的或是由原来用作其他用途的电动机来驱动的，则主操舵装置可由来自主配电板的一个电路供电。
Translation: On board ships of less than 1,600 gross tonnage, the main steering gear may be supplied from a single circuit from the main distribution board if the auxiliary steering gear required under paragraph 29.4.3 to be power-operated is not electrically driven or driven by an electric motor originally used for other purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 当这类原来用作其他用途的电动机作为这种辅助舵装置的动力时，如主管机关对其保护装置表示满意，并认为其满足适用于辅助操舵装置的第29.5.1条和29.5.2条以及第29.7.3条的要求时，可免除本条3的要求。
Translation: When such motors originally intended for other purposes are used as the power source for this auxiliary steering gear, they may be exempted from the requirements of paragraph 3 of this regulation if the Administration is satisfied with its protective devices and considers that they meet the requirements of regulations 29.5.1, 29.5.2 and 29.7.3 applicable to auxiliary steering gear.

Query_Text_cn: 1对船舶推进和安全所必需的主机和辅机应设有有效的操作和控制装置。
Translation: The main machinery and auxiliary machinery necessary for propulsion and safety shall be provided with effective operating and control devices.

Query_Text_cn: 2对每一独立的螺旋桨，应由一个控制装置进行遥控，该控制装置的设计和制造应使其在运行时无需对机器的操作细节予以特别注意。
Translation: For each independent propeller, there shall be a control device for remote control, the design and manufacture of which shall ensure that no special attention needs to be paid to the operational details of the machinery during its operation.

Query_Text_cn: 5推进机械在同一个时间内仅能由一处进行遥控；在这些处所可允许有互相连接的控制位置。
Translation: 5 Propulsion machinery may only be remotely controlled from one location at any given time; interconnected control stations may be permitted at these locations.

Query_Text_cn: 1除另有明文规定者外，本章应适用于1998年7月1日或以后安放龙骨或处于类似建造阶段的船舶。
Translation: 1. Except as otherwise provided, this Chapter shall apply to vessels laid down or at a similar stage of construction on or after 1 July 1998.

Query_Text_cn: 2该船业已开始的装配量至少为50t，或为全部结构材料估算重量的1%，取较小者。
Translation: The assembly work already commenced for the vessel shall be at least 50 tons or 1% of the estimated total weight of all structural materials, whichever is smaller.

Query_Text_cn: 3无论何时建造的货船，一经改装为客船后，从开始改装之日应视作客船。
Translation: 3 Any cargo ship, regardless of when constructed, once converted into a passenger ship, shall be deemed to be a passenger ship as of the date the conversion begins.

Query_Text_cn: 2确保当此类船舶更换救生设备或装置，或当此类船舶进行涉及到更换或增设其现有救生设备或装置的重大修理、改装或改建时，这些救生设备和装置在合理可行的情况下满足本章要求。
Translation: When such ships replace their life-saving appliances and arrangements, or when such ships undergo major repairs, modifications, or reconstructions involving the replacement or addition of their existing life-saving appliances and arrangements, these life-saving appliances and arrangements shall meet the requirements of this Chapter to the greatest extent practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果更换的只是除气胀式救生筏外的救生艇筏而不更换其降落设备，或是相反，则救生艇筏或降落设备可与被更换者是相同类型的。
Translation: However, if the replacement concerns lifeboats or liferafts (excluding inflatable liferafts) without replacing their launching appliances, or vice versa, the lifeboats/liferafts or launching appliances may be of the same type as the replaced equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 1主管机关如考虑到航程的遮蔽性及其条件认为实施本章的某些要求为不合理或不必要时，对在航程中距最近陆地不超过20nmile的个别船舶或某些类型的船舶，可免除这些要求。
Translation: If the competent authority considers that implementing certain requirements of this Chapter would be unreasonable or unnecessary due to the sheltered nature of the voyage and its conditions, it may exempt individual ships or certain types of ships operating in a voyage where the distance from the nearest land does not exceed 20nmile.

Query_Text_cn: 2《1973年特种业务客船舱室要求议定书》所附的规则。
Translation: Article 2 of the Rules annexed to the 1973 Protocol on Special Trade Passenger Ship Cabins.

Query_Text_cn: 1抗暴露服系指设计成供救助艇艇员和海上撤离系统人员使用的保护服。
Translation: An anti-exposure suit means a garment designed for crew members of rescue boats and personnel of marine evacuation systems.

Query_Text_cn: 2持证人员系指持有主管机关按照现行的《国际海员培训、发证和值班标准公约》要求，授权签发的或承认有效的精通救生艇筏业务证书的人员；或持有非该公约缔约国的主管机关为公约证书同一目的而签发或承认的证书的人员。
Translation: Qualified personnel means those who hold certificates of proficiency in survival craft and rescue boat operations issued in accordance with the authorization or recognized as valid by the competent authority under the current International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers (STCW Convention); or those who hold certificates issued or recognized by the competent authorities of non-Contracting Parties to the Convention for the same purpose as the Convention certificates.

Query_Text_cn: 3探测系指幸存者或救生艇筏位置的测定。
Translation: 3. Detection refers to the determination of the location of survivors or lifeboats/life rafts.

Query_Text_cn: 4登乘梯系指设置在救生艇筏登乘站以供安全登入降落下水后的救生艇筏的梯子。
Translation: An embarkation ladder refers to a ladder located at the embarkation station for lifeboats and life rafts, used for safely embarking onto the lifeboats and life rafts after they have been lowered into the water.

Query_Text_cn: 5自由漂浮下水系指救生艇筏从下沉中的船舶自动脱开并立即可用的降落方法。
Translation: A free-fall launching system refers to a method of deploying lifeboats and rafts that automatically disengage from a sinking vessel and are immediately operational.

Query_Text_cn: 6自由降落下水系指载足全部乘员和属具的救生艇筏在船上脱开并在没有任何制约装置的情况下，任其下降到海面的降落方法。
Translation: A free-fall launching system refers to the method where lifeboats or life rafts, fully loaded with occupants and equipment, are disengaged from the vessel and allowed to descend freely to the water surface without any restraining devices.

Query_Text_cn: 7救生服系指减少在冷水中穿着该服人员体热损失的保护服。
Translation: 7. Immersion suit means a protective suit that reduces the heat loss of personnel when worn in cold water.

Query_Text_cn: 8气胀式设备系指依靠非刚性的充气室作浮力，而且在准备使用前通常保持不充气状态的设备。
Translation: Inflatable equipment refers to equipment that relies on non-rigid inflatable chambers to provide buoyancy and typically remains uninflated prior to being prepared for use.

Query_Text_cn: 9充气式设备系指依靠非刚性的充气室作浮力，而且一直保持充气备用状态的设备。
Translation: Inflatable equipment refers to devices that rely on non-rigid air chambers as their buoyancy source and remain inflated in a standby state at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 10国际救生设备（LSA）规则（本章内称“规则”）系指本组织海上安全委员会MSC.48(66)决议通过的，可由本组织修正的《国际救生设备（LSA）规则》，但这种修正案的通过、生效和实施应按本公约第VIII条有关适用于除第I章外的附则的修正程序的规定进行。
Translation: The International Life-Saving Appliances (LSA) Rules (referred to in this Chapter as the "Rules") mean the International Life-Saving Appliances (LSA) Rules adopted by resolution MSC.48(66) of the Organization's Marine Safety Committee, which may be amended by the Organization. However, the adoption, entry into force, and implementation of such amendments shall be conducted in accordance with the amendment procedures provided in Article VIII of this Convention regarding amendments applicable to Annexes other than Chapter I.

Query_Text_cn: 11降落设备或装置系指将救生艇筏或救助艇从其存放位置安全地转移到水上的设施。
Translation: A launching appliance or device means the facilities for safely transferring lifeboats, liferafts, or rescue boats from their stowage positions to the water.

Query_Text_cn: 12长度系指量自龙骨上面的最小型深85%处水线总长的96%，或沿该水线从首柱前缘量至舵杆中心线的长度，取较大者。
Translation: The length of 12 is defined as the greater of 96% of the total length at the waterline at 85% of the minimum molded depth above the keel or the length measured along that waterline from the forward edge of the stem post to the centerline of the rudder stock.

Query_Text_cn: 对设计为具有倾斜龙骨的船舶，其计量长度的水线应与设计水线平行。
Translation: For vessels designed with an inclined keel, the waterline of the measured length shall be parallel to the design waterline.

Query_Text_cn: 13最轻载航行状态系指船舶处于平浮、无货，备品和燃料有10%剩余量的装载状态；对客船而言，船舶处于载足全额乘客和船员及其行李的装载状态。
Translation: The lightest navigational condition refers to the loading state where the vessel is evenly floating, without cargo, and retains 10% of stores and fuel remaining; for passenger ships, it refers to the loading state where the vessel carries the full complement of passengers and crew along with their luggage.

Query_Text_cn: 14海上撤离系统系指将人员从船舶的登乘甲板迅速转移到漂浮的救生艇筏上的设备。
Translation: Maritime Evacuation System refers to the equipment used to rapidly transfer personnel from the boarding deck of a vessel to floating lifeboats and rafts.

Query_Text_cn: 1型深系指从龙骨上面量到在船舷处的干舷甲板横梁上面的垂直距离。
Translation: Type 1 depth is defined as the vertical distance measured from the upper side of the keel to the upper side of the beam at the freeboard deck at the ship's side.

Query_Text_cn: 对木质船舶和混合结构船舶，此垂直距离从龙骨槽口的下缘量起。
Translation: For wooden and composite vessels, the vertical distance is measured from the lower edge of the keel slot.

Query_Text_cn: 如船舶中横剖面的下部具有凹形，或如装有厚龙骨翼板，此垂直距离从船底平坦部分向内延伸线与龙骨侧面相交之点量起。
Translation: If the lower part of the midship section is concave, or if thick keel wing plates are fitted, the vertical distance shall be measured from the point where the inward extension line of the flat bottom portion intersects with the side of the keel.

Query_Text_cn: 2具有圆弧形舷边的船舶，型深应量至甲板型线和船舶外板型线相交之点，这些线的延伸是把该舷边看作是设计为角形的。
Translation: The molded depth for a vessel with a rounded gunwale shall be measured to the intersection point of the deck profile line and the shell plate profile line, with their extensions considered as if the gunwale were designed with an angular shape.

Query_Text_cn: 3凡干舷甲板为阶梯形并且其升高部分延伸到超过决定型深的点时，型深应量至甲板较低部分与升高部分平行的延伸线。
Translation: When the freeboard deck is stepped and its raised portion extends beyond the point determining the molded depth, the molded depth shall be measured to the parallel extension line of the lower portion of the deck and the raised portion.

Query_Text_cn: 16新颖救生设备或装置系指具有本章或规则之规定未全部包括的新型特征，但达到等效的或更高的安全标准的救生设备或装置。
Translation: 16 Novel life-saving appliances or devices mean those possessing novel features not fully encompassed by the provisions of this Chapter or the Rules, but meeting equivalent or higher safety standards.

Query_Text_cn: 17正稳性系指艇筏在移去一横倾力矩后回复到其初始位置的能力。
Translation: 17. Positive stability refers to the ability of a lifeboat or raft to return to its initial position after a lateral heeling moment is removed.

Query_Text_cn: 18救助艇的回收时间系指该艇被提升至某一位置，而使艇上人员可从该处登上大船甲板所需的时间。
Translation: The recovery time of a rescue boat refers to the time required to hoist the boat to a position where its occupants can board the ship's deck.

Query_Text_cn: 回收时间包括在救助艇上做的回收准备工作所需的时间，诸如抛投和系住首缆，连接救助艇与降落设备，以及提升救助艇的时间。
Translation: The recovery time includes the duration required for preparations on the rescue boat, such as launching and securing the bow line, connecting the rescue boat to the lowering gear, and hoisting the rescue boat.

Query_Text_cn: 回收时间不包括把降落设备降低至回收救助艇的位置所需要的时间。
Translation: The recovery time does not include the time required to lower the lowering equipment to the position for retrieving the rescue boat.

Query_Text_cn: 19救助艇系指为救助遇险人员及集结救生艇筏而设计的艇。
Translation: 19. Rescue boat means a boat designed for the purpose of rescuing persons in distress and assembling lifeboats and liferafts.

Query_Text_cn: 20拯救系指安全寻回幸存者。
Translation: 20 Rescue refers to the safe retrieval of survivors.

Query_Text_cn: 21客滚船系指具有第II-2/3条定义的滚装装货处所或特种处所的客船。
Translation: The Ro-Pax ship means a passenger ship equipped with roll-on/roll-off cargo spaces or special spaces as defined in Section II-2/3.

Query_Text_cn: 22短程国际航行系指在航行中，船舶距离能够安全安置乘客和船员的港口或地点不超过200nmile的国际航行。
Translation: A short international voyage refers to an international voyage where the vessel's distance from a port or place where passengers and crew can be safely embarked and disembarked does not exceed 200 nautical miles during the voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 启航国最后停靠港至最终目的港之间距离与返航航程均应不超过600nmile。
Translation: The distance from the last port of call in the flag state to the final destination port and the return voyage shall not exceed 600 nautical miles.

Query_Text_cn: 最终目的港系指船舶开始返航回到启航国前的计划航次中的最后停靠港。
Translation: The Final Port of Discharge shall mean the last port of call in the planned voyage prior to the commencement of the return voyage to the country of departure.

Query_Text_cn: 23救生艇筏系指从弃船时起能维持遇险人员生命的艇筏。
Translation: Lifeboats and liferafts mean craft capable of sustaining the lives of endangered personnel from the time of abandoning ship.
