Query_Text_cn: 24保温用具系指采用低导热率的防水材料制成的袋子或衣服。
Translation: 24. Insulated equipment means bags or garments made from waterproof materials with low thermal conductivity.

Query_Text_cn: 1除按照本条5和6的规定外，本章所规定的救生设备和装置应经主管机关认可。
Translation: Except as provided for in paragraphs 5 and 6 of this Article, the life-saving appliances and apparatus specified in this Chapter shall be approved by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 2业已成功地经受的试验实质上等效于该项建议所规定的试验，并使主管机关满意。
Translation: The tests that have successfully been undergone are substantially equivalent to those specified in the proposed recommendation and satisfy the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 2业已成功地经受实质上等效于该项建议的鉴定和试验，并使主管机关满意。
Translation: 2 has successfully undergone testing and inspection substantially equivalent to the proposal and has satisfied the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 4主管机关所采用的认可程序还应包括继续认可或撤消认可的条件。
Translation: The accreditation procedures adopted by the competent authorities shall also include the conditions for the continuation or revocation of accreditation.

Query_Text_cn: 5在接受主管机关原先未予认可的救生设备和装置之前，主管机管应确信该救生设备和装置符合本章和规则的要求。
Translation: Before accepting life-saving appliances and apparatus not previously recognized by the competent authority, the authority shall be satisfied that such life-saving appliances and apparatus meet the requirements of this Chapter and the Rules.

Query_Text_cn: 6本章所要求的救生设备，如其详细的技术规定未列入规则，应使主管机关满意。
Translation: The life-saving appliances required by this Chapter, where their detailed technical specifications are not included in the Rules, shall be acceptable to the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关应要求救生设备必经必要的生产试验，以确保救生设备是按已认可的原型设备的同一标准进行制造。
Translation: Competent authorities shall require life-saving appliances to undergo necessary production trials to ensure that they are manufactured in accordance with the same standards as the type-approved prototype appliances.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织A.689(17)决议通过的《关于救生设备试验的建议案》。
Translation: ① See the recommendations embodied in the Organization's Resolution A.689(17) regarding "Guidelines for Testing of Life-saving Appliances".

Query_Text_cn: 对1999年7月1日或以后安装在船上的救生设备，参见海上安全委员会MSC.81(70)决议通过的《经修订的关于救生设备试验的建议案》。
Translation: For lifesaving equipment installed on board ships on or after 1 July 1999, refer to the revised Recommendation on Testing of Lifesaving Equipment adopted in MSC.81(70) resolution of the Maritime Safety Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 参见本组织A.520(13)决议通过的《原型新颖救生设备和装置的鉴定、试验及验收实施规则》。
Translation: See the Implementation Rules for the Assessment,Testing and Acceptance of Novel Prototype Life-saving Equipment and Devices adopted under Resolution A.520(13) of this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 1本条2适用于所有客船和300总吨及以上的所有货船。
Translation: This Article applies to all passenger ships and all cargo ships of 300 gross tons and above.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1.1每艘客船和每艘500总吨及以上的货船，应至少配备3台双向甚高频（VHF）无线电话设备。
Translation: 2.1.1 Each passenger ship and each cargo ship of 500 gross tons and above shall be provided with at least three two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatus (VHF).

Query_Text_cn: 每艘300总吨及以上，但小于500总吨的货船，应至少配备2台双向VHF无线电话设备。
Translation: Each cargo ship of 300 gross tons and above but less than 500 gross tons shall be provided with at least two two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatus.

Query_Text_cn: 该设备所符合的性能标准应不低于本组织通过的性能标准①。
Translation: The performance standards complied with by the device shall not be lower than those adopted by this organization①.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在救生艇筏上装有固定式双向VHF无线电话设备，其所符合的性能标准也应不低于本组织通过的性能标准①。
Translation: If the lifeboat or liferaft is equipped with fixed two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatus, the performance standards it complies with should also not be lower than those adopted by this Organization①.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1.21992年2月1日以前在船上配备的，且不完全符合本组织通过的性能标准的双向VHF无线电话设备，只要主管机关确信它们同经认可的双向VHF无线电话设备相容，在1999年2月1日前仍可被主管机关接受。
Translation: 2.1.21Two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatus installed on board ships before February 1, 1992, that do not fully comply with the performance standards adopted by the Organization may continue to be accepted by the competent authority until February 1, 1999, provided that the competent authority is satisfied that they are compatible with recognized two-way VHF radiotelephone apparatus.

Query_Text_cn: 每艘客船和每艘500总吨及以上的货船，每舷应至少配有1台雷达应答器。
Translation: Each passenger ship and each cargo ship of 500 gross tons and above shall be provided with at least one radar transponder on each side.

Query_Text_cn: 每艘300总吨及以上，但小于500总吨的货船应至少配有1台雷达应答器。
Translation: Each cargo ship of 300 gross tons and above but less than 500 gross tons shall be provided with at least one radar transponder.

Query_Text_cn: 该雷达应答器所符合的性能标准应不低于本组织通过的性能标准②。
Translation: The performance standards complied with by the radar transponder shall not be lower than those adopted by the Organization②.

Query_Text_cn: 雷达应答器③应存放在能迅速放入任何救生艇筏的位置处（第31.1.4条要求的救生筏除外）。
Translation: Radar Transponder ③ shall be stowed in a location from which it can be quickly placed into any lifeboat or liferaft, except for liferafts required by paragraph 31.1.4.

Query_Text_cn: 或者，应在每一救生艇筏上存放1台雷达应答器（第31.1.4条要求的救生艇筏除外）。
Translation: Alternatively, a radar transponder shall be stowed on each lifeboat or liferaft (except those required by paragraph 31.1.4).

Query_Text_cn: 在至少配有2台雷达应答器以及配备自由降落救生艇的船上，其中的一台雷达应答器应存放在一艘自由降落救生艇内，另一台存放在紧邻驾驶室之处，以便能在船上使用，并能便于转移至任一其他救生艇筏上。
Translation: On board ships equipped with at least two radar transponders and free-fall lifeboats, one radar transponder shall be stowed in a free-fall lifeboat and the other located near the bridge so that it can be used on board and easily transferred to any other lifeboat or life raft.

Query_Text_cn: 应配备不少于12支符合规则3.1要求的火箭降落伞火焰信号，并应存放在驾驶室或其附近。
Translation: The vessel shall be provided with not less than 12 rocket parachute flares in compliance with Regulation 3.1, and shall be stowed in the wheelhouse or its vicinity.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织A.809(19)决议通过的，可能经修正的《救生艇筏双向甚高频（VHF）无线电话设备性能标准》附件1或附件2的适用者。
Translation: the applicable Annex 1 or Annex 2 of the Performance Standards for Two-way VHF Radiotelephone Apparatus for Survival Craft, as adopted by resolution A.809(19) of this Organization and as may be amended.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织A.802(19)决议通过的，可能经修正的《供搜救作业使用的救生艇筏雷达应答器性能标准》。
Translation: See the *Performance Standards for Radar Transponders for Lifeboats and Liferafts Used in Search and Rescue Operations*, as adopted by resolution A.802(19) of this Organization and as may be amended.

Query_Text_cn: ③这些雷达应答器其中之一可以是第IV/7.1.3条所要求的雷达应答器。
Translation: ③ One of these radar transponders may be the radar transponder required by paragraph 7.1.3 of Chapter IV.

Query_Text_cn: 4.1应配备1套固定式或手提式设备构成的或由这两种型式构成的应急设施，供船上应急控制站、集合站和登乘站及要害位置之间的双向通信联系使用。
Translation: Emergency facilities shall be equipped with one set of fixed or portable equipment or a combination of both types for the purpose of two-way communication between emergency control stations, assembly stations, embarkation stations, and critical locations on board.

Query_Text_cn: 4.2应配备符合规则7.2.1要求的通用应急报警系统，以供召集乘客与船员至集合站和采取应变部署表所列行动之用。
Translation: 4.2 A general emergency alarm system shall be provided in compliance with the requirements of Rule 7.2.1 for the purpose of assembling passengers and crew at the assembly stations and taking the actions listed in the muster list.

Query_Text_cn: 该系统应以符合规则7.2.2要求的公共广播系统或其他适宜的通信设施作为补充。
Translation: The system shall be supplemented by a public broadcast system complying with the requirements of Rule 7.2.2 or other suitable communication facilities.

Query_Text_cn: 当通用应急报警系统启动时，娱乐声响系统应自动关闭。
Translation: When the general emergency alarm system is activated, the entertainment sound system shall automatically shut down.

Query_Text_cn: 4.3客船通用应急报警系统应在所有开敞甲板上都能听到。
Translation: 4.3 The General Emergency Alarm System on passenger ships shall be audible on all open decks.

Query_Text_cn: 4.4配备海上撤离系统的船舶应确保登乘站和平台或救生艇筏之间的通信联络。
Translation: 4.4 Vessels equipped with marine evacuation systems shall ensure communication links between embarkation stations and platforms or lifeboats/life rafts.

Query_Text_cn: 5.1除第II-2/40.5①或II-2/41-2条①（视何者适用）及本条4.2的要求外，所有客船还应设置一套公共广播系统。
Translation: All passenger ships shall be provided with a public address system, except for the requirements of Chapter II-2/Regulation 40.5, paragraph ①, or Chapter II-2/Regulation 41.2, paragraph ① (whichever is applicable), and the requirements of paragraph 4.2 of this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 对于1997年7月1日以前建造的客船，除5.5的规定外，5.2和5.4的要求应在不迟于1997年7月1日以后第一次定期检验的日期适用。
Translation: For passenger ships constructed before July 1, 1997, the requirements of paragraphs 5.2 and 5.4 shall apply not later than the date of the first periodic survey after July 1, 1997, except as specified in paragraph 5.5.

Query_Text_cn: 5.2公共广播系统应按规则7.2.2.1所述，在所有处所内都高于环境噪声，并能清晰地听到。该系统还应配备一个可从驾驶室的某一位置以及主管机关认为必需的船上的其他位置进行控制的越控功能，以便当有关处所内的任一扩音器已被关闭，其音量已被关小或公共广播系统供作他用时，也能广播所有的紧急信息。
Translation: The public address system shall comply with the requirements of Rule 7.2.2.1, ensuring that its volume exceeds ambient noise levels and is clearly audible in all spaces. The system shall also be equipped with an override function controllable from a position within the wheelhouse and other locations on board deemed necessary by the competent authority. This function shall enable broadcasting of all emergency information even when any loudspeaker in the relevant space has been switched off, its volume reduced, or the public address system is in use for other purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 2公共广播系统及其性能标准应经主管机关考虑了本组织所通过的建议案②后予以认可。
Translation: 2 The public broadcasting system and its performance standards shall be recognized by the competent authority after taking into account Recommendation ② adopted by this organization.

Query_Text_cn: 5.4公共广播系统应与第II-1/42.2.2条要求的应急电源相连接。
Translation: The public address system shall be connected to the emergency power supply required by Article II-1/42.2.2.

Query_Text_cn: 5.5对1997年7月1日以前建造的船舶，如已设有经主管机关认可的且确实符合5.2、5.4和规则7.2.2.1所要求的公共广播系统，则不要求改变该系统。
Translation: For ships constructed before 1 July 1997, if they have been installed with a public address system recognized by the competent authority and which indeed complies with the requirements of paragraphs 5.2,5.4 and Regulation 7.2.2.1, such a system shall not be required to be altered.

Query_Text_cn: ①此处系指2002年7月1日前实施的第II-2章，同等规定见经修正的第II-2章第12.3条。
Translation: ① Hereinafter refers to Chapter II-2 as implemented prior to July 1, 2002. Equivalent provisions are set forth in Regulation 12.3 of the amended Chapter II-2.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见海安会通函MSC/Circ.808《关于客船公共广播系统,包括其布线的性能标准建议案》。
Translation: See MSC/Circ.808, MSC Circular: 'Recommendation on Performance Standards for Public Address Systems on Passenger Ships, Including Their Wiring'.

Query_Text_cn: 2其存放应能随时迅速取下，不应以任何方式永久系牢。
Translation: Its placement should allow for quick removal at any time and should not be permanently secured in any manner.

Query_Text_cn: 1.2船舶每舷至少有1个救生圈应设有符合规则2.1.4要求的可浮救生索，其长度不少于其存放处在最轻载航行水线以上高度的2倍，或30m，取较大者。
Translation: Each side of the ship shall have at least one lifebuoy equipped with a floating lifeline complying with the requirements of Regulation 2.1.4, the length of which shall be not less than twice the height from its stowage position to the waterline at the lightest loaded condition, or 30 meters, whichever is greater.

Query_Text_cn: 设有自亮灯的和设有自亮灯及自发烟雾信号的救生圈，应均等地分布在船舶两舷，这类救生圈不应是按本条1.2要求的装有救生索的救生圈。
Translation: Lifebuoys equipped with self-igniting lights and those equipped with both self-igniting lights and self-activating smoke signals shall be evenly distributed along both sides of the ship. Such lifebuoys shall not be the type fitted with a life line as required by paragraph 1.2 of this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 1.4每个救生圈应以粗体罗马大写字母标明其所属船舶的船名和船籍港。
Translation: 1.4 Each lifebuoy shall be marked with the ship's name and port of registry in bold Roman uppercase letters.

Query_Text_cn: 2配备足够数量的救生衣，以供值班人员使用，并供设置在远处的救生艇筏站使用。
Translation: 2 Ensure the provision of a sufficient number of lifejackets for use by duty personnel and for use at lifeboat/raft stations located at a distance.

Query_Text_cn: 供值班人员使用的救生衣应存放在驾驶室、机舱控制室和任何其他有人值班的地方。
Translation: Lifejackets for use by on-duty personnel shall be stored in the bridge, engine room control room, and any other location where personnel are on duty.

Query_Text_cn: 2.2救生衣应放在容易到达之处，其位置应予明显标示。
Translation: 2.2 Life jackets shall be stored in easily accessible locations and their positions shall be clearly marked.

Query_Text_cn: 凡由于船舶的特殊布置，而使按本条2.1要求配备的救生衣可能无法拿到时，可制定使主管机关满意的变通措施，其中可包括增加救生衣的配备数量。
Translation: When, due to the special arrangement of the ship, the lifejackets required by paragraph 2.1 of this Regulation may not be readily accessible, alternative arrangements satisfactory to the competent authority may be established, which may include increasing the number of lifejackets carried.

Query_Text_cn: 2.3除自由降落救生艇外，用于全封闭救生艇上的救生衣应不妨碍人员进入救生艇或在艇内就座，包括系好安全带。
Translation: Except for free-fall lifeboats, lifejackets intended for fully enclosed lifeboats shall not hinder personnel in boarding the lifeboat or seating in the boat, including securing the seatbelts.

Query_Text_cn: 2.4为自由降落救生艇选用的救生衣及其存放和穿着方式应不妨碍人员进入救生艇、乘员安全或该艇的操作。
Translation: The lifejackets selected for the free-fall lifeboat and their storage and wearing methods shall not impede access to the lifeboat, crew safety, or the operation of the lifeboat.

Query_Text_cn: 应为每个被指派为救助艇员或海上撤离系统工作人员的人分别配备1件合身的、符合规则2.3要求的救生服或符合规则2.4要求的抗暴露服。
Translation: Each person assigned as a member of a manned lifeboat crew or marine evacuation system personnel shall be provided with one properly fitting life-saving suit complying with the requirements of Rule 2.3 or an anti-exposure suit complying with the requirements of Rule 2.4.

Query_Text_cn: 如果船舶一直在主管机关认为无需热保护的温暖气候①区域航行，则不必配备该保护服。
Translation: If the vessel operates continuously in warm climatic zones① which the competent authority determines do not require thermal protection, it may not be required to be equipped with such protective clothing.

Query_Text_cn: 1本条适用于所有船舶。
Translation: 1. This provision applies to all vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 2应为船上每个人员配备1份在紧急情况下必须遵循的明确的须知。
Translation: 2. Each person on board must be provided with one clear set of instructions that must be followed in emergency situations.

Query_Text_cn: 如为客船，这些须知应使用船旗国要求的一种或数种语言以及英语写成。
Translation: If the vessel is a passenger ship, these notices should be written in one or more languages required by the flag state and English.

Query_Text_cn: 3符合第37条要求的应变部署表和应变须知应展示在全船各个显著之处，包括驾驶室、机舱和各船员起居处所。
Translation: The muster list and emergency instructions in compliance with paragraph 37 shall be posted in all conspicuous locations on board, including the bridge, engine room, and all crew accommodations.

Query_Text_cn: 3救生衣的穿着方法。
Translation: 3. Method of wearing a life jacket.

Query_Text_cn: 3使用符合本组织建议案的符号。
Translation: 3. Use symbols consistent with the recommendations of this organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2船上应有足够数量受过培训的人员来召集和协助未受培训的人员。
Translation: 2. Ships should have a sufficient number of trained personnel on board to assemble and assist the untrained personnel.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见海安会通函MSC/Circ.1046《热保护评定指南》。
Translation: Refer to MSC/Circ.1046, *Guidelines for Thermal Protection Evaluation*.

Query_Text_cn: 参见本组织A.760(18)决议通过的,经MSC.82(70)决议修正的《与救生设备和装置有关的符号》。
Translation: See the Symbols Related to Life-saving Appliances and Apparatus adopted by Resolution A.760(18) and amended by Resolution MSC.82(70).

Query_Text_cn: 3船上应有足够数量的船员（他们可以是驾驶员或持证人员）来操作船上全体人员弃船所需要的救生艇筏及其降落装置。
Translation: The ship shall have a sufficient number of crew members (who can be deck officers or certificated personnel) to operate the lifeboats and liferafts, together with their embarkation facilities and lowering appliances, required for the abandonment of all persons on board.

Query_Text_cn: 4每艘要使用的救生艇筏，均应设置1名驾驶员或持证人员负责指挥。
Translation: 4 Each lifeboat or life raft intended for use shall be provided with one officer or certificated person in charge of command.

Query_Text_cn: 但主管机关经适当考虑到航程的性质、船上人数和船舶的特点后，可以准许精通救生筏操纵和操作的人员来代替具有上述资格的人员负责指挥救生筏。
Translation: The competent authority may permit persons proficient in the handling and operation of life rafts to assume responsibility for commanding the life raft in place of persons with the qualifications mentioned above, provided that due consideration has been given to the nature of the voyage,the number of persons on board,and the characteristics of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 如为救生艇，还应指派1名副指挥。
Translation: If it is a lifeboat, one deputy commander should also be appointed.

Query_Text_cn: 5救生艇筏负责人应有1份该救生艇筏船员名单，并应确保在其指挥下的船员是熟悉他们的各项任务的。
Translation: 5. The person in charge of each lifeboat/raft shall have a list of the crew members assigned to that lifeboat/raft and shall ensure that the crew members under their command are familiar with their respective duties.

Query_Text_cn: 救生艇的副指挥亦应有1份该救生艇船员名单。
Translation: The deputy commander of the lifeboat should also have one copy of the crew list for that lifeboat.

Query_Text_cn: 6应为每艘机动救生艇筏指派1名能操作发动机和进行小调整的人。
Translation: 6. Each motorized life raft shall be assigned one person capable of operating the engine and making minor adjustments.

Query_Text_cn: 7船长应确保本条2、3和4所指人员妥善地分配到本船救生艇筏中。
Translation: The Master shall ensure that the personnel referred to in paragraphs 2, 3, and 4 of this article are properly assigned to the lifeboats and life rafts of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 1须有认可的降落设备的救生艇和救生筏，应存放在尽可能靠近起居处所和服务处所的地方。
Translation: Lifeboats and life rafts equipped with recognized lowering appliances shall be stowed as close as possible to the living quarters and service areas.

Query_Text_cn: 2集合站应设在紧靠登乘站的地方。
Translation: Station 2 shall be located adjacent to the boarding station.

Query_Text_cn: 每个集合站应在甲板上有足够的无障碍场所，以容纳指定在该站集合的所有人员，但人均占面积至少为0.35m2。
Translation: Each assembly station shall have sufficient accessible area on the deck to accommodate all personnel designated to assemble at that station, with a minimum area of at least 0.35 m² per person.

Query_Text_cn: 3集合站与登乘站均应设在容易从起居处所和工作区域到达的地方。
Translation: Muster stations and embarkation stations shall be located in places easily accessible from living quarters and work areas.

Query_Text_cn: 4集合站与登乘站应根据情况，由第II-1/42或II-1/43条所要求的应急电源照明系统提供足够的照明。
Translation: The assembly stations and embarkation stations shall be provided with sufficient lighting as appropriate, by the emergency lighting system required by Regulation II-1/42 or II-1/43.

Query_Text_cn: 5通往集合站与登乘站的通道、梯道和出口应予照明。
Translation: 5 The passageways, stairways, and exits leading to the assembly and boarding stations shall be illuminated.

Query_Text_cn: 该照明系统应能根据情况由第II-1/42或II-1/43条所要求的应急电源供电。
Translation: The lighting system shall be powered by the emergency power supply as required by Article II-1/42 or II-1/43, as applicable.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，并且作为第II-2/28.1.10条①要求的标志的一部分，通往集合站的路线应按本组织为此用途而提出的建议案用集合站的符号标明。
Translation: Additionally, as part of the mark required by Regulation II-2/28.1.10①, the route to assembly stations shall be indicated with assembly station symbols in accordance with the recommendations proposed by the Organization for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 6吊艇架降落和自由降落的救生艇筏集合站与登乘站的布置，应能使担架病人抬进救生艇筏。
Translation: The arrangement of muster stations and embarkation stations for lifeboats and life rafts rigged by davit and free-fall shall be such that stretcher cases can be carried into the lifeboats and life rafts.

Query_Text_cn: 7在船舷降落的救生艇筏的每处登乘站或每二处相邻的登乘站均应设置一个符合规则6.1.6要求的登乘梯，其单根长度在船舶纵倾至10°和任何一舷横倾至20°的不利情况下可从甲板延伸至最轻载航行水线。
Translation: A compliant embarkation ladder in accordance with the requirements of Regulation 6.1.6 shall be provided at each muster station or every two adjacent muster stations for ship’s side launched lifeboats and liferafts. The single length of such ladder shall extend from the deck to the lightest navigation load waterline under unfavorable conditions of longitudinal inclination of 10° and transverse inclination of 20° on either side.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，主管机关可准许用进入在水面上的救生艇筏的认可装置代替这些梯子,但船舶的两舷均应设有至少一个登乘梯。
Translation: However, the competent authority may permit the use of approved apparatus for accessing lifeboats and liferafts on the water to replace these ladders, but each side of the ship shall be provided with at least one embarkation ladder.

Query_Text_cn: 第31.1.4条要求的救生筏可准许用能以受控方式下降至水面的其他登乘设施。
Translation: Other embarkation appliances capable of being lowered to the water surface in a controlled manner may be permitted in lieu of the life rafts required by Regulation 31.1.4.

Query_Text_cn: 8如有必要，应设置将吊艇架降落的救生艇筏贴靠并系留在船舷的装置，以便人员能安全登乘。
Translation: If necessary, devices shall be provided to secure davit-launched life rafts alongside the ship's side to ensure safe embarkation of personnel.

Query_Text_cn: ①此处系指2002年7月1日前实施的第II-2章，同等规定见经修正的第II-2章第13.3.2.5.1条。
Translation: "This refers to Chapter II-2 implemented before July 1, 2002. Equivalent provisions are set forth in Section 13.3.2.5.1 of the amended Chapter II-2."

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织A.760(18)决议通过的,经MSC.82(70)决议修正的《与救生设备和装置有关的符号》以及本组织A.752(18)决议通过的《客船低位照明的鉴定、试验和应用指南》。
Translation: Refer to the Symbols Relating to Life-saving Appliances and Apparatus, as adopted by resolution A.760(18) of this Organization and amended by resolution MSC.82(70), and the Guidelines for Testing,Certification and Application of Low-level Lighting on Passenger Ships, as adopted by resolution A.752(18) of this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 降落站的位置应确保救生艇筏安全降落，应特别注意离开推进器及船体陡斜悬空部分，除专门设计为自由降落的救生艇筏外，应尽可能使救生艇筏能从船舷平直部分降落下水。
Translation: The location of embarkation stations shall ensure safe launching of lifeboats and life rafts, taking particular care to keep clear of propellers and overhangs of the ship's hull. Except for lifeboats and life rafts specifically designed for free-fall launching, every effort shall be made to enable lifeboats and life rafts to be launched from the straight part of the ship's side into the water.

Query_Text_cn: 如降落站设置在船的前部，则应设置在防撞舱壁后方有遮蔽的地方，对此，主管机关应对降落设备的强度予以特别考虑。
Translation: If the landing station is located in the forward part of the ship, it shall be situated at a sheltered location aft of the collision bulkhead. In this regard, the competent authority shall give special consideration to the structural strength of the landing gear.

Query_Text_cn: 5在切实可行的情况下，位于安全的并有遮蔽的地方，并加以保护免受火灾和爆炸引起的损坏。
Translation: 5. Where practicable, it shall be located in a safe and sheltered area and protected against damage caused by fire and explosion.

Query_Text_cn: 尤其是，油船上的救生艇筏，除第31.1.4条要求的救生筏外，不应存放在货油舱、污油舱或其他含有爆炸性或危险性货物的液舱上或其上方。
Translation: The survival craft and life rafts on oil tankers shall not be stowed on or above cargo oil tanks, sludge tanks, or other liquid tanks containing explosive or hazardous cargo, except for the inflatable life rafts required by Article 31.1.4.

Query_Text_cn: 2顺船舷降落的救生艇应存放在推进器前方尽量远的地方。
Translation: Lifeboats launched alongside the ship's side shall be stowed as far forward as possible from the propellers.

Query_Text_cn: 在船长为80m及以上但少于120m的货船上，每艘救生艇应存放在使该救生艇尾端在推进器前方不少于该救生艇长度的地方。
Translation: On cargo ships where the length of the ship is 80 meters or more but less than 120 meters, each lifeboat shall be stowed in such a position that the stern of the lifeboat is not less than the length of the lifeboat ahead of the propeller.

Query_Text_cn: 在船长为120m及以上的货船与船长为80m及以上的客船上，每艘救生艇应存放在使该救生艇尾端在推进器前方不少于该救生艇一倍半长度的地方。
Translation: On cargo ships with a length of 120 meters or more and passenger ships with a length of 80 meters or more, each lifeboat shall be stowed such that the stern of the lifeboat is not less than one and a half times the length of the lifeboat ahead of the propeller.

Query_Text_cn: 如适合，船舶的布置应对在存放位置的救生艇加以保护，使其免受巨浪引起的损坏。
Translation: Where appropriate, the ship's arrangement shall be designed to protect lifeboats at their stowage positions from damage caused by heavy waves.

Query_Text_cn: 3救生艇应附连于其降落设备上存放。
Translation: The lifeboat shall be stored attached to its launching appliance.

Query_Text_cn: 4.1每只救生筏的存放应将其首缆牢固地系在船上。
Translation: 4.1 The stowage of each life raft shall ensure that its painter is securely made fast to the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 4.2每只救生筏或救生筏组的存放应设有一个符合规则4.1.6要求的自由漂浮装置，以使每只救生筏能自由漂浮，如为气胀式，在船舶下沉时能自动充气。
Translation: 4.2 The stowage of each life raft or life raft assembly shall be equipped with a free-floating appliance complying with the requirements of Rule 4.1.6 to ensure that each life raft can float freely. In the case of inflatable types, they shall automatically inflate when the vessel sinks.

Query_Text_cn: 4.3救生筏的存放应能在用人工将其从系固装置上解脱时，一次释放1只筏或容器。
Translation: The stowage of life rafts shall be such that, when manually released from their securing appliances, one raft or container is released at a time.

Query_Text_cn: 4.4上述4.1和4.2不适用于第31.1.4条要求的救生筏。
Translation: 4.4 The above-mentioned 4.1 and 4.2 do not apply to the life rafts required by Article 31.1.4.

Query_Text_cn: 5吊艇架降落的救生筏应存放在吊筏钩可到达的范围内，除非设有某种转移设施，该设施在本条1.2所规定的纵倾和横倾范围内并非无法操作，也未因船舶运动或动力故障而无法操作。
Translation: Life rafts hoistable from davits shall be stowed within reach of the raft cradle hooks unless a transfer arrangement is provided which is not inoperable within the longitudinal and transverse inclinations specified in paragraph 1.2 of this regulation, nor rendered inoperable due to ship movement or power failure.

Query_Text_cn: 6用于抛出舷外降落的救生筏的存放，应能容易地转移到船舶的任一舷降落，除非船舶每舷已按第31.1条要求的总容量存放了救生筏，且能在任一舷降落。
Translation: The stowage of inflatable liferafts for over-the-side launching shall permit ready transfer to either side of the ship for launching, unless the vessel has stowed liferafts on each side in accordance with the total capacity required under paragraph 31.1 and such liferafts can be launched from either side.

Query_Text_cn: 4在其兼作救生艇时，符合第13条的要求。
Translation: When it serves as a lifeboat, it complies with the requirements of Article 13.

Query_Text_cn: 1在海上撤离系统的登乘站和最轻载航行水线之间的船侧不应有任何开口，并应设有保护该系统免受任何突出物影响的设施。
Translation: No openings shall be permitted on the ship's side between the boarding station of the marine evacuation system and the lightest loaded navigation waterline, and protection facilities shall be provided to shield the system from any projecting objects.

Query_Text_cn: 2海上撤离系统应布置在能安全降落的位置，应特别注意离开推进器及船体陡斜悬空部分，以尽可能使海上撤离系统能从船舷平直部分降落下水。
Translation: 2. The Marine Evacuation System shall be positioned at a location that allows for safe landing, paying particular attention to keeping away from the propellers and steep overhang areas of the hull, to facilitate the deployment and lowering of the system into the water from the straight sections of the ship's side.

Query_Text_cn: 3每一海上撤离系统的存放应使通道或平台，或其存放或操作装置均不会妨碍任何其他救生设备在任何其他降落站的操作。
Translation: The stowage of each marine evacuation system shall ensure that passageways or platforms, or their stowage or operating mechanisms, do not impede the operation of any other life-saving appliances at any other embarkation station.

Query_Text_cn: 4如适合，船舶的布置应对在存放位置的海上撤离系统加以保护，使其免受巨浪引起的损坏。
Translation: Where practicable, the arrangement of the ship shall protect the marine evacuation system (MES) stored at their stowage positions from damage caused by large waves.

Query_Text_cn: 5供连同海上撤离系统一起使用并符合规则6.2要求的救生艇筏，且存放方式为可在纵倾至10°和任何一舷横倾至20°的不利情况下直接从存放地点降落下水。
Translation: Lifeboats or liferafts intended for use in conjunction with a marine evacuation system (MES) and complying with the requirements of Regulation 6.2 shall be stowed in a manner that allows them to be safely launched directly from their stowage positions into the water in adverse conditions of longitudinal inclination of 10° and transverse inclination of 20° on either side.

Query_Text_cn: 2每艘救生艇应设有1台能降落和回收该救生艇的设备。
Translation: Each lifeboat shall be provided with one launching appliance capable of launching and recovering the lifeboat.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，还应配备放开救生艇的装置，以便释放机构在不受载的情况下进行维护保养。
Translation: In addition, a device for releasing the lifeboat should be provided to enable maintenance and servicing of the release mechanism without load.

Query_Text_cn: 3降落与回收装置应使该设备的操作人员在救生艇筏降落期间，以及在救生艇回收期间，能随时在船上观察到救生艇筏。
Translation: The lowering and recovery apparatus shall ensure that the operating personnel can observe the lifeboat or liferaft on board the ship at all times during the lowering of the lifeboat or liferaft, as well as during the recovery of the lifeboat.

Query_Text_cn: 4船上所配备的类似救生艇筏应仅使用同一种型号的释放机械装置。
Translation: The lifeboats and life rafts equipped on board shall use the same model of release mechanism.

Query_Text_cn: 5在任一降落站，救生艇筏的准备和操作不应妨碍任何其他降落站的任何其他救生艇筏或救助艇的迅速准备和操作。
Translation: The preparation and operation of lifeboats and liferafts at any embarkation station shall not impede the rapid preparation and operation of any other lifeboats, liferafts, or rescue boats at any other embarkation station.

Query_Text_cn: 6吊艇索（如使用）应有足够的长度，以便船舶在最轻载航行时在纵倾至10°和任何一舷横倾至20°时，可使救生艇筏到达水面。
Translation: The gantline(s), where fitted, shall be of sufficient length to allow the lifeboat or liferaft to reach the water when the ship is at the minimum operational draught with a longitudinal inclination of 10° and transverse inclination of 20° to either side.

Query_Text_cn: 7在准备和降落过程中，救生艇筏及其降落设备以及准备降落的水域，应根据情况使用第II-1/42或II-1/43条所要求的应急电源供电的照明系统予以足够的照明。
Translation: The lifeboats, liferafts, their lowering equipment, and the waters utilized during preparation and lowering processes shall be adequately illuminated by the emergency power supply-fed lighting systems in compliance with either Regulation II-1/42 or II-1/43.

Query_Text_cn: 8在弃船过程中，应有能防止船舶的任何排水排放到救生艇筏内的设施。
Translation: During the abandonment of the ship, facilities shall be provided to prevent the discharge of any drainage from the ship into lifeboats and liferafts.

Query_Text_cn: 9如救生艇筏有被船舶减摇翼造成损坏的危险，则应有由应急电源驱动的、能将减摇翼收回船内的设施；驾驶室应设有应急电源操纵的指示减摇翼位置的指示器。
Translation: If lifeboats and liferafts are at risk of damage from anti-roll fins, there shall be facilities powered by the emergency power supply to retract the anti-roll fins into the ship; the bridge shall be equipped with an emergency power-operated indicator showing the position of the anti-roll fins.

Query_Text_cn: 10如配备符合规则4.5要求的部分封闭救生艇，应装设吊艇架横张索，在其上设置不少于2根足够长度的救生索，以便船舶在最轻载航行时在纵倾至10°和任何一舷横倾至20°的不利情况下，可使救生艇到达水面。
Translation: If a partially enclosed lifeboat complying with Rule 4.5 is provided, davit cross stays shall be fitted, with not less than two life-lines of sufficient length installed thereon, so that the lifeboat can be lowered to the water surface under unfavorable conditions when the ship is in her lightest loaded condition with longitudinal inclination up to 10° and transverse inclination up to 20° on either side.

Query_Text_cn: 救助艇的登乘与降落装置，应在尽可能短的时间内，使船员能登上并降落救助艇。
Translation: The embarkation and launching appliances for rescue boats shall enable crew members to embark and launch the rescue boat within the shortest practicable time.

Query_Text_cn: 2如救助艇是船舶救生艇筏中的一艘，其登乘装置与降落站应符合第11条和第12条的要求。
Translation: If a rescue boat is one of the ship's life-saving appliances, its embarkation arrangements and launching appliances shall comply with the requirements of paragraphs 11 and 12.

Query_Text_cn: 3降落装置应符合第16条的要求。
Translation: The landing device shall comply with the requirements of Article 16.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，所有救助艇均应能在船舶于平静水面上前进航速达到5kn时降落，如必要可用艇首缆。
Translation: All lifeboats shall be capable of being launched when the vessel is proceeding at a forward speed of 5kn on calm water, and if necessary, using a bow line.

Query_Text_cn: 4救助艇在载足全部乘员及属具时的中等海况下的回收时间应不超过5min。
Translation: The recovery time of the 4-person lifeboat, when fully loaded with all occupants and equipment under moderate sea conditions, shall not exceed 5 minutes.

Query_Text_cn: 如救助艇兼作救生艇，应能在此时间内回收载有救生艇属具及认可的、额定乘员至少为6人的救助艇。
Translation: If a rescue boat is also used as a lifeboat, it shall be capable of being recovered within this time while carrying the lifeboat equipment and approved rescue boat with a rated capacity for at least six persons.

Query_Text_cn: 5救助艇登乘和回收装置应允许安全而有效地搬运担架病人。
Translation: 5. The embarkation and recovery equipment for lifeboats should allow for the safe and effective transfer of stretcher cases.

Query_Text_cn: 如果重型动索滑车构成危险，为了安全应设有供恶劣天气下使用的回收环索。
Translation: If a heavy movable block and tackle poses a danger, it should be equipped with a recovery loop rope for use in adverse weather conditions for safety.

Query_Text_cn: 应配备1具符合规则7.1要求的抛绳设备。
Translation: Shall be equipped with 1 heaving line appliance complying with the requirements of Regulation 7.1.

Query_Text_cn: 2.1每位被指派为具有应急职责的船员，应在开航前熟悉这些职责。
Translation: Every crew member designated with emergency duties shall familiarize themselves with these duties prior to departure.

Query_Text_cn: 并向乘客介绍救生衣的使用方法以及在紧急情况下应采取的行动。
Translation: and introduce passengers to the proper use of life jackets and the necessary actions to take in emergency situations.

Query_Text_cn: 2.3当有新的乘客登船时，应在开航前，或在开航后立即召开一次乘客安全简要介绍会。
Translation: 2.3 When new passengers embark, a passenger safety briefing shall be conducted prior to departure or immediately after departure.

Query_Text_cn: 介绍会应包括第8.2条和第8.4条所要求的应变须知并应以一种或几种易被乘客听懂的语言进行宣讲。
Translation: The briefing shall include the emergency protocols required under Articles 8.2 and 8.4 and shall be conducted in one or more languages easily understood by passengers.

Query_Text_cn: 宣讲应使用船上的公共广播或用其他等效的方式，至少使得在航行中尚未听到的乘客易于听到。
Translation: Announcements should be made using the ship's public address system or other equivalent means to ensure that passengers who have not yet heard the announcements during the voyage can easily hear them.

Query_Text_cn: 如果上述2.2要求的集合是在开航后立即举行的，则简要介绍会也可被包括在该集合演习之内。
Translation: If the assembly required under paragraph 2.2 is held immediately after departure, the briefing session may also be included in that muster exercise.

Query_Text_cn: 也可以使用资料卡或标贴，或船上录像机播放的录像节目作为简要介绍会的补充，但其不可以替代宣讲。
Translation: Brochures, posters, or onboard video programs can be used as a supplement to the briefing session, but they cannot replace the formal presentation.

Query_Text_cn: 3.1演习应尽可能按实际紧急情况进行。
Translation: 3.1 Exercises should be conducted as far as possible in accordance with actual emergency situations.

Query_Text_cn: 3.2每位船员每月应至少参加一次弃船演习和一次消防演习。
Translation: 3.2 Each crew member shall participate in at least one abandon ship drill and one fire drill per month.

Query_Text_cn: 若有25%以上的船员未参加船上的上个月弃船和消防演习，应在该船离港后24h内举行该两项船员演习。
Translation: If more than 25% of the crew did not participate in the abandon ship and fire drills conducted on board last month, the two drills shall be conducted within 24 hours after the vessel's departure.

Query_Text_cn: 当船舶在经重大改建后首次投入营运时，或有新船员时，应在开航前举行这些演习。
Translation: When a vessel first enters into service after major reconstruction or has new crew members, such drills shall be conducted prior to departure.

Query_Text_cn: 对于无法这样做的各类船舶，主管机关可同意至少是等效的其他安排。
Translation: For ships of various types that are unable to comply, the competent authority may approve other arrangements that are at least equivalent.

Query_Text_cn: 9介绍无线电救生设备的使用。
Translation: 9 Introduction to the use of radio life-saving equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.2不同的救生艇应尽实际可能按本条3.3.1.5要求，在逐次演习中降放。
Translation: 3.3.2 Different lifeboats shall be lowered, as far as practicable, in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 3.3.1.5 of this Section during successive drills.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.3除本条3.3.4和3.3.5规定外，每艘救生艇应在弃船演习中每3个月至少有一次乘载被指派的操艇船员降落下水，并在水上进行操纵。
Translation: 3.3.3 Except as specified in paragraphs 3.3.4 and 3.3.5 of this regulation, each lifeboat shall, during abandon ship drills, be lowered into the water with its designated boat crew onboard at least once every three months and maneuvered on the water.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.4如自由降落下水不可行，可允许将救生艇降放至水面，而不作自由降落下水，但该救生艇应每6个月至少有一次乘载被指派的操艇船员自由降落下水，并在水上进行操纵。
Translation: If free fall launching is not feasible, the lifeboat may be permitted to be lowered to the water without free fall launching. However, such a lifeboat shall undergo at least one free fall launching exercise every six months while carrying the assigned boat crew, and shall conduct maneuvers in the water.

Query_Text_cn: 但如不可行时，主管机关可将此期限延长至12个月，但必须按不超过6个月的间隔期安排一次类似的降落试验。
Translation: If it is not feasible, the competent authority may extend the period to 12 months but must conduct a similar landing test at intervals not exceeding six months.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.5对于从事短程国际航行的船舶，如果由于港口泊位的安排及其运输方式不允许救生艇在某一舷降落下水，主管机关可准许救生艇不在该舷降落下水。
Translation: For ships engaged in short international voyages, if the arrangement of port berths and the vessel's mode of operation do not permit lifeboats to embark and lower from either side, the competent authority may authorize that lifeboats need not be required to embark and lower from that side.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，所有这些救生艇应至少每3个月下降一次并每年至少降落下水一次。
Translation: However, all such lifeboats should be lowered at least once every three months and lowered into the water at least once annually.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.6除兼作救生艇的救助艇外，其他救助艇均应在合理和可行的范围内，每个月乘载指定的船员降落下水并在水上进行操纵。
Translation: Except for rescue boats that also serve as lifeboats, all other rescue boats shall, within reasonable and practicable limits, be boarded by assigned crew members, lowered into the water, and maneuvered on the water monthly.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下，应至少每3个月按此要求进行一次。
Translation: Under any circumstances, it should be conducted in accordance with the requirements at least once every three months.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.7如救生艇与救助艇的降落下水演习是在船舶前进航行中进行，由于涉及危险，该项演习应仅在有遮蔽的水域，并在有此项演习经验的驾驶员监督下进行。
Translation: If the lowering and launching drills for lifeboats and rescue boats are conducted while the ship is underway, due to the associated risks, this exercise should only be carried out in sheltered waters and under the supervision of officers experienced in such drills.

Query_Text_cn: 参见本组织A.624(15)决议通过的《关于在前进航行中船舶的救生艇和救助艇降落下水的培训指南》。
Translation: See the Guidelines for Training on Lowering and Launching Lifeboats and Rescue Boats While Underway adopted by resolution A.624(15) of this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.8如船上配备海上撤离系统，演习应包括按对该系统布放所要求的程序，演练至即将实际布放这一系统的程度。
Translation: 3.3.8 If the vessel is equipped with a marine evacuation system, the drill shall include procedures for deploying the system up to the point of actual deployment.

Query_Text_cn: 这方面的演习应使用第35.4条要求的船上培训教具按正规规程予以增加。
Translation: Exercises in this regard should be increased in accordance with established procedures, using the on-board training equipment required under Article 35.4.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，该系统的每一成员还应尽实际可能，通过在船上或岸上参加类似系统在水中的全面布放而进行进一步的培训，参加的间隔期应不超过2年，但无论如何不得超过3年。
Translation: Each member of the system shall endeavor to the greatest extent practicable to undergo further training through participation in the full deployment of similar systems in water either on board or ashore. The intervals between participations shall not exceed two years, but in no case shall exceed three years.

Query_Text_cn: 此种培训可同第20.8.2条要求的布放结合起来进行。
Translation: This training may be conducted in combination with the deployment required under Article 20.8.2.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.9在每次弃船演习时，应测试用于集合与弃船的应急照明系统。
Translation: 3.3.9 During each abandon ship drill, the emergency lighting system used for assembly and embarkation shall be tested.

Query_Text_cn: 3.4.1在制定消防演习计划时，对在根据船型和货物类型而可能发生的各种紧急情况下的常规做法，应给予充分考虑。
Translation: 3.4.1 When developing a fire drill plan, full consideration should be given to the standard practices applicable to various emergencies that may occur based on ship type and cargo type.

Query_Text_cn: 6检查供随后弃船用的必要装置。
Translation: Check the necessary equipment required for the subsequent abandonment of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 3.4.3演习中使用过的设备应立即恢复到完好的操作状况；演习中发现的任何故障和缺陷，应尽快予以消除。
Translation: 3.4.3 Equipment used in exercises should be immediately restored to good operational condition; any faults and defects identified during exercises should be promptly addressed and eliminated.

Query_Text_cn: 4.1船员上船后，应尽快在不迟于2个星期内，对其进行有关使用包括救生艇筏属具在内的船上救生设备和使用船上灭火设备的船上培训。
Translation: After crew members board the vessel, they should receive onboard training regarding the use of onboard life-saving equipment, including lifeboat/life raft accessories, and the use of onboard fire-fighting equipment as soon as possible but no later than two weeks.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果船员是定期安排轮派上船，则这种培训应在不迟于船员第一次上船后2个星期内进行。
Translation: However, if crew members are regularly rotated onto the vessel, such training should be conducted no later than two weeks after the crew member's first assignment aboard.

Query_Text_cn: 应讲授船舶灭火设备和救生设备的用法以及海上救生的课程，授课间隔期与演习间隔期相同。
Translation: Training sessions on the use of firefighting and lifesaving equipment on board vessels, as well as courses on maritime survival, shall be provided. The intervals between training sessions shall be the same as those between drills.

Query_Text_cn: 每次授课可以包括船舶救生设备和灭火设备的各个不同部分，但在任何2个月的授课期内应包括该船的全部救生和灭火设备。
Translation: Each session may cover different components of the ship's lifesaving and fire-fighting equipment, but within any two-month training period, the entire complement of lifesaving and fire-fighting equipment must be included.

Query_Text_cn: 4灭火设备的操作与使用。
Translation: 4. Operation and Use of Fire Extinguishing Equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 4.3在每艘装有吊架降落式救生筏的船上，应在不超过4个月的间隔时间内举行一次此项设备用法的船上培训。
Translation: 4.3 On each ship equipped with a gantry-launched life raft, a training session on the use of this equipment shall be conducted at intervals not exceeding 4 months.

Query_Text_cn: 凡可行时，此项培训应包括一个救生筏的充气与下降。
Translation: Where practicable, the training should include the inflation and deployment of a life raft.

Query_Text_cn: 这个救生筏可以是培训专用救生筏，而不是船舶救生设备的组成部分，并应明显地标出专用救生筏标志。
Translation: This life raft can be a training-specific life raft rather than a component of the ship's lifesaving equipment and should be clearly marked with the training-specific life raft designation.

Query_Text_cn: 举行集合的日期、弃船演习和消防演习的详细情况、其他救生设备演习以及船上培训均应记载于主管机关可能规定的航海日志内。
Translation: The dates of musters, abandonship drills and fire drills, drills for other lifesaving appliances, and on-board training shall be entered in the ship’s logbook as prescribed by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在指定时间内未举行全部集合、演习或培训项目，则应在航海日志内记述其原因和已举行的集合、演习或培训项目的范围。
Translation: If all musters, drills, or training exercises are not conducted within the specified timeframe, the reasons for non-conduction and the scope of those exercises actually held shall be recorded in the nautical logbook.

Query_Text_cn: 1986年7月1日以前建造的船舶，应尽实际可能符合本条3和6.2的要求。
Translation: Ships constructed before July 1,1986 shall comply with the requirements of paragraphs 3 and 6.2 of this Section as far as practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 1除另有明文规定外，本章适用于本规则所适用的所有船舶，和300总吨及以上的货船。
Translation: Unless otherwise expressly provided, this Chapter applies to all ships to which this Regulation applies and cargo ships of 300 gross tons and above.

Query_Text_cn: 2本章不适用于航行在北美洲五大湖及其东至加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔的圣拉姆伯特船闸下游出口处为止的相连水域和支流的船舶，而这些船舶在其他情况下应适用本规则①。
Translation: This Chapter does not apply to vessels navigating in the North American Great Lakes and their connected waters and tributaries eastward to the downstream exit of the Saint Lambert Lock in Montreal, Quebec, Canada; however, such vessels shall comply with this Rule in all other circumstances①.

Query_Text_cn: 3本章的规定不应妨碍遇险的任何船舶、救生艇筏或人员使用任何方法以引起注意、表明其位置并获得援助。
Translation: The provisions of this Chapter shall not preclude any ship, lifeboat, life raft, or persons in distress from using any means to attract attention, indicate their position, and secure assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 1驾驶室对驾驶室的通信系指在船舶通常驾驶位置进行的船舶之间的安全通信。
Translation: Bridge-to-bridge communications means safety communications between vessels conducted at the usual navigating position of the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 2连续值班系指有关的无线电值班不应中断，除非当船舶接收能力由于自身通信被削弱或阻塞时，或当设备处于定期维护或检查时，而引起短暂间隔。
Translation: Continuous watch refers to the requirement that the relevant radio watch shall not be interrupted, except when the vessel's reception capability is weakened or blocked due to its own transmissions, or when equipment is undergoing routine maintenance or inspection, resulting in brief interruptions.

Query_Text_cn: 3数字选择呼叫（DSC）系指使用数码，使一个无线电台与另一个电台或一组电台建立联系和传递信息，并符合国际无线电咨询委员会（CCIR）②有关建议案的一种技术。
Translation: Digital Selective Calling (DSC) refers to a technology that uses digital means to enable a radio station to establish communication with another station or a group of stations and transmit information, complying with relevant recommendations from the International Radio Consultative Committee (CCIR)②.

Query_Text_cn: 4直接印字电报系指符合国际无线电咨询委员会（CCIR）②有关建议案的自动电报技术。
Translation: Direct printing telegraphy refers to the automatic telegraph technology that complies with the relevant Recommendations of the International Consultative Committee for Radio (CCIR).

Query_Text_cn: 5一般无线电通信系指通过无线电进行的除遇险、紧急和安全信息通信以外的业务和公共通信。
Translation: General radio communications refer to services and public communications conducted through radio, excluding distress, emergency, and safety communications.

Query_Text_cn: 6国际海事卫星组织（INMARSAT）③系指按1976年9月3日通过的国际海事卫星组织公约成立的组织。
Translation: ③INMARSAT means the organization established under the International Maritime Satellite Organization Convention adopted on September 3, 1976.

Query_Text_cn: ①此类船舶按为安全目的对有关无线电的特殊要求办理，此要求载于加拿大与美利坚合众国的有关协议内。
Translation: ① This type of vessel shall be operated in accordance with the special requirements pertaining to radio regulations for safety purposes, which are set forth in the relevant agreements between Canada and the United States of America.

Query_Text_cn: ②因1992年日内瓦国际电信规则第1条规定，该委员会名称改为“ITU无线电通信部”(ITU-R)。
Translation: According to Article 1 of the 1992 Geneva International Telecommunication Regulations, the committee's name was changed to "ITU Radiocommunication Sector" (ITU-R).

Query_Text_cn: ③因1994年12月5日～9日的第10次国际海事卫星组织（特别）会议通过对公约的修正案和操作协议的规定，该组织的名称改为“国际移动卫星组织”(Inmarsat)。
Translation: Following the adoption of amendments to the Convention and the Operational Regulations at the 10th Special Meeting of the International Maritime Satellite Organization from December 5 to 9, 1994, the organization's name was changed to the International Mobile Satellite Organization (Inmarsat).

Query_Text_cn: 7国际奈伏泰斯（NAVTEX）业务系指在518kHz上，使用窄带直接印字电报手段，用英语协调广播和自动接收海上安全信息①。
Translation: The International NAVTEX service refers to coordinated broadcasting and automatic reception of maritime safety information① via narrow-band direct-printing telegraphy in English, operating on the 518kHz frequency.

Query_Text_cn: 8定位系指发现遇险的船舶、航空器、海上设施或人员。
Translation: Positioning means locating vessels, aircraft, marine installations, or persons in distress.

Query_Text_cn: 9海上安全信息系指向船舶播发的航行和气象警报、气象预报和与安全有关的其他紧急信息。
Translation: The Maritime Safety Information System refers to navigational and meteorological alerts, weather forecasts, and other emergency information related to safety that are transmitted to vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 10极轨道卫星业务系指利用极轨道卫星接收和转发来自卫星应急无线电示位标（EPIRB）的遇险报警，并提供其位置的业务。
Translation: The polar orbit satellite business refers to a service that utilizes polar orbit satellites to receive and relay distress alerts from satellite emergency radio beacons (EPIRBs) and provide their locations.

Query_Text_cn: 11无线电规则系指随时有效的最新国际电信公约附件或被视为附件的无线电规则。
Translation: The Radio Regulations referred to in this Article mean the latest Radio Regulations, which are the Annexes to the International Telecommunication Convention currently in force or deemed to be such Annexes.

Query_Text_cn: 12A1海区系指至少由一个具有连续DSC报警能力的甚高频（VHF）海岸电台的无线电话所覆盖的区域，该区域可由各缔约国政府规定②。
Translation: The Area 12A1 means a sea area covered by at least one VHF (very high frequency) coast station providing continuous DSC alerting capability through radiotelephone service, which may be specified by the Contracting Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 13A2海区系指除A1海区以外，至少由一个具有连续DSC报警能力的中频（MF）海岸电台的无线电话所覆盖的区域，该区域可由各缔约国政府规定①。
Translation: Area A2-13 means the area, excluding Area A1, covered by at least one medium frequency (MF) radiotelephone with continuous DSC alerting capability from a coast station. Such areas may be defined by the respective contracting governments①.

Query_Text_cn: 14A3海区系指除A1和A2海区以外，由具有连续报警能力的INMARSAT对地静止卫星所覆盖的区域。
Translation: Area 14A3 is defined as the region outside Areas A1,A2 that is covered by INMARSAT geostationary satellites with continuous alerting capability.

Query_Text_cn: 15A4海区系指A1、A2和A3海区以外的区域。
Translation: The 15A4 Zone means the area outside of A1,A2,A3 zones.

Query_Text_cn: 16全球海上遇险和安全系统（GMDSS）标识系指可由船舶设备发送并用于识别船舶的海上移动业务识别码、船舶呼号、Inmarsat识别码和系列号识别码。
Translation: The Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS) identifier means the Maritime Mobile Service Identity (MMSI), ship station call sign, Inmarsat identification code and series identity code sent by shipboard equipment and used to identify a vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 2本章所使用的并在无线电规则和可能经修正的《1979年国际海上搜索与救助（SAR）公约》中已定义的所有其他术语和缩写语，具有与无线电规则和SAR公约所定义的相同含义。
Translation: All terms and abbreviations used in this chapter and defined in the Radio Regulations and the 1979 International Convention on Maritime Search and Rescue (SAR Convention) as may be amended shall have the same meanings as defined in the Radio Regulations and the SAR Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2主管机关已考虑到这些免除对所有船舶安全业务总的有效性的影响。
Translation: The competent authorities have taken into account the impact of these exemptions on the effectiveness of all ship safety business totals.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织认可的NAVTEX手册（出版物IMO-951E）。
Translation: ① Refer to the Organization’s recognized NAVTEX Manual (Publication IMO-951E).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见A.801(19)决议《关于全球海上遇险和安全系统(GMDSS)无线电业务的规定》。
Translation: See Resolution A.801(19), "Provisions for Radio Communications in the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS)."

Query_Text_cn: 2在例外情况下，船舶在为之配备的海区或多个海区外进行单次航行。
Translation: 2. In exceptional circumstances, vessels may operate outside the designated sea area or multiple sea areas for a single voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 3各主管机关应在每年的1月1日后尽快向本组织提交1份上一年度内按本条1和2所有核准免除的报告，并阐明核准这些免除的理由。
Translation: Each competent authority shall submit to the Organization, as soon as possible after January 1 each year, a report on all exemptions approved in accordance with paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article during the preceding calendar year and explain the reasons for approving these exemptions.

Query_Text_cn: 9发送和接收驾驶室对驾驶室的通信。
Translation: 9 Transmit and receive cab-to-cab communications.

Query_Text_cn: ①应注意到船舶执行GMDSS功能应该使用本组织A.814(19)决议通过的《避免错误的遇险报警指南》。
Translation: It should be noted that vessels operating GMDSS functional capabilities should utilize the "Guidelines for Avoiding False Distress Alerts" adopted through IMO Resolution A.814(19).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见A.614(15)决议《关于在9,300～9,500MHz频带上工作的雷达配备》。
Translation: See Resolution A.614(15), 'On the Radar Equipment Operating in the 9,300–9,500 MHz Frequency Band'.

Query_Text_cn: ③应注意到船舶在港口时可能有必要接收某些海上安全信息。
Translation: It should be noted that when vessels are in port, they may need to receive certain maritime safety information.

Query_Text_cn: 1每个缔约国政府承诺，在其认为可行和必要时，充分考虑本组织的建议案②单独或与其他缔约国政府合作，为空间和地面无线电通信业务提供适当的岸基设施。
Translation: Each Contracting Government undertakes to fully take into account the recommendations of this Organization when it deems such action feasible and necessary, and to provide appropriate shore-based facilities for space and terrestrial radio communication services either individually or in cooperation with other Contracting Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 5在415kHz～535kHz③及1,605kHz～4,000kHz频带内的海上移动业务。
Translation: 5 Maritime mobile service within the frequency bands of 415 kHz to 535 kHz③ and 1,605 kHz to 4,000 kHz.

Query_Text_cn: 2各缔约国政府承担义务向本组织提供关于在其沿海指定海区建立的海上移动业务、移动卫星业务和海上移动卫星业务的岸基设施的有关资料④。
Translation: 2. Each Contracting Government undertakes to provide the Organization with information regarding shore-based facilities established in the designated sea areas along their coastlines for the Maritime Mobile Service, Mobile-Satellite Service, and Maritime Mobile-Satellite Service④.

Query_Text_cn: 1本条适用于所有航行的所有船舶。
Translation: This provision applies to all vessels engaged in any navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 2每个缔约国政府承担义务确保做出适当安排以登记全球海上遇险和安全系统（GMDSS）识别码，并使救助协调中心全天24h能获得这些识别码。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall undertake the obligation to ensure that appropriate arrangements are made for the registration of Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS) identification codes, and enable Rescue Coordination Centres to have access to these identification codes 24 hours a day.

Query_Text_cn: 如适合，缔约国政府应向保存这些识别码登记的国际组织通报所授予的识别码。
Translation: Contracting Governments shall notify the assigned identifiers to the international organizations maintaining the registry of these identifiers where appropriate.

Query_Text_cn: ①并不要求各缔约国政府提供所有无线电通信业务。
Translation: ① Does not require each Contracting Government to provide all radio communication services.

Query_Text_cn: 对覆盖不同海区的岸基设施的要求应具体规定。
Translation: Requirements for shore-based infrastructure covering different maritime zones should be specifically stipulated.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见A.801(19)决议《关于全球海上遇险和安全系统(GMDSS)无线电业务的规定》。
Translation: ② See Resolution A.801(19),Provisions on Radio Service for the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见A.617(15)决议《关于作为世界范围航行警告业务一部分的NAVTEX系统的实施》。
Translation: ③ See Resolution A.617(15), On the Implementation of the NAVTEX System as Part of the Global Ship Reporting Service.

Query_Text_cn: ④根据缔约国政府提供的信息，GMDSS岸基设施的总布置图，将通过GMDSS通函向所有有关方面通告。
Translation: ④The overall layout of GMDSS shore-based facilities will be communicated to all concerned parties via GMDSS circulars based on the information provided by Contracting Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 1每艘船舶应设有在其整个预定航程中均能符合第4条所述之功能要求的无线电装置；除非按第3条已免除外，所有无线电装置应能符合第7条的要求以及第8、9、10或11条的要求（视预定航程所通过的海区或多个海区而定）。
Translation: Each ship shall be provided with radio installations capable of meeting the functional requirements specified in Article 4 throughout its intended voyage; unless exempted in accordance with Article 3, all radio installations shall meet the requirements of Article 7 and Articles 8, 9, 10 or 11, depending on the sea area or areas through which the intended voyage passes.

Query_Text_cn: 5清楚地标明船舶呼号，船舶电台识别码及适于无线电装置使用的其他代码。
Translation: 5. Clearly specify the ship’s call sign, ship radio station identification number and other codes suitable for use with radio apparatus.

Query_Text_cn: 此要求可由手提式VHF设备来满足。
Translation: This requirement can be met by portable VHF equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 4在客船上，遇险控制板应安装在指挥位置。
Translation: The emergency control panel on passenger ships should be installed at the command position.

Query_Text_cn: 该控制板可以设有一个单独按钮，当按下这个按钮时，船上所有具有遇险报警功能的无线电通信装置发出遇险警报，或者为各个装置各设有一个按钮。
Translation: The control panel may have a single button that, when pressed, triggers a distress alert from all onboard radio communication equipment with distress alerting functionality, or alternatively, separate buttons may be provided for each piece of equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 无论单按钮或多个按钮被按下时，控制板上均应有清晰的视觉显示。
Translation: Regardless of whether a single button or multiple buttons are pressed, the control panel should have a clear visual indication.

Query_Text_cn: 应设有防止单按钮或多个按钮误操作的设施。
Translation: Shall be equipped with a mechanism to prevent misoperation of a single button or multiple buttons.

Query_Text_cn: 如果卫星紧急无线电示位标用作发送遇险警报的第二种措施，且不能被遥控，则应可在驾驶室指挥位置附近安装一个附加的卫星紧急无线电示位标。
Translation: If a satellite emergency position-indicating radio beacon (EPIRB) is used as a secondary means for transmitting distress alerts and cannot be remotely activated, an additional EPIRB shall be capable of being installed near the steering position in the wheelhouse.

Query_Text_cn: 5客船按下遇险控制板上的按钮时，应能连续和自动地将船舶位置资料传送至所有有关的无线电通信设备，包括原始的遇险警报。
Translation: When the button on the distress control panel is pressed, the vessel should be capable of continuously and automatically transmitting the vessel's position data to all relevant radio communication equipment, including the original distress alert.

Query_Text_cn: 6对于客船，遇险报警板应安装在指挥位置。
Translation: For passenger ships,the distress alarm panel should be installed at the command position.

Query_Text_cn: 遇险报警板应能对任何遇险报警或船上收到的警告给出视觉和听觉指示，并且还应指示出通过何种无线电通信业务接收到该遇险警报。
Translation: The distress alarm panel shall be capable of providing visual and auditory indications for any distress alarm or warnings received on board, and shall also indicate the radio communication service through which the distress alert was received.

Query_Text_cn: 1.1在156.525MHz（70频道）频率上的DSC。
Translation: 1.1 DSC on 156.525 MHz (Channel 70).

Query_Text_cn: 51台接收来自Inmarsat增强群呼系统②的海上安全信息的无线电设备（如果船舶航行在Inmarsat所覆盖的，但不具有国际NAVTEX业务的任何区域内）。
Translation: 51 units of radio equipment receiving maritime safety information from the Inmarsat Enhanced Group Call System ② (if the vessel is navigating in any area covered by Inmarsat but without international NAVTEX service).

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果船舶仅航行在具有高频（HF）直接印字电报海上安全信息业务的区域，而且该船已装设了能接收这种业务的设备，则可免除本要求③。
Translation: However, if the vessel only operates in areas with a high frequency (HF) direct-printing telegraphy maritime safety information service and is equipped with apparatus capable of receiving such service, it may be exempted from requirement ③.

Query_Text_cn: 6.5能人工启动发送遇险报警。
Translation: 6.5 is capable of manually initiating the transmission of a distress alert.

Query_Text_cn: ①某些船舶可以免除该要求（见第9.4条）。
Translation: Certain vessels may be exempt from this requirement (see Paragraph 9.4).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见本组织A.705(17)决议通过的《关于发布海上安全信息的建议案》。
Translation: ③ See Recommendation on the Dissemination of Maritime Safety Information adopted by Resolution A.705(17) of this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ④参见关于搜救寻位能力的A.616(15)决议。
Translation: ④ See the A.616(15) Resolution on search and rescue location capability.

Query_Text_cn: ⑤应考虑到Inmarsat卫星所覆盖的各个洋区相对应的进行接收和处理的地面设施的有效性。
Translation: The effectiveness of the corresponding ground facilities for receiving and processing should be taken into account for the various ocean regions covered by Inmarsat satellites.

Query_Text_cn: 2每艘客船都应设有从船舶通常驾驶的位置与现场用航空频率121.5MHz和123.1MHz进行以搜救为目的的双向无线电通信的设备。
Translation: Every passenger ship shall be provided with equipment enabling two-way radio communication for搜救 purposes on the aviation frequencies 121.5 MHz and 123.1 MHz from the usual驾驶 position and at the现场 location.

Query_Text_cn: 1在VHF频带上使用DSC工作。
Translation: Operate using DSC on the VHF frequency band.

Query_Text_cn: 2通过在406MHz频率上工作的极轨道卫星业务来工作。
Translation: 2 operates via the polar-orbiting satellite service operating at the 406 MHz frequency.

Query_Text_cn: 5.2第7.1.6条所要求的卫星EPIRB。该卫星EPIRB应位于靠近船舶通常驾驶的位置或能从船舶通常驾驶的位置遥控启动。
Translation: The satellite EPIRB required under Clause 7.1.6 of Section 5.2 shall be located in proximity to the usual steering position of the ship or be capable of being remotely activated from the usual steering position.

Query_Text_cn: 2第7.1.1条所要求的VHF无线电装置还应能用无线电话发送和接收一般无线电通信。
Translation: The VHF radio installation required by paragraph 7.1.1 shall also be capable of transmitting and receiving general radio communications via radiotelephone.

Query_Text_cn: 3仅航行于A1海区的船舶可以装有1台EPIRB以代替第7.1.6条所要求的卫星EPIRB。
Translation: Ships operating solely in the A1 sea area may be fitted with one EPIRB instead of the satellite EPIRB required by paragraph 7.1.6.

Query_Text_cn: 5能人工启动发送遇险报警。
Translation: 5 can be manually activated to transmit a distress alert.

Query_Text_cn: ①此要求可由能进行双向通信的Inmarsat船舶地面站来满足，如Inmarsa-A、Inmarsa-B和Fleet-77（A.808(19)决议和海安会决议MSC.130(75)）或Inmarsa-C（经修正的A.807(19)决议）。
Translation: This requirement can be met by bidirectional communication-capable Inmarsat ship earth stations such as Inmarsat-A, Inmarsat-B, and Fleet-77 (Resolution A.808(19) and IMO MSC Resolution MSC.130(75)) or Inmarsat-C (amended Resolution A.807(19)).

Query_Text_cn: 除另有说明外，本注释适用于对本章规定的Inmarsat船舶地面站的所有要求。
Translation: Unless otherwise specified, this note applies to all requirements for Inmarsat ship earth stations prescribed in this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 21台能在2,187.5kHz频率上保持连续DSC值班的无线电装置。
Translation: 21 units of radio equipment capable of maintaining continuous DSC watch on the 2,187.5 kHz frequency.

Query_Text_cn: 3.3.2第7.1.6条所要求的卫星EPIRB。该卫星EPIRB应位于靠近船舶通常驾驶的位置，或能从船舶通常驾驶的位置遥控启动。
Translation: The satellite EPIRB required under Clause 7.1.6 of Section 3.3.2 shall be located in proximity to the usual navigation position of the ship or be capable of being remotely activated from the usual navigation position of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 2本条1.1和1.3所要求的无线电装置应能从船舶通常驾驶的位置启动发送遇险报警。
Translation: The radio equipment required under paragraphs 1.1 and 1.3 of this clause shall be capable of initiating the transmission of a distress alarm from the usual navigating position on board the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 11台在1,605～4,000kHz或4,000～27,500kHz频率内工作的无线电装置。
Translation: Eleven units of radio equipment operating within the frequency ranges of 1,605-4,000kHz or 4,000-27,500kHz.

Query_Text_cn: 21台Inmarsat船舶地面站。
Translation: 21 units of Inmarsat maritime ground stations.

Query_Text_cn: 4对1997年2月1日以前建造的且仅航行于A2海区的船舶，在实际可行时，只要这些船舶在其通常驾驶的位置在VHF16频道上保持连续守听值班，主管机关可免除第7.1.1.1条和第7.1.2条的要求。
Translation: For ships constructed before February 1, 1997, and operating solely within the A2 sea area, the Administration may exempt them from the requirements of paragraphs 7.1.1.1 and 7.1.2 where practicable, provided that such ships maintain continuous listening watch on VHF channel 16 at their usual navigation positions.

Query_Text_cn: 31台能在2,187.5kHz频率上保持连续DSC值班的无线电装置。
Translation: 31 radio units capable of maintaining a continuous DSC watch at the 2,187.5 kHz frequency.

Query_Text_cn: 4.3通过Inmarsat静止卫星业务进行，增加一台船舶地面站或用第7.1.6条所要求的卫星EPIRB，该卫星EPIRB应位于靠近船舶通常驾驶的位置，或可以从船舶通常驾驶的位置遥控启动。
Translation: 4.3 The operation shall be conducted via the Inmarsat geostationary satellite service, adding a ship earth station or using the satellite EPIRB required under Clause 7.1.6. The satellite EPIRB shall be located near the vessel's usual navigation position or capable of being remotely activated from the vessel's usual navigation position.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何时候，应能选择这些DSC遇险和安全频率中的任一频率。
Translation: At any time, one should be able to select any of the DSC distress and safety frequencies.

Query_Text_cn: 4此外，船舶应能通过在1,605～4,000kHz和4,000～27,500kHz频带内的工作频率上工作的MF/HF无线电装置，使用无线电话或直接印字电报进行发送和接收一般无线电通信。
Translation: Furthermore, the ship shall be capable of transmitting and receiving general radiocommunications via an MF/HF radio installation operating on frequencies within the 1,605–4,000 kHz and 4,000–27,500 kHz bands, using radiotelephony or direct printing telegraphy.

Query_Text_cn: 此要求可由上述.1所要求的设备增加该性能来满足。
Translation: This requirement can be met by enhancing the performance of the equipment specified in the aforementioned.1.

Query_Text_cn: 3在本条1.1、1.2、1.4、2.1和2.3中所规定的无线电装置应能从船舶通常驾驶的位置启动发送遇险报警。
Translation: The radio apparatus specified in paragraphs 1.1, 1.2, 1.4, 2.1 and 2.3 of this clause shall be capable of initiating a distress alert from the usual navigation position of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 4对1997年2月1日以前建造的且仅航行于A2和A3海区的船舶，在实际可行时，只要这些船舶在其通常驾驶的位置在VHF16频道上保持连续守听值班，主管机关可免除第7.1.1.1条和7.1.2条的要求。
Translation: For ships constructed before 1 February 1997 and solely navigating in A2 and A3 sea areas, where practicable, the Administration may exempt them from the requirements of Regulation 7.1.1.1 and 7.1.2 provided that such ships maintain continuous listening watch on VHF Channel 16 at their usual navigation positions.

Query_Text_cn: 1航行于所有海区的船舶，除满足第7条的要求外，还应设有第10.2条所要求的无线电装置和设备，但是，不应接受用第10.2.3.2条所要求的设备替代第10.2.3.1条所要求的设备，因为第10.2.3.1条所要求的设备应始终是必备的。
Translation: All ships operating in all sea areas shall be provided with the radio installations and equipment required under Regulation 10.2 in addition to complying with the requirements of Regulation 7. However, substitution of the equipment required under Regulation 10.2.3.2 for that required under Regulation 10.2.3.1 shall not be accepted, as the equipment specified in Regulation 10.2.3.1 shall always be mandatory.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，航行于所有海区的船舶还应满足第10.3条的要求。
Translation: Additionally, ships operating in all sea areas shall also comply with the requirements of Clause 10.3.

Query_Text_cn: 3根据第10.2.2条或11.1条的要求，安装有MF/HF无线电装置的船舶，在DSC遇险和安全频率2,187.5kHz和8,414.5kHz频率上以及至少在DSC遇险和安全频率4,207.5kHz、6,312kHz、12,577kHz或16,804.5kHz中的一个频率上保持连续值班，视一天中的时间和船舶所在的地理位置而定。
Translation: According to the requirements of Article 10.2.2 or 11.1, vessels equipped with MF/HF radio installations shall maintain a continuous watch on the DSC distress and safety frequencies 2,187.5 kHz and 8,414.5 kHz, as well as on at least one of the following DSC distress and safety frequencies: 4,207.5 kHz, 6,312 kHz, 12,577 kHz, or 16,804.5 kHz. The specific frequency selection shall depend on the time of day and the geographic location of the vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 4根据第10.1.1条的要求，安装有Inmarsat船舶地面站的船舶，应对卫星岸对船的遇险报警保持连续值班。
Translation: Ships equipped with Inmarsat ship earth stations shall maintain continuous watch on satellite shore-to-ship distress alerts in accordance with the requirements of Article 10.1.1.

Query_Text_cn: 2每艘船舶在海上时，应在向该船舶航行区域发布海上安全信息的适当频率或多个频率上，对海上安全信息的播发保持无线电值班。
Translation: Every ship when at sea shall maintain a continuous radio watch on the appropriate frequency or frequencies for the broadcast of maritime safety information to the ship's navigational area.

Query_Text_cn: 3至1999年2月1日或至海上安全委员会可能确定的其他日期①，每艘船舶在海上时，如实际可行，应在船舶通常驾驶的位置在VHF16频道上保持连续守听值班。
Translation: From 3 to February 1, 1999, or until any other date as may be determined by the Maritime Safety Committee①, every ship at sea shall, if practicable, maintain continuous watch on VHF Channel 16 at the usual navigation position of the ship.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶在海上时，应始终可获得足够的电源供无线电装置工作，并对作为无线电装置的1个或多个备用电源组成部分的蓄电池进行充电。
Translation: While a vessel is at sea, it shall always have available sufficient power supply for the operation of radio installations and to charge batteries forming part of one or more standby power sources for the radio installations.

Query_Text_cn: 2每艘船舶应设有1个或多个备用电源，当船舶主电源和应急电源发生故障时，向无线电装置供电，以便进行遇险和安全通信。
Translation: Each ship shall be provided with one or more standby power supplies, which shall supply power to the radio installation when the ship's main power supply and emergency power fail, in order to enable distress and safety communications.

Query_Text_cn: 2对于船舶配有的应急电源，如其不完全符合第II-1/42条或43条有关要求，包括向无线电装置供电，6h②。
Translation: For the emergency power supply installed on board the ship, if it does not fully comply with the relevant requirements of Regulation 42 or 43 of Chapter II-1, including the provision of power to radio installations for 6 hours②.

Query_Text_cn: ①海上安全委员会决定(MSC.131(75)决议)，所有GMDSS船舶在海上时，如切实可行，仍应继续在VHF的16频道上保持连续守听值班。
Translation: The Maritime Safety Committee decided (Resolution MSC.131(75)) that all GMDSS ships at sea should continue to maintain a continuous watch on VHF Channel 16, where practicable.

Query_Text_cn: ②作为指导，建议用以下公式来确定在遇险情况下对于每台无线电装置备用电源所能供给的电负荷：1/2发射所消耗的电流＋接收所消耗的电流＋任何附加负载消耗的电流。
Translation: As a guideline, the following formula is recommended for determining the electrical load that the standby power supply for each radio installation can provide in distress situations: 1/2 the transmitting current + receiving current + current consumed by any additional loads.

Query_Text_cn: 1个或多个备用电源不必同时向各自独立的HF和MF无线电装置供电。
Translation: One or more standby power sources do not need to supply power simultaneously to their respective independent HF and MF radio apparatuses.

Query_Text_cn: 31个或多个备用电源应独立于船舶推进动力及船舶电力系统。
Translation: 31 or more standby power sources shall be independent of the ship's propulsion system and electrical system.

Query_Text_cn: 2如果其他无线电装置中仅1台能同时和VHF无线电装置一起与1个或多个备用电源相连时，则应取其他无线电装置中耗电最大的1台。
Translation: If among the other radio apparatus only one unit can be connected to one or more backup power sources along with the VHF radio apparatus, then the one with the highest power consumption among the other radio apparatus shall be selected.

Query_Text_cn: 51个或多个备用电源可以用来向第6.2.4条所要求的电气照明供电。
Translation: 51 or more backup power sources can be used to supply power to the electrical lighting as required by Clause 6.2.4.

Query_Text_cn: 2应在不超过12个月的间隔期内，使用适当的方法①对不在航的船舶检查蓄电池或蓄电池组的容量。
Translation: 2 Within an interval not exceeding 12 months, the capacity of batteries or battery banks on non-operational vessels shall be inspected using appropriate method①.

Query_Text_cn: 5在任何气候条件下，充足电的蓄电池应至少满足所要求的最少工作小时数。
Translation: In any climatic conditions, fully charged batteries must be capable of providing at least the minimum required operating hours.

Query_Text_cn: 8如果需要将船舶的导航或其他设备的信息连续输入到本章要求的无线电装置（包括第18条中所述的导航接收装置）中以确保其适当的性能，应具有能确保在船舶主电源或应急电源发生故障时继续提供此类信息的措施。
Translation: If information from the ship’s navigation or other equipment needs to be continuously inputted into the radio apparatus required under this Chapter (including the navigation receiving apparatus referred to in Article 18) to ensure its proper performance, measures shall be provided to ensure the continued provision of such information in the event of failure of the ship’s main power supply or emergency power supply.

Query_Text_cn: ①检查蓄电池容量的一种方法是，用正常工作电流和时间（例如10h）对蓄电池彻底地放电和充电。
Translation: A method to inspect the battery's capacity involves discharging and recharging it completely using the standard operating current and duration, such as 10 hours.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何时候都可对充电情况进行评定，但是，当船舶在海上时，不应进行大量放电。
Translation: The charging status can be assessed at any time; however, significant discharging should not be conducted when the vessel is at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 1本章适用的所有设备应为主管机关认可的型式。
Translation: All equipment applicable to this chapter shall be of a type approved by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 这些设备所符合的相应性能标准应不低于本组织通过的性能标准①。
Translation: The corresponding performance standards that these devices comply with should not be lower than the performance standards adopted by the organization ①.

Query_Text_cn: 1A.525(13)决议《船舶航行和气象警报以及紧急信息的窄带直接印字电报设备的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 1A.525(13) on "Performance Standards for Narrowband Direct Printing Telegraphy Equipment for the Navigation of Ships, Meteorological Alerts, and Emergency Information"

Query_Text_cn: 2A.694(17)决议《作为全球海上遇险和安全系统(GMDSS)组成部分的船载无线电设备和电子导航设备的一般要求》。
Translation: Resolution 2A.694(17) - General Requirements for Shipborne Radio Equipment and Electronic Navigation Equipment as Part of the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS)

Query_Text_cn: 3A.808(19)决议《经修正的能进行双向通信的船舶地面站性能标准》和A.570(14)决议《船舶地面站的型式认可》及MSC.130(75)决议《能进行双向通信的Inmarsat船舶地面站性能标准》。
Translation: Resolutions A.808(19) on "Amended Performance Standards for Two-way Communications Ship Earth Stations", A.570(14) on "Type Approval of Ship Earth Stations", and MSC.130(75) on "Performance Standards for Two-way Communications Inmarsat Ship Earth Stations".

Query_Text_cn: 4A.803(19)决议《经修正的能进行通话和数字选择呼叫的船载VHF无线电装置的性能标准》和海安会MSC.68(68)决议附件1（对2000年1月1日或以后安装的设备有效）。
Translation: Resolution 4A.803(19), *Performance Standards for Revised Shipborne VHF Radio Equipment Capable of Voice Communication and Digital Selective Calling*, and Maritime Safety Committee MSC.68(68) resolution, Annex 1 (applicable to equipment installed on or after 1 January 2000).

Query_Text_cn: 5A.804(19)决议《经修正的能进行通话和数字选择呼叫的船载MF无线电装置的性能标准》和海安会MSC.68(68)决议附件2（对2000年1月1日或以后安装的设备有效）。
Translation: Resolution 5A.804(19) "Performance Standards for Revised Shipboard MF Radio Apparatus with Voice and Digital Selective Calling Capabilities" and Annex 2 of MSC.68(68) resolution (effective for equipment installed on or after 1 January 2000).

Query_Text_cn: 6A.806(19)决议《经修正的能进行通话、窄带直接印字和数字选择呼叫的船载MF/HF无线电装置的性能标准》和海安会MSC.68(68)决议附件3（对2000年1月1日或以后安装的设备有效）。
Translation: Resolution 6A.806(19) 'Performance Standards for Shipborne MF/HF Radiocommunication Equipment with Capabilities for Voice Communication, Narrow Band Direct Printing (NBDP), and Digital Selective Calling (DSC)' and IMO MSC.68(68) Resolution Annex 3 (applies to equipment installed on or after January 1, 2000).

Query_Text_cn: 7A.810(19)决议《在406MHz频率上工作的自浮式卫星应急无线电示位标（EPIRBs）的性能标准》和海安会决议MSC.120(74)《通过在406MHz频率上工作的自浮式卫星应急无线电示位标（EPIRBs）性能标准（A.810(19)决议）的修正案》（还参见A.696(17)决议《在COSPAS SARSAT系统工作的卫星应急无线电示位标（EPIRBs）的型式认可》）。
Translation: Resolution 7A.810(19) Performance Standards for Self-activating Satellite Emergency Position Indicating Radio Beacons (EPIRBs) Operating on the 406 MHz Frequency and MSC Resolution MSC.120(74) Amendments to the Performance Standards for Self-activating Satellite Emergency Position Indicating Radio Beacons (EPIRBs) Operating on the 406 MHz Frequency (Resolution A.810(19)) (as well as Resolution A.696(17) Type Approval of Satellite Emergency Position Indicating Radio Beacons (EPIRBs) Operating in the COSPAS SARSAT System)

Query_Text_cn: 8A.802(19)决议《用于搜救作业的救生艇筏雷达应答器的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 8A.802(19) — Performance Standards for Radar Transponders on Lifeboats and Liferafts Used in Search and Rescue Operations.

Query_Text_cn: 9A.805(19)决议《自浮式VHF应急无线电示位标的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 9A.805(19) on "Performance Standards for Self-floating VHF Emergency Radio Beacons".

Query_Text_cn: 10A.807(19)决议《经修正的能发射和接收直接印字通信的Inmarsat-C船舶地面站的性能标准》,海安会MSC.68(68)决议附件3（对2000年1月1日或以后安装的设备有效）和A.570(14)决议《船舶地面站的型式认可》。
Translation: Resolution A.807(19) "Performance Standards for Inmarsat-C Ship Stations with the Capability to Transmit and Receive Direct Printing Telegraphy Communications (as amended)", Annex 3 of MSC.68(68) resolution (applicable to equipment installed on or after 1 January 2000), and Resolution A.570(14) "Type Approval of Ship Stations".

Query_Text_cn: 11A.664(16)决议《增强的群呼设备的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 11A.664(16), "Performance Standards for Enhanced Group Calling Equipment"

Query_Text_cn: 12A.812(19)决议《在1.6GHz频率上通过Inmarsat对地静止卫星系统工作的自浮式卫星应急无线电示位标的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 12A.812(19): "Performance Standards for Self-floating Satellite Emergency Position-indicating Radio Beacons Operating at the 1.6 GHz Frequency via the Inmarsat Geostationary Satellite System"

Query_Text_cn: 13A.662(16)决议《应急无线电设备的自浮释放和启动装置的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 13A.662(16) on "Performance Standards for the Self-floating Release and Activation Device of Emergency Radio Equipment"

Query_Text_cn: 14A.699(17)决议《使用高频窄带直接印字技术进行海上安全信息播发和协调的系统性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 14A.699(17) on System Performance Standards for the Dissemination and Coordination of Maritime Safety Information Using High Frequency Narrowband Direct Printing Technology

Query_Text_cn: 15MSC.148(77)决议《通过经修订的接收船舶航行和气象警告以及紧急信息的窄带直接印字电报设备（NAVTEX）的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution MSC.148(77) on the Adoption of the Revised Performance Standards for Narrow-band Direct Printing Telegraphy Equipment (NAVTEX) for Receiving Maritime Navigation and Meteorological Warnings and Emergency Information

Query_Text_cn: 16A.811(19)决议《在GMDSS中使用的船载无线电综合通信系统（IRCS）的性能标准》。
Translation: Resolution 16A.811(19) – Performance Standards for the Integrated Radio Communication System (IRCS) Used in the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS)

Query_Text_cn: 17MSC.80(70)决议附件1《航空双向便携式VHF无线电话设备性能标准》。
Translation: Annex 1 to Resolution 17MSC.80(70), "Aeronautical Two-way Portable VHF Radiotelephone Apparatus Performance Standards".

Query_Text_cn: 1设备的设计应使主要部件能易于更换而无需仔细地重新校准或调整。
Translation: The design of the equipment should ensure that major components are easily replaceable without the need for meticulous recalibration or adjustment.

Query_Text_cn: 2若适合，设备的构造和安装应便于进行检查和船上维修。
Translation: 2. If applicable, the construction and installation of the equipment shall be designed to facilitate inspection and on-board maintenance.

Query_Text_cn: 3考虑到本组织的建议案①，应备有足够的资料，以便对设备进行正确的操作和维修。
Translation: In accordance with the Organization's Recommendation No. ①, sufficient documentation shall be provided to ensure proper operation and maintenance of the equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 4应备有足够的工具和备件以便能对设备进行维修。
Translation: 4. Sufficient tools and spare parts shall be provided to enable the repair of the equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 5主管机关应确保本章要求的无线电设备可予维修，以保证第4条规定的功能要求的有效性，并满足对这些设备所建议的性能标准。
Translation: Competent authorities shall ensure that the radio equipment referred to in this Chapter can be maintained to ensure the effectiveness of the functional requirements specified in Article 4 and to meet the recommended performance standards for these devices.

Query_Text_cn: 6航行在A1和A2海区的船舶，应使用可能经主管机关认可的，诸如双套设备、岸上维修或海上电子维修能力的方法，或其组合，以确保功能要求的有效性。
Translation: Ships operating in A1 and A2 sea areas shall use methods recognized by the competent authority, such as duplicate equipment, shore-based maintenance, or maritime electronic repair capability, or combinations thereof, to ensure the effectiveness of functional requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 7航行在A3和A4海区的船舶，考虑到本组织的建议案②，应使用可能经主管机关认可的至少二种组合方法，如双套设备、岸上维修或海上电子维修能力，以确保功能要求的有效性。
Translation: Ships operating in A3 and A4 sea areas, taking into account the Organization's Recommendation ②, shall use at least two combination methods recognized by the competent authority, such as dual equipment, shore-based maintenance, or maritime electronic repair capability, to ensure the effectiveness of functional requirements.

Query_Text_cn: 8虽然应采取一切合理的步骤使设备保持有效的工作状态，以确保符合第4条规定的所有功能要求，但是只要船舶能够实施所有的遇险安全功能，在第4.8条所要求的用于提供一般无线电通信的设备发生故障的情况下不应认为该船舶不适航，或作为使船舶滞留在不易提供维修设施的港口的理由。
Translation: Although all reasonable steps shall be taken to maintain equipment in effective working order to comply with all functional requirements specified in paragraph 4, a ship shall not be deemed unseaworthy or detained in a port where repair facilities are not readily available solely because the equipment required under paragraph 4.8 for general radio communication purposes has failed, provided that the ship is capable of performing all distress safety functions.

Query_Text_cn: 9卫星应急无线电示位标（EPIRBs）应在不超过12个月的间隔期内，对其操作有效性的各个方面进行测试，着重注意频率的稳定性、信号强度和编码。
Translation: The testing of satellite emergency position indicating radio beacons (EPIRBs) for all aspects of operational effectiveness shall be conducted at intervals not exceeding 12 months, with particular attention to frequency stability, signal strength and encoding.

Query_Text_cn: 但如认为适当和合理时，主管机关可将期限延长至17个月。
Translation: However, the competent authority may extend the period to 17 months if it deems it appropriate and reasonable.

Query_Text_cn: 测试可在船上或经认可的测试站或检修站进行。
Translation: Testing may be conducted on board the vessel or at an approved test station or maintenance facility.

Query_Text_cn: 1每艘船舶应配有主管机关满意的、能胜任遇险和安全无线电通信的人员。
Translation: Each ship shall be provided with personnel satisfactory to the competent authority and qualified to handle distress and safety radio communications.

Query_Text_cn: ③这些人员应持有无线电规则中规定的适当证书。在遇险时，应指定其中任何人员担负起无线电通信的主要责任。
Translation: These personnel shall hold appropriate certificates as specified in the Radio Regulations. In the event of distress, any of these personnel shall be designated to assume primary responsibility for radio communications.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织A.694(17)决议通过的《关于作为全球海上遇险和安全系统组成部分的船载无线电设备和电子导航设备一般要求的建议案》，以及A.813(19)决议中关于船舶的所有电气电子设备的电磁兼容性（EMC）的一般要求和海安会通函MSC/Circ.862《IMO对GMDSS设备性能标准有关要求的澄清》。
Translation: See the MSC general requirements on shipboard radio equipment and electronic navigation equipment as components of the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS), as adopted in resolution A.694(17); and the general requirements regarding electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) for all electrical and electronic equipment on ships in resolution A.813(19), along with MSC/Circ.862 Circular titled "Clarification of Performance Standards Requirements for GMDSS Equipment as specified in IMO".
