Query_Text_cn: ②参见A.702(17)决议中关于A3和A4海区的全球海上遇险和安全系统的无线电维修指南。
Translation: Refer to the radio maintenance guidelines for the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS) in the A3 and A4 sea areas as specified in resolution A.702(17).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见STCW规则第IV章第B-IV/2节。
Translation: ③ See STCW Code, Chapter IV, Section B-IV/2.

Query_Text_cn: 2客船上，至少应指派一名按本条1要求的有资格的人员，在遇险时只执行无线电通信责任。
Translation: On a Type II passenger ship, at least one qualified person designated in accordance with paragraph 1 of this regulation shall, in the event of distress, be solely responsible for radio communication duties.

Query_Text_cn: 应备有使主管机关满意并符合无线电规则要求的无线电记录，该记录应记载对于海上人命安全显然具有重要性的与无线电通信业务有关的所有遇险事故。
Translation: The radio log shall contain all distress incidents related to radiocommunications service that are clearly significant to the safety of life at sea, and shall meet the requirements of the competent authority and the Radio Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 适用本章的船舶，其船上备有的能在遇险报警时自动报告船位的所有双向通信设备，均应自动从内部或外部导航接收装置（如设有）获得该信息。
Translation: Vessels subject to this Chapter shall ensure that all two-way communication equipment onboard capable of automatically reporting the vessel's position when a distress alert is activated shall automatically obtain such information from internal or external navigational receiving equipment, if fitted.

Query_Text_cn: 如果未安装这种接收装置，则船舶在航行中的位置以及船位确定的时间应按不超过4小时的间隔期手动更新，以便随时可由该设备发送。
Translation: If such a receiving device is not installed, the vessel's position and the time of positioning shall be manually updated at intervals not exceeding four hours so that they can be transmitted by the device at any time.

Query_Text_cn: 2对1997年2月1日以前建造的且仅航行于A2、A3和A4海区的船舶，在实际可行时，只要这些船舶在其通常驾驶的位置在VHF16频道上保持连续守听值班，主管机关可免除第7.1.1.1条和7.1.2条的要求。
Translation: For ships constructed before February 1, 1997 and operating exclusively in A2, A3, and A4 sea areas, where practicable, the Administration may exempt such ships from the requirements of paragraphs 7.1.1.1 and 7.1.2 provided that they maintain a continuous watch on VHF Channel 16 at their usual navigation positions.

Query_Text_cn: 2专门航行于北美洲五大湖以及与其连接的东至加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔的圣拉姆伯特船闸下游出口处为止的水域及支流的船舶。
Translation: Vessels specifically navigating the waters of the North American Great Lakes and their connecting waterways downstream to and including the downstream exit of the Saint Lambert Lock in Montreal, Quebec, Canada, and their tributaries.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，仍鼓励军舰、海军辅助船或由缔约国政府拥有或经营的仅用于政府非商业性目的的其他船舶在合理和可行的范围内，与本章保持一致。
Translation: However, it is encouraged that warships, naval auxiliary vessels, or other ships owned or operated by Contracting Governments and used solely for non-commercial governmental purposes align with this chapter to the extent reasonable and feasible.

Query_Text_cn: 2主管机关可决定本章对仅在按国际法规定的基准线以内（向岸一侧）水域营运的船舶适用范围。
Translation: The competent authority may determine the scope of application of this Chapter to vessels operating solely within waters landward of the baseline as defined under international law (on the landward side).

Query_Text_cn: 3就本章而言，顶推船舶和被顶推船舶的刚性连接混合单元，当其设计成专用的整体拖船和驳船组合体时，应视为单一船舶。
Translation: For the purposes of this Chapter, a rigidly connected composite unit consisting of a pushing vessel and a vessel being pushed shall be considered as a single ship when designed as a dedicated integral tug and barge combination.

Query_Text_cn: 3渔船。
Translation: 3 fishing vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 3该船业已开始的装配量至少为50t，或为全部结构材料估算重量的1%，取较小者。
Translation: The assembled quantity of the vessel that has already commenced shall be at least 50 tons or 1% of the estimated weight of all structural materials, whichever is smaller.

Query_Text_cn: 2海图或航海出版物系指专用的图或书，或支持这种图或书的经特殊编辑的数据库，由政府主管当局，经授权的水文局或其他相关的政府机构正式颁布，用于满足航海要求①。
Translation: Charts or nautical publications means specialized charts or publications, or specially edited databases that support such charts or publications, officially issued by government authorities, authorized hydrographic offices, or other relevant government agencies to meet maritime requirements①.

Query_Text_cn: 3所有船舶系指所有船或艇，而不论其类型和用途。
Translation: 3 All vessels mean all ships or boats, regardless of their type and purpose.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见国际水文组织关于沿岸国根据第9条提供海图的权利和责任的相应决议和建议。
Translation: See the relevant resolutions and recommendations of the International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) regarding the rights and obligations of coastal states to provide nautical charts under Article 9.

Query_Text_cn: 1主管机关对无机械推进装置的船舶可准予全面免除第15、17、18、19（19.2.1.7除外）、20、22、24、25、26、27和28条的要求。
Translation: The competent authority may grant a full exemption from the requirements of Articles 15, 17, 18, 19 (except for Article 19.2.1.7), 20, 22, 24, 25, 26, 27, and 28 for vessels without mechanical propulsion.

Query_Text_cn: 2如个别船舶所从事的航行，其距岸的最大距离、航程的长短和性质、大体上无航行危险以及影响安全的其他情况使完全实施本章的规定成为不合理或不必要时，主管机关可对任何这种船舶准予部分或有条件的免除或等效，但主管机关必须事先考虑到这种免除和等效对所有其他船舶的安全可能产生的影响。
Translation: When the navigation engaged in by certain ships, considering their maximum distance from the coast, voyage duration and nature, general absence of navigation hazards, and other circumstances affecting safety, makes it unreasonable or unnecessary to fully implement the provisions of this chapter, the competent authority may grant partial or conditional exemptions or equivalencies to any such ship. However, the competent authority must first take into account the potential impact of such exemptions and equivalencies on the safety of all other ships.

Query_Text_cn: 3各主管机关应在每年的1月1日以后尽快向本组织提交一份报告，该报告应汇总上一日历年度内按本条2之规定准予的所有新的免除和等效并说明准予这种免除和等效的理由。
Translation: 3. Competent authorities shall submit a report to the Organization as soon as possible after January 1 each year. The report shall summarize all new exemptions and equivalences granted in accordance with paragraph 2 of this Article for the preceding calendar year and state the reasons for granting such exemptions and equivalences.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织应将这些内容分发给其他缔约国政府，以供参考。
Translation: The Organization should disseminate these materials to other Contracting Governments for their reference.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应采取所有必要的步骤，确保其从任何可靠的来源获悉危险的情报时，迅速通知有关各方并传送到其他相关的国家政府①。
Translation: Contracting Governments shall take all necessary steps to ensure that, upon becoming aware of dangerous intelligence from any reliable sources, they promptly notify the concerned parties and transmit it to other relevant national governments①.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，鼓励海上船舶收集气象资料，并用最适宜于助航目的方式安排这些资料的审查、传送和交换②。
Translation: Each Contracting Government undertakes to encourage maritime vessels to collect meteorological data and to arrange for the review, transmission, and exchange of such data in the most appropriate manner for navigational purposes②.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关应鼓励使用高度精确的气象仪器，并应于接到校核此种仪器的请求时给予便利。
Translation: The competent authorities should encourage the use of highly precise meteorological instruments and should provide facilitation upon receiving requests to calibrate such instruments.

Query_Text_cn: 国家相应的气象服务机构可作出安排，免费向船舶提供这种校核。
Translation: The relevant national meteorological service agencies may arrange to provide such verification free of charge to ships.

Query_Text_cn: 1使用陆地和空间无线电通信服务机构的相应岸基设备以文字、并尽实际可能以图象格式发出信息，警告船舶注意强风，风暴和热带气旋。
Translation: Use the respective shore-based equipment of land and space radio communication service providers to issue information in text form and, as far as practicable, in image format to warn vessels of strong winds, storms, and tropical cyclones.

Query_Text_cn: 2每日至少2次通过相应的陆地和空间无线电通信服务③发出适用于航运的气象信息，其中包括天气、波浪和冰的数据、分析、警报和预报。
Translation: Twice daily at a minimum, transmit maritime-specific meteorological information through the respective land-based and space-based radio communication services③, including data, analyses, alerts, and forecasts on weather, wave, and ice conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 这些信息应以文字、并尽实际可能以图象格式发送，其中包括通过传真或以数字形式发送的气象分析和预测图象，供船上数据处理系统重新编制。
Translation: This information should be transmitted in text and graphic formats wherever practicable, including meteorological analysis and forecast images sent via fax or in digital form, for recompilation by shipboard data processing systems.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织以A.706(17)决议通过的经修正的《IMO/IHO全球航行警报服务导则》。
Translation: See the as-amended IMO/IHO Guidelines for the Global Navigation Alerting Service (GAINS) adopted by this Organization through Resolution A.706(17).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.528(13)决议通过的《关于气象航线划定的建议案》。
Translation: ② See the Recommendation on the Establishment of Meteorological Routes adopted by this Organization under Resolution A.528(13).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见第IV/7.1.4和IV/7.1.5条。
Translation: 3. See paragraphs IV/7.1.4 and IV/7.1.5.

Query_Text_cn: 3编制并发行供海上顺利开展气象工作所可能需要的出版物（如可行时），并安排发布及提供每日天气图供出航船舶参考。
Translation: Compile and issue publications required to facilitate meteorological operations at sea (where feasible), and arrange for the publication and provision of daily weather charts for reference by vessels at sea.

Query_Text_cn: 4安排选定的船舶装设经过校验的船用气象仪器（例如气压计、气压记录仪、湿度计及测量海水温度的适宜仪器），以供气象服务之用，并使其在主要标准时进行气象观测且记录和发送观测结果（如环境许可，每日至少4次），作为海面天气形势分析之用，并鼓励其他船舶用变通方式进行观测且记录和发送观测结果，特别是在航船稀少的区域。
Translation: Arrange for selected ships to install calibrated marine meteorological instruments (such as barometers, barographs, hygrometers, and suitable instruments for measuring sea water temperature) for meteorological services, and ensure that they conduct meteorological observations, record, and transmit the results at principal standard times (if conditions permit, at least four times daily) for the purpose of sea surface weather analysis, and encourage other ships to conduct observations in a flexible manner and record and transmit the results, especially in areas with sparse shipping.

Query_Text_cn: 5鼓励船公司尽可能多地将其船舶投入到气象观测和记录工作中；观测结果使用船舶陆地或空间无线电通信设备发送，以使各国气象服务机构受益。
Translation: The shipping industry is encouraged to deploy as many vessels as possible for meteorological observation and record-keeping; observation data should be transmitted via the ships' terrestrial or space-based radio communication equipment to benefit meteorological service institutions across nations.

Query_Text_cn: 6这些气象观测结果免费向有关船舶发送。
Translation: 6. The meteorological observation results are transmitted free of charge to relevant vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 7当在热带气旋或疑似热带气旋附近时，应鼓励船舶尽可能增加其观测和发送观测结果的次数，但应牢记船上驾驶员在风暴情况下需先行处理的航行任务。
Translation: When in the vicinity of a tropical cyclone or a suspected tropical cyclone, vessels should be encouraged to increase their observations and the transmission of observations as much as possible, but it should be borne in mind that shipboard officers must prioritize navigational duties during storm conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 8使用陆地和空间无线电通信服务机构的相应岸基设备，安排接收来自船舶和向船舶发送气象信息。
Translation: Using the corresponding shore-based equipment of land and space radio communication service institutions to arrange the reception of meteorological information from vessels and the transmission of such information to vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 9鼓励船长在遇到风速50kn或以上（蒲福风级10级）时，通知附近船舶及海岸电台。
Translation: 9. Encourage captains to notify nearby vessels and coast radio stations when encountering wind speeds of 50 knots or above (Beaufort scale force 10).

Query_Text_cn: 10努力使上述国际气象服务获得统一程序，并尽可能地符合世界气象组织提出的技术规则和建议。
Translation: Article 10 shall endeavor to establish uniform procedures for the aforementioned international meteorological services and ensure they are as far as possible in conformity with the technical regulations and recommendations proposed by the World Meteorological Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府可以将执行本公约过程中可能产生的任何气象问题提交世界气象组织研究和征求意见。
Translation: The Governments of the Contracting Parties may submit any meteorological issues that may arise during the implementation of this Convention to the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) for study and consultation.

Query_Text_cn: 3应以发送格式提交本条所规定的信息，并按《无线电规则》规定的优先顺序发送，在“向所有电台”发送气象信息、预报和警报时，所有船舶电台都必须遵守《无线电规则》的规定。
Translation: 3 shall submit the information specified in this provision in the prescribed format for transmission and send it in accordance with the priority order set out in the Radio Regulations. When transmitting meteorological information, forecasts, and alerts to all stations, all ship stations must comply with the provisions of the Radio Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 4供船舶使用的预报、警报、天气形势和其他气象资料，应按有关缔约国政府间的共同协定，特别是按世界气象组织系统为针对全球海上遇险和安全系统（GMDSS）范围内的公海编制和传播气象预报和警报所规定的要求，由具备最佳位置为不同沿海和公海区域服务的国家气象服务机构进行发布和传送。
Translation: Meteorological forecasts, alerts, weather conditions, and other meteorological data for maritime use shall be issued and transmitted in accordance with agreements among the contracting governments, particularly in compliance with the requirements established by the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) system for the preparation and dissemination of meteorological forecasts and alerts within the high seas covered by the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System (GMDSS). Such information shall be provided by national meteorological service providers best positioned to serve different coastal and high-seas areas.

Query_Text_cn: 1冰区巡逻有助于在北大西洋内的海上人命安全、航行安全和航行效率以及海洋环境保护。
Translation: Ice patrol operations contribute to maritime safety of life, navigation safety, operational efficiency, and marine environmental protection within the North Atlantic.

Query_Text_cn: 在冰季期间穿越由冰区巡逻警戒的冰山区的船舶，应要求使用冰区巡逻所提供的服务。
Translation: Vessels navigating ice areas under the surveillance of the Ice Patrol during the ice season shall be required to use the services provided by the Ice Patrol.

Query_Text_cn: 2各缔约国政府承担义务，继续担任北大西洋冰区巡逻和冰情的研究与观测服务。
Translation: The Contracting Governments undertake the obligation to continue conducting patrols in the ice areas of the North Atlantic and providing research and observation services for ice conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 在整个冰季期间，即每年的2月15日至7月1日，在纽芬兰大浅滩附近冰山区的东南、南及西南界限应予警戒，以便将该危险区的范围通知过往船舶，研究浮冰的一般情况以及对巡逻船舶和飞机活动区内的船舶和船员提供所需的帮助。
Translation: During the entire ice season, which runs from February 15 to July 1 each year, the southeastern, southern, and southwestern boundaries of the ice area near the Grand Banks of Newfoundland shall be kept under surveillance in order to: (1) notify passing vessels of the extent of the hazardous area; (2) study the general conditions of the pack ice; and (3) provide necessary assistance to vessels and crews within the areas patrolled by ships and aircraft.

Query_Text_cn: 在一年其余时间内也应适当保持对冰情的研究与观测。
Translation: During the rest of the year, appropriate research and monitoring of ice conditions should also be maintained.

Query_Text_cn: 3用于供冰区巡逻服务及研究与观测冰情的船舶和飞机，可担任分配的其他任务，但这些其他任务不得妨碍本服务工作的原有目的或增加其费用。
Translation: Vessels and aircraft used for ice patrol services, as well as research and observation of ice conditions, may be assigned to other tasks; however, such other tasks shall not interfere with the original purpose of the service or increase its costs.

Query_Text_cn: 4美利坚合众国政府同意继续全面管理冰区巡逻服务及冰情的研究与观测，包括传播由此得到的信息。
Translation: 4 The Government of the United States of America agrees to continue exercising full management over icebreaking services and the research and observation of ice conditions, including the dissemination of information obtained therefrom.

Query_Text_cn: 5在本章的附录《北大西洋冰区巡逻管理、运作和费用规则》中阐明了适用于冰区巡逻之管理、运作和费用的各项条件，该附录是本章一个组成部分。
Translation: The Appendix in this Chapter, titled "Rules Governing the Management, Operations, and Costs of the Patrol of the North Atlantic Ice Areas," sets forth the conditions applicable to the management, operations, and costs of the ice area patrol. This Appendix constitutes an integral part of this Chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 6无论何时，美利坚合众国政府和/或加拿大政府如欲中止提供这些服务，即可以这样做，并且各缔约国政府应根据其共同利益解决继续这些服务的问题。
Translation: At any time, the Government of the United States of America and/or the Government of Canada may cease to provide such services, and the Contracting Parties shall resolve the issue of continuing these services in accordance with their mutual interests.

Query_Text_cn: 美利坚合众国和/或加拿大政府对于在中止提供这些服务之前受益于这些服务且获准悬挂缔约国国旗的船舶和在缔约国政府已延用本条要求的领土内注册的船舶，应提前18个月向所有有关缔约国政府发出中止服务的书面通知。
Translation: The government(s) of the United States of America and/or Canada, with respect to vessels that, prior to the termination of the provision of these services, have benefitted from such services and are authorized to fly the flag of a Contracting State, and vessels registered within territories of Contracting State governments that have continued the application of this Article, shall provide written notice of termination to all concerned Contracting State governments 18 months in advance.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，确保为其负责区域内的遇险通信和相互协调并为营救其海岸附近的海上遇险者作出必要的安排。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall ensure the provision of necessary arrangements for distress communications and mutual coordination within its areas of responsibility and for the rescue of persons in maritime distress near its coasts.

Query_Text_cn: 这些安排，考虑到海上交通的密度和航行障碍物的密度，应包括视为实际可行和必要的搜救设施的建立、运转和维护，并应尽可能提供足够的寻找和营救遇险人员的设备①。
Translation: Such arrangements, taking into account the density of maritime traffic and navigational obstacles, should include the establishment, operation, and maintenance of search and rescue facilities deemed practically feasible and necessary, and should provide, to the extent possible, sufficient equipment for locating and rescuing distressed personnel①.

Query_Text_cn: 2各缔约国政府承担义务，向本组织提供其现有搜救设施的资料以及对其中内容所作的更改方案（如有）。
Translation: Each Contracting Government undertakes the obligation to provide the Organization with information on its existing search and rescue facilities and any modification proposals made to such information (where applicable).

Query_Text_cn: 3适用第I章的客船，应备有在紧急情况下与相应的搜寻和救助机构合作的计划。
Translation: Passenger ships subject to Chapter I of this Regulation shall have on board a plan for cooperation with the corresponding search and rescue (SAR) authorities in emergency situations.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划应由船舶、第IX/1条所定义的公司以及搜救机构共同制定。
Translation: The plan shall be jointly formulated by the ship, the company as defined in Article IX/1, and the search and rescue authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划应包括要进行定期演习以证明该计划有效性的规定。
Translation: The plan should include provisions requiring regular exercises to demonstrate its effectiveness.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划应根据本组织制定的指南而编制。
Translation: The plan should be prepared in accordance with the guidelines established by this organization.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见《1979年国际海上搜寻救助（SAR）公约》和本组织通过的下列决议：《搜救飞机的自导能力》（A.225(VII)决议）、《雷达应答器用于搜寻和救助》（A.530(13)决议）、《搜救自导能力》（A.616(15)决议）和《国际航空海上搜寻和救助手册（IAMSAR）》（A.894(21)决议）。
Translation: See the 1979 International Convention on Maritime Search and Rescue (SAR) and the following resolutions adopted by this Organization: *Automatic Direction-Finding for Search and Rescue Aircraft* (Resolution A.225(VII)), *Use of Radar Transponders for Search and Rescue Purposes* (Resolution A.530(13)), *Search and Rescue Automatic Direction-Finding* (Resolution A.616(15)), and *International Aeronautical and Maritime Search and Rescue Manual (IAMSAR)* (Resolution A.894(21)).

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府承担义务作好安排，使从事搜救工作的搜救设施在与遇险船舶或遇险人员通信时使用救生信号。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall ensure that search and rescue facilities engaged in rescue operations use distress signals when communicating with vessels or persons in distress.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，安排水文资料的收集和编制，并且出版、传播以及不断更新为安全航行所必需的所有航海资料。
Translation: Each Contracting Government undertakes the obligation to arrange for the collection and compilation of hydrographic data, and to publish, disseminate, and continuously update all hydrographic and nautical publications necessary for safe navigation.

Query_Text_cn: 4提供数据管理安排以支持这些服务。
Translation: 4 Provide data management arrangements to support these services.

Query_Text_cn: 3各缔约国政府承担义务，确保尽最大可能统一海图和航海出版物，并且无论何时都要考虑到有关的国际决议和建议①。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall undertake to ensure the maximum possible uniformity of nautical charts and navigation publications and to take into account the relevant international resolutions and recommendations① at all times.

Query_Text_cn: 4各缔约国政府承担义务以最大程度协调其活动，确保在全球范围内尽可能及时、可靠并明确地提供水文和航行资料。
Translation: The governments of the Contracting Parties undertake obligations to coordinate their activities to the greatest extent possible to ensure the provision of hydrological and navigational data on a global scale as promptly, reliably, and clearly as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶航线划定系统有利于海上人命安全、航行安全及效率和/或海洋环境保护。
Translation: The vessel route planning system contributes to maritime life safety, navigation safety and efficiency, and/or the protection of the marine environment.

Query_Text_cn: 如采纳和实施本组织制定的指南和衡准②，建议所有船舶，某些类型船舶或载运某些货物的船舶使用船舶航线划定系统，这也可以作为强制性要求。
Translation: If the guidelines and standards established by this Organization are adopted and implemented, it is recommended that all ships, including ships of certain types or those carrying specific cargoes, use the vessel routing system, which may also be designated as a mandatory requirement.

Query_Text_cn: 2本组织是公认的为船舶航线划定系统制定国际性指南、衡准和规则的唯一国际机构。
Translation: The Organization is recognized as the sole international body responsible for establishing international guidelines, standards, and regulations for the ship route designation system.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应将通过船舶航线划定系统的提案送交本组织。
Translation: Contracting Governments shall submit to this Organization proposals developed through the vessel route designation system.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织将核对有关已通过的所有船舶航线划定系统的全部资料并分发各缔约国政府。
Translation: This organization will review all relevant documents pertaining to the approved maritime route designation systems and distribute them to all Contracting Governments.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见国际水文组织通过的相应决议和建议。
Translation: ① See the corresponding resolutions and recommendations adopted by the International Hydrological Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.572(14)决议通过的经修订的《船舶航线划定的一般规定》。
Translation: See paragraph ② of the revised *General Provisions for the Designation of Shipping Routes* adopted by this organization under resolution A.572(14).

Query_Text_cn: 3发起建立船舶航线划定系统是各有关国家政府的责任。
Translation: Initiating the establishment of a ship route delineation system is the responsibility of all relevant national governments.

Query_Text_cn: 为使本组织通过此系统，在建立这类系统时应考虑到本组织制订的指南及衡准。
Translation: To ensure that this organization can effectively utilize this system, the guidelines and standards developed by the organization should be taken into consideration when establishing such systems.

Query_Text_cn: 4船舶航线划定系统应提交本组织通过。
Translation: The 4 ship route designation system shall be submitted to the Organization for approval.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，对于一国或多国政府实施的船舶航线划定系统不准备提交本组织通过或未经本组织通过，则鼓励其尽可能考虑本组织制订的指南及衡准①。
Translation: However, where a State or Governments of multiple States establishes a vessel routing system without submission to this Organization for adoption or despite it not having been adopted by this Organization, the System is encouraged to take into account the guidelines and criteria formulated by this Organization as far as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 5如果两国或两国以上政府共同关注某一特定区域，应在他们之间达成协议的基础上制定联合提案明确说明他们对该区域船舶航线划定系统的表述和使用。
Translation: If two or more governments have a common interest in a specific area, they should establish a joint proposal on the basis of an agreement between them to specify their designation and use of the ship routeing system in that area.

Query_Text_cn: 收到此提案并开始考虑其是否通过之前，本组织应确保把该提案的详细内容分发给共同关注此地区的政府，包括在此船舶航线划定系统附近的国家。
Translation: Prior to receiving this proposal and commencing consideration of its approval, the organization should ensure the distribution of its detailed content to governments jointly concerned with this region, including countries in proximity to the vessel route delineation system.

Query_Text_cn: 6缔约国政府应遵守本组织通过的关于船舶航线划定系统的措施。
Translation: Article 6. Contracting Governments shall comply with the measures concerning ship routeing systems adopted by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 他们应公布安全有效地使用船舶航线划定系统所必需的资料。
Translation: They should publish the necessary materials for the safe and effective use of the vessel route demarcation system.

Query_Text_cn: 有关的一国或多国政府可监督这些系统的运行。
Translation: The relevant governments of one or more countries may supervise the operation of these systems.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应在其权力范围内全力确保适当使用本组织通过的船舶航线划定系统。
Translation: Contracting Governments shall take all necessary measures within their respective competence to ensure the appropriate use of the ship routeing system established by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 7船舶应按其船型或运载货物的要求，使用本组织通过的强制性船舶航线划定系统，并符合现行的有关规定，除非有不使用船舶航线划定系统的令人信服的理由。
Translation: Vessels shall use the mandatory vessel routing systems adopted by the Organization according to their ship type or cargo requirements and comply with applicable regulations, unless there are compelling reasons for not using the vessel routing systems.

Query_Text_cn: 所有这些理由应记录于船舶日志内。
Translation: All these reasons should be recorded in the ship’s log.

Query_Text_cn: 8强制性的船舶航线划定系统应由各有关缔约国政府按照本组织制定的指南和衡准①审核。
Translation: Mandatory ship routing systems shall be subject to review by the concerned Contracting Governments in accordance with the guidelines and criteria① established by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 9所有已通过的船舶航线划定系统和为实施这些系统所采取的行动应符合国际法，包括1982年联合国海洋法公约的有关规定。
Translation: All established ship route designation systems and actions taken to implement these systems shall be in conformity with international law, including the provisions of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea of 1982.

Query_Text_cn: 10本条及其相关指南和衡准的任何内容均不侵害各国政府根据国际法或关于国际航行海峡及群岛海道的法律体系所具有的权利和义务。
Translation: The provisions of this Article and its associated guidelines and standards shall not prejudice the rights and obligations of States under international law or the legal framework governing international straits and archipelagic sea lanes.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶报告系统有利于海上人命安全、航行安全及效率和/或海洋环境保护。
Translation: Ship reporting systems contribute to maritime life safety, navigational safety and efficiency, and/or the protection of the marine environment.

Query_Text_cn: 船舶报告系统在按照本组织根据本条的要求制定的指南和衡准③予以通过并实施后，应按每个所通过的系统的规定适用于所有船舶或某些类型船舶或载运某些货物的船舶。
Translation: Ship reporting systems, after being approved and implemented in accordance with the guidelines and standards③ developed by this Organization in accordance with the provisions of this paragraph, shall apply to all ships, certain types of ships, or ships carrying certain types of cargo as specified in each approved system.

Query_Text_cn: 2本组织是公认的为船舶报告系统制定国际性指南、衡准和规则的唯一国际机构。
Translation: The Organization is recognized as the sole international body responsible for establishing international guidelines, standards and regulations for ship reporting systems.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府应将采用船舶报告系统的提案送交本组织。
Translation: The Governments of Contracting States shall submit proposals for the adoption of a ship reporting system to the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 本组织将核对有关已通过的所有船舶报告系统的全部资料并分发各缔约国政府。
Translation: This organization will review all relevant documents pertaining to approved ship reporting systems and distribute them to all Contracting Governments.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织以A.572(14)决议通过的经修订的《船舶航线划定的一般规定》。
Translation: See the revised *General Provisions for the Laying Down of Ship Routes* adopted by the Organization through Resolution A.572(14).

Query_Text_cn: ②本条不涉及各国政府为搜救目的而建立且适用经修正的1979年搜救公约第5章的船舶报告系统。
Translation: This paragraph does not apply to ship reporting systems established by governments for the purpose of search and rescue and applicable under Chapter V of the amended 1979 International Convention on Maritime Search and Rescue (SAR).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.43(64)决议通过并以MSC.111(73)决议修正的指南和衡准。
Translation: See the guidelines and criteria adopted by resolution MSC.43(64) and amended by resolution MSC.111(73) of the Maritime Safety Committee of this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 并参见本组织以A.851(20)决议通过的《船舶报告系统总则和船舶报告要求，包括涉及危险品、有害物质和/或海洋污染物事故报告指南》。
Translation: See also the General Principles of Ship Reporting Systems and Ship Reporting Requirements, including Guidelines for Reporting Accidents involving Dangerous Goods, Harmful Substances, and/or Marine Pollutants, adopted by this Organization through resolution A.851(20).

Query_Text_cn: 3发起建立船舶报告系统是各有关政府的责任。
Translation: Initiating the establishment of a ship reporting system is the responsibility of all relevant governments.

Query_Text_cn: 在建立此类系统时，应考虑到本组织制定的指南和衡准①中的规定。
Translation: When establishing such a system, the provisions outlined in the guidelines and benchmarks① formulated by this organization should be considered.

Query_Text_cn: 4未提交本组织通过的船舶报告系统不需遵守本条要求。
Translation: Ship reporting systems that have not been submitted to and approved by this Organization are not required to comply with the provisions of this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，鼓励实施这种系统的缔约国政府尽可能遵循本组织制定的指南和衡准①。
Translation: However, the Contracting Governments implementing such systems are encouraged to follow the guidelines and standards established by this Organization as much as possible.

Query_Text_cn: 各缔约国政府可向本组织提交这种系统由本组织认可。
Translation: Contracting Governments may submit such systems to the Organization, which shall be recognized by it.

Query_Text_cn: 5如果两国或两国以上政府共同关注某一特定区域，应在他们之间达成协议的基础上制定一个经协调的船舶报告系统的提案。
Translation: If two or more governments have a common interest in a specific area, they shall develop a coordinated ship reporting system proposal on the basis of an agreement among them.

Query_Text_cn: 在着手通过船舶报告系统的提案以前，本组织应向在该系统覆盖的区域内具有共同利益的那些缔约国政府通报该提案的详细内容。
Translation: Before proceeding to adopt the proposal for a ship reporting system, the Organization shall notify the contracting Governments with a common interest within the area covered by the system of the details of the proposal.

Query_Text_cn: 如果通过并建立了一个经协调的船舶报告系统，则该系统应具有统一的程序和操作。
Translation: If adopted and established, the coordinated ship reporting system should have uniform procedures and operations.

Query_Text_cn: 6在按本条的要求通过船舶报告系统后，各有关国家政府应采取所有必要的措施公布有效使用该系统所需的任何资料。
Translation: 6. After complying with the requirements of this provision regarding the ship reporting system, the relevant national authorities shall take all necessary measures to publish any information required for the effective use of the system.

Query_Text_cn: 任何已通过的船舶报告系统应具有相互交流的能力以及在必要时为船舶提供资料的能力。
Translation: All approved ship reporting systems shall have the capability for mutual communication and the capability to provide ships with information when necessary.

Query_Text_cn: 这种系统应按照本组织根据本条的要求制定的指南和衡准2进行操作。
Translation: This system shall be operated in accordance with the guidelines and standards/criteria established by the organization in compliance with the requirements of this provision.

Query_Text_cn: 7船长应遵守所通过的各个船舶报告系统的要求，并按其中每一系统的规定向有关当局报告所要求的所有资料。
Translation: The master shall comply with the requirements of the applicable vessel reporting systems and report all required information to the competent authorities in accordance with the provisions of each such system.

Query_Text_cn: 8所有已通过的船舶报告系统和为实施这些系统所采取的行动应符合国际法，包括联合国海洋法公约的有关规定。
Translation: All established ship reporting systems and the measures taken to implement these systems shall conform to international law, including the relevant provisions of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).

Query_Text_cn: 9本条及其相关指南和衡准的任何内容均不应侵害各国政府根据国际法或关于国际航行海峡及群岛海道的法律体系所具有的权利和义务。
Translation: Article 9, its associated guidelines and standards shall not prejudice the rights and obligations of States Parties under international law or the legal framework governing international straits and archipelagic sea lanes.

Query_Text_cn: 10船舶按已通过的船舶报告系统的规定加入系统，应对有关船舶免收费用。
Translation: Ships joining the system in accordance with the established ship reporting system regulations shall be exempt from charges.

Query_Text_cn: 11本组织应确保根据本组织制定的指南和衡准，对已通过的船舶报告系统进行审核。
Translation: 11 This Organization shall ensure that approved ship reporting systems are reviewed in accordance with the guidelines and criteria established by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 1船舶交通服务（VTS）有利于海上人命安全、航行安全及效率和/或保护海洋环境、附近岸上区域、工地和海上设施免受海洋运输可能带来的不利影响。
Translation: The Vessel Traffic Service (VTS) contributes to maritime safety of life at sea, navigational safety and efficiency, and/or the protection of the marine environment, nearby coastal areas, construction sites, and offshore installations from the adverse impacts of marine transportation.

Query_Text_cn: 2缔约国政府承担义务，在其认为因交通量和危险程度而需要船舶交通服务的场所作出建立这种服务的安排。
Translation: 2 Contracting Governments undertake the obligation to establish vessel traffic services (VTS) in areas where they determine that such services are necessary due to traffic volume and the degree of hazard.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.43(64)决议通过并以MSC.111(73)决议修正的指南和衡准。
Translation: See the guidelines and criteria adopted by resolution MSC.43(64) and amended by resolution MSC.111(73) of the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 3缔约国政府规划和实施船舶交通服务，应尽可能遵循守本组织制定的指南①。
Translation: 3. Contracting Governments planning and implementing vessel traffic services should as far as possible adhere to the guidelines established by this Organization.①

Query_Text_cn: 船舶交通服务的使用，仅在沿海国家领海所属的海域内才可作为强制性要求。
Translation: The use of vessel traffic services may only be mandated within the territorial seas of coastal states.

Query_Text_cn: 4各缔约国政府应确保悬挂其国旗的船舶参予船舶交通服务并遵守该服务的规定。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall ensure that ships flying its flag participate in the vessel traffic service and comply with the regulations of the service.

Query_Text_cn: 5本条或本组织通过的指南之任何内容均不侵害各国政府根据国际法或关于国际航行海峡及群岛海道的法律体系所具有的权利和义务。
Translation: The provisions of this Article or the guidelines adopted by this Organization shall not impair the rights and obligations of States in accordance with international law or the legal framework governing international straits and archipelagic sea lanes.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，在其认为可行和必要时，根据交通量和危险程度的需要，单独或与其他缔约国政府合作提供助航设备。
Translation: Each Contracting Government shall undertake to provide aids to navigation at such times as they deem feasible and necessary, in accordance with the requirements of traffic volume and degree of hazard, individually or in cooperation with other Contracting Governments.

Query_Text_cn: 2为尽最大可能达到助航设备的一致性，缔约国政府承担义务在设置这些助航设备时，注意到国际上的建议和指南②。
Translation: Contracting Governments undertake obligations to establish these aids to navigation in accordance with international recommendations and guidelines② to the greatest extent possible, so as to ensure consistency among such aids.

Query_Text_cn: 3缔约国政府承担义务，安排向所有有关方面提供与助航设备有关的信息。
Translation: Contracting Governments shall undertake to arrange for the provision of information concerning navigational aids to all concerned parties.

Query_Text_cn: 会对船上所设接收机的性能产生不利影响的定位系统发送的变化，应尽可能避免并仅在及时和适当地发布通告之后才可起作用。
Translation: Changes to the positioning system transmission that could adversely affect the performance of receivers installed on board should be avoided as much as possible and may only take effect after timely and appropriate notices have been duly issued.

Query_Text_cn: 1各缔约国政府承担义务，各自对本国船舶保持实行或在必要时采取措施，以确保所有船舶从海上人命安全观点出发，配备足够数量和胜任的船员③。
Translation: The Governments of Contracting States undertake to maintain measures for their respective ships or take such measures when necessary to ensure that all ships are provided with a sufficient number of adequately qualified crew from the standpoint of maritime safety of life at sea③.

Query_Text_cn: 2本公约第I章适用的每艘船舶，应备有1份由主管机关颁发的适当的最少安全配员证明或等效证明，作为符合本条1之规定所需的最少安全配员的凭证。
Translation: Each ship to which Chapter I of this Convention applies shall have on board an appropriate minimum safe manning certificate or equivalent document issued by the competent authority as evidence of compliance with the requirement for minimum safe manning prescribed in paragraph 1 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 3在所有船舶上，为确保船员在安全事务上起到有效作用，应规定一种工作语言并将其记录在船舶航海日志上。
Translation: On all ships, a common working language shall be designated to ensure that crew members can effectively contribute to safety matters, and such designation shall be recorded in the ship’s official logbook.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约第IX/1条所定义的公司或船长（合适者）应确定适当的工作语言。
Translation: The company or the master (as appropriate), as defined in Article IX/1 of this Convention, shall determine the appropriate working language.

Query_Text_cn: 应要求每个船员能懂得这种语言，并在合适情况下使用这种语言下达指令和指示以及应答。
Translation: Each crew member shall be required to be proficient in this language and use it to issue commands, instructions, and respond in appropriate circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该工作语言不是船旗国的官方语言，则所有需张贴的图纸和图表内应有该工作语言的译文。
Translation: If the working language is not an official language of the flag State, all drawings and charts required to be posted shall include translations in the working language.

Query_Text_cn: 4在本公约第I章适用的船舶上，英语应作为驾驶台的工作语言，用以进行驾驶台对驾驶台、驾驶台对岸的安全通信以及用于引航员和驾驶台值班人员④之间在船上的通信，除非直接参与通信的人员都讲英语以外的一种共同语言。
Translation: English shall be used as the working language on the bridge of ships to which Chapter I of this Convention applies, for the purpose of conducting bridge-to-bridge, bridge-to-shore safety communications and communications on board the ship between pilots and bridge watchkeeping personnel④, unless all persons directly involved in the communication share a common language other than English.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织以A.857(20)决议通过的《船舶交通服务指南》。
Translation: Refer to the Organization's Guidelines for Vessel Traffic Services as adopted by Resolution A.857(20).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见IALA的相应建议和指南，以及SN/Circ.107通函《海上浮标系统》。
Translation: ② See IALA’s relevant recommendations and guidelines, as well as the SN/Circ.107 Circular "Maritime Buoyage System".

Query_Text_cn: ③参见本组织以A.890(21)决议通过并以A.955(23)决议修正的《安全配员原则》。
Translation: ③ See the Organization’s Principles of Safe Manning, adopted by Resolution A.890(21) and amended by Resolution A.955(23).

Query_Text_cn: ④为此可使用经修正的《IMO标准海上通信用语》（A.918(22)决议）。
Translation: For this purpose, the amended IMO Standard Marine Communication Phrases (Resolution A.918(22)) may be used.

Query_Text_cn: 3使驾驶台工作人员和引航员能够方便和连续地访问重要信息。
Translation: 3 Enables bridge staff and pilots to conveniently and continuously access critical information.

Query_Text_cn: 7通过监视和报警系统最大限度降低人为错误的风险并在发生人为错误时可探测到，以使驾驶台工作人员和引航员及时采取相应行动。
Translation: Through monitoring and alarm systems to minimize the risk of human error and detect such errors when they occur, so that bridge personnel and pilots can promptly take corresponding actions.

Query_Text_cn: 1应具有使主管机关满意的适当安排，以确保本章所要求设备的性能得到维护。
Translation: 1 shall have appropriate arrangements satisfactory to the competent authority to ensure that the performance of the equipment required under this Chapter is maintained.

Query_Text_cn: 2除第I/7(b)(ii)、I/8和I/9条规定者外，虽应采取一切合理措施以保持本章所要求的设备处于有效工作状态，但不应把这些设备的功能失常视为船舶不适航，或作为将船舶滞留在不易提供维修设施的港口的理由，只要船长在计划和实行一个安全航程以将船舶驶往可以进行维修的港口时注意到无法工作的设备或不可得到的信息，并作了适当的安排。
Translation: Except as provided in regulations I/7(b)(ii), I/8, and I/9, although all reasonable measures shall be taken to maintain equipment required by this Chapter in an effective operational state, such equipment's malfunction shall not be deemed as unseaworthiness of the ship, nor shall it constitute grounds for detaining the vessel in a port where repair facilities are not readily available, provided that the master has taken account of the non-functional equipment or unavailable information in planning and executing a safe voyage to a port where repairs can be effected, and has made appropriate arrangements.

Query_Text_cn: 1各国主管机关应确保安装在2002年7月1日或以后建造的船舶上，位于驾驶台或邻近驾驶台的所有电气和电子设备，应结合本组织制定的建议案②，进行电磁兼容性试验。
Translation: Competent authorities of all States shall ensure that all electrical and electronic equipment installed on board ships constructed on or after 1 July 2002, located in or adjacent to the bridge, undergo electromagnetic compatibility testing in accordance with the recommendations② of this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2电气和电子设备的安装应使电磁干扰不会影响航行系统和设备的正常功能。
Translation: 2. The installation of electrical and electronic equipment shall ensure that electromagnetic interference does not affect the normal functioning of navigational systems and equipment.

Query_Text_cn: 3如果便携式电气和电子设备可能影响航行系统和设备的正常功能，则其不应在驾驶台进行操作。
Translation: If portable electrical and electronic devices may interfere with the normal operation of navigation systems and equipment, they shall not be operated on the bridge.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见《驾驶台设备和布置的人机工程学衡准指南》（MSC/Circ.982号通函）和IBS性能标准（MSC.64(67)决议，附件1）及INS性能标准（MSC.86(70)决议，附件3）。
Translation: See the Ergonomic Guidelines for Bridge Equipment and Arrangements (MSC/Circ.982ircular), the Integrated Bridge System (IBS) Performance Standards (Resolution MSC.64(67), Annex 1), and the Integrated Navigation System (INS) Performance Standards (Resolution MSC.86(70), Annex 3).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.813(19)决议通过的《所有船用电气和电子设备电磁兼容性的一般要求》。
Translation: See the General Requirements for Electromagnetic Compatibility of All Marine Electrical and Electronic Equipment adopted by this Organization through resolution A.813(19).

Query_Text_cn: 1需满足本章第19条和20条要求的系统和设备应为主管机关认可的型式。
Translation: Systems and equipment that meet the requirements of Paragraphs 19 and 20 of this chapter shall be of types recognized by the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 2在2002年7月1日或以后安装，用于执行第19条和20条的功能要求的系统和设备，包括相关的后备装置（如适用），其所达到的相应性能标准应不低于本组织通过的性能标准①。
Translation: Systems and equipment installed on or after July 1, 2002, intended to fulfill the functional requirements specified in Articles 19 and 20, including related backup devices (where applicable), shall achieve corresponding performance standards that are not lower than those performance standards① adopted by this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 《关于船舶首向发送装置（THDs）性能标准的建议案》（MSC.116(73)决议）。
Translation: "Recommendation on Performance Standards for Thrust Direction Indicators (THDs) (Resolution MSC.116(73))"

Query_Text_cn: 3当在2002年7月1日以前建造的船舶上替换或添加系统和设备时，这些系统和设备应在合理和可行的范围内符合本条2的要求。
Translation: When replacing or adding systems and equipment on ships constructed before July 1, 2002, such systems and equipment shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 2 of this section to the extent reasonable and practicable.

Query_Text_cn: 4在本组织通过相关的性能标准之前安装的系统和设备，主管机关在充分考虑了本组织通过的建议衡准后，可以对其免除完全符合这种标准的要求。
Translation: Systems and equipment installed before the adoption of relevant performance standards by this Organization may be exempted by the competent authorities from the requirement to fully comply with such standards, provided that the recommended criteria adopted by this Organization have been fully taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，对于视为满足19.2.1.4条之海图配备要求的电子海图显示与信息系统（ECDIS），该系统所达到的相关性能标准应不低于本组织所通过且在其安装之日有效的性能标准，或者，对于在1999年1月1日以前安装的系统，应不低于本组织在1995年11月23日通过的性能标准①。
Translation: However, for Electronic Chart Display and Information Systems (ECDIS) regarded as meeting the chart carriage requirements of paragraph 19.2.1.4, the relevant performance standards achieved by such systems shall not be lower than the performance standards adopted by the Organization and in effect on the date of their installation. For systems installed before January 1, 1999, the performance standards shall not be lower than those adopted by the Organization on November 23, 1995①.

Query_Text_cn: 5主管机关应要求制造商具有一个由适任机构审核的质量控制系统，以确保持续符合型式认可条件。
Translation: Competent authorities shall require manufacturers to have a quality control system audited by a competent body to ensure continuous compliance with type approval conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 作为替代，主管机关可以在该产品安装上船之前使用最终产品验证程序，由适任机构验证其是否符合型式认可证书。
Translation: As an alternative, the competent authority may use the final product verification procedure prior to installation on board to have the qualified body verify whether it complies with the type approval certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 6在对具有本章未涉及之新特征的航行系统或设备认可之前，主管机关应确保这种特征对功能的支持与本章所要求者至少同样有效。
Translation: Before approving navigational systems or equipment having new features not addressed in this chapter, the competent authority shall ensure that such features provide support for the functions at least as effective as those required in this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 7如果除第19条和20条要求的各项设备以外，船上还配有本组织已制定性能标准的设备，则这种设备应经过认可且所达到的性能标准应尽实际可能不低于本组织通过的性能标准。
Translation: If the ship is equipped with any equipment for which performance standards have been established by the Organization in addition to the equipment required under Articles 19 and 20, such equipment shall be recognized and the performance standards attained shall be to the greatest extent practicable not lower than those adopted by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 8航行数据记录仪系统，包括所有传感器，应作年度性能试验。
Translation: 8. The Voyage Data Recorder (VDR) system, including all sensors, shall undergo annual performance tests.

Query_Text_cn: 试验应由认可的试验或检修机构进行，以验证所记录数据的精度、持续时间和可恢复性。
Translation: The tests shall be conducted by accredited testing or maintenance organizations to verify the accuracy, duration, and recoverability of the recorded data.

Query_Text_cn: 另外还应进行试验和检查，以确定所有防护外罩和辅助定位装置的适用性。
Translation: Additionally, tests and inspections should be conducted to determine the suitability of all protective covers and auxiliary positioning devices.

Query_Text_cn: 船上应保留1份由试验机构颁发的载明符合日期和适用性能标准的符合证书，应有一份副本保留在船上。
Translation: A copy of the certificate of compliance issued by the testing authority, specifying the date of compliance and applicable performance standards, shall be retained on board. A copy thereof shall also be kept on board.

Query_Text_cn: 1.1在2002年7月1日或以后建造的船舶，应配备满足本条2.1至2.9规定要求的航行系统和设备。
Translation: Ships constructed on or after July 1, 2002 shall be equipped with navigational systems and equipment meeting the requirements specified in paragraphs 2.1 to 2.9 of this paragraph.

Query_Text_cn: ①《关于电子海图显示与信息系统（ECDIS）性能标准的建议案》（A.817(19)决议）。
Translation: Recommendation Concerning Performance Standards for Electronic Chart Display and Information Systems (ECDIS), Resolution A.817(19)

Query_Text_cn: 3不迟于本条2.4.2和2.4.3规定的日期，配备本条2.4要求的系统。
Translation: 3. Not later than the dates specified in Sections 2.4.2 and 2.4.3 of this Article, install the system required under Section 2.4 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 91部电话，或其他装置，用与向应急操舵位置（如设有）传递首向信息。
Translation: A 91-telephone or other device for transmitting course information to the emergency steering position (where provided).

Query_Text_cn: ①合适的对开纸质航海图可作为ECDIS的后备装置。
Translation: Suitable full-size paper nautical charts can serve as a backup for an ECDIS.

Query_Text_cn: 可接受ECDIS的其他后备装置（见经修正的A.817(19)决议的附录6）。
Translation: Other acceptable alternative equipment for ECDIS (See Appendix 6 to resolution A.817(19) as amended).

Query_Text_cn: 21套白昼信号灯，或其他装置，用于在白天和夜晚通过灯光进行联络，使用电源，但非唯一依靠船上电源供电。
Translation: 21 sets of daylight signal lights or equivalent devices, designed for communication during both day and night through lighting, utilizing power sources but not solely dependent on the vessel's own power supply.

Query_Text_cn: 51台经过适当校正的首向传送装置，或其他装置，用于传送首向信息以输入到本条2.3.2、2.3.3和2.4所述的设备中。
Translation: 51 properly calibrated heading transmission devices, or other devices, for transmitting heading information to be input into the equipment specified in paragraphs 2.3.2, 2.3.3, and 2.4 of this Section.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见第I/8条。
Translation: ① See Article I/8.

Query_Text_cn: ②第一次安全设备检验系指安全设备的第一次年度检验、第一次定期检验或第一次换证检验，以在2004年7月1日以后先到期者为准，此外，对于在建船舶，系指初次检验。
Translation: The first survey of safety equipment refers to its first annual survey, first intermediate survey, or first certificate renewal survey, whichever occurs first after July 1, 2004. Additionally, for ships under construction, it refers to the initial survey.

Query_Text_cn: 7AIS的操作应考虑到本组织通过的指南21。
Translation: The operation of 7AIS should take into account Guideline 21 adopted by this organization.

Query_Text_cn: 配备AIS的船舶应使AIS始终保持运行状态，但国际协定、规则或标准规定要保护航行信息的情况除外。
Translation: Vessels equipped with AIS shall keep AIS operational at all times except when international agreements, regulations, or standards require the protection of navigational information.

Query_Text_cn: 31台电罗经方位复视器，或其他装置，通过使用上述.1所述的电罗经或其他装置，在水平360o弧度范围内量取方位。
Translation: 31 units of electronic compass azimuth duplex indicators, or other devices, using the electronic compass or other devices as specified in.1 above, to take bearings within a horizontal arc of 360 degrees.

Query_Text_cn: 51台自动跟踪仪，或其他装置，用于自动标绘其他目标的距离和方位，以确定碰撞危险。
Translation: 51 units of automatic tracking devices or other equipment designed to automatically plot the distance and bearing of other targets to determine collision hazards.

Query_Text_cn: 1本章适用于因其对船舶或船上人员的特别危害而需在本规则所适用的一切船舶上，及小于500总吨的货船上采取特别预防措施的货物的装运（散装液体、散装气体和其他章内已作出装运规定的除外）。
Translation: This Chapter applies to cargoes whose carriage requires special precautionary measures on all ships to which these Rules apply and on ships of less than 500 gross tons, excluding bulk liquids, bulk gases, and other cargoes for which carriage requirements are specified in other Chapters.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，对小于500总吨的货船，如果主管机关认为因航行的遮蔽性和条件，应用本章A部分或B部分的任何具体要求是不合理或不必要的，则可采取能够确保这些船舶所需安全的其他有效措施。
Translation: However, for cargo ships of less than 500 gross tonnage, if the competent authority considers that the application of any specific requirement of Part A or Part B of this Chapter is unreasonable or unnecessary due to navigational sheltered conditions and circumstances, it may adopt alternative effective measures to ensure the required level of safety for such ships.

Query_Text_cn: 2作为本章A部分和B部分规定的补充，每一缔约国政府应保证提供有关货物及其堆装和系固的适当资料，特别说明安全装运此类货物所必需的预防措施。
Translation: 2. As a supplement to the provisions of Parts A and B of this Chapter, each Contracting Government shall ensure the provision of appropriate information regarding the cargo, its stowage and securing, specifically indicating the preventive measures necessary for the safe carriage of such cargo.

Query_Text_cn: 1发货人应在装货前及早向船长或其代表提供关于该货物的适当资料，以便能实施为此种货物的适当堆装和安全装运可能是必需的预防措施。
Translation: The shipper shall provide the master or his representative with appropriate information regarding the cargo in good time prior to loading, in order to enable the implementation of preventive measures that may be necessary for the proper stowage and safe carriage of such cargo.

Query_Text_cn: 此类资料②应在货物装船前以书面形式③和适当的运输单证予以确认。
Translation: Such documents (Item ②) should be confirmed in writing (Item ③) along with appropriate transport documents prior to shipment.

Query_Text_cn: 1对于杂货和以货物单元运输的货物，应有货物的一般说明、货物或货物单元的毛重和货物的任何有关特性。
Translation: For general cargo and cargo transported in units, there should be a general description of the cargo, its gross weight, and any relevant characteristics of the cargo.

Query_Text_cn: 就本条而言，应提供本组织以A.714(17)决议通过并可能经修正的《货物堆装和系固安全操作规则》第1.9节所要求的货物资料。
Translation: For the purposes of this provision, the cargo information required under section 1.9 of the Safety Operational Code for Cargo Stowage and Securing, as adopted by resolution A.714(17) and as may be amended, shall be provided to the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 2对于散装货物，应有关于货物积载因数、平舱方法、移动的可能性（包括稳定角,如适用）以及任何其他有关特性的资料。
Translation: For bulk cargo, information shall include the stowage factor, trimming methods, possibility of shifting (including angle of repose where applicable), and any other relevant characteristics.

Query_Text_cn: 3本组织以A.434(XI)决议通过的经修正的《固体散装货物安全操作规则(BC规则)》。
Translation: 3. The Organization adopted the revised Code for the Safe Carriage of Solid Bulk Cargoes (BC Code) through Resolution A.434(XI).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见MSC/Circ.663通函《货物资料表》。
Translation: See MSC Circular 663, 'Cargo Declaration Form'.

Query_Text_cn: ③本条所指的单证并不排除作为书面文件的一种辅助手段而使用电子数据处理（EDP）和电子数据交换（EDI）的传输技术。
Translation: The documents referred to in this provision do not exclude the use of electronic data processing (EDP) and electronic data interchange (EDI) transmission technologies as an auxiliary means for written documents.

Query_Text_cn: 3对于未按第VII/1.1条所定义的IMDG规则的规定分类，但具有可能造成潜在危害的化学性质的散装货物，除上述各项要求的资料外，还应有关于其化学性质的资料。
Translation: For bulk cargo that has not been classified in accordance with the IMDG Code as defined in Article VII/1.1 but possesses chemical properties with the potential to cause harm, information regarding their chemical properties shall also be included along with the information specified above.

Query_Text_cn: 3在货物单元装船前，发货人应确保这类货物单元的毛重与运输单证中表明的毛重是一致的。
Translation: Before loading, the shipper shall ensure that the gross mass of such cargo units is consistent with that stated in the transport documents.

Query_Text_cn: 1在运输可能释放有毒或易燃气体或可能在货物处所中造成氧气耗尽的散装货物时，应备有测量空气中这类气体或氧气浓度的适当仪器，及其详细的使用说明书。
Translation: When transporting bulk cargo that may release toxic or flammable gases or cause oxygen depletion in cargo spaces, appropriate instruments for measuring the concentration of such gases or oxygen in the air, along with detailed instructions for their use, shall be provided.

Query_Text_cn: 这种仪器应使主管机关满意。
Translation: The instrument should satisfy the competent authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 2主管机关应采取措施，确保船员在上述仪器使用方面受到培训。
Translation: 2. Competent authorities shall take measures to ensure that crew members are trained in the use of the aforementioned instruments.

Query_Text_cn: 在船上使用杀虫剂，尤其是为熏舱而使用杀虫剂时，应采取适当预防措施。
Translation: When using insecticides on board ships, especially for fumigation purposes, appropriate preventive measures should be taken.

Query_Text_cn: 1在甲板上和甲板下装运的货物、货物单元②和货物运输单元③，其装载、堆装和系固应尽可能防止在整个航程中对船舶和船上人员造成损害或危险，以及防止货物落水灭失。
Translation: The loading, stowage, and securing of cargo, cargo units②, and transport units for cargo③ carried on deck and under deck shall be arranged in such a manner as to prevent as far as possible damage or danger to the ship and crew throughout the entire voyage, and to prevent cargo from being lost overboard.

Query_Text_cn: 2货物、货物单元和货物运输单元，其在单元中的包装和系固，应能防止在整个航程中对船舶和船上人员造成损害或危险。
Translation: 2. Cargo, cargo units, and transport units for cargo, their packaging and securing within the units, shall be such that they prevent damage or hazard to the ship and personnel on board throughout the voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 3在重型货物或异常外形尺寸货物的装载和运输过程中，应采取适当的预防措施，确保不发生船舶结构性损坏，并在整个航程中保持足够的稳性。
Translation: Appropriate preventive measures shall be taken during the loading and transportation process of heavy cargo or cargo with abnormal dimensions or configurations to ensure no structural damage occurs to the vessel and to maintain sufficient stability throughout the entire voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 4在滚装船上货物单元和货物运输单元的装载和运输过程中，应采取适当的预防措施，特别是注意这种船上和货物单元和货物运输单元上的系固装置，以及系固点和捆索的强度。
Translation: During the loading and transportation processes of cargo units and transport units on roll-on/roll-off vessels, appropriate preventive measures shall be taken, particularly paying attention to the securing devices on board such ships and on the cargo units and transport units, as well as the strength of the securing points and lashings.

Query_Text_cn: 5货运集装箱的装载应不超过经修正的《国际集装箱安全公约》（CSC）规定的安全核准牌上注明的最大总重量。
Translation: The loading of freight containers must not exceed the maximum total weight specified on the safety approval plaques issued in accordance with the amended International Convention for Safe Containers (CSC).

Query_Text_cn: 6在整个航程中，除散装固体和液体货物以外的所有货物、货物单元和货物运输单元，应按照主管机关认可的《货物系固手册》进行装载、堆装和系固。
Translation: All cargoes, cargo units, and cargo transport units, except for bulk solid and liquid cargoes, shall be stowed, stacked, and secured in accordance with the Cargo Securing Manual recognized by the competent authority throughout the entire voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 对于具有第II-2/3.41条定义的滚装处所的船舶，应在离开泊位之前按照《货物系固手册》完成所有这些货物、货物单元和货物运输单元的系固。
Translation: For ships with roll-on/roll-off spaces as defined in Regulation II-2/3.41, all such cargo, cargo units, and cargo transport units must be secured in accordance with the Cargo Securing Manual prior to leaving the berth.

Query_Text_cn: 《货物系固手册》的编制标准应至少与本组织制定的相关指南④相当。
Translation: The compilation standards of the Cargo Securing Manual shall be no less than those of the relevant guidelines④ established by the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见经修正的IMO《关于在船上安全使用杀虫剂的建议案》。
Translation: ① Refer to the revised IMO Recommendations on the Safe Use of Pesticides on Board Ships.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.714(17)决议通过的经修正的《货物堆装和系固安全操作规则》。
Translation: ② See the revised *Safety Operational Rules for Cargo Stowage and Securing* adopted by this Organization through resolution A.714(17).

Query_Text_cn: ③参见本组织以MSC.122(75)决议通过的《国际海运危险货物（IMDG）规则》。
Translation: ③ See the International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code, adopted by resolution MSC.122(75) of this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ④参见《货物系固手册编制指南》（MSC/Circ.745通函）。
Translation: 4. See the "Cargo Securing Manual Preparation Guidelines" (MSC/Circ.745 Circular).

Query_Text_cn: 1在散装货物装船前，船长应得到关于船舶稳性和标准装载条件下货物分布的综合资料。
Translation: Prior to loading bulk cargo, the master shall be provided with comprehensive documentation regarding the ship’s stability and cargo distribution under standard loading conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 提供此种资料的方法，应使主管机关满意。
Translation: The method of providing such materials shall satisfy the competent authorities.

Query_Text_cn: 2对浓缩物或可液化的其他货物，只有当其实际含水量小于其可运含水极限时才能被接受装船。
Translation: 2. Concentrates and other liquefiable cargoes shall only be accepted for loading when their actual moisture content is less than their transportable moisture limit.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，如果作出了使主管机关满意的安全布置，确保在货物移动时有足够的稳性而且船舶具有充分的结构完整性，则即使其含水量超过了上述极限，仍可接受此种浓缩物和其他货物装船。
Translation: However, if safety arrangements satisfactory to the competent authority are made to ensure sufficient stability during cargo movement and the ship has adequate structural integrity, such concentrates and other cargoes may be accepted for shipment even if their moisture content exceeds the aforementioned limits.

Query_Text_cn: 3对于未按第VII/1.1条所定义的IMDG规则的规定分类，但具有可能造成潜在危害的化学性质的散装货物，在装船之前应对其安全运输采取特别预防措施。
Translation: For bulk cargoes that have not been classified in accordance with the IMDG Code as defined in Section VII/1.1 but possess chemical properties that may pose potential hazards, special precautionary measures shall be taken prior to loading to ensure their safe transport.

Query_Text_cn: 1就本条而言，码头代表系指船舶装卸货物的码头或其他设施使用方指定的人员，其负责这个码头或设施对该特定船舶进行作业。
Translation: For the purposes of this provision, "wharf representative" means the designated personnel appointed by the user of the wharf or other facility engaged in cargo loading and unloading operations, who is responsible for the operations of such wharf or facility in relation to the specific vessel.

Query_Text_cn: 2为能使船长防止船体结构中产生过大应力，应给船舶配备一本手册，并应采用为负责货物作业的高级船员所熟悉的语言编写。
Translation: To enable the captain to prevent excessive stresses from developing in the ship's structure, the vessel shall be provided with a manual, which shall be written in a language familiar to senior crew members responsible for cargo operations.

Query_Text_cn: 如该种语言不是英文，则船上也应配备一本用英文写成的手册。
Translation: If the language in question is not English, a manual written in English should also be provided on board.

Query_Text_cn: 2本组织以A.562(14)决议通过的《关于船长24m及以上客船和货船完整稳性的突风和横摇衡准(气象衡准)的建议案》。
Translation: The Recommendation on the Criteria for Wind Waves and Roll Motion (Meteorological Criteria) for Intact Stability of Passenger Ships and Cargo Ships of 24 Meters in Length and Above, adopted by the Organization through Resolution A.562(14).

Query_Text_cn: ②参见本组织以A.862(20)决议通过的《散货船安全装卸操作规则(BLU规则)》。
Translation: ② See the Code of Safe Practice for Cargo Operations on Bulk Carriers (BLU Code) adopted by this Organization through resolution A.862(20).

Query_Text_cn: 7如要求强度计算，在装卸货物及航行期间船体上的最大许用载荷和力矩。
Translation: If a strength calculation is required, the maximum permissible loads and moments on the hull during the loading and unloading of cargo and navigation shall be specified.

Query_Text_cn: 3固体散装货物在装货或卸货之前，船长和码头代表应商定一项计划①，该计划应确保在装卸货物期间不超过船上的许用应力和力矩，同时还应包括装卸货物的次序、数量及速率,此时应考虑到装卸货物的速度、船上添注口的数量及减压载或加压载的能力。
Translation: Before loading or unloading solid bulk cargo, the Master and the terminal representative shall agree on a plan (①), which shall ensure that during cargo operations, the vessel's allowable stresses and moments are not exceeded. The plan shall include the sequence, quantity, and rate of loading or unloading, taking into account loading/unloading speed, the number of onboard injection ports, and the capacity for de-ballasting or ballasting.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划及其后的任何修改，应提交给港口国的有关当局。
Translation: The plan and any subsequent modifications shall be submitted to the competent authorities of the port State.

Query_Text_cn: 4散装货物应在整个货物处所范围内装载并按需要合理平舱，以尽量减少货物移动的危险，并确保在整个航行期间保持足够的稳性。
Translation: 4 Bulk cargo shall be loaded throughout the cargo spaces and properly trimmed as necessary to minimize the risk of cargo shifting, and ensure sufficient stability is maintained throughout the voyage.

Query_Text_cn: 5在甲板间舱装载散装货物时，如果装载资料表明船底结构在舱口开启时的应力会达到不可接受的程度，则这些甲板间的舱口应关闭。
Translation: When loading bulk cargo in deck inter compartments, if the loading data indicates that the stresses on the hull structure during the opening of the hatch would reach an unacceptable level, these deck hatches shall be closed.

Query_Text_cn: 应将货物合理平舱，并应延伸到两舷，或用具有足够强度的附加纵向隔壁加以固定。
Translation: The cargo shall be properly trimmed and shall extend to both sides of the vessel, or secured with additional longitudinal bulkheads of sufficient strength.

Query_Text_cn: 应注意甲板间舱的安全承载能力，以确保甲板结构不过载。
Translation: Attention should be paid to the safe load capacity of the deckhouse to ensure that the deck structure is not overloaded.

Query_Text_cn: 6船长和码头代表应确保装卸货物作业按照商定的计划进行。
Translation: 6 The Captain and the terminal representative shall ensure that cargo loading and unloading operations are conducted in accordance with the agreed plan.

Query_Text_cn: 7如果在装卸货物期间，本条2所述的对船舶的任一限制已经超出或者如果装卸继续进行下去可能导致超出，则船长有权中止装卸作业并有责任将此通知给批准这个计划的港口国有关当局。
Translation: If during the loading and unloading of cargo any of the restrictions on the vessel specified in Paragraph 2 of this Clause have been exceeded, or if continuation of loading and unloading may result in such exceeding, the Master has the right to suspend the loading and unloading operations and is obligated to notify the relevant authorities of the port State that approved this plan.

Query_Text_cn: 船长和码头代表应确保采取纠正措施。
Translation: The captain and the terminal representative should ensure that corrective measures are taken.

Query_Text_cn: 当卸货时，船长和码头代表应确保卸货方法不损坏船体结构。
Translation: When discharging cargo, the captain and terminal representative should ensure that the cargo discharge method does not damage the vessel’s structure.

Query_Text_cn: 8船长应确保船上人员连续不断地监视货物装卸作业。
Translation: 8. The master shall ensure that the ship's crew continuously monitor cargo loading and unloading operations.

Query_Text_cn: 如有可能，在装卸货物期间应定期校核吃水以确认提供的吨位数。
Translation: If possible, during cargo loading and unloading operations, the draft should be regularly monitored to confirm the declared tonnage.

Query_Text_cn: 每次测得的吃水和吨位数应记入货物日志。
Translation: Each measurement of draft and tonnage shall be recorded in the cargo logbook.

Query_Text_cn: 如发现与商定的计划有显著的偏差，则应调整货物装卸或压载作业，或两者，以确保偏差被纠正。
Translation: If a significant deviation from the agreed plan is detected, cargo handling operations, ballasting operations, or both shall be adjusted to ensure that the deviation is corrected.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织以A.862(20)决议通过的《散货船安全装卸操作规则(BLU规则)》。
Translation: See the Rules for Safe Loading and Unloading Operations of Bulk Carriers (BLU Rules) adopted under resolution A.862(20) of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 1国际谷物规则系指由本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.23(59)决议通过并可能经本组织修正的《国际散装谷物安全装运规则》，但这类修正案应按本公约第VIII条有关除第I章外适用的附则修正程序的规定予以通过、生效和实施。
Translation: The International Grain Code refers to the International Code for the Safe Carriage of Grain in Bulk adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization under resolution MSC.23(59) and as may be amended by the Organization, provided that such amendments shall be adopted, entered into force and implemented in accordance with the amendment procedures applicable to the Annexes of this Convention other than Chapter I as set out in Article VIII of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 2谷物一词包括小麦、玉蜀黍（苞米）、燕麦、稞麦、大麦、大米、豆类、种子以及由其加工而成并在自然状态下具有类似特征的制品。
Translation: The term "grains" includes wheat, corn (苞米), oats, rye, barley, rice, legumes, seeds, and products processed from the aforementioned grains and legumes that retain similar characteristics in their natural state.

Query_Text_cn: 1除本规则任何其他适用的要求外，装运谷物的货船还应符合《国际谷物规则》的要求，并持有1份按该规则要求的批准文件。
Translation: In addition to any other applicable requirements of this Code, cargo ships carrying grain shall comply with the requirements of the International Grain Code and hold one copy of the approval document required by the Code.

Query_Text_cn: 就本条而言，该规则的要求应强制性执行。
Translation: For the purposes of this provision, the requirements of this rule shall be enforced compulsorily.

Query_Text_cn: 2没有这种批准文件的船舶，在船长使主管机关或代表主管机关的装货港的缔约国政府确信该船所提出的装载情况符合《国际谷物规则》的要求之前，不应装载谷物。
Translation: Ships without such approval documents shall not load grain until the master has satisfied the competent authority or the Contracting Government of the port of loading acting on its behalf that the proposed loading arrangement of the ship complies with the requirements of the International Grain Code.

Query_Text_cn: 本章适用于所有核能船舶，但军用船舶除外。
Translation: This chapter applies to all nuclear-powered vessels except military vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 本公约的其他各章中的规则均适用于核能船舶，但经本章修订者除外。
Translation: The rules in the other chapters of this Convention apply to nuclear-powered vessels except as revised herein.

Query_Text_cn: 在任何情况下，核能船舶均应符合本公约的任何规则，不应被免除。
Translation: Under any circumstances, nuclear-powered ships shall comply with the provisions of this Convention and shall not be exempt therefrom.

Query_Text_cn: 核反应堆装置的设计、构造以及检查和装配的标准均应经主管机关认可和满意，并应考虑因辐射而使检验所受到的限制。
Translation: The standards for the design, construction, inspection, and assembly of nuclear reactors shall be approved and accepted by the competent authority and shall take into account the limitations imposed on inspections due to radiation.

Query_Text_cn: 设计核反应堆装置时，应考虑船舶在正常和异常两种航行情况下的特殊工作条件。
Translation: When designing nuclear reactor installations, specific operational conditions under both normal and abnormal navigation conditions of the vessel should be taken into account.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关应采取措施，确保在海上或港内不使船员、乘客或公众，或水道或食物或水源受到不当的辐射或其他的核能危害。
Translation: The competent authorities shall take measures to ensure that mariners, passengers, or members of the public, as well as waterways, food, or water sources are not subjected to unauthorized radiation or other nuclear hazards at sea or in port.

Query_Text_cn: (a)应编写安全鉴定书，以评定核动力装置的性能和船舶的安全，从而确保在海上或港内不使船员、乘客或公众，或水道或食物或水源受到不当的辐射或其他的核能危害。
Translation: (a) Safety assessment reports shall be prepared to assess the performance of the nuclear power plant and the safety of the vessel, so as to ensure that crew members, passengers, or the public, or waterways, food, or water sources are not subjected to improper radiation or other nuclear hazards at sea or in port.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关对鉴定书满意时，应予以认可，该鉴定书应始终保持更新。
Translation: When the competent authority is satisfied with the certification report, it shall endorse it, and the report shall remain updated at all times.

Query_Text_cn: (b)应提前足够的时间将安全鉴定书送交核能船舶拟驶往的缔约国政府，以供其评定该核能船舶的安全性。
Translation: (b) The safety appraisal certificate shall be submitted to the Contracting Government of the intended destination of the nuclear-powered ship in sufficient time in advance to allow it to assess the safety of the nuclear-powered ship.

Query_Text_cn: 应制订关于核动力装置的所有操作事项且着重于安全的操作手册，作为操作人员在工作时的参考和指导。
Translation: A manual covering all operational procedures for nuclear propulsion systems with a focus on safety should be developed to serve as a reference and guide for operators during their work.

Query_Text_cn: 主管机关对操作手册满意时，应予以认可。
Translation: When the competent authority is satisfied with the operating manual, it shall grant its approval.

Query_Text_cn: 应有一份操作手册保存在船上，且应始终保持更新。
Translation: There shall be an operating manual kept on board, and it shall always remain updated.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见《核能商船安全规则》（A.491(XII)决议），该规则补充了本章的要求。
Translation: ① See Safety Rules for Nuclear Merchant Ships (Resolution A.491(XII)), which supplements the requirements of this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 对核能船舶的检验应包括第I/7条或第I/8、9和10条中的适用要求，但对于因辐射而受到限制的检验除外。
Translation: The inspection of nuclear-powered ships shall include the applicable requirements of Chapter I/7 or Chapters I/8, I/9 and I/10, except for inspections restricted due to radiation.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，检验还应包括安全鉴定书的任何特殊要求。
Translation: Additionally, inspections should also include any specific requirements of safety certification documents.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然有第I/8条和10条的规定，但在所有情况下，对核能船舶的检验应不少于每年1次。
Translation: Although Articles I/8 and 10 apply, in all cases the inspection of nuclear-powered vessels shall be conducted no less than once per year.

Query_Text_cn: (a)第I/12(a)条及第I/14条的规定不适用于核能船舶。
Translation: (a) The provisions of Article I/12(a) and Article I/14 shall not apply to nuclear-powered ships.

Query_Text_cn: (b)对经检查和检验后符合第II-1章、第II-2章、第III章、第IV章和第VIII章的要求及本规则其他有关要求的核能客船，应签发核能客船安全证书。
Translation: (b) Nuclear passenger ships that comply with the requirements of Chapters II-1, II-2, III, IV and VIII and other relevant requirements of this Code after inspection and testing shall be issued a Nuclear Passenger Ship Safety Certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (c)对经检查和检验后满足第I/10条所规定的货船检验要求并符合第II-1章、第II-2章、第III章、第IV章和第VIII章的要求以及本规则其他有关要求的核能货船，应签发核能货船安全证书。
Translation: (c) Nuclear cargo ships that meet the requirements for cargo ship surveys specified in Regulation I/10 and comply with the requirements of Chapters II-1, II-2, III, IV and VIII and other relevant requirements of this Code shall be issued with a Nuclear Cargo Ship Safety Certificate.

Query_Text_cn: (d)在核能客船安全证书和核能货船安全证书中应阐明：“此船为核能船舶，此船符合公约第VIII章的所有要求，并与所认可的此船安全鉴定书相一致”。
Translation: (d) The Nuclear-Powered Passenger Ship Safety Certificate and the Nuclear-Powered Cargo Ship Safety Certificate shall state: "This ship is a nuclear-powered ship, complies with all requirements of Chapter VIII of the Convention, and is consistent with the recognized safety assessment certificate for this ship."

Query_Text_cn: (e)核能客船安全证书和核能货船安全证书的有效期限均不应超过12个月。
Translation: (e) The validity period of the Safety Certificate for Nuclear-Powered Passenger Vessels and the Safety Certificate for Nuclear-Powered Cargo Vessels shall not exceed 12 months.

Query_Text_cn: (f)核能客船安全证书和核能货船安全证书应由主管机关或由其正式授权的个人或机构签发。
Translation: (f) Safety certificates for nuclear-powered passenger vessels and safety certificates for nuclear-powered cargo vessels shall be issued by the competent authority or by a person or body formally authorized by it.

Query_Text_cn: 在所有情况下，主管机关应对该证书负全部责任。
Translation: In all cases, the competent authority shall bear full responsibility for the certificate.

Query_Text_cn: 除按第I/19条所规定的控制外，核能船舶在进入各缔约国港口之前以及在港时均应受到特殊控制，其目的是为证实船上已具备有效的核能船舶安全证书，并证实在海上或港内，该船对船员、乘客或公众，或对水道或食物或水源没有不当的辐射或其他的核能危害。
Translation: In addition to the controls prescribed under Article I/19, nuclear-powered vessels shall be subject to special controls prior to entering the ports of Contracting Parties and while in port. The purpose is to verify that the vessel holds valid nuclear-powered vessel safety certificates and to ensure that the vessel does not pose undue radiological or other nuclear hazards to crew, passengers, the public, or to waterways, food supplies, or water sources while at sea or in port.

Query_Text_cn: 当核能船舶发生任何可能导致危害周围环境的事故时，该船船长应立即报告主管机关。
Translation: When a nuclear-powered vessel is involved in any accident that may cause harm to the surrounding environment, the master of the vessel shall immediately report to the competent authority.

Query_Text_cn: 船长还应立即报告该船在损坏情况下可能处于的水域或驶往的水域所属国家政府的主管当局。
Translation: The master shall immediately report to the competent authority of the government of the State to which the waters where the ship may be located or proceeding to belong.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见IMO/IAEA《关于核能商船使用港口的安全建议》。
Translation: ① See IMO/IAEA *Safety Recommendations on the Use of Ports by Nuclear-Powered Merchant Ships*.

Query_Text_cn: 11994年高速船规则（1994HSC规则）系指由本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.36(63)决议通过的《国际高速船安全规则》。该规则可能由本组织修正，但这类修正案应按照本公约第VIII条有关的除第I章外适用的附则修正程序的规定予以通过、生效和实施。
Translation: The 1994 High-Speed Craft Code (1994 HSC Code) refers to the International Code for the Safety of High-Speed Craft adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of this Organization through resolution MSC.36(63). This Code may be amended by this Organization, but such amendments shall be adopted, entered into force, and implemented in accordance with the procedures for amendment of the annexes applicable other than Chapter I as provided in Article VIII of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 22000年高速船规则（2000HSC规则）系指由本组织海上安全委员会以MSC.97(73)决议通过的《2000年国际高速船安全规则》。该规则可能由本组织修正，但这类修正案应按照本公约第VIII条有关的除第I章外适用的附则修正程序的规定予以通过、生效和实施。
Translation: The 22000 High-Speed Craft Code (2000HSC Code) refers to the International Code of Safety for High-Speed Craft, 2000, adopted by the Maritime Safety Committee of this Organization through Resolution MSC.97(73). This Code may be amended by this Organization, but such amendments shall be adopted, entered into force and implemented in accordance with the provisions of Article VIII of this Convention concerning the amendment procedure applicable to the Annexes other than Chapter I.

Query_Text_cn: 式中：▽=相应于设计水线的排水量，m3。不包括在非排水状态下船体由地效应产生的气动升力完全支承在水面以上的船舶。
Translation: In the formula: ▽ = displacement volume corresponding to the design waterline, in cubic meters (m³). This excludes vessels where the hull is fully supported above the water surface by aerodynamic lift generated by ground effect under non-displacement conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 4建造的船系指安放龙骨或处于类似建造阶段的船。
Translation: 4. A vessel under construction means a ship where the keel has been laid or an equivalent stage of construction has been reached.

Query_Text_cn: 2该船业已开始的装配量至少为50t，或为全部结构材料估算重量的3%，取较小者。
Translation: The vessel's commenced assembly weight shall be no less than 50 tonnes or 3% of the estimated total weight of all structural materials, whichever is smaller.

Query_Text_cn: 2在其营运的航线上，满载时以其营运航速航行至避难地不超过8h的500总吨及以上的货船。
Translation: Cargo ships of 500 gross tons and above operating on routes where, when fully loaded, they can sail at their operational speed to reach a haven within a time not exceeding 8 hours.

Query_Text_cn: 2任何船，不论其建造日期，当进行修理、改装、改建以及与之有关的舾装时，应至少继续符合原适用于该船的要求。
Translation: Any ship, regardless of its construction date, shall continue to meet at least the original applicable requirements for the ship when undergoing repair, modification, conversion, and outfitting related to such activities.

Query_Text_cn: 在2002年7月1日以前建造的高速船，一般应符合对该日期或以后建造的船的要求，且至少能达到在对其修理、改装、改建或舾装之前的同等程度。
Translation: High-speed craft constructed before July 1, 2002 shall comply with the requirements applicable to ships constructed on or after that date, and at least meet the equivalent level prior to their repair, modification, conversion, or fitting-out.

Query_Text_cn: 对于重大的修理、改装、改建以及与之有关的舾装，在主管机关认为合理和可行的范围内，均应满足对2002年7月1日或以后建造的高速船的要求。
Translation: For major repairs, modifications, reconstructions, and related outfitting, within the scope deemed reasonable and feasible by the competent authority, all shall comply with the requirements applicable to high-speed craft constructed on or after 1 July 2002.

Query_Text_cn: 1在1996年1月1日或以后，但在2002年7月1日以前建造的高速船，如完全符合1994年高速船规则的要求，并按该规则的规定业已检验和发证，则其应视为符合第I章至第IV章及第V/18、19和20条的要求。
Translation: "High-speed craft constructed on or after January 1, 1996 but before July 1, 2002 shall be deemed to comply with the requirements of Chapters I to IV and of Chapters V/18, V/19 and V/20 if they fully meet the requirements of the 1994 High-Speed Craft Code and have been surveyed and certified in accordance with the provisions thereof."

Query_Text_cn: 2在2002年7月1日或以后建造的高速船，如完全符合2000年高速船规则的要求，并按该规则的规定业已检验和发证，则其应视为符合第I章至第IV章及第V/18、19和20条的要求。
Translation: 2. High-speed crafts constructed on or after 1 July 2002, if fully compliant with the requirements of the 2000 Code for High-Speed Craft and having been surveyed and certificated in accordance with the provisions of the said Code, shall be deemed to meet the requirements of Chapters I to IV and paragraphs V/18, 19 and 20.

Query_Text_cn: 2按照《高速船规则》签发的证书和许可证，应与按照第I章规定签发的证书具有同样的效力和获得同样的承认。
Translation: Certificates and licenses issued in accordance with the High-Speed Craft Code shall have equivalent validity and be entitled to the same recognition as those certificates issued in compliance with Chapter I.

Query_Text_cn: 1散货船系指第IX/1.6条所定义的散货船。
Translation: 1. A bulk carrier means a ship as defined in Regulation IX/1.6.

Query_Text_cn: 2单舷侧结构散货船系指货舱边界为舷侧壳板的散货船。
Translation: 2. A single-side shell structure bulk carrier refers to a bulk carrier where the cargo hold boundary is formed by the side shell plating.

Query_Text_cn: 3散货船的船长系指现行《国际载重线公约》所定义的长度。
Translation: The length of a Type 3 bulk carrier means the length as defined in the current International Load Line Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 4固体散货系指除液体或气体外，粉状、颗粒状或任何较大块物质构成的货物，其一般是均匀的，可直接装进装货处所而不需用任何形式的容器盛装。
Translation: Solid bulk cargo means cargo other than liquids or gases composed of powdered, granular, or any larger lumps of material, which is generally uniform in composition and can be loaded directly into cargo spaces without requiring any form of container.

Query_Text_cn: 5散货船舱壁和双层底强度标准系指1974年国际海上人命安全公约缔约国政府大会于1997年11月27日通过的决议4《对最前两个货舱之间垂向槽形水密舱壁构件尺寸和最前部货舱许可装载的评估标准》，该标准可能经本组织修正，但这类修正案应按照本公约第VIII条有关的除第I章外适用的附则修正程序的规定予以通过、生效和实施。
Translation: The strength standards for bulk carrier bulkhead and double-bottom refer to the criteria set out in Resolution 4, "Guidelines for the Assessment of Component Dimensions of Vertical Slot-Type Watertight Bulkheads Between the First Two Cargo Holds and Permissible Loading of the Foremost Cargo Hold", adopted by the Conference of Contracting Governments to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea, 1974 on 27 November 1997. These standards may be amended by the Organization, provided that such amendments shall be adopted, enter into force and be implemented in accordance with the amendment procedures applicable to Chapters other than Chapter I of the relevant Annexes as specified in Article VIII of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 6建造的船舶与第II-1/1.1.3.1条的含义相同。
Translation: The vessels constructed under Section 6 have the same meaning as those specified in Chapter II-1/1.1.3.1.

Query_Text_cn: 散货船除符合其他各章的适用要求外，还应符合本章的要求。
Translation: In addition to complying with the applicable requirements of other chapters, bulk carriers shall also comply with the requirements of this chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 3对1999年7月1日船龄小于15年的散货船，船龄达到15年后的第一次定期检验日期,但不迟于船龄达到17年之日。
Translation: For bulk carriers with a ship age of less than 15 years as of July 1, 1999, the first periodic survey date after the ship’s age reaches 15 years, but no later than when the ship’s age reaches 17 years.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织海上安全委员会MSC.79(70)和MSC.89(71)决议通过的《对SOLAS公约第XII章关于散货船的附加安全措施规定的解释》。
Translation: See the interpretations of the additional safety measures for bulk carriers in SOLAS Convention Chapter XII as adopted through MSC resolutions MSC.79(70) and MSC.89(71) of this Organization's Maritime Safety Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 1船长150m及以上，设计用于载运密度为1,000kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物，于1999年7月1日或以后建造的单舷侧结构散货船，当装载至夏季载重线时，应在所有装载状态下能承受任一货舱进水，并能按本条3的规定在令人满意的平衡状态下保持漂浮。
