Translation: For single-side skin bulk carriers of 150 meters or more in length, designed to carry solid bulk cargoes with a density of 1,000 kg/m³ or higher, constructed on or after July 1, 1999, when loaded to the summer load line, the ship shall be capable of surviving flooding of any cargo hold and maintaining afloat in a satisfactory equilibrium condition as required by paragraph 3 of this regulation under all loading conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 2船长150m及以上，用于载运密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物，于1999年7月1日以前建造的单舷侧结构散货船，当装载至夏季载重线时，应在所有装载状态下能承受最前部货舱进水，并能按本条3的规定在令人满意的平衡状态下保持漂浮。
Translation: Bulk carriers of 150 meters in length or more, built before 7 July 1999 with a single-sided hull structure or single-bottom construction, and intended for the carriage of solid bulk cargoes with a density of 1,780 kg/m³ or higher, when loaded to the summer load line, shall be capable of withstanding flooding in the foremost cargo hold and maintaining a satisfactory balanced floating condition in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 3 of this Regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 应按第3条规定的实施计划符合本要求。
Translation: The implementation plan shall conform to the requirements herein as specified in Article 3.

Query_Text_cn: 3按本条6的规定，进水后的平衡状态应满足经A.514(13)决议修正的A.320(IX)决议的附件《等效于1966年国际载重线公约第27条的规则》所规定的平衡状态。
Translation: The equilibrium condition after water ingress shall comply with the prescribed equilibrium condition set out in the annex to Resolution A.320(IX), as amended by Resolution A.514(13), entitled "Rules Equivalent to Article 27 of the 1966 International Load Line Convention", in accordance with paragraph 6 of this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 假定的进水只需考虑货舱处所进水。
Translation: The assumed flooding should only take into account that in cargo spaces.

Query_Text_cn: 除非进水货舱容积中被货物占据部分的渗透率按该特定货物予以假定，并且该货舱剩余的空余容积的渗透率假定为0.95,否则载货舱的渗透率应假定为0.9，而空货舱的渗透率应假定为0.95。
Translation: Unless the permeability of the portion of the cargo hold volume occupied by cargo is assumed based on the specific cargo and the permeability of the remaining unoccupied volume is assumed to be 0.95, the permeability of a loaded cargo hold shall be assumed as 0.9 and that of an empty cargo hold as 0.95.

Query_Text_cn: 41999年7月1日以前建造并按1966年4月5日通过的《1966年国际载重线公约》第27(7)条已核定为减小干舷的散货船，可视为符合本条2的要求。
Translation: Bulk carriers constructed before 1 July 1999 and certified as having reduced freeboard in accordance with Article 27(7) of the International Load Line Convention, 1966, adopted on 5 April 1966, shall be deemed to comply with the requirements of this paragraph 2.

Query_Text_cn: 5按经A.514(13)决议修正的A.320(IX)决议通过的《等效于1966年国际载重线公约第27条的规则》(8)的规定已核定为减小干舷的散货船，可视为符合本条1或2的相应要求。
Translation: A bulk carrier certified for reduced freeboard in accordance with the Rules equivalent to Article 27 of the 1966 International Load Line Convention, as adopted by resolution A.320(IX) as amended by resolution A.514(13), shall be deemed to comply with the corresponding requirements of paragraph 1 or 2 of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 6按《1966年国际载重线公约1988年议定书》附则B第27(8)条的规定已核定为减小干舷的散货船，进水后的平衡状态应满足该议定书的有关规定。
Translation: For bulk carriers with reduced freeboard certified in accordance with Article 27(8) of Annex B of the 1966 International Load Line Convention 1988 Protocol, the flooding condition equilibrium shall comply with the relevant provisions of the Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 船长150m及以上，设计用于载运密度为1,000kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物的单舷侧结构散货船,应在所有装载压载状态下有足够强度承受任一货舱进水，并计及舱内进水所产生的动力影响，同时考虑到本组织通过的建议案。
Translation: Single-hull structured bulk carriers with a length of 150 meters and above, designed to carry solid bulk cargoes with a density of 1,000 kg/m³ or higher, shall possess sufficient structural strength to withstand flooding in any cargo hold under all loaded and ballasted conditions, taking into account the dynamic effects of water ingress within the flooded compartment, as well as the recommendations adopted by this Organization (e.g., IMO).

Query_Text_cn: ①参见1997年SOLAS公约缔约国大会通过的决议3《关于符合SOLAS公约第XII/5条的建议案》。
Translation: ① Refer to Resolution 3 adopted by the Conference of Contracting Parties to the SOLAS Convention in 1997, titled 'Recommendations on Compliance with SOLAS Convention Article XII/5'.

Query_Text_cn: 1船长150m及以上，载运密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物的单舷侧结构散货船应按第3条规定的实施计划符合本条要求。
Translation: Single-side skin bulk carriers of 150 meters and above in length, when carrying solid bulk cargoes with a stowage density of 1,780 kg/m³ and above, shall comply with the requirements of this provision in accordance with the implementation plan specified in paragraph 3.

Query_Text_cn: 2最前两个货舱间的水密横舱壁及最前部货舱的双层底应符合散货船舱壁和双层底强度标准，有足够强度承受最前部货舱进水，并计及舱内进水所产生的动力影响。
Translation: The watertight transverse bulkheads between the first two cargo holds and the double bottom of the foremost cargo hold shall comply with the strength standards for bulk carrier bulkheads and double bottoms, possessing sufficient strength to withstand flooding in the foremost cargo hold while taking into account the dynamic effects of the flooding within the compartments.

Query_Text_cn: 就本条而言,散货船舱壁和双层底强度标准应视作强制性标准。
Translation: For the purposes of this provision, the strength standards for cargo ship bulkheads and double bottoms shall be considered as mandatory standards.

Query_Text_cn: 2最大载重量的限制。
Translation: The 2 maximum load capacity limit.

Query_Text_cn: 4对为满足本条2的要求而采用以上3.1和3.2的一种或两种限制的散货船，当装载密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散货时，均应符合这些限制条件。
Translation: For bulk carriers which adopt one or both of the restrictions specified in 3.1 and 3.2 above to meet the requirements of this Section 2, when carrying solid bulk cargoes with a density of 1,780 kg/m² or higher, they shall comply with these restrictions.

Query_Text_cn: 2所有货舱按第XI/2条要求的加强检验程序中的定期检验要求通过了同样范围的检验。
Translation: All cargo holds have undergone inspections of the same scope as required by the enhanced inspection procedures as stipulated in Chapter XI-2.

Query_Text_cn: 1第VI/7.2条要求的小册子应由主管机关或其代表签署以表明其符合本章第4、5、6和7条的适用要求。
Translation: The booklet required under Article VI/7.2 shall be signed by the Competent Authority or its representative to indicate compliance with the applicable requirements of Articles 4, 5, 6 and 7 of this Chapter.

Query_Text_cn: 2按第6条的要求对载运密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散装货物的任何限制应在本条1所述的小册子上作出标识和记录。
Translation: Any restrictions imposed in accordance with the requirements of Article 6 on the carriage of solid bulk cargoes with a density of 1,780 kg/m³ or higher shall be identified and recorded in the booklet specified in paragraph 1 of this clause.

Query_Text_cn: 3适用本条2的散货船应在船中部左、右舷侧外板上勘划一个实心的永久性等边三角形标志，其边长为500mm，顶点在甲板线以下300mm处，并漆成与船体有反差的颜色。
Translation: Bulk carriers subject to paragraph 2 of this article shall be marked with a solid permanent equilateral triangular mark on the port and starboard outer plates at midships, with a side length of 500 mm, its apex located 300 mm below the deck line, and painted in a color that contrasts with the hull.

Query_Text_cn: 3提供特定货舱进水状况的详细资料。
Translation: 3. Provide detailed information on the specific flooding condition of the cargo hold.

Query_Text_cn: 该资料应附有按《国际安全管理（ISM）规则》第8节规定制定的有关撤离部署的详细须知，并作为船员培训和演习的基础。
Translation: The documentation shall be accompanied by detailed instructions on muster and evacuation as required by Section 8 of the International Safety Management (ISM) Code, and shall serve as the basis for crew training and drills.

Query_Text_cn: 1散货船装货之前，发货人除按第VI/2条要求提交货物资料外，还应申报货物密度。
Translation: Before loading on a bulk carrier, the shipper shall, in addition to submitting cargo information as required under Article VI/2, also declare the density of the cargo.

Query_Text_cn: 2对于适用第6条的散货船，除非这些散货船符合本章有关装运密度为1,780kg/m3及以上的固体散货的所有要求，申报的密度在1,250kg/m3至1,780kg/m3范围内的任何货物应由经授权的试验机构验证其密度。
Translation: 2. For bulk carriers to which Article 6 applies, unless such bulk carriers comply with all the requirements of this Chapter relating to the carriage of solid bulk cargoes having a density of 1,780 kg/m³ or greater, the density of any cargo declared to be within the range of 1,250 kg/m³ to 1,780 kg/m³ shall be verified by an authorized testing organization.

Query_Text_cn: 1船长150m及以上的散货船均应配备装载仪，该装载仪应能结合本组织所通过的建议案②，提供主船体梁的剪力和弯矩资料。
Translation: All cargo ships of 150 meters in length and above shall be equipped with a loading computer capable of providing shear force and bending moment data for the main hull girder in accordance with the recommendations adopted by this Organization (Recommendation ②).

Query_Text_cn: 21999年7月1日以前建造的船长150m及以上的散货船，应不迟于1999年7月1日以后的第一次中间检验或定期检验之日符合本条1的要求。
Translation: All bulk carriers constructed before July 1, 1999, with a length of 150 meters or more shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 1 of this regulation no later than the first intermediate or periodic survey after July 1, 1999.

Query_Text_cn: ①在验证固体散货密度时,可参见海安会MSC/Circ.908通函《测量散货密度的统一方法》。
Translation: When verifying the density of solid bulk cargo, refer to the MSC/Circ.908 circular titled "Unified Method for the Determination of Bulk Cargo Density".

Query_Text_cn: ②参见1997年SOLAS公约缔约国大会通过的决议5《关于装载仪的建议案》。
Translation: See Resolution 5, "Recommendation on Loading Instruments", adopted by the Conference of Contracting Parties to the SOLAS Convention in 1997.

Query_Text_cn: 1在每一货舱内，当水位达到高出任何货舱内底0.5m时应发出听觉和视觉报警，并在水位高度达到不小于货舱深度15%但不超过2m时也应发出听觉和视觉报警。
Translation: Within each cargo hold, audible and visual alarms shall be activated when the water level reaches 0.5 meters above any cargo hold inner bottom, and shall also be activated when the water level height reaches not less than 15% of the cargo hold depth but not exceeding 2 meters.

Query_Text_cn: 对于第9.2条适用的散货船，只需安装后一个报警的探测器。
Translation: For bulk carriers subject to Clause 9.2, only the aft alarm detector is required to be installed.

Query_Text_cn: 水位探测器应安装在货舱的尾端。
Translation: The water level detector should be installed at the after end of the cargo hold.

Query_Text_cn: 对于用做水压载的货舱，可以安装一个报警越控装置。
Translation: For cargo holds used for water ballasting, an alarm override device can be installed.

Query_Text_cn: 2对第II-1/11条所要求的防撞舱壁前方的任一压载舱，当舱内的液面达到不超过舱容的10%时应发出听觉和视觉报警。
Translation: For any ballast tank forward of the collision bulkhead as required by Regulation II-1/11, both audible and visual alarms shall be activated when the liquid level inside the tank reaches not more than 10% of the tank capacity.

Query_Text_cn: 3在除锚链舱以外的任何干燥处所或空舱内，延伸至首货舱前方的任何部位，在水位高出甲板0.1m时应发出听觉和视觉报警。
Translation: In any dry spaces or void spaces other than the chain locker, any part extending forward of the fore cargo hold shall sound an audible alarm and illuminate a visual alarm when the water level exceeds the deck by 0.1 meters.

Query_Text_cn: 当围蔽处所内的容量不超过船舶最大排水量的0.1%时，不必安装此类报警器。
Translation: When the volume within enclosed spaces does not exceed 0.1% of the ship's maximum displacement, there is no need to install such alarms.

Query_Text_cn: 2在上述1中规定的听觉和视觉报警器应设于驾驶室。
Translation: The audible and visual alarms specified in Clause 1 shall be installed in the cab.

Query_Text_cn: 32004年7月1日以前建造的散货船，应在不迟于2004年7月1日后船舶进行的年度检验、中间检验或换证检验时符合本条要求，取早者。
Translation: Bulk carriers constructed before July 1, 2004 shall comply with the requirements of this paragraph no later than the earliest of the annual survey, intermediate survey, or renewal survey conducted after July 1, 2004.

Query_Text_cn: 1散货船上，用于排放和泵吸位于防撞舱壁前方的压载舱的压载水，和任何部位延伸至首货舱前的干燥处所的舱底水的设备，应能从一个可进入的围蔽处所内将其运行，该围蔽处所应能从驾驶室或主机控制站进入而无需穿过露天干舷甲板或上层建筑甲板。
Translation: The equipment on bulk carriers for discharging and pumping ballast water from ballast tanks located forward of the collision bulkhead, and bilge water from any dry spaces whose any part extends forward of the foremost cargo hold, shall be capable of being operated from an accessible enclosed space. Such enclosed space shall be accessible from the bridge or the main engine control station without passing through exposed weather decks or superstructure decks.

Query_Text_cn: 如果用于这些舱或舱底水的管路穿过防撞舱壁，作为第II-1/11.4条规定的阀的控制的替代措施，只要此类阀门控制器的位置符合本条的规定，也可接受通过遥控启动阀门操作的装置。
Translation: If the piping for these compartments or the bilge water passes through a collision bulkhead, as an alternative to the valve controls specified in Regulation II-1/11.4, a remotely operated device for actuating the valves may also be accepted, provided that the location of such valve controls complies with the provisions of this regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 22004年7月1日以前建造的散货船，应在不迟于2004年7月1日后船舶进行第一次中间检验或换证检验时，但无论如何不得迟于2007年7月1日符合本条要求。
Translation: Bulk carriers constructed before July 1, 2004 shall comply with the requirements of this paragraph no later than the first intermediate or certificate renewal survey conducted after July 1, 2004, but in any case not later than July 1, 2007.

Query_Text_cn: ①参见本组织海上安全委员会MSC.145(77)决议通过的《散货船水位探测器性能标准》。
Translation: ① See the "Performance Standards for Water Level Detectors on Bulk Carriers" as adopted by resolution MSC.145(77) of the Maritime Safety Committee of the Organization.

Query_Text_cn: ②参见海安会通函MSC/Circ.1069《对SOLAS公约第XII/13条的解释》。
Translation: ② See MSC Circular 1069, Interpretation of SOLAS Convention Chapter XII/Regulation 13.

Query_Text_cn: 1现行生效的1974年国际海上人命安全公约（1974年SOLAS公约）是由国际海事组织（IMO）于1974年11月1日召开的国际海上人命安全公约会议通过的，并于1980年5月25日生效。
Translation: The current 1974 International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS Convention) was adopted by the International Maritime Organization (IMO) at the International Conference on the Safety of Life at Sea held on November 1, 1974, and entered into force on May 25, 1980.

Query_Text_cn: 2国际检验与发证协调系统会议1988年11月11日通过的议定书（1988年SOLAS议定书），于2000年2月3日生效，并在1988年SOLAS议定书缔约国之间替代并废除1978年SOLAS议定书。
Translation: The Protocol adopted by the International Conference on the Harmonized System of Inspection and Certification on November 11, 1988 (1988 SOLAS Protocol), entered into force on February 3, 2000, and replaced and superseded the 1978 SOLAS Protocol among the Contracting Parties to the 1988 SOLAS Protocol.

Query_Text_cn: 27以1974年国际海上人命安全公约缔约国政府会议决议1通过的2002年12月修正案，于2004年7月1日生效。
Translation: The amendments adopted in December 2002 pursuant to Resolution 1 of the Assembly of Contracting Governments to the 1974 International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) entered into force on 1 July 2004.

Query_Text_cn: 28以MSC.142(77)决议通过的2003年6月修正案。
Translation: Amendment No.28,adopted by Resolution MSC.142(77) in June2003.

Query_Text_cn: 29以MSC.151(78)决议（第II-1/3-6条）、MSC.152(78)决议（第III章和第IV章及附则的附录）和MSC.153(78)决议（第V章）通过的2004年5月修正案。
Translation: The May 2004 amendments, adopted through MSC.151(78) Resolution (Chapter II-1/Regulation 3.6), MSC.152(78) Resolution (Chapter III and Chapter IV plus Annex appendices), and MSC.153(78) Resolution (Chapter V).

Query_Text_cn: 海上安全委员会在通过这些修正案时决定，这些修正案应分别于2005年7月1日、2006年1月1日和2006年1月1日视为已被接受，除非在这些日期以前，三分之一以上的SOLAS公约缔约国政府，或商船合计吨数不少于世界商船总吨数50%的缔约国政府通知其反对这些修正案。
Translation: The Maritime Safety Committee, upon adopting these amendments, decided that they shall be deemed to have been accepted as of 1 July 2005, 1 January 2006, and 1 January 2006 respectively, unless prior to those dates, objections to the amendments are notified by either more than one-third of the Contracting Governments to the SOLAS Convention, or by Contracting Governments whose merchant shipping tonnage aggregates not less than 50% of the world's total merchant shipping tonnage.

Query_Text_cn: 这些修正案如被接受，将分别于2006年1月1日、2006年7月1日和2006年7月1日生效。
Translation: These amendments, if adopted, will take effect on January 1, 2006, July 1, 2006, and July 1, 2006, respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 其生效条件于2003年7月1日达到，该修正案于2004年1月1日生效。
Translation: The entry-into-force conditions were met on July 1, 2003, and the amendment came into effect on January 1, 2004.

Query_Text_cn: 1988年SOLAS议定书还经MSC.154(78)决议通过的2004年5月修正案作了修正。
Translation: The 1988 SOLAS Protocol was amended by the May 2004 amendment adopted through Resolution MSC.154(78).

Query_Text_cn: 海上安全委员会在通过该修正案时决定，该修正案将于2006年1月1日应视为已被接受，除非在此日期以前，三分之一以上的1988年SOLAS议定书缔约国政府，或商船合计吨数不少于世界商船总吨数50%的缔约国政府通知其反对该修正案。
Translation: The Maritime Safety Committee decided that the amendment shall be deemed to have been accepted as from 1 January 2006, unless, before that date, the governments of more than one-third of the Contracting Parties to the SOLAS Protocol of 1988, or the governments of Contracting Parties whose merchant shipping tonnage constitutes not less than 50% of the world merchant shipping tonnage, notify their opposition to the amendment.

Query_Text_cn: 这些修正案如被接受，将于2006年7月1日生效。
Translation: If accepted, these amendments will come into effect on July 1, 2006.

Query_Text_cn: 4本出版物包括了1974年SOLAS公约、1988年SOLAS议定书以及其后直到并包括2002年12月修正案的全部修正案的综合文本。
Translation: These four publications include the consolidated text of the 1974 SOLAS Convention, the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, and all amendments thereafter through and including the December 2002 amendments.

Query_Text_cn: IMO秘书处编辑了合成文本，其用意是便于参照2004年7月1日起适用的SOLAS公约要求。
Translation: The IMO Secretariat compiled a consolidated text intended to facilitate reference to the requirements of the SOLAS Convention applicable as of 1 July 2004.

Query_Text_cn: 2第2部分，包括关于全球统一执行检验和发证协调系统（HSSC）的A.883(21)决议、船上应具备的证书和文件①清单、前述的SOLAS公约缔约国会议通过的决议清单以及SOLAS公约第II-1章第12-2条。
Translation: Part 2 includes Resolution A.883(21) regarding the Global Harmonized Systems of Survey and Certification (HSSC), the list of certificates and documents required to be carried on board (①), the list of resolutions adopted by the aforementioned Assembly of Contracting Parties to the SOLAS Convention, and Regulation 12.2 of Chapter II-1 of the SOLAS Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 证书清单包括了规定的所有证书和文件的用途简述，以便有助于岸上工作人员、官员和船长评估证书和文件，这些对港口国控制和船舶在港内的顺利作业都是必需的。
Translation: The certificate list includes a brief description of the purposes of all specified certificates and documents to assist shore-based staff, officials, and the captain in assessing them. These are essential for port state control and ensuring the smooth operations of the vessel while in port.

Query_Text_cn: 6总体而言，本综合文本所包含的作业方面要求适用于所有船舶，而有关船舶构造和设备的要求只适用于各个条款所规定的日期或其后建造的船舶。
Translation: Overall, the operational requirements contained in this consolidated text apply to all ships, while the requirements concerning construction and equipment apply only to ships constructed on or after the dates specified in the respective provisions.

Query_Text_cn: 为确定适用于2001年以前建造船舶的构造和设备要求，应查阅以前的1974年SOLAS公约、1988年SOLAS议定书以及本公约修正案。
Translation: To determine the construction and equipment requirements applicable to ships constructed before 2001, reference should be made to the previous 1974 SOLAS Convention, the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, and amendments to this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，对现有客船的特殊要求未包含在1981年修正案的第II-2章中，也没有包含在本综合文本之中，而是只包含在原始的1974年SOLAS公约第II-2章的F部分之中。
Translation: For example, the special requirements for existing passenger ships are not included in Chapter II-2 of the 1981 amendments, nor in the consolidated text, but rather only in Part F of the original Chapter II-2 of the 1974 SOLAS Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 而经1978年SOLAS议定书修改的1974年SOLAS公约其他各章的有关规定无类似符号表示，因为在本公约第I章中的有关规定已被1988年SOLAS议定书缔约国之间所替代并废除的同时，这些规定业已被其后通过的SOLAS公约修正案所替代。
Translation: The provisions of other Chapters of the 1974 SOLAS Convention as amended by the 1978 SOLAS Protocol lack similar notations, since the provisions in Chapter I of this Convention were simultaneously replaced and superseded by the 1988 SOLAS Protocol among its Contracting States, while those provisions have been superseded by subsequent amendments to the SOLAS Convention adopted thereafter.

Query_Text_cn: 8总体而言，本出版物收入了1974年SOLAS公约和1988年SOLAS议定书的文本，并包括了在其正式文本中所给出的修改和修正案内容。
Translation: Overall, this publication includes the texts of the 1974 SOLAS Convention and the 1988 SOLAS Protocol, incorporating modifications and amendments as provided in their official texts.

Query_Text_cn: 4已按A.351(IX)决议采用国际单位制（SI）的公制值。
Translation: Item 4 has adopted pursuant to Resolution A.351(IX) the metric values of the International System of Units (SI).

Query_Text_cn: 9本综合文本中的脚注（正如海上安全委员会（MSC）所说明的，其并不构成公约的一部分，之所以引入，只是为了便于参照）提出与某一特定条文有关的规则、指南和建议案供参照，并已由秘书处在出版时加以更新。
Translation: The footnotes (as explained by the Maritime Safety Committee (MSC), which do not form part of the Convention but are introduced solely for the purpose of facilitating reference) provide references to the rules, guidelines, and recommendations associated with a particular article and have been updated by the Secretariat at the time of publication.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，还根据规则、指南和建议案及其他MSC决定的有关文本，插入一些解释性脚注。
Translation: Additionally, some explanatory footnotes have been incorporated based on rules, guidelines, recommendations, and other texts related to MSC decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 在所有情况下，读者都必须使用所指文本的最新版本，并记住：这些文本可能已被自经修正的本公约综合文本出版以后的更新材料所修改或废除。
Translation: In all cases, readers must use the latest version of the referenced text and that these texts may have been modified or repealed by updates issued since the publication of the amended consolidated text of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 按照第七十六条的规定，应依本附件以下各条成立一个二百海里以外大陆架界限委员会。
Translation: In accordance with the provisions of Article 76, the Continental Shelf Boundary Committee beyond two hundred nautical miles shall be established in accordance with the following provisions of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 1.本委员会应由二十一名委员组成，委员应是地质学、地球物理学或水文学方面的专家，由本公约缔约国从其国民中选出，选举时应妥为顾及确保公平地区代表制的必要，委员应以个人身分任职。
Translation: This Committee shall consist of twenty-one members, who shall be experts in geology, geophysics or hydrology, selected by the Contracting Parties from among their nationals, taking due account of the necessity of ensuring equitable regional representation, and shall serve in their individual capacities.

Query_Text_cn: 2.初次选举应尽快举行，无论如何应在本公约生效之日后十八个月内举行。
Translation: The initial election shall be held as soon as possible and, in any case, no later than eighteen months after the entry into force of this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 联合国秘书长应在每次选举之日前至少三个月发信给各缔约国，邀请它们在进行适当的区域协商后于三个月内提出候选人。
Translation: The United Nations Secretary-General shall send a letter to all member states at least three months before each election, inviting them to submit candidates within three months after conducting appropriate regional consultations.

Query_Text_cn: 秘书长应依字母次序编制所有候选人的名单，并将名单提交所有缔约国。
Translation: The Secretary-General shall compile a list of all candidates in alphabetical order and submit the list to all contracting parties.

Query_Text_cn: 3.委员会委员的选举应由秘书长在联合国总部召开缔约国会议举行。
Translation: The election of the Committee members shall be convened by the Secretary-General through a Meeting of the Contracting Parties held at the United Nations Headquarters.

Query_Text_cn: 在该次会议上，缔约国的三分之二应构成法定人数，获得出席并参加表决的缔约国代表三分之二多数票的候选人应当选为委员会委员。
Translation: At this meeting, the quorum shall be constituted by two-thirds of the Contracting Parties. The candidate(s) who obtain(s) a two-thirds majority vote of the representatives of the Contracting Parties present and voting shall be elected as members of the Committee.

Query_Text_cn: 从每一地理区域应至少选出三名委员。
Translation: At least three commissioners should be selected from each geographic region.

Query_Text_cn: 连选可连任。
Translation: May be re-elected without term limits.

Query_Text_cn: 5.提出委员会委员候选人的缔约国应承担该委员在执行委员会职务期间的费用。
Translation: 5. The Contracting State proposing a candidate for the committee membership shall bear the expenses of that member during the period of their service on the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 有关沿海国应承担为提供本附件第三条第1款(b)项所指的咨询意见而引起的费用。
Translation: The relevant coastal States shall bear the costs incurred in providing the advisory opinions referred to in Article 3, paragraph 1(b), of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会秘书处应由联合国秘书长提供。
Translation: The secretariat of the committee should be provided by the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: (b)经有关沿海国请求，在编制(a)项所述资料时，提供科学和技术咨询意见。
Translation: (b) At the request of the relevant coastal States, provide scientific and technical advice and consultation when compiling the information referred to in subparagraph (a).

Query_Text_cn: 2.委员会可在认为必要和有用的范围内与联合国教科文组织的政府间海洋学委员会、国际水文学组织及其他主管国际组织合作，以求交换可能有助于委员会执行职务的科学和技术情报。
Translation: The Committee may cooperate, within the limits it deems necessary and appropriate, with the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of UNESCO, the International Hydrographic Organization, and other competent international organizations to exchange scientific and technical information that may assist the Committee in fulfilling its mandate.

Query_Text_cn: 拟按照第七十六条划定其二百海里以外大陆架外部界限的沿海国，应将这种界限的详情连同支持这种界限的科学和技术资料，尽早提交委员会，而且无论如何应于本公约对该国生效后十年内提出。
Translation: Coastal States intending to delimit the outer limits of their continental shelf beyond 200 nautical miles in accordance with Article 76 shall submit to the Commission the details of such limits together with scientific and technical data supporting such limits as soon as possible, and in any event within ten years following the entry into force of this Convention for that State.

Query_Text_cn: 沿海国应同时提出曾向其提供科学和技术咨询意见的委员会内任何委员的姓名。
Translation: Coastal states shall also submit the names of any member of the committee who have provided scientific and technical advisory opinions to them.

Query_Text_cn: 除委员会另有决定外，委员会应由七名委员组成的小组委员会执行职务，小组委员会委员应以平衡方式予以任命，同时考虑到沿海国提出的每一划界案的具体因素。
Translation: Unless otherwise decided by the committee, the committee shall be represented by a subcommittee consisting of seven members in the performance of its duties. Members of the subcommittee shall be appointed in a balanced manner, taking into account the specific circumstances of each delimitation proposal put forward by coastal states.

Query_Text_cn: 为已提出划界案的沿海国国民的委员会委员，或曾提供关于划界的科学和技术咨询意见以协助该国的委员会委员，不得成为处理该案的小组委员会委员，但应有权以委员身分参与委员会处理该案的程序。
Translation: Members of the Commission who are nationals of a coastal State that has submitted a delimitation proposal, or who have previously provided scientific and technical advisory opinions on delimitation to assist that coastal State, shall not be eligible to serve as members of the subcommittee handling that proposal, but shall retain the right to participate in the Commission's proceedings on the matter as members.

Query_Text_cn: 向委员会提出划界案的沿海国可派代表参与有关的程序，但无表决权。
Translation: Coastal states that submit a delimitation proposal to the committee may send representatives to participate in the relevant proceedings but without voting rights.

Query_Text_cn: 1.小组委员会应将其建议提交委员会。
Translation: The subcommittee should submit its recommendations to the committee.

Query_Text_cn: 2.小组委员会的建议应由委员会以出席并参加表决的委员三分之二多数核准。
Translation: The subcommittee's recommendations shall be approved by the committee by a two-thirds majority of the members present and voting.

Query_Text_cn: 3.委员会的建议应以书面递交提出划界案的沿海国和联合国秘书长。
Translation: The recommendations of the Committee shall be submitted in writing to the coastal State that proposed the delimitation case and the Secretary-General of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 沿海国应依第七十六条第8款的规定并按照适当国家程序划定大陆架的外部界限。
Translation: Coastal States shall delimit the outer limits of the continental shelf in accordance with the provisions of Article 76, paragraph 8, and appropriate national procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 在沿海国不同意委员会建议的情形下，沿海国应于合理期间内向委员会提出订正的或新的划界案。
Translation: In the event that the coastal state disagrees with the committee's recommendations, it shall submit revised or new delimitation proposals to the committee within a reasonable period.

Query_Text_cn: 委员会的行动不应妨害海岸相向或相邻国家间划定界限的事项。
Translation: The commission's actions should not prejudice the delimitation of boundaries between coastal States with opposite or adjacent coasts.

Query_Text_cn: 矿物按照本公约回收时，其所有权即转移。
Translation: When minerals are recovered in accordance with this Convention,their ownership is immediately transferred.

Query_Text_cn: 1.(a)管理局应鼓励在“区域”内探矿。
Translation: 1.(a) The Authority shall encourage exploration for minerals within the "Region".

Query_Text_cn: (b)探矿只有在管理局收到一项令人满意的书面承诺以后才可进行，申请探矿者应在其中承诺遵守本公约和管理局关于在第一四三和第一四四条所指的训练方案方面进行合作以及保护海洋环境的规则、规章和程序，并接受管理局对其是否加以遵守进行查核。
Translation: (b) Exploration may only proceed after the Authority has received a satisfactory written commitment, in which the applicant undertakes to comply with the provisions of this Convention and the rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority regarding cooperation in the training programmes referred to in Articles 143 and 144 and the protection of the marine environment, and to accept verification by the Authority of compliance therewith.

Query_Text_cn: 申请探矿者在提出承诺的同时，应将准备进行探矿的一个或多个区域的大约面积通知管理局。
Translation: Prospecting applicants shall notify the Administration of the approximate area(s) of one or more areas they intend to prospect when submitting their commitments.

Query_Text_cn: (c)一个以上的探矿者可在同一个或几个区域内同时进行探矿。
Translation: (c) More than one prospector may conduct prospecting simultaneously in the same area or in several areas.

Query_Text_cn: 2.探矿不应使探矿者取得对资源的任何权利。
Translation: Mineral exploration should not entitle explorers to any rights over the resources.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，探矿者可回收合理数量的矿物供试验之用。
Translation: However, prospectors may recover a reasonable quantity of minerals for testing purposes.

Query_Text_cn: 1.企业部、缔约国和第一五三条第2款(b)项所指的其他实体，可向管理局申请核准其关于“区域”内活动的工作计划。
Translation: The Enterprise Department, Contracting States, and other entities referred to in Article 153, paragraph 2, subparagraph (b), may apply to the Authority for approval of their work plans for activities in the Area.

Query_Text_cn: 2.企业部可对“区域”的任何部分提出申请，但其他方面对保留区域的申请，应受本附件第九条各项附加条件的限制。
Translation: The Corporate Department may submit an application for any part of the area, but applications by other parties for the reserved area shall be subject to the restrictions imposed by the additional conditions set forth in Article 9 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 3.勘探和开发应只在第一五三条第3款所指的，并经管理局按照本公约以及管理局的有关规则、规章和程序核准的工作计划中所列明的区域内进行。
Translation: Exploration and development shall only be conducted within the areas specified in subsection 3 of Article 153 and listed in the work program approved by the Authority in accordance with this Convention and the Authority's relevant rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: (c)按照管理局的规则、规章和程序，授予经营者在工作计划所包括的区域内勘探和开发指明类别的资源的专属权利。
Translation: (c) Grant the operator the exclusive right to explore and develop resources of the specified categories within the areas included in the work plan, in accordance with the rules, regulations, and procedures of the Administration Bureau.

Query_Text_cn: 如果申请者申请核准只包括勘探阶段和开发阶段的工作计划，核准的工作计划应只就该阶段给予这种专属权利。
Translation: If the applicant's application for approval covers only the work program for the exploration phase and development phase, the approved work program shall grant such exclusive rights solely for those phases.

Query_Text_cn: 5.经管理局核准后，每项工作计划，除企业部提出者外，应采取由管理局和一个或几个申请者订立合同的形式。
Translation: Following the approval of the Administration, each work plan, except those proposed by the Enterprise Department, shall be implemented through a contract between the Administration and one or more applicants.

Query_Text_cn: 1.企业部以外的申请者如具备第一五三条第2款(b)项所指明的国籍或控制和担保，且如遵守管理局规则、规章和程序所载列的程序并符合其中规定的资格标准，即应取得资格。
Translation: Applicants outside the Corporate Department shall be eligible if they possess the nationality or control and guarantees specified in Article 153, paragraph 2(b), comply with the procedures set out in the Authority's rules, regulations, and procedures, and meet the eligibility criteria stipulated therein.

Query_Text_cn: 2.除第6款所规定者外，上述资格标准应包括申请者的财政和技术能力及其履行以前同管理局订立的任何合同的情形。
Translation: Except as provided in paragraph 6,the qualification criteria set forth above shall include the applicant's financial and technical capabilities and their performance of any contracts previously entered into with the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: 3.每一申请者应由其国籍所属的缔约国担保，除非申请者具有一个以上的国籍，例如几个国家的实体组成的合伙团体或财团，在这种情形下，所有涉及的缔约国都应担保申请；或者除非申请者是由另一个缔约国或其国民有效控制，在这种情形下，两个缔约国都应担保申请。
Translation: Each applicant shall be guaranteed by the Contracting State of which the applicant is a national, unless the applicant holds nationality of more than one State, such as a partnership or consortium composed of entities of several States, in which case all the Contracting States concerned shall guarantee the application; or unless the applicant is effectively controlled by another Contracting State or its nationals, in which case both Contracting States shall guarantee the application.

Query_Text_cn: 实施担保规定的标准和程序应载入管理局的规则、规章和程序。
Translation: The standards and procedures for implementing the guarantee provisions shall be included in the Authority's rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 4.担保国应按照第一三九条，负责在其法律制度范围内，确保所担保的承包者应依据合同条款及其在本公约下的义务进行“区域”内活动。
Translation: A sponsoring State shall, in accordance with Article 139, be responsible within the framework of its legal system for ensuring that the contractors it sponsors conduct activities in the Area in accordance with the contract terms and their obligations under this Convention.

Query_Text_cn: 但如该担保国已制定法律和规章并采取行政措施，而这些法律和规章及行政措施在其法律制度范围内可以合理地认为足以使在其管辖下的人遵守时，则该国对其所担保的承包者因不履行义务而造成的损害，应无赔偿责任。
Translation: If the sponsoring State has enacted laws and regulations and taken administrative measures, and such laws, regulations, and administrative measures can, within their legal system, reasonably be regarded as sufficient to ensure compliance by persons under their jurisdiction, then the State shall not be liable for damage caused by the failure of the contractor it has sponsored to fulfill its obligations.

Query_Text_cn: 5.缔约国为申请者时，审查其资格的程序，应顾及申请者是国家的特性。
Translation: When a Contracting State acts as an applicant, the procedures for examining its qualifications shall take into account the fact that the applicant is a state.

Query_Text_cn: (d)遵守本附件第五条所载有关技术转让的规定。
Translation: (d) Comply with the provisions regarding technology transfer set forth in Article 5 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 1.每一申请者在提出工作计划时，应向管理局提交关于进行“区域”内活动所使用的装备和方法的一般性说明，以及关于这种技术的特征的其他非专有的有关情报和可以从何处取得这种技术的情报。
Translation: Each applicant shall, when submitting a work plan, provide the Authority with a general description of the equipment and methods to be used for activities conducted in the "Area", as well as non-proprietary information regarding the characteristics of such technology and information on where such technology can be obtained.

Query_Text_cn: 2.经营者每当作出重大的技术改变或革新时，均应将对依据第1款提出的说明和情报所作的修改通知管理局。
Translation: Operators shall notify the Authority of any modifications made to the statements and information submitted under paragraph 1 whenever they make significant technical changes or innovations.

Query_Text_cn: (a)经管理局一旦提出要求，即以公平合理的商业条款和条件向企业部提供他根据合同进行“区域”内活动时所使用而且该承包者在法律上有权转让的技术。
Translation: (a) The Authority shall promptly provide the Enterprise Department, upon its request, with technology used by him in conducting activities in the "Area" pursuant to the contract and which the contractor is legally entitled to transfer, on fair and reasonable terms and conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 这应以承包者与企业部商定并在补充合同的特别协议中订明的特许方式或其他适当安排来履行。
Translation: This shall be fulfilled through the designated manner or other appropriate arrangements agreed upon between the contractor and the Corporate Department and specified in the supplementary contract's special provisions.

Query_Text_cn: (b)对于根据合同进行“区域”内活动所使用，但通常不能在公开市场上获得，而且为(a)项所不包括的任何技术，从技术所有人取得书面保证，经管理局一旦提出要求，技术所有人将以特许方式或其他适当安排，并以公平合理的商业条款和条件，在向承包者提供这种技术的同样程度上向企业部提供这种技术。
Translation: (b) Obtain from the technology owner a written assurance that, upon the request of the Authority, the technology owner shall make such technology available to the Enterprise Department, by way of license or other appropriate arrangements and on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions, to the same extent as it provides such technology for activities conducted within the "Area" under contract but not normally obtainable on the open market and not included in paragraph (a).

Query_Text_cn: (c)经企业部提出要求，而承包者又不致因此承担巨大费用时，对承包者根据合同进行“区域”内活动所使用而在法律上无权转让，并且通常不能在公开市场上获得的任何技术，通过一项可以执行的合同，从技术所有人取得转让给企业部的法律权利。
Translation: (c) At the request of the Enterprise Department, and when the contractor would not incur substantial costs as a result, obtain from the technology owner, through an enforceable contract, the legal right to transfer to the Enterprise Department any technology used by the contractor in connection with activities conducted in the Area pursuant to the contract that is legally non-transferable and ordinarily not available on the open market.

Query_Text_cn: 在承包者与技术所有人之间具有实质性公司关系的情形下，应参酌这种关系的密切程度和控制或影响的程度来判断是否已采取一切可行的措施。
Translation: In cases where there exists a substantial corporate relationship between the contractor and the technology owner, the closeness of such relationship and the degree of control or influence should be taken into account to determine whether all feasible measures have been taken.

Query_Text_cn: (e)为了按照本附件第九条申请合同的发展中国家或发展中国家集团的利益，采取(a)、(b)、(c)和(d)项所规定的相同措施，但此项措施应以对承包者所提出的按照本附件第八条已予保留的一部分区域的开发为限，而且该发展中国家或发展中国家集团所申请的根据合同进行的活动须不涉及对第三国或第三国国民的技术转让。
Translation: (e) To take the same measures as specified in subparagraphs (a), (b), (c), and (d) for the benefit of a developing country or group of developing countries applying for contracts under Article 9 of this Annex, provided that such measures shall be limited to the development of areas reserved under Article 8 of this Annex as proposed by the contractor, and that the activities under the contracts applied for by such developing country or group shall not involve technology transfer to third countries or nationals thereof.

Query_Text_cn: 根据本项的义务应只在尚未经企业部要求提供技术或尚未由特定承包者向企业部转让的情形下，才对该承包者适用。
Translation: The obligations under this provision shall apply only where the enterprise department has not required the contractor to provide the technology, or the specific contractor has not transferred to the enterprise department, and shall only be applicable to such contractor under such circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 4.关于第3款所要求的承诺的争端，象合同其他规定一样，均应按照第十一部分提交强制解决程序，遇有违反这种承诺的情形，则可按照本附件第十八条命令暂停或终止合同或课以罚款。
Translation: Disputes regarding the commitments required under Clause 3 shall be submitted to the mandatory dispute resolution procedures under Part Eleven, and in cases of breach of such commitments, the procedures under Article 18 of this Annex may be invoked to suspend or terminate the Contract or impose penalties.

Query_Text_cn: 关于承包者所作提议是否在公平合理的商业条款和条件的范围内的争端，可由任何一方按照联合国国际贸易法委员会的仲裁规则或管理局的规则、规章和程序可能有所规定的其他仲裁规则，提交有拘束力的商业仲裁。
Translation: Disputes regarding whether the proposal made by the contractor falls within the scope of fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions may be submitted to binding commercial arbitration by either party in accordance with the arbitration rules of the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law (UNCITRAL) or other arbitration rules as may be prescribed by the rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: 如果裁决认为承包者所作提议不在公平合理的商业条款和条件的范围以内，则在管理局按照本附件第十八条采取任何行动以前，应给予承包者四十五天的时间以修改其提议，使其合乎上述范围。
Translation: If the determination is that the proposal made by the contractor falls outside the scope of fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions, the Authority shall grant the contractor a period of forty-five days to revise its proposal and bring it within the aforementioned scope before taking any action under Article 18 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 5.如果企业部未能以公平合理的商业条款和条件取得适当的技术，使其能及时开始回收和加工“区域”的矿物，理事会或大会可召集由从事“区域”内活动的缔约国、担保实体从事“区域”内活动的缔约国、以及可以取得这种技术的其他缔约国组成的一个集团。
Translation: If the Enterprise Department fails to obtain appropriate technology on fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions to enable it to commence recovery and processing of minerals in the Area in a timely manner, the Council or Assembly may convene a group composed of Contracting States engaged in activities in the Area, Contracting States with sponsoring entities engaged in activities in the Area, and other Contracting States capable of obtaining such technology.

Query_Text_cn: 这个集团应共同协商，并应采取有效措施，以保证这种技术以公平合理的商业条款和条件向企业部提供。
Translation: The Group should engage in collective consultations and take effective measures to ensure that this technology is made available to the enterprise sector under fair and reasonable commercial terms and conditions.

Query_Text_cn: 每一个这种缔约国都应在其自己的法律制度范围内，为此目的采取一切可行的措施。
Translation: Each such Contracting Party shall take all feasible measures within its own legal system for this purpose.

Query_Text_cn: 6.在同企业部进行联合企业的情形下，技术转让将按照联合企业协议的条款进行。
Translation: In the case where the enterprise department enters into a joint venture, technology transfer shall be conducted in accordance with the terms of the joint venture agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 7.第3款所要求的承诺应列入进行“区域”内活动的每一个合同，至企业部开始商业生产后十年为止，在这段期间内可援引这些承诺。
Translation: The commitments required under paragraph 3 shall be included in each contract for activities within the "Region", remaining valid until ten years after the enterprise department commences commercial production, during which period these commitments may be invoked.

Query_Text_cn: 8.为本条的目的，“技术”是指专用设备和技术知识，包括为装配、维护和操作一个可行的系统所必要的手册、设计、操作指示、训练及技术咨询和支援，以及在非专属性的基础上为该目的使用以上各个项目的法律权利。
Translation: "For the purposes of this clause, 'technology' refers to specialized equipment and technical knowledge, including manuals, designs, operating instructions, training, and technical consultation and support necessary for the assembly, maintenance, and operation of a viable system, as well as the non-exclusive legal rights to use the aforementioned items for such purposes."

Query_Text_cn: 1.管理局应于本公约生效后六个月，以及其后每逢第四个月，对提议的工作计划进行审查。
Translation: The Authority shall review the proposed work programme six months after the entry into force of this Convention and every fourth month thereafter.

Query_Text_cn: (a)申请者是否遵守按照本附件第四条规定的申请程序，并已向管理局提供该条所规定的任何这种承诺和保证。
Translation: (a) Whether the applicant has complied with the application procedures prescribed in Article 4 of this Annex and has provided to the Administration any such commitments and assurances as prescribed in Article 4.

Query_Text_cn: (b)申请者是否具备本附件第四条所规定的必要资格。
Translation: (b) Whether the applicant possesses the necessary qualifications specified in Article 4 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 3.所有提议的工作计划，应按其收到的顺序予以处理。
Translation: All proposed work plans shall be processed in the order in which they are received.

Query_Text_cn: 提议的工作计划应符合并遵守本公约的有关条款以及管理局各项规则、规章和程序，其中包括关于作业条件、财政贡献和有关技术转让承诺的那些规则、规章和程序。
Translation: The proposed work plan shall comply with and adhere to the relevant provisions of this Convention and the rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority, including those related to operational conditions, financial contributions, and commitments regarding technology transfer.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵在非保留区域进行勘探和开发多金属结核的工作计划，而这些区域合并计算构成海底区域中未予保留或未依据第一六二条第2款(X)项不准开发的部分的总面积的百分之二。
Translation: A work program for the exploration and exploitation of polymetallic nodules in non-retained areas, which collectively account for two percent of the total area of the seabed that has not been retained or is not subject to prohibition of development under paragraph 2(X) of Article 162.

Query_Text_cn: 4.为了第3款(c)项所指标准的目的，一个合伙团体或财团所提议的工作计划应在按照本附件第四条第3款规定提出担保的各缔约国间按比例计算。
Translation: For the purpose of the criteria referred to in paragraph (c) of this Article 3, the proposed work plan of a partnership or consortium shall be calculated proportionally among the Contracting Parties that have provided guarantees in accordance with paragraph 3 of Article 4 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 如果管理局确定第3款(c)项所述工作计划的核准不致使一个缔约国或由其担保的实体垄断“区域”内活动的进行，或者排除其他缔约国进行“区域”内活动，管理局可核准这种计划。
Translation: If the Authority determines that the approval of the work programme referred to in paragraph (c) of Article 3 would not cause a Contracting State or an entity sponsored by it to monopolize the conduct of activities in "the Area", or exclude other Contracting States from conducting activities in "the Area", the Authority may approve such a plan.

Query_Text_cn: 5.虽有第3款(a)项，在第一五一条第3款所规定的过渡期间结束后，管理局可以通过规则、规章和程序制订其他符合本公约规定的程序和准则，以便在须对提议区域的申请者作出选择的情形下，决定哪些工作计划应予核准。
Translation: Notwithstanding paragraph (a) of this Article, after the expiration of the transition period specified in paragraph 3 of Article 151, the Authority may establish through rules,regulations and procedures other criteria in accordance with the provisions of this Convention to determine which work plans shall be approved in cases where it is necessary to select among applicants for proposed areas.

Query_Text_cn: 这些程序和准则应确保在公平和无歧视的基础上核准工作计划。
Translation: These procedures and guidelines should ensure the approval of work plans on a fair and non-discriminatory basis.

Query_Text_cn: 如果核准所有这些申请不会超出第一五一条规定的生产限制或违背管理局按照该条参与的商品协定或安排下的义务，则管理局应发给所申请的许可。
Translation: If the approval of all these applications would not exceed the production limits prescribed in Article 151 or breach the obligations of the Board under any commodity agreements or arrangements in which it participates in accordance with that Article, the Board shall issue the requested permits.

Query_Text_cn: 2.如果由于第一五一条第2至7款所规定的生产限制，或由于管理局按照第一五一条第1款的规定参与的商品协定或安排下的义务而必须在生产许可的申请者中作出选择时，管理局应以其规则、规章和程序中所订客观而无歧视的标准进行选择。
Translation: If, due to production restrictions specified under Articles 2 to 7 of Article 151, or due to obligations under commodity agreements or arrangements entered into by the Authority in accordance with Article 151 paragraph 1, it becomes necessary to make a selection among applicants for production permits, the Authority shall conduct such selection based on objective and non-discriminatory criteria established in its rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: (c)在探矿和勘探方面已投入最多资源和尽最大努力者。
Translation: (c) The party that has allocated the most resources and made the greatest efforts in mineral prospecting and exploration.

Query_Text_cn: 4.未在任何期间内被选定的申请者，在随后各段期间应有优先，直到其取得生产许可为止。
Translation: Applicants not selected in any period shall be entitled to priority in subsequent periods until such applicant obtains a production license.

Query_Text_cn: 5.申请者的选择应考虑到有必要使所有缔约国，不论其社会经济制度或地理位置如何，都有更多的机会参加“区域”内活动，以避免对任何国家或制度有所歧视，并防止垄断这种活动。
Translation: The selection of applicants should take into account the need to ensure that all contracting parties, regardless of their social and economic systems or geographical locations, have more opportunities to participate in activities within the "region", to avoid discriminating against any country or system and prevent the monopolization of such activities.

Query_Text_cn: 6.当开发的保留区域少于非保留区域时，对保留区域生产许可的申请应有优先。
Translation: When the number of developed reserved areas is less than that of non-reserved areas, applications for production permits in reserved areas should be given priority.

Query_Text_cn: 7.本条所述的各项决定，应于每一段期间结束后尽快作出。
Translation: 7. The decisions referred to in this paragraph shall be made as soon as possible after the end of each period.

Query_Text_cn: 每项申请，除了企业部或任何其他实体就保留区域所提出者外，应包括一个总区域，它不一定是一个单一连续的区域，但须足够大并有足够的估计商业价值，可供从事两起采矿作业。
Translation: Applications, except those submitted by the Corporate Department or any other entity regarding reserved areas, shall include a total area which does not have to be a single contiguous area but must be sufficiently large and have sufficient estimated commercial value to accommodate two mining operations.

Query_Text_cn: 申请者应指明座标，将区域分成估计商业价值相等的两个部分，并且提交他所取得的关于这两个部分的所有资料。
Translation: The applicant shall specify coordinates, divide the area into two parts of equal estimated commercial value, and submit all documentation obtained regarding these two parts.

Query_Text_cn: 在不妨害本附件第十七条所规定管理局的权力的情形下，提交的有关多金属结核的资料应涉及制图、试验、结核的丰度及其金属含量。
Translation: Without prejudice to the authority of the Administration as specified in Article 17 of this Annex, the information submitted regarding polymetallic nodules shall include mapping, testing, the abundance of the nodules, and their metal content.

Query_Text_cn: 在收到这些资料后的四十五天以内，管理局应指定哪一个部分专保留给管理局通过企业部或以与发展中国家协作的方式进行活动。
Translation: Within forty-five days after receiving the documents, the Agency shall designate which portion is to be exclusively reserved for activities conducted by the Agency through the corporate sector or in collaboration with developing countries.

Query_Text_cn: 如果管理局请一名独立专家来评断本条所要求的一切资料是否都已提交管理局，则作出这种指定的期间可以再延四十五天。
Translation: If the Authority engages an independent expert to assess whether all the materials required under this Article have been submitted to the Authority, the period for making such a designation may be extended by an additional forty-five days.

Query_Text_cn: 一旦非保留区域的工作计划获得核准并经签订合同，指定的区域即应成为保留区域。
Translation: Once the work plan for non-reserved areas has been approved and contracts signed, the designated area shall become a reserved area.

Query_Text_cn: 1.对每一个保留区域企业部应有机会决定是否有意在其内进行“区域”内活动。
Translation: For each reserved area, the enterprise department should have the opportunity to decide whether it intends to carry out "regional" activities within it.

Query_Text_cn: 这项决定可在任何时间作出，除非管理局接到按照第4款发出的通知。在这种情形下，企业部应在合理时间内作出决定。
Translation: This decision may be made at any time unless the Authority receives a notice issued in accordance with paragraph 4. In such circumstances, the Corporate Division shall make the decision within a reasonable time.

Query_Text_cn: 企业部可决定同有兴趣的国家或实体成立联合企业来开发这种区域。
Translation: The Corporate Department may decide to establish a joint venture with interested countries or entities to develop such regions.

Query_Text_cn: 2.企业部可按照附件四第十二条订立关于执行其部分活动的合同，并可同任何按照第一五三条第2款(b)项有资格进行“区域”内活动的实体为进行这种活动成立联合企业。
Translation: The Enterprise Department may enter into contracts regarding the implementation of certain of its activities in accordance with Article 12 of Annex IV, and may establish joint ventures with any entity qualified to engage in activities within the "region" pursuant to Article 53(2)(b) for the purpose of conducting such activities.

Query_Text_cn: 企业部在考虑成立这种联合企业时，应提供发展中国家缔约国及其国民有效参加的机会。
Translation: When the Enterprise Department considers establishing such joint ventures, it should ensure opportunities for effective participation by Contracting Parties from developing countries and their nationals.

Query_Text_cn: 3.管理局可在其规则、规章和程序内规定这种合同和联合企业的实质性和程序性要求和条件。
Translation: The Authority may prescribe the substantive and procedural requirements and conditions for such contracts and joint ventures within its rules,regulations,and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 4.任何发展中国家缔约国，或该国所担保并受该国或受具有申请资格的另一发展中国家缔约国有效控制的任何自然人或法人，或上述各类的任何组合，可通知管理局愿意按照本附件第六条就某一保留区域提出工作计划。
Translation: Any developing country Party, or any natural or legal persons guaranteed by such a State and under the effective control of such a State or another qualified developing country Party, or any combination of the foregoing categories, may notify the Authority of their intention to submit a work plan for a reserved area in accordance with paragraph 6 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 如果企业部按照第1款决定无意在该区域内进行活动，则应对该工作计划给予考虑。
Translation: If the Corporate Department decides in accordance with Article 1 that it has no intention to carry out activities within the region, the work plan shall be taken into consideration.

Query_Text_cn: 按本附件第三条第4款(c)项的规定取得核准只进行勘探的工作计划的经营者，就同一区域和资源在各申请者中应有取得开发工作计划的优惠和优先。
Translation: Operators who have obtained approval for an exploration-only work program in accordance with paragraph (c) of Subparagraph 4 of Article 3 of this Annex shall be entitled to preferential treatment and priority in obtaining a development work program for the same area and resources among applicants.

Query_Text_cn: 但如经营者的工作成绩不令人满意时，这种优惠或优先可予撤销。
Translation: If the operator's performance does not meet satisfactory standards, such preferential treatment or priority may be revoked.

Query_Text_cn: 1.合同可规定承包者同由企业部代表的管理局之间采用联合企业或分享产品的形式，或任何其他形式的联合安排，这些联合安排在修改、终止、暂停方面享有与管理局订立的合同相同的保障。
Translation: The Contract may stipulate that the contractor and the Administration represented by the Department of Enterprises adopt the form of a joint venture, product-sharing arrangements, or any other form of joint arrangement, and such joint arrangements shall enjoy the same safeguards as those provided under contracts entered into with the Administration regarding modification, termination, or suspension.

Query_Text_cn: 2.与企业部成立这种联合安排的承包者，可取得本附件第十三条中规定的财政鼓励。
Translation: Contractors who establish such joint arrangements with the Enterprise Department may be eligible to receive the fiscal incentives prescribed in Article 13 of this Annex.

Query_Text_cn: 3.同企业部组成的联合企业的合伙者，应按照其在联合企业中的份额负责缴付本附件第十三条所规定的款项，但须受该条规定的财政鼓励的限制。
Translation: Partners in the joint venture formed with the Department of Enterprise shall be responsible for paying the amounts specified in Article 13 of this Annex in accordance with their share in the joint venture, subject to the limitations of the fiscal incentives provided under said Article.

Query_Text_cn: 1.企业部依据第一五三条第2款(a)项进行的“区域”内活动，应遵守第十一部分，管理局的规则、规章和程序及其有关的决定。
Translation: Activities conducted by the Department within the "Area" in accordance with Article 153, subsection 2(a) shall comply with Part Eleven,the rules,regulations,and procedures of the Authority and its related decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 2.企业部提出的任何工作计划应随附证明其财政及技术能力的证据。
Translation: Any work plan proposed by the Corporate Department shall be accompanied by evidence attesting to their financial and technical capabilities.

Query_Text_cn: (f)保证不致因依据第14款，按照本附件第十九条予以审查的合同条款或有关联合企业的本附件第十一条的规定向承包者提供财政鼓励，造成津贴承包者使其比陆上采矿者处于人为的竞争优势的结果。
Translation: (f) ensure that providing financial incentives to contractors in accordance with Article 14, through contractual terms subject to review under Article 19 of this Annex or the provisions of Article 11 of this Annex regarding joint ventures, does not result in granting contractors subsidies that place them in an artificial competitive advantage over land-based miners.

Query_Text_cn: 2.为支付处理关于核准合同形式的勘探和开发工作计划的申请的行政开支，应征收规费，并应规定每份申请的规费为五十万美元。
Translation: To cover the administrative expenses incurred in processing applications for the approval of the form of contract regarding exploration and development work programs, a fee shall be levied, and the fee for each application shall be prescribed as five hundred thousand US dollars.

Query_Text_cn: 该规费应不时由理事会加以审查，以确保其足以支付处理这种申请的行政开支。
Translation: The fee should be reviewed from time to time by the council to ensure that it is sufficient to cover the administrative expenses associated with processing such applications.

Query_Text_cn: 如果管理局处理申请的行政开支少于规费数额，管理局应将余额退还给申请者。
Translation: If the administrative expenses incurred by the Authority in processing the application are less than the amount of the regulatory fee, the Authority shall refund the balance to the applicant.

Query_Text_cn: 3.承包者应自合同生效之日起，缴纳固定年费一百万美元。
Translation: Contractor shall pay a fixed annual fee of one million US dollars from the effective date of the contract.

Query_Text_cn: 如果因为按照第一五一条发出生产许可有所稽延而推迟经核准的商业生产的开始日期，则在这段推迟期间内应免缴固定年费。
Translation: If the issuance of the production license under Article 151 is delayed, causing the approved start date of commercial production to be postponed, the fixed annual fee shall be exempted during the period of such postponement.

Query_Text_cn: 自商业生产开始之日起，承包者应缴付第4款所指的财政贡献或固定年费，以较大的数额为准。
Translation: From the date of commencement of commercial production, the Contractor shall pay the higher of the financial contribution or fixed annual fee referred to in Clause 4.

Query_Text_cn: (b)同时缴付生产费和一份收益净额。
Translation: (b) Pay simultaneously the production fee and a share of net proceeds.

Query_Text_cn: (b)上述市价应为按照第7和第8款的规定，在有关会计年度自合同包括的区域回收的多金属结核生产的加工金属数量和这些金属平均价格的乘积数。
Translation: (b) The market value referred to above shall be the product of the quantity of processed metals produced from polymetallic nodules recovered from the area covered by the contract and the average prices of these metals during the relevant accounting year, in accordance with the provisions of Articles 7 and 8.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在(d)项所规定的商业生产第二期的任何一个会计年度内，按百分之四缴付生产费的结果会使(m)项所规定的投资利得降低到百分之十五以下，则该会计年度的生产费应为百分之二而非百分之四。
Translation: If in any fiscal year within the second phase specified in item (d) of the commercial production period, paying a production fee at four percent would result in the investment gains specified in item (m) being reduced to below fifteen percent, then the production fee for that fiscal year shall be two percent instead of four percent.

Query_Text_cn: (b)上述市价应为按照第7和第8款的规定，在有关会计年度自合同包括的区域回收的多金属结核生产的加工金属数量和这些金属平均价格的乘积数。
Translation: The market value referred to above shall be, in accordance with the provisions of Articles 7 and 8, the product of the quantity of processed metals produced from the recovery of polymetallic nodules in the area covered under the contract during the relevant fiscal year and the average price of these metals.

Query_Text_cn: (c)⑴管理局在收益净额中的份额应自承包者因开采合同包括的区域资源所得到的那一部分收益净额中拨付，这笔款额以下称为开发合同区域收益净额。
Translation: (c)(1) The share of the Authority in the net proceeds shall be paid out of that portion of the net proceeds received by the contractor from the exploitation of the resources in the area covered by the contract, and such amount shall hereinafter be referred to as the Net Proceeds of the Contract Area for Exploitation.

Query_Text_cn: 在承担发展费用的第一个会计年度，未收回的发展费用应等于发展费用减去该年的现金赢余。
Translation: In the first fiscal year in which development expenses are incurred, the unrecovered development expenses should equal the total development expenses minus the cash surplus of that year.

Query_Text_cn: 在以后的每一人会计年度，未收回的发展费用应等于前一会计年度未收回的发展费用加上发展费用以年利十分计算的利息，加上本会计年度所承担的发展费用，减去承包者本会计年度的现金赢余。
Translation: For each subsequent fiscal year, the unrecovered development costs shall equal the unrecovered development costs from the previous fiscal year plus interest calculated at an annual rate of ten percent on the development costs, plus the development costs incurred during the current fiscal year, minus the contractor's cash surplus for the current fiscal year.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵商业生产的第二期，应从商业生产的第一期终了后下一个会计年度开始，并应继续至合同结束时为止。
Translation: The second phase of commercial production shall commence in the next fiscal year following the conclusion of the first phase of commercial production and shall continue until the termination of the contract.

Query_Text_cn: (e)“开发合同区域收益净额”是指承包者收益净额乘以在承包者发展费用中其采矿部门发展费用所占比率的乘积数。
Translation: (e) "Net Proceeds of the Contract Area for Development" means the product of the Net Proceeds of the Contractor and the ratio of the development costs of the mining department to the total development costs of the Contractor.

Query_Text_cn: 如果承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核、主要生产三种加工金属，即钴、铜和镍，则开发合同区域收益净额不应少于承包者收益净额的百分之二十五。
Translation: If the Contractor engages in the exploration, exploitation, and transportation of polymetallic nodules and primarily produces three types of processed metals, namely cobalt, copper, and nickel, the net proceeds from the Contracted Area shall not be less than twenty-five percent of the Contractor's net proceeds.

Query_Text_cn: 在(n)项规定的限制下，在所有其他情形，包括承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核、主要生产四种加工金属，即钴、铜、锰和镍的情形下，管理局可在其规则、规章和程序中规定适当的最低限额，这种限额与每一种情形的关系，应与百分之二十五的最低限额与三种金属和情形的关系相同。
Translation: Under the restrictions of paragraph (n), in all other circumstances, including those where contractors engage in the exploration, exploitation, transportation of polymetallic nodules, and the primary production of four processed metals, namely cobalt, copper, manganese, and nickel, the Authority may establish appropriate minimum limits in its rules, regulations, and procedures. The relationship between such limits and each circumstance shall be the same as that between the 25% minimum limit and the three metals and circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: (f)“承包者收益净额”是指承包者收益毛额减去其业务费用再减去按照(j)项收回的发展费用。
Translation: (f) "Net Contractor Proceeds" means the Gross Contractor Proceeds minus operating expenses and minus development costs recovered in accordance with paragraph (j).

Query_Text_cn: (g)⑴如果承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核、生产加工金属，则“承包者收益毛额”是指出售加工金属的收入毛额，以及按照管理局财务规则、规章和程序任何其他可以合理地归因于根据合同进行业务所得的款项。
Translation: (g)(1) If the Contractor engages in the mining, transportation of polymetallic nodules, and the production and processing of metals, the "Contractor’s Gross Proceeds" shall mean the gross proceeds from the sale of processed metals, and any other amounts that may reasonably be attributed to activities conducted under the contract in accordance with the financial rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵除(g)项(l)目和(n)项⑶目所列举者外，在所有其他情形下，“承包者收益毛额”是指出售自合同包括的区域回收物的金属结核生产的半加工金属所得收入毛额，以及按照管理局财务规则、规章和程序任何其他可以合理地归因于根据合同进行业务所得的款项。
Translation: Except for the items listed under (g)(l) and (n)(⑶), in all other circumstances, "Contractor’s Gross Proceeds" refers to the gross proceeds from the sale of semi-processed metals produced from the mineral nodules recovered from the area covered by the contract, and any other amounts that may reasonably be attributed to activities conducted under the contract in accordance with the Authority’s financial rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵在商业生产开始后，为执行工作计划而需要承担的与以上⑴目所载相类似的开支，但可计入业务费用的开支除外。
Translation: (2) Expenses incurred after the commencement of commercial production for the purpose of implementing the work plan that are similar to those set forth in the preceding item (1), excluding expenses that can be classified as business expenses.

Query_Text_cn: (i)处理7资本资产所得的收益，以及合同所规定的业务不再需要而又未予出售的那些资本资产的市场价值，应从有关的会计年度的承包者发展费用中扣除。
Translation: The proceeds from the disposal of capital assets, as well as the market value of capital assets that are no longer required for the contracted business under the contract and have not been disposed of, shall be deducted from the contractor's development expenses for the relevant accounting period.

Query_Text_cn: 这些扣除的数额超过承包者发展费用时，超过部分应计入承包者收益毛额。
Translation: When the deducted amounts exceed the contractor's development costs, the excess shall be included in the contractor's gross proceeds.

Query_Text_cn: (j)(h)项⑴目和(n)项⑷目所指的在商业生产开始之前承担的承包者发展费用，应从商业生产开始之日起，平均分为十期收回，每年一期。
Translation: The development costs incurred by the contractor prior to the commencement of commercial production as specified in items (j)(h)(1) and (n)(4) shall be recovered in equal installments over ten years, with one installment per year commencing from the date of commercial production start.

Query_Text_cn: (h)项⑵目和(n)项⑷目所指的在商业生产开始以后承担的承包者发展费用，应平均分为十期或不到十期收回，每年一期，以确保在合同结束前全部收回。
Translation: The development costs borne by the contractor as referred to in Item (h)(ii) and Item (n)(iv), after the commencement of commercial production, shall be recovered in equal installments over ten years or fewer, with one installment per year, to ensure full recovery prior to the contract's expiration.

Query_Text_cn: (k)“承包者业务费用”是指在商业生产开始后，为合同所规定的业务，而依照一般公认的会计原则所承担的经营合同包括的区域的生产能力及其有关活动的一切开支，其中除其他外包括：固定年费或生产费(以较大的数额为准)、工资、薪给、员工福利、材料、服务、运输、加工和销售费用、利息、公用事业费、保全海洋环境、具体与合同业务有关的间接费用和行政费用等项开支，以及其中规定的从其前或其后的年度转帐的任何业务亏损净额。
Translation: (k) "Contractor’s Operational Expenses" means all expenditures incurred for the contractual operations specified in the Contract after the commencement of commercial production, in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, including but not limited to: fixed annual fees or production fees (whichever is higher), salaries, wages, employee benefits, materials, services, transportation, processing and sales expenses, interest, utility costs, environmental protection of the marine environment, specific indirect and administrative expenses related to the contractual operations, as well as the net amount of any operational losses transferred from prior or subsequent fiscal years as specified herein.

Query_Text_cn: 业务亏损净额可以连续两年转入下一年度的帐目，但在合同的最后两年除外，这两年可转入其前两年的帐目。
Translation: Net operating losses may be carried forward to the next fiscal year for two consecutive years, except in the final two years of the contract, during which the losses may be carried back to the accounts of the two preceding years.

Query_Text_cn: (l)如果承包者从事开采、运输多金属结核并生产加工金属和半加工金属，则“采矿部门发展费用”是指依照一般公认的会计原则和管理局的财务规则、规章和程序，承包者发展费用中与开采合同包括的区域的资源直接有关的部分，其中除其他外包括：申请费、固定年费以及在可适用的情形下在合同包括的区域进行探矿和勘探的费用和一部分研究与发展费用。
Translation: (l) "Mining Sector Development Costs" refers to the directly attributable portion of the Contractor's development costs related to the resources within the area covered by the mining contract, in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles and the financial rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority. This includes, without limitation: application fees, fixed annual fees, and, where applicable, expenses for exploration in the area covered by the contract and a portion of research and development expenses.

Query_Text_cn: (m)任何会计年度的“投资利得”是指该年度的开发合同区域收益净额与采矿部门发展费用的比率。
Translation: The "investment gains" of any accounting year refers to the ratio of the net proceeds from the development contract area to the development expenses of the mining sector.

Query_Text_cn: 为计算这一比率的目的，采矿部门发展费用应包括采矿部门购买新装备或替换装备的开支减去被替换的装备的原价。
Translation: For the purpose of calculating this ratio, the development expenses of the mining sector shall include the expenditures on purchasing new equipment or replacement equipment minus the original cost of the replaced equipment.

Query_Text_cn: ⑴“开发合同区域收益净额”是指承包者的全部收益净额。
Translation: "Net Proceeds from the Development of the Contract Area" means the net proceeds of the Contractor.

Query_Text_cn: ⑵“承包者收益净额”的定义与(f)项相同。
Translation: (2) The definition of "net proceeds of the contractor" is the same as that in paragraph (f).

Query_Text_cn: ⑶“承包者收益毛额”是指出售多金属结核的收入毛额，以及按照管理局财务规则、规章和程序任何其他可以合理地归因于根据合同进行业务所得的款项。
Translation: "The term 'Contractor’s Gross Proceeds' refers to the gross proceeds from the sale of polymetallic nodules, as well as any other amounts that can reasonably be attributed to activities conducted under the contract in accordance with the financial rules, regulations, and procedures of the International Seabed Authority."

Query_Text_cn: ⑷“承包者发展费用”是指如(h)项⑴目所述在商业生产开始前所承担的以及如(h)项⑵目所述在商业生产开始后所承担的按照一般公认的会计原则与开采合同包括的区域资源直接有关的一切开支。
Translation: "Development Costs of the Contractor" means all expenses incurred prior to the commencement of commercial production as set forth in item (1) of clause (h) and all expenses incurred after the commencement of commercial production as set forth in item (2) of clause (h), which are directly attributable to the area covered by the production sharing contract in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.

Query_Text_cn: ⑸“承包者业务费用”是指如(k)项所述的按照一般公认的会计原则与开采合同包括的区域资源直接有关的承包者业务费用。
Translation: (5) "Contractor's Operating Expenses" means the expenses of the contractor's business that are directly related to the resources within the area covered by the exploitation contract, as set forth in item (k), and calculated in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

Query_Text_cn: ⑹任何会计年度的“投资利得”是指该年度的承包者收益净额与承包者发展费用的比率。
Translation: The 'investment gains' of any accounting year refers to the ratio of the net contractor revenue to contractor development expenses for that year.

Query_Text_cn: 为计算这一比率的目的，承包者发展费用应包括购买新装备或替装备的开支减去被替换的装备的原价。
Translation: For the purpose of calculating this ratio, contractor development expenses shall include purchases of new equipment or costs of replacing equipment minus the original cost of the equipment being replaced.

Query_Text_cn: (o)关于(h)、(k)(l)和(n)项所指的承包者所付的有关利息的费用，应在一切情形下，只有在管理局按照本附件第四条第1款，并顾及当时的商业惯例，认为债务资产净值比率和利率是合理的限度内，才容许列为费用。
Translation: The costs of interest paid by the contractors referred to in paragraphs (h), (k), (l), and (n) shall, under all circumstances, only be allowable as expenses to the extent that the Authority deems the debt-to-net-assets ratio and interest rates reasonable in accordance with paragraph 1 of Article IV of this Annex, having regard to prevailing commercial practices at the time.

Query_Text_cn: (p)本款所指费用不应解释为包括缴付国家对承包者业务所征收的公司所得税或类似课税的款项。
Translation: (p) The fees referred to in this paragraph shall not be construed to include taxes imposed by a State on the contractor’s business operations and paid by the contractor, such as corporate income tax or similar taxes.

Query_Text_cn: 7.(a)第5和第6款所指的“加工金属”是指国际中心市场上通常买卖的最基本形式的金属。
Translation: 7.(a) The term "processed metals" as referred to in paragraphs 5 and 6 means the most basic forms of metals that are typically traded on international commodity markets.

Query_Text_cn: 为此目的，管理局应在财务规则、规章和程序中列明有关的国际中心市场。
Translation: For this purpose, the Authority should specify the relevant international central markets in its financial rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: (b)如果管理局无法以其他方式确定第5款(b)项和第6款(b)项所指自合同包括在区域回收的多金属结核生产的加工金属的数量，此项数量应依照管理局的规则、规章和程序并按照一般公认的会计原则，根据结核的金属含量、加工回收效率和其他有关因素予以确定。
Translation: (b) If the Authority is unable to determine by other means the quantity of processed metals referred to in paragraph (b) of Article 5 and paragraph (b) of Article 6 that are included in the production from polymetallic nodules recovered within the Area, such quantity shall be determined in accordance with the rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority and in conformity with generally accepted accounting principles, based on the metal content of the nodules, processing recovery efficiency, and other relevant factors.

Query_Text_cn: 8.如果一个国际中心市场为加工金属、多金属结核和产自这种结核的半加工金属提供一个有代表性的定价机构，即应使用这个市场的平均价格。
Translation: If an international central market serves as a representative pricing authority for processed metals, polymetallic nodules and semi-processed metals derived from such nodules, then the average price of this market shall be applied.

Query_Text_cn: 在所有其他情形下，管理局应在同承包者协商后，按照第9款为上述产品定出一个公平的价格。
Translation: In all other circumstances, the Authority shall, after consultation with the contractor, determine a fair price for the aforementioned products in accordance with paragraph 9.

Query_Text_cn: 9.(a)本条所指的一切费用、开支、收益和收入，以及对价格和价值的一切决定，均应为自由市场或正当交易的结果。
Translation: 9.(a) All expenses, expenditures, revenues, and income referred to in this paragraph, as well as all determinations of prices and values, shall be the result of free market or bona fide transactions.

Query_Text_cn: (b)为了保证本款的规定得到遵守和执行，管理局应遵循联合国跨国公司委员会、发展中和发达国家间税务条约专家组以及其他国际组织对于正当交易所制定的原则和所作的解释，并应在其规则、规章和程序中，具体规定划一的和国际上接受的会计规则和程序，以及为了遵照这些规则、规章和程序查核帐目的目的，由承包者选择管理局认可的领有执照的独立会计师的方法。
Translation: (b) In order to ensure compliance with and enforcement of the provisions of this paragraph, the Authority shall follow the principles and interpretations established by the United Nations Committee on Transnational Corporations, the Group of Experts on Tax Treaties between Developed and Developing Countries, and other international organizations regarding arm's length transactions. It shall also specify in its rules, regulations, and procedures uniform and internationally accepted accounting rules and procedures, as well as the method by which contractors may select licensed independent auditors recognized by the Authority for the purpose of examining accounts in accordance with these rules, regulations, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 10.承包者应按照管理局的财务规则、规章和程序，向会计师提供为决定本条是否得到遵守所必要的财务资料。
Translation: The Contractor shall, in accordance with the financial rules, regulations, and procedures of the Authority, provide the accountant with the necessary financial information required to determine compliance with this Article.

Query_Text_cn: 大约在十五年前，有一天我在友人古斯塔夫·哈隆教授的书房里，和他共同研读主要是道家思想的古书《管子》。这次，他建议很快翻过我们正在读的那一章的某些材料，因为其中似乎只包括一些关于动物的荒诞无稽的传说。可是我却仔细地研究了它。
Translation: About fifteen years ago, I was in the study of my friend Professor Gustave Harlon, where we were jointly studying the ancient text *Guanzi*, which primarily focused on Daoist thought. On this occasion, he suggested we quickly skim over some material in the chapter we were reading, as it seemed to contain only absurd legends about animals. However, I carefully studied it instead.

Query_Text_cn: 结果发现，其中有一段文字谈到某些海洋动物受到月亮周期的影响，它们的大小随着月亮的盈亏而增大或缩小。
Translation: The findings revealed that a section of the text discussed how certain marine animals are influenced by lunar cycles, with their sizes expanding or contracting in accordance with the phases of the moon.

Query_Text_cn: 我大为惊奇，因为我记得亚里士多德曾说过完全相同的话。
Translation: I was greatly surprised because I remember Aristotle had said exactly the same words.

Query_Text_cn: 亚里士多德的叙述中所指的是海。我们现在已经证实了他的观察。
Translation: Aristotle's narration refers to the sea. We have now confirmed his findings.

Query_Text_cn: 后一种看法的可能性是难以令人信服的。
Translation: The possibility of the latter view is not convincing.

Query_Text_cn: 还有一次，在我写这些段文字之前的几个星期，我参加了皇家医学会的一次会议，会上有另一位老朋友查尔斯·辛格博士谈到盖伦和古代解剖学的关系。
Translation: A few weeks before I wrote these paragraphs, I attended a meeting of the Royal Medical Society where Dr. Charles Singer, another old friend, discussed the relationship between Galen and ancient anatomy.

Query_Text_cn: 他强调说，盖伦本人从来没有解剖过人体，他的老师们也没有解剖过，可是亚历山大时代的人确实进行过解剖，这开始于公元前3世纪上半叶的希罗菲卢斯和埃拉西斯特拉图斯。
Translation: He emphasized that Galen himself had never dissected a human body, nor had his teachers, but people of Alexander the Great's time did perform dissections, which began in the first half of the 3rd century BCE with Herophilus and Erasistratus.

Query_Text_cn: 早期菡督教的神父们大都把解剖当作一件骇人听闻的事情，他们自己从来不接触解剖。我感到这个事实是很奇特的，因为在中国也可以看到古代解剖学出现过类似的兴起和衰落。中国古代解剖学起源相当早，始于扁鹊，王莽时代（公元9年）已有进行解剖的确据，并持续到稍晚的三国时期（公元240年前后）。此后，也象在欧洲一样，解剖学便绝迹了，直到中世纪晚期才再度出现。
Translation: Early Christian clergy generally viewed dissection as an abhorrent practice and never engaged in it themselves. I find this fact intriguing, as a similar pattern of emergence and decline in anatomical studies can also be observed in ancient China. Chinese anatomical knowledge originated quite early, beginning with Bian Que, and there is documented evidence of dissections conducted during Wang Mang's era (9 CE), continuing into the slightly later Three Kingdoms period (around 240 CE). Thereafter, just as in Europe, the study of anatomy vanished until its resurgence in the late Middle Ages.

Query_Text_cn: 宋朝的解剖学者，大约比蒙迪诺·德·卢齐早一个世纪，可是没有发展下去。
Translation: The anatomists of the Song Dynasty, about a century earlier than Mondino de Luzzi, but did not see further development.

Query_Text_cn: 我举这些事例——还可以举出其他许多同样惊人的类似事例——目的是想指出，在讨论中国思想史和各门科学史之前，有必要谈谈在不同的历史时期内东亚和西欧之间思想传播的可靠性。
Translation: I cite these examples—with many other similarly striking instances that could be adduced—to point out that before discussing the history of Chinese thought and the histories of various sciences, it is necessary to address the reliability of intellectual transmission between East Asia and Western Europe across different historical periods.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，作为必要的准备，简要地讨论一下诸如通过贸易路线和翻译人员可能产生相互影响的各种条件等整个问题，显然是适宜的。
Translation: Therefore, as a necessary preparation, it is clearly appropriate to briefly discuss the entire issue of the various conditions under which mutual influence might arise through trade routes and interpreters.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管有大量的文献讨论到中国和欧洲之间的交往（下面即将简要地概述这些文献），可是我们还是没有足够的事实来作出总结，而且愈是深入追溯历史细节，情形当然便变得愈加复杂。
Translation: Despite the abundance of literature discussing Sino-European interactions (as will be briefly outlined below), we still lack sufficient factual basis to draw conclusive summaries, and the more we delve into historical specifics, the more intricate the situation naturally becomes.

Query_Text_cn: 已经编写出来的文献中，有许多东西只不过是猜想而已。
Translation: In the existing literature, much is nothing more than speculation.

Query_Text_cn: 在关于文字那一节中，我们提到过18世纪时的“体系”，当时人们根据早先的认识，了解到中国文字是象形性质的，因而认为中国人是“古代埃及人的移民”。
Translation: In the section on writing, we mentioned the "system" of the 18th century, when people, based on earlier understanding, recognized that Chinese characters were pictographic and therefore concluded that the Chinese were "immigrants from ancient Egyptians."

Query_Text_cn: 到19世纪，有些人在讨论中曾固执地坚持这一观点，可是现在象特里恩·德·拉库佩里或鲍尔的理论早已被驳倒了，因此主张中国文明主要是独立发展的人们，再也用不着与他们争辩了。
Translation: By the 19th century, some had stubbornly upheld this view in discussions, but the theories of figures like Triomphe de l'Alcée or Baer have long been refuted. Consequently, those advocating that Chinese civilization developed primarily independently no longer need to debate with them.

Query_Text_cn: 可是，认为在中国人的思想和实践中，有一大部分特殊的发展来源于西方，这种成见是很难消除的。
Translation: However, the prejudice that a significant portion of the distinct developments in Chinese thought and practice stem from the West is hard to dispel.

Query_Text_cn: 让我们举几个例子。
Translation:
The Chinese government is committed to promoting high-quality economic development through an innovation-driven strategy while strengthening environmental protection to achieve sustainable development goals.  
Globalization has reshaped international trade patterns, intensifying competition among nations in technology and talent sectors.  
The Belt and Road Initiative aims to enhance connectivity across Asia, Europe, and Africa via infrastructure investment and policy coordination.  
Monetary policy adjustments by central banks directly impact capital flows and inflation rates within the global economy.  
Climate change mitigation requires coordinated efforts from governments, enterprises, and civil society organizations worldwide.

Query_Text_cn: 马伯乐起先认为，《山海经》中所叙述的中国古代地理学是受到公元前5世纪外来（印度和伊朗）潮流的刺激，并且大部分中国天文学也是由于西方的启发。
Translation: Paul Pelliot initially believed that the ancient Chinese geography described in the *Shanhaijing* was stimulated by foreign influences from India and Iran in the 5th century BCE, and that most of Chinese astronomy was also inspired by Western influences.

Query_Text_cn: 他认为二十八宿、岁星纪年、圭表和漏壶是在大流士时代传入的；而在亚历山大时代的第二次潮流中，又传入了几何学、十二循环法、星表体系等等。
Translation: He believed that the Twenty-Eight Mansions, the Jupiter-based calendar system, the gnomon, and the clepsydra were introduced during the era of Darius I; a second wave during the time of Alexander the Great brought in geometry, the duodecimal cycle method, star catalog systems, and so on.

Query_Text_cn: 我们将要看到，所有这些说法都是根据不足的，并且，马伯乐在他自己后来关于中国天文学的优秀专著中，也放弃了这些观点，不再谈交流和刺激的问题了。
Translation: We will see that all these claims lack sufficient evidence. Moreover, in his later excellent monograph on Chinese astronomy, Marc Aurel Stein also abandoned these views and ceased to discuss issues of exchange and stimulus.

Query_Text_cn: 中国的“宿”和印度的“纳沙特拉”（意为月站）的关系，至今还是一个难题，人们尚无法决定其孰先孰后。
Translation: The relationship between China's "xiù" (constellation divisions) and India's "Nakṣatra" (Lunar mansion, meaning lunar stations) remains a puzzle, as scholars have yet to determine which originated first.

Query_Text_cn: 它们都可能来源于巴比伦。
Translation: They may all have originated from Babylon.

Query_Text_cn: 另有一些作者则任意地假设中国科学中的几乎每种有价值的东西都来自西方。例如，瓦卡曾不加思索地得出结论说，汉代的记里鼓车来自亚历山大里亚的赫伦（著称于公元60年）。可是在中国文献中最早提到记里鼓车，是和燕太子丹（公元前240—前226年）及韩延寿（公元前140—前70年之间）的名字连在一起的。
Translation: Some authors, however, arbitrarily assume that almost everything of value in Chinese science originated from the West. For instance, Vacca once concluded without hesitation that the Han Dynasty’s ji li gu che (a vehicle that marked distances) was derived from Hero of Alexandria (noted in AD 60). Yet in Chinese records, the earliest mention of the ji li gu che is associated with the names of Yan Crown Prince Dan (240–226 BCE) and Han Yan Shou (between 140–70 BCE).

Query_Text_cn: 汉代早期的这些记载并没有把记里鼓车当作很新鲜的事物；人们即使对当时所记述的记里鼓车究竟是什么车子还有点怀疑，那末，在汉代后期便有了关于记里鼓车的确切描述，这些记述出现得如此之快，以致很难认为它是从亚历山大里亚城传入的。瓦卡还认为，《周髀算经》中的几何学也来自西方，中国早期对∏值的计算也是从西方得到启发，而1300年朱世杰的二项式系数表则是从欧麦尔·海亚姆来的等等。
Translation: The records from the early Han Dynasty did not treat the ji li gu che as a novel invention. Even if there was some doubt about what exactly the ji li gu che referred to in contemporary accounts, by the later Han period there were precise descriptions of the vehicle. These accounts emerged so quickly that it is difficult to argue they originated from Alexandria.
