Translation: Medical records from hospitalizations and outpatient visits can be used to determine whether patients have experienced AF, ischemic stroke, and cardiovascular death events.

Query_Text_cn: 通过头轴位CT扫描或MRI检查可证实是否发生了缺血性卒中。
Translation: Through head axial CT scans or MRI examinations, it can confirm whether an ischemic stroke has occurred.

Query_Text_cn: 以均数±均数标准误来表示连续变量。
Translation: Continuous variables are expressed as mean ± standard error of the mean.

Query_Text_cn: 两组均数比较采用Studentt检验或Fisher精确检验。
Translation: Comparison of means between two groups was performed using Student's t-test or Fisher's exact test.

Query_Text_cn: 通过单变量、多变量Cox比例风险回归模型可以计算风险比(HR)和95%CI。
Translation: The hazard ratio (HR) and 95% confidence interval (CI) can be calculated using univariate and multivariate Cox proportional hazards regression models.

Query_Text_cn: 通过录入回归模型进行多变量分析，进入多变量模型中每个变量的P≤0.1(基于单变量分析)。
Translation: Multivariate analysis was conducted by entering variables into the regression model, with each variable included having a P ≤ 0.1 (based on univariate analysis).

Query_Text_cn: P＜0.05为差异有统计学意义。
Translation: P < 0.05 indicates statistical significance.

Query_Text_cn: 表1总结了研究人群的临床特征。
Translation: Table 1 summarizes the clinical characteristics of the study population.

Query_Text_cn: 在ST段抬高下壁MI的急性期，有59例患者发生了一过性AF(13.7%)。
Translation: In the acute phase of ST-segment elevation inferior myocardial infarction (STEMI), 59 patients developed transient atrial fibrillation (AF) (13.7%).

Query_Text_cn: 与没有发生AF的患者相比，AF患者的年龄偏大，女性更常见(P＜0.05)。
Translation: Compared with patients without AF, AF patients were older in age and more likely to be female (P < 0.05).

Query_Text_cn: 然而，两组患者在高血压患病率、糖尿病、高脂血症、吸烟、MI的部位及其病情程度、MI的再灌注治疗或LVEF等方面并无显著性差异(均为P＞0.05)。
Translation: There were no significant differences between the two groups in terms of prevalence rates of hypertension, diabetes, dyslipidemia, smoking history, location and severity of myocardial infarction (MI), reperfusion therapy for MI, or left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) (all P > 0.05).

Query_Text_cn: 出院时两组患者均给予口服阿司匹林，对合并AF的患者没有给予特殊的抗凝治疗或抗心律失常药物。
Translation: All patients in both groups were prescribed oral aspirin upon discharge, while those with atrial fibrillation (AF) were not administered specific anticoagulant therapy or antiarrhythmic medications.

Query_Text_cn: 经其他心血管处方药物如氯吡格雷、β-肾上腺素能受体阻滞剂、血管紧张素转化酶抑制剂/血管紧张素受体拮抗剂或他汀类药物治疗后，两组患者的疗效亦无显著差异(P＞0.05)。
Translation: There was also no significant difference in efficacy between the two groups of patients after treatment with other cardiovascular prescription medications such as clopidogrel, beta-adrenergic receptor blockers, ACE inhibitors (ACEIs)/angiotensin II receptor antagonists (ARBs), or statins (P > 0.05).

As shown in Figure 1, although the use of direct coronary intervention has increased significantly (13.5% from 2001 to 2005; 0.5% from 1997 to 2000; P < 0.05), there has been no obvious change in the incidence rate of acute MI with transient atrial fibrillation (AF) (13.6% from 2001 to 2005; 13.8% from 1997 to 2000; P > 0.05).

Query_Text_cn: 经(38.5±1.4)mo(均数±均数标准误)随访后，在一过性AF患者组中有20例患者(34%)进展为AF；而在无一过性AF组患者只有9例(2.4%)(P＜0.01，图2)。
Translation: After a follow-up period of (38.5 ± 1.4) months (mean ± standard error of the mean), 20 patients (34%) in the paroxysmal AF group progressed to persistent/ permanent atrial fibrillation; whereas only 9 patients (2.4%) in the non-paroxysmal AF group exhibited such progression (P < 0.01, Figure 2).

Query_Text_cn: 通过观察发现大部分患者(93%)在急性MI后第1年内发生的AF均为阵发性。
Translation: Observation found that the majority of patients (93%) who developed AF within the first year after acute MI were paroxysmal.

Query_Text_cn: 合并一过性AF与无一过性AF两组患者相比，AF的年发病率分别为22%和1.3%(P＜0.01)。
Translation: Compared to patients without transient AF, the annual incidence rate of AF was 22% in those with transient AF versus 1.3% (P < 0.01).

Query_Text_cn: Cox回归分析显示存在一过性AF(HR13.4，95%CI6.0～30.0；P＜0.01)和年龄＞65岁(HR3.3，95%CI1.1～9.9；P＜0.04)是急性MI后发生AF的独立预测因子。
Translation: Cox regression analysis showed that paroxysmal AF (HR 13.4, 95% CI 6.0 to 30.0; P < 0.01) and age >65 years (HR 3.3, 95% CI 1.1 to 9.9; P <0.04) were independent predictors of AF following acute MI.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管应用了抗血小板治疗，随访期间一过性AF患者组中有13例患者发生了缺血性卒中(22%)，而无一过性AF患者组中只有15例(4%)(P＜0.01，图3)。
Translation: Despite the application of antiplatelet therapy, the group with transient AF experienced 13 cases of ischemic stroke (22%) during the follow-up period, while the group without transient AF had only 15 cases (4%). (P <0.01, see Figure 3).

Query_Text_cn: 在一过性AF患者中，缺血性卒中的年发病率在随访的第1年和第2年分别为10.2%和7.5%，明显高于无一过性AF患者组(分别为1.8%和0.5%)(P＜0.01)。
Translation: In patients with transient AF, the annual incidence rates of ischemic stroke were 10.2% and 7.5% during the first and second years of follow-up, respectively, which were significantly higher than those in the group without transient AF (1.8% and 0.5%, respectively) (P < 0.01).

Query_Text_cn: 而在无一过性AF患者组中，仅有1例患者(7%)发生缺血性卒中(P＜0.01)。
Translation: In the group of patients without paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF), only one patient (7%) experienced an ischemic stroke (P < 0.01).

Query_Text_cn: 在两组发生卒中的患者中，在卒中同时均出现了AF。
Translation: In both groups of stroke patients, AF was present at the time of stroke.

Query_Text_cn: Cox回归分析显示存在一过性AF(HR5.1，95%CI2.4～11.2；P＜0.01)和年龄＞65岁(HR3.3，95%CI1.2～9.2；P＜0.03)是急性MI后发生缺血性卒中的独立预测因子。
Translation: Cox regression analysis identified that paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF) (HR 5.1, 95% CI 2.4–11.2; P <0.01) and age >65 years (HR 3.3, 95% CI 1.2–9.2; P <0.03) were independent predictors of ischemic stroke following acute myocardial infarction (MI).

Query_Text_cn: 在随访期间，共有62例患者死亡，伴一过性AF组死亡8人(14%)，无一过性AF组死亡54人(15%)。两组相比，病死率并无显著差异(P=0.85)。
Translation: During the follow-up period, a total of 62 patients died, with 8 deaths (14%) in the group with transient AF and 54 deaths (15%) in the group without transient AF. There was no statistically significant difference in mortality rates between the two groups (P=0.85).

Query_Text_cn: 本次研究结果显示急性ST段抬高下壁MI合并一过性AF是后续发生AF和缺血性卒中的高危因素。
Translation: The study results indicate that acute ST-segment elevation inferior wall myocardial infarction combined with transient atrial fibrillation (AF) is a significant risk factor for subsequent occurrence of AF and ischemic stroke.

Query_Text_cn: 在本研究中，大约有14%的急性ST段抬高下壁MI患者合并一过性AF。
Translation: In this study, approximately 14% of patients with acute ST-segment elevation inferior wall myocardial infarction coexisted with transient atrial fibrillation.

Query_Text_cn: 在急性MI后为期1y的随访中，与无一过性AF组患者相比，有一过性AF组患者发生AF的风险增加了15倍(大约22%)，发生缺血性卒中的风险增加了5倍(大约10%)。
Translation: During a 1-year follow-up after acute MI, compared to patients without transient AF, those with transient AF had a 15-fold increased risk of AF (approximately 22%) and a 5-fold increased risk of ischemic stroke (approximately 10%).

Query_Text_cn: 更重要的是，在急性MI期间发生一过性AF的患者中，约77%的病例在发生AF的同时合并缺血性卒中。
Translation: More importantly, among patients who developed transient AF during acute myocardial infarction, approximately 77% of cases presented with ischemic stroke concurrently with AF.

Query_Text_cn: 该项发现提示，在急性MI期间一过性AF患者的AF反复发作导致了缺血性卒中。
Translation: This finding suggests that recurrent episodes of AF in patients with transient AF during acute myocardial infarction (MI) led to ischemic stroke.

Query_Text_cn: 既往的研究显示MI后新发AF者近期或远期的临床预后不良。
Translation: Previous studies have shown that patients with new-onset AF following MI have poor short-term and long-term clinical outcomes.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，这些研究包括了不同特征的患者群，频繁发生AF的患者通常伴随不良的预后因素，如发生前壁MI以及与急性MI相关的心源性休克。
Translation: However, these studies included patient populations with diverse characteristics, and those with frequent occurrence of AF were typically associated with poor prognostic factors such as anterior wall MI and cardiogenic shock related to acute MI.

Query_Text_cn: 已有研究提示，急性MI合并AF可能仅是反映总体临床状态较差的一项指标，而非不良临床预后的单独预测因子。
Translation: Existing studies suggest that acute myocardial infarction coexisting with atrial fibrillation may merely be an indicator reflecting the overall poorer clinical status rather than a standalone predictive factor for adverse clinical outcomes.

Query_Text_cn: 本次研究对急性MI后远期预后良好的急性ST段下壁抬高性MI和LVEF＞45%患者进行调查，探讨了一过性AF的临床意义。
Translation: This study investigated the clinical significance of transient atrial fibrillation (AF) in patients with favorable long-term prognosis following acute myocardial infarction (MI), specifically focusing on cases of acute ST-segment elevation inferior wall MI and left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) >45%.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，在急性MI期间应用直接冠脉介入干预进行再灌注治疗看来并未影响一过性AF的发病率。
Translation: Additionally, the application of direct coronary intervention for reperfusion therapy during acute MI does not appear to affect the incidence of transient AF.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，与MI后LVEF受损的患者相比，本研究人群在急性MI期间出现的急性血流动力学变化更不可能是一过性AF的原发病因。
Translation: Therefore, compared to patients with LVEF impairment following MI, the acute hemodynamic changes observed during the acute MI in the study population are less likely to be the primary etiology of transient AF.

Query_Text_cn: 在本次对于急性下壁MI后一过性AF患者的研究中，其长期随访期间所见的AF高复发率(34%)与阵发性AF相当[16]。
Translation: In this study of patients with transient AF following acute inferior wall myocardial infarction, the high recurrence rate of AF (34%) observed during long-term follow-up was comparable to that of paroxysmal AF [16].

Query_Text_cn: 对此合理的解释是上述患者内在发生AF的倾向被急性MI所诱发。
Translation: A plausible explanation is that the aforementioned patients' underlying predisposition to develop AF was triggered by acute MI.

Query_Text_cn: 在平均39mo随访期间，大约6%的患者在服用抗血小板药物治疗期间发生了缺血性卒中。
Translation: During an average follow-up period of 39 months, approximately 6% of patients experienced an ischemic stroke while undergoing antiplatelet therapy.

Query_Text_cn: 高出那些伴有较多危险因素AF患者的2～3倍，但是却低于既往研究中急性ST段抬高性MI后单独应用抗血小板因子治疗亦发生持久性AF患者的发病率(大约14%)。
Translation: The incidence is 2 to 3 times higher than among AF patients with more risk factors, but lower than the prevalence observed in previous studies of patients who developed persistent AF after acute ST-segment elevation MI treated with antiplatelet therapy alone (approximately 14%).

Query_Text_cn: 尽管最近的美国心脏病学会/美国心脏学会/欧洲心脏病学会有关AF的指南认为，冠脉疾病是AF患者发生卒中的低危因素。而美国国家健康与临床研究院(NICE)指南认为，年龄＞75岁且合并冠脉疾病是卒中的高危因素。
Translation: Although recent guidelines from the American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association/European Society of Cardiology consider coronary artery disease a low-risk factor for stroke in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF), the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) guidelines view age >75 years combined with coronary artery disease as a high-risk factor for stroke.

Query_Text_cn: 本次研究结果表明，存在一过性AF和年龄＞65岁是急性MI患者发生缺血性卒中的独立预测因子。
Translation: The results of this study indicate that the presence of paroxysmal AF and age >65 years are independent predictors of ischemic stroke in patients with acute MI.

Query_Text_cn: 存在MI是AF患者发生卒中的一种中危因素，单独应用抗血小板药物治疗可能不能有效地防止血栓栓塞。
Translation: The presence of MI is a moderate risk factor for stroke in AF patients, and the use of antiplatelet agents alone may not effectively prevent thromboembolism.

Query_Text_cn: 既往研究提出应用中－高强度的华法林抗凝治疗可使国际标准化比值(INR)达到3～4，有助于保护MI患者的血管，与应用阿司匹林所达到的抗凝效果相当，而华法林联合应用阿司匹林会增加出血的危险性。
Translation: Previous studies have proposed that moderate-to-high intensity warfarin anticoagulation therapy, which elevates the international normalized ratio (INR) to 3–4, can help protect vascular function in MI patients, with anticoagulant effects comparable to those achieved with aspirin. However, combined use of warfarin and aspirin increases bleeding risk.

Query_Text_cn: 对于中等强度抗凝治疗(INR2～3)，关于其疗效目前还没有有明确的资料支持，但是却普遍应用于AF患者，作为MI患者的二级预防。
Translation: Moderate-intensity anticoagulation therapy (INR 2-3) currently lacks conclusive evidence to support its efficacy, yet it is widely used in AF patients as a secondary prevention measure for MI.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，在MI合并AF的患者中，如果没有禁忌证，阿司匹林联合中等强度的华法林抗凝治疗(INR2～3)是不错的抗凝方案。
Translation: Therefore, in patients with MI and AF, in the absence of contraindications, aspirin combined with moderate-intensity warfarin anticoagulation therapy (INR 2–3) is a reasonable anticoagulation regimen.

Query_Text_cn: 对于AF患者在急性MI期间给予经皮冠脉介入治疗的情况就比较复杂。
Translation: The situation regarding percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) for AF patients during acute MI is rather complex.

Query_Text_cn: 在采用冠脉支架行经皮冠脉介入治疗的患者中，单独应用华法林抗凝治疗的不良心血管事件发生率较高。
Translation: In patients undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) with coronary stents, the incidence rate of adverse cardiovascular events is higher when warfarin anticoagulation therapy is used alone.

Query_Text_cn: 关于此类患者的最佳抗凝治疗方案，资料记载有限。
Translation: There is limited documentation on the optimal anticoagulant therapy regimen for such patients.

Query_Text_cn: 这也导致了经皮冠脉介入治疗的AF患者中可见多种抗凝治疗方案。
Translation: This also leads to the presence of various anticoagulation regimens among AF patients undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention.

Query_Text_cn: 最近，美国心脏病学会/美国心脏学会/欧洲心脏病学会有关AF治疗的指南[19]提出，在冠脉介入治疗后可立即给予小剂量阿司匹林和(或)氯吡格雷或与抗凝治疗联合应用。
Translation: The recent guidelines from the American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association/European Society of Cardiology on AF treatment [19] recommend that low-dose aspirin and/or clopidogrel may be immediately initiated following coronary intervention, or used in combination with anticoagulant therapy.

Query_Text_cn: 但延长三联治疗的时间会增加大出血的危险性。
Translation: But extending the duration of triple therapy increases the risk of major bleeding.

Query_Text_cn: 据此，根据植入支架的种类以及复发性心肌缺血和出血的风险，认为联合应用华法林和氯吡格雷可长期维持治疗。
Translation: Based on the types of implanted stents and the risks of recurrent myocardial ischemia and bleeding, the combined use of warfarin and clopidogrel is considered appropriate for long-term maintenance therapy.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，该治疗方案并非基于临床研究评估，而是来自专家共识意见。
Translation: However, the treatment regimen is not based on clinical trial evaluations but rather derived from expert consensus opinions.

Query_Text_cn: 需进一步研究以明确口服抗凝药在联合抗血小板治疗急性MI合并AF患者中的最佳剂量。
Translation: Further research is needed to clarify the optimal dose of oral anticoagulants in combined antiplatelet therapy for patients with acute myocardial infarction and atrial fibrillation.

Query_Text_cn: 2006年4月，一11个月女婴在学步车中玩耍时从15层台阶上跌落。
Translation: In April 2006, an 11-month-old girl infant fell from a flight of 15 steps while playing in a walker.

Query_Text_cn: 患儿神志清楚，似乎并无严重问题。
Translation: The pediatric patient is alert and oriented, with no apparent serious issues.

Query_Text_cn: 患儿父母认为其休息就可无碍。
Translation: The parents of the child believe that rest alone will suffice to ensure no complications.

Query_Text_cn: 医生未发现严重损伤或神经功能损伤的证据。
Translation: Doctors found no evidence of severe injuries or neurological dysfunction.

Query_Text_cn: 头颅和颈部CT未发现出血或骨折，颈椎X线检查亦无阳性发现。
Translation: CT scans of the head and neck showed no evidence of hemorrhage or fractures, and cervical spine X-rays also revealed no positive findings.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，在患儿留观期间（伤后24h），开始出现下肢无力，并进展至下肢瘫痪。
Translation: However, during the observation period (within 24 hours after the injury), the child began to exhibit lower limb weakness, which progressed to lower limb paralysis.

Query_Text_cn: 在随后的12h内，患儿发展至四肢瘫痪。
Translation: Within the subsequent 12 hours, the pediatric patient progressed to quadriplegia.

Query_Text_cn: 急诊CT检查依然未发现异常。
Translation: Emergency CT scan still failed to detect any abnormalities.

Query_Text_cn: 最终患儿被转至我们医院进行MRI检查。
Translation: Eventually, the pediatric patient was transferred to our hospital for an MRI examination.

Query_Text_cn: 到达我院时为伤后36h，患儿保持清醒，但表现为四肢瘫痪。
Translation: Upon arrival at our hospital, the patient was 36 hours post-injury, remained conscious, but presented with quadriplegia.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，出现明显的呼吸窘迫(48次/min)，并且感到疼痛（尤其在接触其肢体时加重），给予扑热息痛和安乃近后疼痛缓解。
Translation: Additionally, there was evident respiratory distress (48 breaths/min), and the patient experienced pain, which worsened on contact with the limb. After administration of Paracetamol and Analgin, the pain subsided.

Query_Text_cn: MRI显示颈2~6之间脊髓明显肿胀（附图）。
Translation: MRI shows marked swelling of the spinal cord between C2 and C6 (see figure).

Query_Text_cn: 诊断为无放射影像学异常的脊髓损伤（SCIWORA）。
Translation: Diagnosed with spinal cord injury without radiographic abnormality (SCIWORA).

Query_Text_cn: 12h后，患儿因脊髓受损发展为呼吸衰竭，需要在重症监护室进行机械性辅助呼吸。
Translation: After 12 hours, the pediatric patient developed respiratory failure due to spinal cord injury and required mechanical ventilation in the intensive care unit (ICU).

Query_Text_cn: 当天，还发现患儿出现周围性水肿。
Translation: On the same day, it was also found that the pediatric patient developed peripheral edema.

Query_Text_cn: 血液检查显示肌酸激酶水平极度增高(>2.3x105U/L，正常值小于202U/L)；此外还出现肌红蛋白尿(5500nmol/L，正常值小于0.4nmol/L)。
Translation: Blood tests revealed a markedly elevated level of creatine kinase (>2.3 × 10⁵ U/L, with a normal value <202 U/L). Additionally, myoglobinuria was present (5500 nmol/L, with a normal value <0.4 nmol/L).

Query_Text_cn: 随后几天，血液检查显示肌酐和尿素氮水平分别高达115μmol/L（正常范周27~62μmol/L）和48.6mmol/L。
Translation: Blood tests in the following days showed creatinine and blood urea nitrogen levels as high as 115 μmol/L (normal range 27-62 μmol/L) and 48.6 mmol/L, respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 经过静脉输液和使用呋塞米治疗，肾功能和肌酸激酶水平逐渐恢复正常。
Translation: Following intravenous infusion and treatment with Furosemide, renal function and creatine kinase levels gradually returned to normal.

Query_Text_cn: 我们认为，患儿从高处跌落导致肌溶解，从而引起肾功能衰竭。
Translation: We believe that the child's fall from a height led to rhabdomyolysis, thereby causing renal failure.

Query_Text_cn: 值得注意的是，腹部和腿部肌肉的超声检查、心脏超声、血液和尿液检查均未发现引起肌溶解的其他原因。
Translation: It is worth noting that abdominal and leg muscle ultrasound examinations, cardiac ultrasound, and blood and urine tests did not reveal any other causes leading to rhabdomyolysis.

Query_Text_cn: 住院9d后，撤除呼吸机，患儿被转移至普通病房。
Translation: After 9 days, the ventilator was discontinued, and the infant was transferred to a general ward.

Query_Text_cn: 在随后的12个月内，该女孩四肢活动逐渐恢复正常。
Translation: Over the subsequent 12 months, the girl's limb movements gradually returned to normal.

Query_Text_cn: 并且不再需要学步车。
Translation: And no longer need crutches.

Query_Text_cn: 2006年7月末次随访时状况良好。
Translation: At the time of the final follow-up in July 2006, the condition was good.

Query_Text_cn: 2008年7月，初级保健儿科医生告知，女孩发育正常，而且得到很好的照顾。
Translation: In July 2008, the primary care pediatrician reported that the girl was developing normally and was being well cared for.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，2008年11月，该女孩罹患支气管炎和哮喘，期间死于心脏停搏。
Translation: In November 2008, the girl suffered from bronchitis and asthma, during which she died from cardiac arrest.

Query_Text_cn: 尸检未发现此前漏诊的疾病，也未发现治疗不当的情况。
Translation: The autopsy did not find any previously undiagnosed conditions nor instances of inappropriate treatment.

Query_Text_cn: SCIWORA的常见原因是脊髓过伸或屈曲，占所有儿童脊髓损伤的19%~34%。
Translation: The common causes of SCIWORA are spinal hyperextension or flexion, accounting for 19%-34% of all pediatric spinal cord injuries.

Query_Text_cn: 大约1/4的SCIWORA患儿神经功能障碍属于迟发性或渐进性发作，而且通常在伤后48h内出现。
Translation: Approximately one-quarter of SCIWORA pediatric patients exhibit neurological dysfunction that is delayed-onset or progressive-onset, and typically occurs within 48 hours after the injury.

Query_Text_cn: 多数SCIWORA患儿不能完全恢复或者根本无法恢复。
Translation: Most pediatric patients with SCIWORA cannot fully recover or cannot recover at all.

Query_Text_cn: 婴儿学步车增加了小孩潜在的行走速度和自身重量，可有效防止婴幼儿跌倒；但它使婴幼儿在没有安全保障的情况下处于一个比爬行或行走更高的速度，从而对其安全构成威胁；此外还影响婴幼儿正常的运动和智力发育。
Translation: Baby walkers increase infants' potential walking speed and support their body weight, effectively preventing them from falling; however, they place infants in a higher speed than crawling or walking without adequate safety measures, thereby posing a threat to their safety; additionally, they may also impact infants' normal motor and intellectual development.

Query_Text_cn: 自1997年美国材料检验学会发布婴儿学步车标准以来，因婴儿学步车引起的伤害率也随之下降。
Translation: Since the ASTM International released the standards for infant walkers in 1997, the injury rate caused by infant walkers has also declined.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，婴儿学步车仍然是一种危险的玩具，对婴儿没有任何益处。
Translation: However, infant walkers remain dangerous toys, offering no benefits to infants.

Query_Text_cn: 父母们仍有可能购买婴儿学步车，就像其他一些国家的父母购买婴幼儿配方奶粉一样，他们错误地认为这样对孩子有益，却忽视了这些产品的风险。
Translation: Parents still have the option to purchase infant walkers, just as parents in other countries buy infant formula, mistakenly believing these products are beneficial for their children while overlooking the risks associated with these products.

Query_Text_cn: 加拿大政府从2004年起禁止使用和进口婴儿学步车。我们认为其他国家也应效仿这一做法。
Translation: The Canadian government has banned the use and importation of infant walkers since 2004. We believe other countries should also follow suit.

Query_Text_cn: 其父母闻声迅速跑去了解情况，见孩子鼻腔流血（持续不到1min），前额有一处小的擦伤。
Translation: The parents rushed over upon hearing the noise and found the child bleeding from the nose (lasting less than one minute) with a small abrasion on the forehead.

Query_Text_cn: 但随后，患儿神志逐渐淡漠，父母认为存在异常，1h后将其送至当地医院的急诊科就诊。
Translation: However, the child's mental status gradually became altered, and the parents noticed an abnormality, taking them to the emergency department of the local hospital one hour later.

Query_Text_cn: 背景药物洗脱金属冠状动脉支架易发生晚期支架血栓形成，阻止晚期血管腔扩大，妨碍外科血运重建，并且会影响多层CT的成像结果。
Translation: Drug-eluting metallic coronary artery stents are prone to late stent thrombosis, which prevents late vascular lumen expansion, impedes surgical revascularization, and affects imaging results of multislice CT.

Query_Text_cn: 作者评估了生物可吸收依维莫司洗脱支架(BVS)的安全性。
Translation: The author evaluated the safety of the bioabsorbable everolimus-eluting stent (BVS).

Query_Text_cn: 结果从30倒患者中获取了29例的临床资料。
Translation: A total of 29 out of 30 patients provided clinical data.

Query_Text_cn: 2年时，置入装置安全，未记录到心源性死亡、缺血驱动的靶病变血运重建或支架血栓形成，仅发生1例心肌梗死（非Q波性）。
Translation: At 2 years, the implanted device was found to be safe with no cases of cardiac death, ischemia-driven target lesion revascularization, or stent thrombosis recorded, though a single case of myocardial infarction (non-Q-wave) occurred.

Query_Text_cn: 18个月时多层CT检查（共检查25例患者）显示平均直径狭窄为19%(s=9%)。
Translation: At 18 months, multi-layer CT scans (performed on 25 patients) showed an average diameter stenosis of 19% (s = 9%).

Query_Text_cn: 2年时血管造影显示，支架内晚期丢失为0.48mm(s=0.28mm)，直径狭窄为27%(s=11%)，与6个月时的结果没有差剐。
Translation: At 2 years, angiography demonstrated an in-stent late loss of 0.48 mm (s = 0.28 mm) and a diameter stenosis of 27% (s = 11%), showing no significant difference compared to the results at 6 months.

Query_Text_cn: OCT和血管内超声显示2年时管腔较6个月时扩张的原因是斑块体积下降，而血管大小并未改变。
Translation: The expansion of the lumen at 2 years compared to 6 months, as shown by OCT and intravascular ultrasound, was due to a reduction in plaque volume, while vessel size remained unchanged.

Query_Text_cn: 术后2年时．34.5%的支架置入部位用OCT已难以查见支架特征，证实回声强度和射频反向散射减少。尚存可见的支架放置良好，保持通畅。
Translation: At two years post-surgery, OCT could no longer detect stent features in 34.5% of the stent implantation sites, confirming reduced echo intensity and radiofrequency backscatter. The remaining visible stents were well-placed and maintained patency.

Query_Text_cn: 此外曾经的支架置入部位及其邻近的冠状动脉因响应血管活性药物而出现血管舒缩运动。
Translation: In addition, the previous stent implantation sites and their adjacent coronary arteries exhibited vasomotor responses to vasoactive drugs.

Query_Text_cn: 结论置入2年后支架被生物吸收，重新出现血管运动，防止了再狭窄的发生，而且在临床上安全，提示未发生晚期支架血栓形成。
Translation: The results showed that two years after implantation, the scaffold was biologically absorbed, restoring vascular patency and preventing restenosis. This outcome demonstrated clinical safety, indicating no occurrence of late scaffold thrombosis.

Query_Text_cn: 晚期管腔扩大是否由斑块回缩造成（而无血管重构参与）尚需进一步证实。
Translation: Whether late lumen enlargement is caused by plaque regression (without vascular remodeling involvement) remains to be further confirmed.

Query_Text_cn: 基金美国AbbottVascular公司。
Translation: Fund the U.S. AbbottVascular company.

Query_Text_cn: 若发生内皮化延迟或不完全，由于生物可吸收支架最终不会有外源性材料暴露于血流，所以与药物洗脱金属支架相比，前者发生晚期血栓形成的可能性明显较小。
Translation: If delayed or incomplete endothelialization occurs, since the bioabsorbable scaffolds will not have any exogenous material exposed to blood flow eventually, compared with drug-eluting metallic stents, the former has a significantly lower possibility of late thrombosis.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，永久性的金属支架还会阻碍外科血运重建、关闭侧支血管、阻止扩张性血管重构、消除反应性血管运动，并影响非侵入性多层CT和MRI血管成像结果。
Translation: Permanent metallic stents also impede surgical revascularization, close collateral vessels, prevent expansive vascular remodeling, eliminate reactive vascular motility, and affect the results of non-invasive multi-layer CT and MRI angiography.

Query_Text_cn: 一项针对生物可吸收（非药物洗脱）多聚L-乳酸(PLLA)支架的研究显示，其置入后的远期结局与裸金属支架置入的远期结局相似，这表明了生物可吸收PLLA多聚物支架具有可行性和安全性。
Translation: A study on bioresorbable (non-drug-eluting) poly(L-lactic acid) (PLLA) stents demonstrated that their long-term outcomes following implantation were comparable to those of bare-metal stents, indicating the feasibility and safety of bioresorbable PLLA polymer stents.

Query_Text_cn: 由于镁支架置入后很快被生物腐蚀，导致其只能在短期内对血管的弹性回缩力产生抵抗，也由于没有抗增殖药物来防止新生内膜增生，因此镁支架置入后的再狭窄率较高。
Translation: Due to the rapid biodegradation of magnesium stents after implantation, which limits their ability to resist the elastic recoil of blood vessels in the long term, and the absence of anti-proliferative drugs to prevent neointimal hyperplasia, the restenosis rate remains high following magnesium stent placement.

Query_Text_cn: 作为裸金属支架的替代产品，生物可吸收的聚合物药物洗脱支架可提供短期血管支撑，并具有药物释放能力，同时却可避免金属支架远期效果不佳的局限。
Translation: As an alternative to bare-metal stents, bioabsorbable polymer drug-eluting stents provide temporary vascular support with drug-elution capability while avoiding the long-term limitations associated with metal stents.

Query_Text_cn: 我们报道了ABSORB试验在6个月时的血管造影和血管内超声结局以及在12个月时的临床结局，该试验采用的是生物可吸收依维莫司洗脱支架(BVS)系统（AbbottVascular，SantaClara，CA,USA）。
Translation: We report the angiographic and intravascular ultrasound outcomes at 6 months and the clinical outcomes at 12 months from the ABSORB trial, which utilized the bioresorbable everolimus-eluting scaffold (BVS) system (AbbottVascular, Santa Clara, CA, USA).

Query_Text_cn: BVS支架具有生物可吸收的多聚乳酸骨架，采用生物可吸收的多聚乳酸涂层，其中含有抗增殖药物依维莫司（Novartis，Basel，Switzerland）。
Translation: The BVS stent has a bioabsorbable polylactic acid scaffold and a bioabsorbable polylactic acid coating containing the anti-proliferative drug everolimus (Novartis,Basel,Switzerland).

Query_Text_cn: 在一组30例患者的系列中，BVS支架在6个月时的血管造影随访结果显示，支架内管腔丢失为0.44mm(s=0.35mm)，其主要是由于支架面积轻度减少（-11.8%），加之轻度的新生内膜反应(5.5%)，最终导致总体管腔面积减少了16.8%。
Translation: In a series of 30-patient cohort, angiographic follow-up results at 6 months showed an in-stent lumen loss of 0.44mm (s=0.35mm), primarily due to a mild reduction in scaffold area (-11.8%), combined with mild neointimal hyperplasia (5.5%), resulting in an overall lumen area reduction of 16.8%.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，仅有的严重不良心脏事件是1例非Q波性心肌梗死。
Translation: Additionally, the only serious adverse cardiac event was one case of non-Q-wave myocardial infarction.

Query_Text_cn: 在最初的12个月内，未记录到缺血性靶病变血运重建，也未发生支架血栓形成。
Translation: In the first 12 months, there were no cases of ischemia-driven target lesion revascularization recorded and no occurrences of stent thrombosis.

Query_Text_cn: 从手术后即刻至术后6个月，采用光学相干断层成像(OCT)以及回声强度和射频反向散射方法记录到了支架的形态学改变。
Translation: From immediately post-surgery to 6 months post-operation, morphological changes of the stent were recorded using optical coherence tomography (OCT) as well as echo intensity and radiofrequency backscatter methods.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，在人冠状动脉中BVS支架生物降解的中期结局如何仍有待进一步研究。
Translation: However, the mid-term outcomes of the biodegradation of BVS stents in human coronary arteries remain to be further studied.

Query_Text_cn: 本文报道18个月时的多层CT扫描结果、2年时的临床随访结果以及术后6个月和2年时采用多种侵入性成像方法对支架和血管壁进行的跟踪评估结果。
Translation: This article reports the results of multilayer CT scans at 18 months, clinical follow-ups at 2 years, and tracking evaluations of stents and vascular walls using various invasive imaging techniques at 6 and 24 months postoperatively and at 2 years.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究的设计方案已经发表。
Translation: The design scheme of the present study has been published.

Query_Text_cn: 简言之，在这项单组、前瞻性、开放标记的研究中，2006年3月7日至7月18日研究人员在4个研究机构共纳入30例患者，以支架安全性和影像学结果作为研究终点。
Translation: In summary, in this single-arm, prospective, open-label study, researchers enrolled a total of 30 patients across four institutions from March 7 to July 18, 2006, with the primary endpoints being stent safety and imaging outcomes.

Query_Text_cn: 患者年龄≥18岁，诊断为稳定性或不稳定性心绞痛或者隐匿性心肌缺血。
Translation: Patients aged ≥18 years diagnosed with stable angina, unstable angina, or silent myocardial ischemia.

Query_Text_cn: 所有治疗病变均为单个、原发于直径为3．0mm的自体冠状动脉内，其中长度小于8mm者置入12mm支架，长度小于14mm者置入18mm支架（仅有2例患者置入了18mm支架），所有治疗病变均有50%~100%的直径狭窄，心肌梗死溶/>1级。
Translation: All treated lesions were single, native coronary artery lesions originating from a 3.0 mm vessel diameter. Stents were placed as follows: 12 mm stents were used for lesions <8 mm in length, and 18 mm stents were used for lesions <14 mm in length (only 2 patients received 18 mm stents). All treated lesions exhibited 50%-100% diameter stenosis, with elevated cardiac biomarkers indicative of myocardial infarction (≥Grade 1).

Query_Text_cn: 主要剔除标准为：患者发生急性心肌梗死或不稳定性心律失常；或者左室射血分数小于30%，有再狭窄病变，病变位于左主干，病变包含直径>2mm的侧支；或者靶血管发生血栓或另外有临床表现明显的狭窄。
Translation: The primary exclusion criteria are: patients with acute myocardial infarction or unstable cardiac arrhythmia; a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) <30% accompanied by lesions including restenosis, located in the left main stem, or containing collaterals with diameters exceeding 2 mm; or thrombosis in the target vessel or another clinically significant stenosis.

Query_Text_cn: 我们根据此前曾报道的文献，采用几种影像学方法进行风险性分析，并将结果提交给当地的伦理委员会。
Translation: Based on previously reported literature, we employed several imaging methods to conduct a risk analysis and submitted the results to the local ethics committee.

Query_Text_cn: 试验方案获得四所参试机构的伦理委员会批准，所有受试患者（意向性治疗人群）在入选试验前均签署知情同意书。
Translation: The trial protocol was approved by the ethics committees of the four participating institutions. All enrolled patients (intention-to-treat population) signed informed consent forms prior to trial enrollment.

Query_Text_cn: 在术后6个月、1年、2年时进行临床终点的评估，随访至术后5年。
Translation: Clinical endpoints were assessed at 6 months, 1 year, and 2 years postoperative, with follow-up through 5 years postoperative.

Query_Text_cn: 在术后6个月时(14d内完成)进行血管造影、血管内超声检查并测定衍生的形态学指标（虚拟组织学、震动学参数及回声强度），并于术后2年复查（28d内完成）。
Translation: Angiography, intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) examination, and measurement of derived morphological indices (virtual histology, vibration parameters, and echo intensity) shall be performed at 6 months post-surgery (within 14 days), with a follow-up assessment conducted at 2 years post-surgery (within 28 days).

Query_Text_cn: 在一个中心(ThoraxCenter,Rotterdam,Netherlands)进行OCT亚组检查。
Translation: The OCT subgroup examination was conducted at a center (Thorax Center, Rotterdam, Netherlands).

Query_Text_cn: 在术后18个月时用多层CT进行非侵入性血管造影检查。
Translation: Non-invasive vascular angiography using multidetector CT was performed at 18 months post-surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 所有的严重不良心脏事件经独立的临床事件委员会裁定，并由数据安全监测委员会对患者的安全进行监测。
Translation: All serious adverse cardiac events were adjudicated by an independent clinical events committee, with patient safety monitored by the Data Safety Monitoring Board.

Query_Text_cn: 全部核心实验室分析指标（QCA、血管运动检查、血管内超声灰度、虚拟组织学、震动学参数、回声强度、多层CT和OCT）均由独立的中心研究机构（CardialysisBV，Rotterdam，Netherlands）进行分析。
Translation: All core laboratory analytical indices (QCA, vascular motion analysis, intravascular ultrasound grayscale, virtual histology, vibration parameters, echo intensity, multilayer CT, and OCT) were analyzed by an independent central research institution (Cardialysis BV, Rotterdam, Netherlands).

Query_Text_cn: 研究设备、聚合物的特性以及体外和临床前资料均已有详细描述。
Translation: The research equipment, properties of polymers, and in vitro and preclinical data have all been thoroughly documented.

Query_Text_cn: 支架为球囊扩张性支架，具有PLLA骨架和多聚D，L乳酸(PDLLA)涂层，涂层中含有抗增殖药物依维莫司并可控制其释放。
Translation: The stent is a balloon-expandable stent with a PLLA scaffold and a poly(D,L-lactic acid) (PDLLA) coating containing the anti-proliferative drug everolimus, which allows for controlled release of the drug.

Query_Text_cn: PLLA和PDLLA均可完全生物吸收。
Translation: PLLA and PDLLA can both be fully biodegradable.

Query_Text_cn: 在生物吸收过程中，随着乳酸重复单位间的酯键被水解，以及直径＜2μm的微粒被巨噬细胞吞噬，PLLA和PDLLA的长链呈进行性缩短。
Translation: In the biological absorption process, as the ester bonds between lactic acid repeating units are hydrolyzed and microscopic particles with diameters <2 μm are phagocytosed by macrophages, the long chains of PLLA and PDLLA progressively shorten.

Query_Text_cn: 最终PLLA和PDLLA降解为乳酸，后者经Krebs循环进行代谢。
Translation: PLLA and PDLLA are ultimately degraded into lactic acid, which is metabolized via the Krebs cycle.

Query_Text_cn: 经强制性预扩张后置入BVS支架。
Translation: Implantation of the BVS stent after mandatory predilation.

Query_Text_cn: 所有患者在研究期内（5年）均需每日服用阿司匹林(>75mg)，并在至少6个月内每日服用氯吡格雷75mg。
Translation: All patients were required to take aspirin (>75 mg daily) throughout the 5-year study period and clopidogrel 75 mg daily for at least 6 months.

Query_Text_cn: 复合临床终点为心源性死亡、心肌梗死和缺血驱动的靶病变血运重建，该终点依据学术研究协会定义确定。
Translation: The composite clinical endpoint was cardiac death, myocardial infarction, and ischemia-driven target lesion revascularization, as defined by the Academic Research Society criteria.

Query_Text_cn: 非Q波心肌梗死的诊断需要肌酸激酶浓度升高超过正常值上限的两倍以上，且肌酸激酶同工酶MB水平升高。
Translation: The diagnosis of non-Q-wave myocardial infarction requires an increase in creatine kinase concentration to more than twice the upper limit of normal and elevated levels of creatine kinase-MB isoenzyme.

Query_Text_cn: 对每例患者，采用定量冠状动脉造影(QCA)对支架置入节段、置入节段周围节段（定义为支架边缘近端和远端各5mm节段）以及它们的复合节段（节段内分析）进行检测，并用冠状动脉造影分析系统Ⅱ(PieMedicallmaging,Maastricht.Netherlands)进行分析。
Translation: For each patient, the stent implantation segment, the surrounding segments of the implantation segment (defined as the 5-mm segments proximal and distal to the stent edges), and their composite segments (segmental analysis) were assessed using quantitative coronary angiography (QCA), and analyzed with the Coronary Angiographic Analysis System II (PieMedicallmaging, Maastricht, Netherlands).

Query_Text_cn: 支架末端微小的放射性标记物(37μm)有助于定位可透射线的支架以进行QCA检查。
Translation: The small radiopaque markers at the distal end of the stent (37μm) help locate the radiopaque stent for QCA assessment.

Query_Text_cn: 晚期丢失定义为手术后与随访期内最小管腔直径的差值。
Translation: Late loss is defined as the difference between the minimal lumen diameters after surgery and during the follow-up period.

Query_Text_cn: 为研究术后2年时的血管运动，根据各参试单位的临床实践，选用非内皮依赖的血管收缩剂马来酸甲基麦角新碱(methergin，Novartis，Basel，Switzerland)或内皮依赖的血管活性药物乙酰胆碱(Ovisot，Daiichi-Sankyo，Tokyo．Japan)进行检测。
Translation: To study vascular motility at 2 years post-surgery, non-endothelium-dependent vasoconstrictor methergine (methergin, Novartis, Basel, Switzerland) or endothelium-dependent vas活性药物乙酰胆碱(Ovisot，Daiichi-Sankyo，Tokyo．Japan)进行检测。ascular reactivity drug acetylcholine (Ovisot, Daiichi-Sankyo, Tokyo, Japan) were selected for testing based on the clinical practices of participating institutions.

Query_Text_cn: 在基线输入盐水后以及用微导管进行超选择性冠状动脉内输注乙酰胆碱（剂量渐增至10-6M）后，用QCA测定平均管腔直径。
Translation: After baseline infusion of saline and following superselective intracoronary infusion of acetylcholine with dose escalation up to 10⁻⁶ M via a microcatheter, the average lumen diameter was measured using QCA.

Query_Text_cn: 进行甲基麦角新碱检测时，在静脉内团注甲基麦角新碱(0.4mg)5min后进行QCA检查。
Translation: When administering Methylergometrine via intravenous bolus injection (0.4mg), the QCA examination is performed 5 minutes later.

Query_Text_cn: 两项测定均通过在冠状动脉内注射200μg硝酸甘油(nitronal,Pohl-BoskampGmbH,Hohenlockstedt,Germany)予以终止。
Translation: Both measurements were terminated by intracoronary injection of 200μg nitronal (Pohl-Boskamp GmbH,Hohenlockstedt,Germany).

Query_Text_cn: 术后及随访期内支架置入血管节段采用相位阵列血管内超声导管(EagleEye，Volcano，RanchoCordova，CA，USA)以每秒自动回撤0.5mm的速度进行检测。
Translation: The implanted vascular segments with stents were examined using a phased-array intravascular ultrasound catheter (EagleEye, Volcano, RanchoCordova, CA, USA) at a rate of 0.5 mm per second during the postoperative period and follow-up.

Query_Text_cn: 我们检测了自支架置入节段远端5mm起至支架近端5mm的目标节段。
Translation: We examined the target segment from 5 mm distal to the implanted segment to 5 mm proximal to the stent.

Query_Text_cn: 采用基于计算机的轮廓探测程序测定血管面积、支架面积和管腔面积、支架内新生内膜面积和管腔面积狭窄。
Translation: Determine vessel area, stent area, lumen area, neointima area within the stent, and lumen area stenosis using a computer-based contour detection program.

Query_Text_cn: 依据此前所描述的算法计算血管内超声所获得的平均管腔直径（单位mm，即所谓的平均投射管腔直径）。
Translation: Calculate the average lumen diameter obtained from intravascular ultrasound using the previously described algorithm (in mm, i.e., the average projected lumen diameter).

Query_Text_cn: 管腔面积狭窄百分比用下式计算：［（支架内平均管腔横截面面积-支架内最小管腔面积）/平均管腔横截面面积］×100%。
Translation: The percentage of vascular lumen area stenosis is calculated using the following formula: [(Average cross-sectional area of the lumen within the stent - Minimum lumen area within the stent) / Average cross-sectional area of the lumen] × 100%.

Query_Text_cn: 采用计算机辅助的灰度值分析程序来确定斑块性质并测定置入后多聚合物支架的回声强度。
Translation: A computer-aided gray-scale analysis program was used to determine plaque characteristics and measure the echo intensity of polymeric stents after implantation.

Query_Text_cn: 基于外膜的平均灰度水平（亮度），将斑块分类为比外膜亮（高回声）和比外膜暗（低回声）。
Translation: Based on the average grayscale level (brightness) of the outer membrane, plaques are classified into those brighter than the outer membrane (high-echoic) and those darker than the outer membrane (low-echoic).

Query_Text_cn: 上限组织定义为平均灰度值高于外膜平均灰度值加上其2倍标准差的组织。
Translation: Upper-limit tissue is defined as the tissue whose mean gray value exceeds the mean gray value of the epicardium plus two times its standard deviation.

Query_Text_cn: 钙化斑块和支架属于上限组织的范畴，为便于本分折，将二者与高回声组织进行合并。
Translation: Calcified plaques and stents fall within the category of upper-limit tissues. To facilitate this analysis, the two are merged with hyperechoic tissues.

Query_Text_cn: 我们计算了整个目标区域内除上限组织外的低回声斑块百分比。
Translation: We calculated the percentage of low-echo plaques in the entire target area excluding the upper-limit organization.

Query_Text_cn: 射频信号的反向散射可提供血管壁组织构成的相关信息（血管内超声-虚拟组织学；Volcano，RanchoCordova，CA，USA）。
Translation: The backscattering of radiofrequency signals provides information related to vascular wall tissue composition (intravascular ultrasound-virtual histology; Volcano, Rancho Cordova, CA, USA).

Query_Text_cn: 尤为典型的是，在超声横截面上坏死核心、致密钙化斑、纤维脂肪组织和纤维组织分别呈现为红色、白色、黄绿色和绿色区域，各部分面积用百分数表示（其面积之和为100%）。
Translation: Notably, in ultrasonic cross-sections, the necrotic core, dense calcified plaques, fibrofatty tissue, and fibrous tissue are respectively presented as red, white, yellowish-green, and green regions, with each area expressed as a percentage (summing to 100%).

Query_Text_cn: 在每个横截面上，由于多聚物具有很强的反向散射特性，多聚物支架常被检测为坏死核心包裹的明显的致密钙化区域。
Translation: In each cross-sectional view, due to the strong backscattering properties of polymers, polymer scaffolds are often detected as prominent dense calcified regions encapsulating a necrotic core.

Query_Text_cn: 我们采用支架置入后到随访期间这些区域在定量分析中的变化作为多聚物生物吸收过程的替代性评价指标。
Translation: We use the changes in these regions observed in quantitative analysis from stent implantation to the follow-up period as a surrogate evaluation metric for the polymer biodegradation process.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究中采用该项分析的原理是为了检测由支架置入和晚期支架生物吸收所造成的微小的应力差异。
Translation: The principle behind this analysis was to detect the subtle stress differences caused by stent placement and the late-stage biodegradation of the stent.

Query_Text_cn: 通过分析不同舒张压水平下射频信号的反向散射来测定血管壁的可变形性。
Translation: The deformability of vascular walls is measured by analyzing the backscattering of radio frequency signals under different diastolic pressure levels.

Query_Text_cn: 利用该方法可建立色彩编码的应变图像，在图像中识别冠状动脉的较硬（低应变，蓝色）和较软（高应变，黄色）区域，其径向应变值范围为0~2%。
Translation: Using this method, color-coded strain images can be established to identify stiffer (low strain, blue) and softer (high strain, yellow) regions of the coronary arteries, with radial strain values ranging from 0 to 2%.

Query_Text_cn: 在术后18个月行多层CT成像。
Translation: Underwent multilayer CT imaging 18 months after surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 除了支架两端的铂标记外，BVS支架是可透射线的，因此不会被多层CT检测到。
Translation: Except for the platinum markers at its ends, the BVS stent is radiolucent and therefore not detectable by multislice CT.

Query_Text_cn: 沿着自动建立的中心管腔线，在支架置入节段内以0.3mm的纵向间距测定横断面管腔面积。
Translation: Along the automatically established central lumen line, the cross-sectional lumen area is measured at a longitudinal spacing of 0.3 mm within the stent implantation segment.

Query_Text_cn: 假定管腔形状为圆形，根据测得的管腔面积计算出管腔直径。
Translation: Assuming the lumen is circular, calculate the lumen diameter based on the measured lumen area.

Query_Text_cn: 支架内直径狭窄或面积狭窄的严重程度用最小支架内管腔直径或面积与参考血管的直径或面积的比值进行计算，而参考血管的直径或面积通过内插法依据其近端和远端管腔参数计算。
Translation: The severity of in-stent diameter or area stenosis is calculated using the ratio of the minimum in-stent lumen diameter or area to the diameter or area of the reference vessel, while the diameter or area of the reference vessel is determined through interpolation based on the proximal and distal lumen parameters.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，测定了支架铂标记物之间的血管长度。
Translation: Additionally, the vascular length between the platinum markers on the stent was determined.

Query_Text_cn: 对入选荷兰鹿特丹Thorax中心的亚组患者采用已上市的OCT系统(ImageWire，LightLab，Westford，MA，USA)进行OCT检查。
Translation: The selected subgroup of patients at the Rotterdam Thorax Center in the Netherlands were examined using commercially available OCT systems (ImageWire, LightLab, Westford, MA, USA).

Query_Text_cn: 该技术采用红外光源，其分辨率达15微米（比血管内超声的分辨率高10倍），可对冠状动脉内结构进行精细成像。
Translation: The technology employs an infrared light source with a resolution of 15 micrometers (10 times higher than that of intravascular ultrasound (IVUS)), enabling precise imaging of intracoronary structures.

Query_Text_cn: 这种成像方法及其定量和定性分析此前已有描述。
Translation: This imaging method and its quantitative and qualitative analyses have been previously described.

Query_Text_cn: 将支架贴壁情况分为贴壁良好（埋人）、对齐排列（突出）和贴壁不良（不完全支架贴壁）。
Translation: Categorize stent apposition into optimal apposition (buried), aligned arrangement (protruding), and inferior apposition (incomplete stent apposition).

Query_Text_cn: 我们测定了随访中持续的、晚期获得的以及溶解的支架贴壁不良。
Translation: We assessed the persistent, late-acquired, and dissolved stent malapposition during follow-up.

Query_Text_cn: 通过将术后、术后6个月和2年获得的OCT横断面影像进行并列比较测定OCT影像形态。
Translation: The morphology of OCT images is determined by conducting a parallel comparison of cross-sectional OCT images obtained postoperative,6 months postoperative,and 2 years postoperative.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究为可行性试验，旨在为将来的研究提供初步观察结果并提出假说。
Translation: This study is a feasibility trial aimed at providing preliminary observational results and proposing hypotheses for future research.

Query_Text_cn: 样本大小并非基于终点假说确定，而是为了给支架的可行性和安全性提供信息。
Translation: The sample size was not determined based on the endpoint hypothesis but rather to inform the feasibility and safety of the stent.

Query_Text_cn: 依据估测的为获得可靠而显著的结果所需的最小患者数确定所需的样本数。
Translation: The required sample size is determined based on the estimated minimum number of patients required to achieve reliable and statistically significant results.

Query_Text_cn: 我们计算了二元变量的百分数。
Translation: We calculated the percentage of the binary variable.

Query_Text_cn: 对连续变量用均数及其标准差表示。
Translation: For continuous variables, the mean and standard deviation are presented.

Query_Text_cn: 对连续变量采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验，对二元再狭窄采用精确McNemar检验，以进行不同时间点的配对比较。
Translation: For continuous variables, the Wilcoxon signed-rank test was used, and the exact McNemar test was applied for binary restenosis to perform paired comparisons at different time points.

Query_Text_cn: 差值和可信区间也基于配对检测数据。
Translation: The differences and confidence intervals are also based on paired test data.

Query_Text_cn: 由于没有预先设定需验证的正式假说，故未进行任何统计学校正。
Translation: Since there were no pre-specified formal hypotheses to test,no statistical corrections were performed.

Query_Text_cn: 由于不能确定这3组观察的一致性，我们选取了最完整的实际观察值（而不是推测值）。
Translation: Since we could not determine the consistency of the three groups of observations, we selected the most complete actual observed values (rather than projected values).

Query_Text_cn: 鉴于多重比较参数的数量较多，本文中所用的P值仅为探索性的初步结果，需要更加谨慎地加以阐释。
Translation: Given the large number of parameters involved in multiple comparisons, the P-values used in this paper are merely exploratory preliminary results and thus require cautious interpretation.

Query_Text_cn: 除非特别说明，对影像学参数的分析是基于按方案治疗人群，对临床终点的分析是基于意向性治疗人群。
Translation: Unless otherwise specified, the analysis of imaging parameters is based on the per-protocol population, while the analysis of clinical endpoints is based on the intention-to-treat population.

Query_Text_cn: 本临床试验已在ClinicalTrials.gov注册，注册号为NCT00300131。
Translation: The clinical trial has been registered on ClinicalTrials.gov with registration number NCT00300131.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究的赞助方参与研究的设计和实施，以及数据的采集、管理、初步分析和解释，并有权对报告进行不受约束的评论。
Translation: The sponsor of this study participated in the design and implementation of the research, as well as data collection, management, preliminary analysis, and interpretation, and has the right to provide comments on the report without constraint.

Query_Text_cn: 全面监控确保了数据采集的准确性。
Translation: Comprehensive monitoring ensures the accuracy of data collection.

Query_Text_cn: 两名资深作者（PWS和JAO）可全权使用研究中的所有数据，并最终负责决定本文的提交发表。
Translation: The two senior authors (PWS and JAO) have full access to all data in the study and are ultimately responsible for deciding the submission and publication of this article.

Query_Text_cn: 表1示患者的人口统计学特征，图1示试验资料。
Translation: Table 1 shows the demographic characteristics of the patients; Figure 1 illustrates the trial data.

Query_Text_cn: 从30例人选受试者中获得了29例的临床随访资料。
Translation: Clinical follow-up data were obtained from 29 out of 30 enrolled subjects.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然有1例患者退出研究，但仍从其顾问医师那里获得了关键的临床状况资料。
Translation: Although one patient withdrew from the study, critical clinical condition data were still obtained from their attending physician.

Query_Text_cn: 1例患者在术后706d由于非心脏原因死亡。
Translation: One patient died of non-cardiac causes on postoperative day 706.

Query_Text_cn: 在术后699d时，患者由于上消化道出血引起血红蛋白下降而入院。
Translation: On postoperative day 699, the patient was admitted due to a decrease in hemoglobin caused by upper gastrointestinal bleeding.

Query_Text_cn: 703d时，患者发生十二指肠穿孔，导致在706d时发生非心源性死亡。
Translation: On day 703, the patient developed a duodenal perforation, which led to a non-cardiac death on day 706.

Query_Text_cn: 该例患者在术后364d时停用氯吡格雷，也未服用阿司匹林。
Translation: The patient in this case discontinued clopidogrel 364 days post-surgery and had not been taking aspirin.

Query_Text_cn: 平均随访时间为740.9d（极差707~800）。
Translation: The mean follow-up time was 740.9 days (range 707 to 800).

Query_Text_cn: 表2示术后2年的临床结局。
Translation: Table 2 presents the clinical outcomes at two years post-surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 在2年时，仅发生1例与治疗无血流限制性狭窄（QCA直径狭窄42%）相关的非Q波性心肌梗死（肌钙蛋白峰值为2.21μg/L）。心肌梗死发生在置入BVS支架46d后，患者是出现静息心绞痛发作（无心电图缺血证据）后安装支架的。
Translation: Within 2 years, only one case of non-Q-wave myocardial infarction associated with treatment of a non-flow-limiting stenosis (42% diameter stenosis via QCA) was reported, with a peak troponin level of 2.21 μg/L. The myocardial infarction occurred 46 days after BVS stent implantation in a patient who underwent stent placement due to episodes of rest angina (without electrocardiographic evidence of ischemia).

Query_Text_cn: 基于可理解的安全性考虑，我们将多聚物支架用药物洗脱金属支架覆盖。
Translation: Based on understandable safety considerations, we covered the polymer scaffolds with drug-eluting metallic stents.

Query_Text_cn: 在术后6个月至2年期间未记录到新发严重不良心脏事件。
Translation: No new onset severe adverse cardiac events were recorded during the period of 6 months to 2 years postoperation.

Query_Text_cn: 按照研究方案或学术研究协会的定义，未发生支架内血栓形成。
Translation: According to the definition in the study protocol or the academic research association, no in-stent thrombosis occurred.

Query_Text_cn: 研究方案设定至少6个月的联合抗血小板治疗，但是实际的治疗时间一般由研究人员依据欧洲心脏学会、美国心脏病学会和美国心脏协会的新指南进行裁定。
Translation: The study protocol specifies a minimum of six months of dual antiplatelet therapy, but the actual treatment duration is generally determined by researchers in accordance with the new guidelines from the European Society of Cardiology, American College of Cardiology and American Heart Association.

Query_Text_cn: 术后1年时有15例患者接受双重抗血小板治疗，术后2年时则仅有1例。
Translation: At the 1-year follow-up, 15 patients were receiving dual antiplatelet therapy, while only one patient was at the 2-year follow-up.

Query_Text_cn: 经剔除5例患者后（3例拒绝检查，1例对造影剂过敏，1例行血运重建）．在术后18个月时对意向性治疗人群中的25例患者进行多层CT扫描。
Translation: After excluding 5 patients (3 refused examination; 1 was allergic to the contrast agent; 1 underwent revascularization), multilayer CT scans were performed on 25 patients in the intention-to-treat population at 18 months post-surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 由于存在严重的运动伪影，对1幅多层CT的血管造影图像无法进行解释。
Translation: Due to the presence of severe motion artifacts, the 1 multislice CT angiographic image cannot be interpreted.

Query_Text_cn: 所有支架均开放。
Translation: All support structures are open.

Query_Text_cn: 平均管腔面积为5.2mm2(s=1.3)，最小管腔面积为3.6mm2(s=0.9)，平均管腔面积狭窄为34%(15%)（图2）。
Translation: The average lumen area was 5.2 mm² (SD=1.3), the minimum lumen area was 3.6 mm² (SD=0.9), and the average lumen area stenosis was 34% (15%) (Figure 2).

Query_Text_cn: 经计算平均直径狭窄为19%(s=9%，极差为1%~33%)。
Translation: The mean percentage diameter stenosis was calculated as 19% (s = 9%, range 1%–33%).

Query_Text_cn: 表1和表3示基线时、术后即刻、术后6个月和2年时的QCA结果。
Translation: Table 1 and Table 3 show the QCA results at baseline, immediately postoperative, 6 months postoperative, and 2 years postoperative.

Query_Text_cn: 术后2年的血管造影支架内晚期丢失为0.48mm(s=0.28mm)。
Translation: The 2-year post-procedural angiographic late loss within the stent was 0.48 mm (s = 0.28 mm).

Query_Text_cn: 我们观察到在术后6个月时有3例患者发生二元再狭窄。
Translation: We observed that three patients developed binary restenosis at six months post-surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 由于缺乏缺血的症状和客观体征，在术后6个月时未进行重复的血运重建。
Translation: Due to the absence of ischemic symptoms and objective signs, repeat revascularization was not performed at 6 months post-operation.

Query_Text_cn: 术后2年时，3处病变中有2处狭窄恢复至小于50%。
Translation: Two years post-surgery, two of the three lesions had their stenosis reduced to below 50%.

Query_Text_cn: 第3例患者拒绝行血管造影。
Translation: The third patient refused to undergo angiography.

Query_Text_cn: 从术后即刻至随访6个月和2年，参考直径明显减小，平均减小大约0.3mm（表3）。
Translation: From immediate postoperative period to 6-month and 2-year follow-ups, the reference diameter showed a marked decrease, with an average reduction of approximately 0.3 mm (Table 3).

Query_Text_cn: 在术后6个月至术后2年期间，未记录到支架内最小管腔直径、直径狭窄百分数和支架内晚期丢失存在明显差异(表3)。
Translation: Between 6 months and 2 years post-surgery, no significant differences were observed in the minimum lumen diameter within the stent, percentage diameter stenosis, and late lumen loss within the stent (Table 3).

Query_Text_cn: 因此，在术后6个月时已经记录到的最小管腔直径、参考血管直径和管腔面积的显著减小在术后2年时仍具有显著性。
Translation: The significant reduction in minimal lumen diameter, reference vessel diameter, and lumen area recorded at 6 months post-surgery remained statistically significant at 2 years post-surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 在术后6个月和2年时，远端节段的晚期丢失显著增加（表3）。
Translation: At 6 months and 2 years post-surgery, there was a significant increase in the late loss of the distal segment (Table 3).

Query_Text_cn: 在甲基麦角新碱组(n=7)，记录到在近端节段和支架置入节段有明显的血管收缩运动（图3）。
Translation: In the methylergometrine group (n=7), marked vascular constriction movements were recorded in the proximal segment and the stent-implanted segment (Fig. 3).

Query_Text_cn: 给予硝酸甘油后，3个节段（近端、支架置入节段和远端）显著扩张，其直径恢复到基线值（图3）。
Translation: After administration of nitroglycerin, the three segments (proximal, stent-implanted and distal) were significantly dilated, with their diameters returning to baseline values (Figure 3).

Query_Text_cn: 在乙酰胆碱组（n=9），有5例患者平均管腔直径扩张至少3%。
Translation: In the acetylcholine group (n=9), 5 patients had a mean lumen diameter expansion of at least 3%.

Query_Text_cn: 硝酸盐诱导支架置入节段及其远端节段发生明显的血管舒张（图3）。
Translation: Nitrate induced marked vasodilation in both the stent-implanted segment and its distal segment (Fig. 3).

Query_Text_cn: 这些结果表明支架置入节段已经重建血管运动功能。
Translation: These results indicate that the stent-implanted segment has restored vascular motility function.

Query_Text_cn: 术后6个月至术后2年期间，灰度血管内超声显示最小管腔面积以及平均管腔面积和容积均显著增加，同时斑块面积和容积显著下降（表3，图4）。
Translation: Between 6 months and 2 years post-surgery, gray-scale intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) showed that the minimum lumen area, as well as the mean lumen area and volume, were significantly increased, while plaque area and volume were significantly reduced (Table 3, Figure 4).

Query_Text_cn: 除外最小管腔面积，2年时的血管面积、平均管腔面积、斑块面积和管腔面积狭窄均与术后即刻检测的结果无明显差异（表3）。
Translation: Except for the minimal lumen area, the vessel area, mean lumen area, plaque area, and lumen area stenosis at 2 years showed no significant difference compared to the results immediately post-procedure (Table 3).

Query_Text_cn: 血管面积和容积在随访中保持稳定，表明未发生明显的血管重构。
Translation: Vascular area and volume remained stable during follow-up, indicating no significant vascular remodeling had occurred.

Query_Text_cn: 我们发现，在意向性治疗人群中，术后即刻与术后6个月问以及术后6个月与术后2年间，高回声组织的百分比显著下降（表3，图4）。
Translation: We observed that the percentage of hyperechoic tissue significantly decreased between immediately post-surgery and 6 months post-surgery, as well as between 6 months post-surgery and 2 years post-surgery (Table 3 and Figure 4).

Query_Text_cn: 术后2年时测得的高回声组织残余水平与在一家研究中心（荷兰鹿特丹Thorax中心）测得的自然高回声斑块水平相似［7.7%(s=6.5%)vs5.6%(s=4.8%)，n=12］。
Translation: The residual levels of hyperechoic tissue measured at 2 years post-surgery were comparable to the naturally occurring hyperechoic plaque levels measured at a research center (Thorax Center, Rotterdam, the Netherlands) [7.7% (s=6.5%) vs. 5.6% (s=4.8%), n=12].

Query_Text_cn: 重要的是，术后6个月时以及此前报道的持续性和晚期获得性贴壁不全在2年随访时已检测不到。
Translation: Importantly, the previously reported persistent and late-acquired non-apposition was undetectable at the 6-month postoperative assessment and remained undetectable throughout the 2-year follow-up.

Query_Text_cn: 血管内超声-虚拟组织学检查显示，在术后6个月与2年间，每种斑块成分的百分比没有显著差异（表3，图4）。
Translation: Intravascular ultrasound-virtual histology demonstrated no significant difference in the percentage of each plaque component between 6 months and 2 years post-operation (Table 3, Figure 4).

Query_Text_cn: 在术后6个月与2年间，纤维-脂肪面积和纤维-斑块面积的绝对值均明显降低（表3）。
Translation: The absolute values of fibro-fatty area and fibro-plaque area were significantly reduced between 6 months and 2 years post-surgery (Table 3).

Query_Text_cn: 与术后即刻相比，除坏死核心面积外术后2年参数均无显著差异（表3）。
Translation: Compared with immediate postoperative measurements, none of the parameters at 2 years postoperation showed significant differences except for the necrotic core area (Table 3).

Query_Text_cn: 在震动学测定中，术后即刻至随访6个月时累积应力值显著增加，但在术后6个月至术后2年间该值无明显改变（表3，图5）。
Translation: In vibrometry measurements, cumulative stress values significantly increased from immediately post-surgery to the 6-month follow-up, but showed no significant change from 6 months post-surgery to 2 years post-surgery (Table 3, Figure 5).

Query_Text_cn: 7例患者具有术后即刻、术后6个月和2年OCT检查的连续资料（意向性治疗人群）。
Translation: The 7 patients had continuous data from immediate postoperative, 6-month, and 2-year postoperative OCT scans (intention-to-treat population).

Query_Text_cn: 可见的支架壁数目从基线时的403个降至随访6个月时的368个，并进而降至2年时的264个（2年内降低34.5%，图6）。
Translation: The number of visible struts decreased from 403 at baseline to 368 at 6-month follow-up and further to 264 at 2-year follow-up, corresponding to a 34.5% reduction over 2 years (Figure 6).

Query_Text_cn: 对封闭箱，可见的支架壁数目从术后6个月时的n=0变为2年后的n=9；对开放箱，可见的支架壁数目从n=143变为n=68；对消解的亮箱，可见的支架壁数目从n=225变为n=185；对消解的暗箱，可见的支架壁数目从n=56变为n=25。所有可见的支架壁均覆盖良好，且与血管壁紧贴。
Translation: For the closed chamber, the number of visible stent struts changed from n=0 at 6 months post-surgery to n=9 at 2 years; for the open chamber, visible stent struts decreased from n=143 to n=68; for the dissolved bright chamber, visible stent struts transitioned from n=225 to n=185; and for the dissolved dark chamber, visible stent struts shifted from n=56 to n=25. All visible stent struts were well covered and closely apposed to the vascular wall.

Query_Text_cn: 所有不完全贴壁（不完全的、持续的以及晚期获得的支架贴壁不完全）均消除。
Translation: All instances of incomplete stent apposition (including incomplete, persistent, and late-acquired cases) have been resolved.

Query_Text_cn: 所有病例中管腔形状规则且边界平整、排列良好．未记录到管腔内组织。
Translation: In all cases, the lumens exhibited regular shapes with smooth margins and were well-aligned. No intraluminal tissue was noted.

Query_Text_cn: 冠状动脉管壁显示出均一、明亮的反向散射外观，不存在组织光学异质性征象。
Translation: The coronary artery wall demonstrates a homogeneous and bright backscatter appearance with no evidence of tissue optical heterogeneity.

Query_Text_cn: 重要的是，术后即刻至术后6个月时最小和平均管腔面积明显下降，但是术后6个月至术后2年二者均扩大。
Translation: It is important to note that from immediately post-procedure to 6 months post-procedure, both the minimum and average lumen areas showed a marked decrease; however, both expanded from 6 months post-procedure to 2 years post-procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 在这项前瞻性、单组、开放标记研究中，BVS支架在临床安全性上表现优异，术后2年内仅发生1例严重不良心脏事件（非Q波性心肌梗死）。
Translation: In this prospective, single-arm, open-label study, the BVS stent demonstrated excellent clinical safety, with only one case of serious adverse cardiac event (non-Q-wave myocardial infarction) occurring within 2 years post-procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 多种影像方法可得出几个重要发现。
Translation: Various imaging methods can yield several significant findings.

Query_Text_cn: 回声强度、虚拟组织学及OCT检查结果表明，术后2年时，这种生物可吸收支架已被整合入血管壁并生物吸收。
Translation: The results of echogenicity, virtual histology, and OCT examinations showed that at the 2-year postoperative follow-up, this bioresorbable scaffold had been integrated into the vascular wall and bioresorbed.

Query_Text_cn: 支架的分子量和质量均显著下降，以至于血管内超声已经不能发现支架壁，几乎未残留可见的特性；因此有1/3的支架通过OCT已不能辨认。
Translation: The molecular weight and mass of the stent have significantly decreased to the extent that intravascular ultrasound can no longer detect the stent struts, with almost no visible structural features remaining; consequently, one-third of the stents were unidentifiable via optical coherence tomography (OCT).

Query_Text_cn: 重要的是，OCT显示出具有光学同质性的血管壁结构，该结果连同已证实的血管运动功能恢复，表明动脉损伤已愈合。
Translation: OCT demonstrated vascular wall structures with optical homogeneity, and these results, together with the confirmed restoration of vascular motility function, indicate that the arterial injury has healed.

Query_Text_cn: 采用多层CT来评估术后18个月时的中期结果。
Translation: The intermediate outcomes at 18 months post-surgery were assessed using multidetector CT.

Query_Text_cn: 这种非侵入性方法显示支架内血管开放和二元再狭窄消失，随后常规血管造影证实了这一结果。
Translation: This non-invasive method demonstrated vessel patency within the stent and disappearance of binary restenosis, which was subsequently confirmed by conventional angiography.

Query_Text_cn: 在一个此前已报道并进行术后研究的患者亚组中，二维和三维QCA常规血管造影、三维血管内超声和多层CT血管造影的定量结果从术后即刻至术后6个月时均具有正相关性，但二维QCA结果倾向于小于基于三维方法测得的结果。
Translation: In a previously reported patient subgroup that underwent postoperative studies, the quantitative results from 2D and 3D QCA, 3D intravascular ultrasound, and multilayer CT angiography demonstrated positive correlations from immediately postoperatively to 6 months postoperatively, but 2D QCA results tended to be smaller than those measured by three-dimensional methods.

Query_Text_cn: 在一项多中心研究中，应用多层CT来分析可透射线的生物可降解支架具有可行性和准确性，这显示采用非侵入性办法评估经可透射线支架治疗的患者已经进入了一个新的时代。
Translation: A multicenter study demonstrated the feasibility and accuracy of using multidetector CT to analyze radiopaque bioresorbable scaffolds, indicating that a new era has begun for non-invasive assessment of patients treated with radiopaque scaffolds.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然停用了噻吩吡啶类药物，但是术后2年内没有发生支架内血栓形成，也未发生其他临床再狭窄。
Translation: Although the use of thiopyridine-based drugs was discontinued, no in-stent thrombosis occurred within 2 years post-surgery, nor were there any other cases of clinical restenosis.

Query_Text_cn: 2处最初在术后6个月时归类为二元再狭窄的病变消退至阈值（50%直径狭窄）以下。
Translation: Two lesions that were initially classified as binary restenosis at 6 months post-surgery regressed below the threshold (50% diameter stenosis).

Query_Text_cn: 6个月时平均直径狭窄为27%，该值在术后2年时仍维持不变。
Translation: At 6 months, the average diameter stenosis was 27%, which remained unchanged at 2 years post-surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，QCA显示血管大小在术后6个月至术后2年间显著下降，最小管腔直径倾向于下降，因此支架内晚期丢失倾向于升高。
Translation: However, QCA showed that vascular size significantly decreased from 6 months to 2 years post-surgery, with the minimal lumen diameter tending to decrease, leading to a tendency toward increased late loss within the stent.

Query_Text_cn: 支架远端5mm的晚期丢失显著增加。
Translation: The late loss at the distal end of the stent (5 millimeters) was significantly increased.

Query_Text_cn: 采用真实的系列观察（n=19）后，记录到了相似的结果。
Translation: Using a series of real-world observations (n=19), similar results were recorded.

Query_Text_cn: 这些血管造影结果与术后即刻至术后6个月间测定的冠状动脉内成像结果一致，但与较后期随访中基于三维方法的观察结果不同。
Translation: These angiographic findings were consistent with the intracoronary imaging results obtained from immediately post-surgery to 6 months post-operation, but differed from the observations based on three-dimensional methods in longer-term follow-up.

Query_Text_cn: 术后6个月至术后2年间血管内超声和OCT测定的平均管腔面积和最小管腔面积显著增加，与此相反，同一时期内血管造影结果则显示管腔面积减少（但不显著）。
Translation: Between 6 months and 2 years post-surgery, the mean and minimum lumen areas measured by intravascular ultrasound and OCT showed significant increases. In contrast, angiographic results during the same period revealed a reduction in lumen area (though not significant).

Query_Text_cn: 血管造影结果与冠状动脉内成像结果间晚期管腔变化的不一致性考虑有以下几种解释。
Translation: The inconsistencies in late lumen changes between angiography results and intracoronary imaging findings can be explained by several hypotheses.

Query_Text_cn: 首先，在随访2年时，QCA检查是在血管运动功能检测经冠状动脉内注射硝酸盐终止后立即进行的。
Translation: At the 2-year follow-up,QCA was performed immediately after termination of vasomotor function assessment with intracoronary nitrate injection.

Query_Text_cn: Kurnik等已描述过马来酸麦角新碱的迟发血管收缩效应。
Translation: Kurnik et al. have described the delayed vasopressor effect of ergometrine maleate.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，用血管内超声和OCT进行冠状动脉内成像检查前均另外注射了硝酸什油，后者可导致血管舒张功能改善，因此可解释两种不同测量方法间的结果差异。
Translation: Prior to intracoronary imaging using intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) and optical coherence tomography (OCT), patients received additional nitroglycerin injections prior to the procedures, which can improve vasodilatory function, thus accounting for the differences in results between the two measurement methods.

Query_Text_cn: TAXUSII研究也显示2年时血管造影和血管超声检查结果不一致。
Translation: The TAXUS II study also showed that the results of coronary angiography and vascular ultrasound were inconsistent at 2 years.

Query_Text_cn: 在这项研究中．TAXUS组测定的参数的连续变化显示，在术后6个月至术后2年期间血管造影检见晚期管腔扩大，但血管内超声结果提示管腔丢失。
Translation: In this study, the continuous changes in the measured parameters of the TAXUS group showed angiographic evidence of late lumen enlargement between 6 months and 2 years post-procedure, but intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) results indicated lumen loss.

Query_Text_cn: 这一结果差异主要归因于血管造影的局部测量（最小管腔直径和管腔丢失）与三维血管内超声连续测量间的差异。
Translation: The discrepancy in results is primarily attributed to the differences between the localized measurements of angiography (minimal lumen diameter and lumen loss) and the three-dimensional continuous measurements of intravascular ultrasound.

Query_Text_cn: 对血管造影和冠状动脉内成像结果不一致的另外一个可能解释是，在术后6个月至术后2年间管腔出现了潜在的远期变化，尤其是考虑到OCT所显示的术后6个月时管腔内皮的波浪状排列在术后2年时演变为接近圆形的外观。
Translation: Another possible explanation for the discrepancy between angiography and intracoronary imaging results could be the potential long-term changes in lumen morphology between 6 months and 2 years post-procedure, particularly considering that the undulating arrangement of the luminal endothelium observed by OCT at 6 months post-procedure transitioned into a near-circular appearance by 2 years post-procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 血管造影和血管内超声间系统性检测的差异或许也可以解释晚期管腔的不一致变化。
Translation: The systematic differences in detection between angiography and intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) may also account for the inconsistent changes in the late lumen.

Query_Text_cn: QCA测得的管腔面积总是小于血管内超声或OCT的检测值，并且血管内超声对管腔面积（尤其是对小直径血管）的估测值明显偏大。
Translation: The lumen area measured by QCA is always smaller than that detected by intravascular ultrasound or OCT, and intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) significantly overestimates lumen area, especially in small-diameter vessels.

Query_Text_cn: 将血管内超声检测获得的最小管腔投射直径与QCA检测结果相比较时，我们发现血管内超声检测低估了大血管腔而高估了小血管腔的值。
Translation: When comparing the minimal lumen diameter obtained from intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) measurements with quantitative coronary angiography (QCA) results, we found that IVUS underestimated larger lumens but overestimated smaller lumens.

Query_Text_cn: 相应地，该方法与QCA比较可低估管腔晚期丢失，或者反过来讲，QCA与血管内超声检查相比，可能高估管腔晚期丢失。
Translation: Accordingly, this method may underestimate late lumen loss compared to QCA, conversely, QCA may overestimate late lumen loss when compared to intravascular ultrasound (IVUS).

Query_Text_cn: 最后，二维QCA检查与三维血管内超声或OCT检查结果的差异也可能是由纳入患者的样本数较小引起。
Translation: Finally, the discrepancies between two-dimensional QCA (quantitative coronary angiography) examinations and three-dimensional intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) or optical coherence tomography (OCT) results may also be attributed to the relatively small sample size of enrolled patients.

Query_Text_cn: 支架置入节段和永久节段对甲基麦角新碱或乙酰胆碱发生反应而重新出现血管运动的现象表明，血管反应性已获得重建，其对血管活性刺激物可能重新产生了生理反应。
Translation: The phenomenon that the stent-implanted segments and permanent segments exhibit vasomotor responses again upon exposure to methylergometrine or acetylcholine indicates that vascular reactivity has been restored, suggesting these segments may have regained physiological responses to vasoactive stimuli.

Query_Text_cn: 与此前报道远端节段内皮功能紊乱的研究有所不同，本研究的首要目的是报道当支架因生物吸收而失去支撑特性时，支架置入节段的血管舒缩功能。
Translation: Unlike previous studies reporting endothelial dysfunction in distal segments, the primary aim of this study is to report the vasomotor function of the stent-implanted segment when the stent loses its supportive properties due to bioabsorption.

Query_Text_cn: 重要的是，在9例用乙酰胆碱进行检测的患者中有5例在输入最大剂量乙酰胆碱时出现血管扩张（平均直径至少扩张了3%），提示出现了对乙酰胆碱的直接血管舒张效应或血流介导的反应，因此也表明支架置入部位出现了具有功能活性的内皮。
Translation: It is important to note that among the 9 patients tested with acetylcholine, 5 exhibited vasodilation when administered the maximum dose (with an average diameter increase of at least 3%), suggesting a direct vasodilatory effect of acetylcholine or a flow-mediated response, thereby indicating the presence of functionally active endothelium at the stent implantation site.

Query_Text_cn: 然而该发现只是一项初步观察结果，显然有待进一步证实。
Translation: However, the finding is merely a preliminary observational result and clearly requires further verification.

Query_Text_cn: 正如此前报道的在一家研究中心进行的包括12例患者的亚组研究中，支架置入前和置入后的平均累积应力值显著下降，表明由于支架的支撑特性，导致血管壁的可变形性下降。
Translation: In a subgroup study involving 12 patients previously reported and conducted at a research center, the average cumulative stress values before and after stent implantation showed a significant decrease, indicating that the decreased deformability of the vascular wall was due to the supportive properties of the stent.

Query_Text_cn: 血管壁的可变形性在最初的6个月内重现并达到一定程度，随后保持稳定。
Translation: The vascular wall compliance was recovered and reached a certain level within the first 6 months and then remained stable.

Query_Text_cn: 术后6个月至2年间记录到斑块面积显著降低，而血管面积没有发生相应变化，这点也需要证实。
Translation: Between 6 months and 2 years post-surgery, plaque area was significantly reduced, while vessel area did not show corresponding changes. This finding also requires verification.

Query_Text_cn: 用冠状动脉内检测技术记录到的斑块回缩可能是真实的，因为在一个动脉粥样硬化的兔模型中置入金属依维莫司洗脱支架可通过包含自噬在内的过程导致巨噬细胞减少。
Translation: Plaque recoil recorded by intravascular imaging techniques may indeed be real, as implantation of a metallic everolimus-eluting stent in an atherosclerotic rabbit model leads to macrophage reduction through processes that include autophagy.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，多聚物材料的吸收以及由此引起的质量减少也可能部分导致了斑块减少。
Translation: However, the absorption of polymeric materials and the resulting mass reduction may also have partially contributed to the reduction in plaque.

Query_Text_cn: 支架置入3年后对猪进行的临床前研究显示，虽然支架壁在2年内即消失，但是它们占据的空间被蛋白多糖材料填充(图7)。
Translation: Preclinical studies in pigs three years after implantation showed that although the scaffold walls had already disappeared within two years, the space they occupied was filled by proteoglycan materials (Figure 7).

Query_Text_cn: 在最初6个月内发生的组织成分的变化伴随着致密钙化斑百分比和坏死核心百分比的下降，而纤维-脂肪和纤维组织的相对百分比和绝对值升高，这些变化在此前曾被解释为来自多聚物支架的反向散射射频信号减少。
Translation: The compositional changes observed within the initial 6 months were accompanied by a decrease in the percentage of dense calcified plaques and necrotic core, along with an increase in the relative percentages and absolute values of fibro-fatty and fibrous tissue. These changes had previously been interpreted as resulting from reduced backscattering radiofrequency signals emanating from the polymer scaffold.

Query_Text_cn: 对术后6个月至2年间坏死核心的中度减少应慎重解释。
Translation: The moderate reduction in the necrotic core between 6 months and 2 years post-surgery should be interpreted cautiously.

Query_Text_cn: 在被纳入一家机构（Thorax中心）的12例患者队列中，我们对支架置入前和置入后、置入6个月和24个月时的坏死核心进行了比较。
Translation: In a cohort of 12 patients from the Thorax Center, we compared the necrotic core before and after stent placement, as well as at 6 and 24 months post-procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 结果发现，由于置入的多聚物支架经射频分析发现后被误认为是围绕坏死核心的致密钙化斑，导致分析的结果是从支架置入前到置入后坏死核心增加（图4）。
Translation: Upon RF analysis, the implanted polymer scaffold was mistakenly identified as dense calcified plaque surrounding the necrotic core, leading to the analysis showing an increase in the necrotic core from pre-implantation to post-implantation (Figure 4).

Query_Text_cn: 在该队列中，我们发现2年时坏死核心的数量与支架置入前相近，表明多聚物支架的出现和消失是术后6个月和术后24个月间坏死核心假性消退的主要原因（数据未报道）。
Translation: In this cohort, we found that the number of necrotic cores at 2 years was comparable to that prior to stent implantation, indicating that the appearance and disappearance of polymer stents are the primary causes of pseudo-regression in necrotic cores between 6 and 24 months post-surgery (data not reported).

Query_Text_cn: 将来，生物可吸收药物洗脱支架的潜在优势将通过二代支架来进行评估。
Translation: The potential advantages of bioabsorbable drug-eluting stents will be evaluated through second-generation stents in the future.

Query_Text_cn: 第一代支架在置入6个月时出现支架回缩，似乎不太可能长期保持机械完整性和径向强度，以完全抵抗由PCI引起的血管壁负性重构的力量。
Translation: The first-generation stents exhibited recoil at the 6-month mark post-implantation and seemed unlikely to maintain long-term mechanical integrity and radial strength sufficient to fully counteract the forces from PCI-induced adverse vascular remodeling.

Query_Text_cn: 新一代支架所用的多聚物加工过程不同，因此其完整性和径向强度可保持很长时间。
Translation: The different manufacturing processes used for the polymers in the new-generation stents ensure that their structural integrity and radial strength can be maintained over an extended period.

Query_Text_cn: 新一代支架的设计采用经直网桥连接的“Z”形环状结构，与最初的MultiLink支架(AbbottVascular，SantaClara，CA，USA)的设计相似。
Translation: The design of the new-generation stent employs a "Z"-shaped annular structure connected via straight strut bridges, similar to the design of the original MultiLink stent (Abbott Vascular, Santa Clara, CA, USA).

Query_Text_cn: 该设计可提供更多均衡的血管支撑和药物释放。
Translation: This design offers more balanced vascular support and drug delivery.

Query_Text_cn: 这些特点有望减少支架回缩，后者在术后6个月时可引起晚期管腔丢失和再狭窄。
Translation: These features are expected to reduce stent recoil, which can lead to late lumen loss and restenosis at six months post-surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 这些潜在改善有待对复杂的亚组病变置入支架时进行验证。
Translation: These potential improvements require validation through stent implantation in complex subsegmental lesions.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究存在一些局限性。
Translation: This study has some limitations.

Query_Text_cn: 研究中纳入的样本数较少(n=30)，并且真正的连续观察也非常少。
Translation: The sample size was relatively small (n=30), and the number of true continuous observations was also limited.

Query_Text_cn: 鉴于多重比较的参数较多，一些结果仅仅用来作为假说，因此需要谨慎地加以解释。
Translation: Given the numerous parameters involved in multiple comparisons, some results are merely used as hypotheses and thus should be interpreted cautiously.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，研究中采用的新成像方法在评价体内和体外多聚物支架方面的作用尚未被明确证实。
Translation: Additionally, the role of the new imaging methods adopted in the study in evaluating both in vivo and in vitro polymeric scaffolds has not been clearly validated.

Query_Text_cn: 动物研究（图7E）提示，一旦血管壁获得同质性且细胞重新长入支架部位，OCT上显示的特征将彻底消失。
Translation: Animal studies (Figure 7E) suggest that once the vascular wall achieves homogeneity and cells repopulate the scaffold area, the features observed on OCT will completely disappear.

Query_Text_cn: 术后2年时的动物研究显示，多聚物已被吸收并由面积大致相同的蛋白多糖所取代，在OCT上表现为可辨别的半透明外观。
Translation: Animal studies at 2 years post-surgery showed that the polymer had been absorbed and replaced by proteoglycans of comparable area, presenting as discernible semi-transparent appearances on OCT.

Query_Text_cn: 在已吸收的支架边缘也偶可见到钙化，并能很反常地通过该技术检测出来。
Translation: Calcification is occasionally observed at the edges of absorbed stents and can be paradoxically detected via this technique.

Query_Text_cn: 术后2年时，某些患者的OCT上仍存留明显的支架信号，表明组织同质性并未完全重建。
Translation: At 2 years post-surgery, some patients still exhibited prominent stent signals on OCT, indicating that tissue homogeneity had not yet been fully reconstructed.

Query_Text_cn: 总之，本研究得出的众多显著观察结果具有临床治疗意义，并且对患者极其有利。
Translation: In summary, the numerous significant findings from this study hold clinical therapeutic significance and are highly beneficial to patients.

Query_Text_cn: 我们发现支架置入后虽短暂存留，却可对血管产生长期有效的支撑作用，支架具有生物可吸收性，能完全贴壁，出现了斑块负荷降低相关的潜在晚期管腔扩大，以及重建血管运动功能等。
Translation: Although stent placement results in short-term retention, it can provide long-term effective support to the vessel walls. The stent is bioabsorbable, enabling complete apposition, and demonstrates potential late lumen enlargement associated with reduced plaque burden, as well as restoration of vascular motility function.

Query_Text_cn: 采用多层CT对支架开放情况进行非侵入性连续监测是可行的。
Translation: It is feasible to use multilayer CT for non-invasive continuous monitoring of stent patency.

Query_Text_cn: 异物消失和血管运动功能重建为血管正常愈合而又不会发生晚期支架血栓形成带来了希望。
Translation: The disappearance of the foreign body and the reconstruction of vascular motility function hold promise for achieving normal vascular healing without late-stage stent thrombosis.

Query_Text_cn: 所有这些发现均需在更大样本的研究中证实，但是这种生物可吸收支架或类似支架在治疗限制血流的斑块时，将可能对重建血管完整性具有至关重要的意义。
Translation: All these findings require validation in larger-scale studies; however, such bioabsorbable scaffolds or similar devices could be of critical significance to rebuilding vascular integrity when treating plaques that block blood flow.

Query_Text_cn: 方法对30例冠状动脉单个原发病变的患者进行为期2年的临床随访和多种成像方法随访，其中包括多层CT、血管造影、血管内超声、衍生的形态学指标（虚拟组织学、震动学参数和回声强度）以及光学相干断层成像(OCT)。
Translation: The method involved a 2-year clinical follow-up and follow-up using multiple imaging modalities for 30 patients with single primary coronary artery lesions, including multilayer CT, angiography, intravascular ultrasound, derived morphological indices (virtual histology, vibration parameters, and echo intensity), and optical coherence tomography (OCT).

Query_Text_cn: 由于在纳入患者时尚无有关BVS支架重叠放置的动物或临床前研究资料，所以若需另外置入支架，则选取Cypher西罗莫司洗脱支架(Cordis，Miami，FL，USA)。
Translation: Since there were no existing animal or preclinical study data on the overlapping placement of BVS stents at the time of patient enrollment, if an additional stent needed to be implanted, the Cypher sirolimus-eluting stent (Cordis, Miami, FL, USA) was selected.

Query_Text_cn: 我们计算了下列QCA参数：最小管腔直径、用内插法获得的参考血管直径，以及二元再狭窄（定义为随访期内在每个节段——支架内和支架周围节段——内直径狭窄超过50%)。
Translation: We calculated the following quantitative coronary angiography (QCA) parameters: minimum lumen diameter, interpolated reference vessel diameter, and binary restenosis (defined as diameter stenosis exceeding 50% within each segment—both in-stent and adjacent non-stented segments—during the follow-up period).

Query_Text_cn: 支架梗阻面积百分比用下式计算：（支架内新生内膜面积／支架面积）×100%。
Translation: The percentage of stent obstruction area is calculated as: (neointimal area within the stent / total stent area) × 100%.

Query_Text_cn: 其所依据的原理是当施加了外力（如波动的动脉血压）后，较软的组织比较硬的组织或支架支撑的组织更容易变形。
Translation: The principle it is based on is that when subjected to external forces (such as pulsating arterial blood pressure), softer tissues are more prone to deformation than harder tissues or those supported by scaffolds.

Query_Text_cn: 采用静脉内对比增强和心电图门控影像重建的单源或双源64排螺旋CT对患者进行检查［SiemensDefinition，Forchheim，Germany(n=18)；GELightspeed，Milwaukee，USA(n=5)；PhilipsBriIIiance，Best，Netherlands(n=2)］。
Translation: Patients were examined using single-source or dual-source 64-slice spiral CT with intravenous contrast-enhanced and electrocardiogram-gated image reconstruction [Siemens Definition, Forchheim, Germany (n=18); GE Lightspeed, Milwaukee, USA (n=5); Philips Brilliance, Best, Netherlands (n=2)].

Query_Text_cn: 在将MSCT数据传送到核心实验室后，采用血管分段和管腔面积定量的半自动化软件程序（Circulation，Siemens，Forchheim，Germany）测定支架内狭窄的程度。
Translation: After transmitting the MSCT data to the core laboratory, the degree of in-stent stenosis was assessed using a semi-automated software program for vascular segmentation and lumen area quantification (Circulation,Siemens,Forchheim,Germany).

Query_Text_cn: 随访中支架形态的变化用此前已发表的方法进行分类：封闭箱、开放箱、消解的亮箱和消解的暗箱。
Translation: The morphological changes of the stent during follow-up were classified using the previously published methods: closed box, open box, degraded bright box, and degraded dark box.

Query_Text_cn: （如果术后6个月结果不可获得，则用术后即刻的值替代；如果术后2年的结果不可获得，当术后6个月的值可获得时则用该值替代，当术后6个月的值不可获得时则用术后即刻的值替代）。
Translation: If 6-month postoperative results are unavailable, the immediate postoperative values shall be used as substitutes; if 2-year postoperative results are unavailable, the 6-month postoperative values shall be used when available, or the immediate postoperative values shall be used if 6-month data is unavailable.

Query_Text_cn: 背景初步研究表明，从生物可降解多聚体中释出biolimus（西罗莫司类似物）的一种新型洗脱支架有望获得良好的临床效果。
Translation: Preliminary studies suggest that a novel drug-eluting stent releasing biolimus (a sirolimus analog) from biodegradable polymers holds promise for favorable clinical outcomes.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究比较了biolimus洗脱支架（具有生物可降解多聚体）和西罗莫司洗脱支架（具有不可降解多聚体）的安全性和疗效。
Translation: This study compared the safety and efficacy of biolimus-eluting stents (bioresorbable polymer) and sirolimus-eluting stents (non-bioresorbable polymer).

Query_Text_cn: 方法作者在欧洲的10个研究中心进行了一项多中心、评估者设盲的非劣效性研究。
