Query_Text_cn: 支气管镜操作程序开始及完成所需的磷泊酚补充用药次数的平均值(±s)在6.5mg/kg组中较低(表3)。
Translation: The mean (± SD) of the number of additional propofol doses required to initiate and complete the bronchoscopy procedure was lower in the 6.5 mg/kg group (Table 3).

Query_Text_cn: 6.5mg/kg组中有一半以上的患者(56%)不需要补充给药，而2mg/kg组相应的患者比例为7%。
Translation: In the 6.5 mg/kg group, more than half (56%) of the patients did not require additional dosing, while the corresponding proportion in the 2 mg/kg group was 7%.

Query_Text_cn: 6.5mg/kg组有8%的患者需要替代性镇静药物，而2mg/kg组相应的患者比例为58.8%。
Translation: In the 6.5 mg/kg group, 8% of patients required alternative sedative drugs, whereas the corresponding proportion in the 2 mg/kg group was 58.8%.

Query_Text_cn: 2mg/kg组中有1例患者也接受了泊酚治疗。
Translation: In the 2 mg/kg group, one patient also received propofol treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 6.5mg/kg组中需要芬太尼辅助治疗的患者较少(分别为16.7%和37.3%)。
Translation: Fewer patients in the 6.5 mg/kg group required fentanyl adjunct therapy (16.7% versus 37.3%).

Query_Text_cn: 镇静深度和持续时间以及其他次要终点从应用首剂磷泊酚到患者完全恢复警觉期间MOAA/S评分为0～1的时间百分比平均值在6.5mg/kg组为(3.7±10.4)%，而2mg/kg组的相应值为(1.5±7.0)%。
Translation: The average percentage of time with a MOAA/S score of 0 to 1 from the first administration of propofol to complete recovery of alertness was (3.7±10.4)% in the 6.5 mg/kg group, while the corresponding value was (1.5±7.0)% in the 2 mg/kg group.

Query_Text_cn: 对达到深度镇静(MOAA/S评分0或1)的患者进行评估时，24例患者中有13例(54.2%)出现了镇静相关AE(例如呼吸暂停、低氧血症和低血压)，而125例患者中有17例患者(13.6%；P＜0.0001)维持轻中度镇静的状态(MOAA/S评分2～5)。
Translation: When assessing patients who achieved deep sedation (MOAA/S score 0 or 1), 13 of 24 patients (54.2%) experienced sedation-related adverse events (e.g., apnea, hypoxemia, and hypotension), while only 17 of 125 patients (13.6%) maintained light to moderate sedation (MOAA/S scores 2–5; P < 0.0001).

Query_Text_cn: 1例需要人工维持辅助通气的患者达到了深度镇静(MOAA/S评分0和1)。
Translation: A patient requiring artificial ventilation reached profound sedation (MOAA/S scores of 0 and 1).

Query_Text_cn: 6.5mg/kg组达到镇静的中位时间少于2mg/kg组(分别为4.0和18.0min)。
Translation: The median time to achieve sedation was shorter in the 6.5 mg/kg group compared to the 2 mg/kg group (4.0 vs 18.0 minutes, respectively).

Query_Text_cn: 对于6.5mg/kg组，从操作开始至完全恢复警觉的中位时间为16.0min，从操作结束至完全恢复警觉的中位时间为5.5min(2.0mg/kg组分别为14.5和3.0min)。
Translation: For the 6.5 mg/kg group, the median time from the start of the procedure to full alertness was 16.0 minutes and the median time from the end of the procedure to full alertness was 5.5 minutes (the corresponding median times for the 2.0 mg/kg group were 14.5 minutes and 3.0 minutes, respectively).

Query_Text_cn: 6.5mg/kg组从操作结束至准备出院的中位时间略长于2.0mg/kg组(分别为8.5和8.0min)，但这一差异没有统计学意义。
Translation: The median time from procedure completion to discharge readiness was slightly longer in the 6.5 mg/kg group compared to the 2.0 mg/kg group (8.5 vs. 8.0 minutes), but this difference was not statistically significant.

Query_Text_cn: 2mg/kg组和6.5mg/kg组的患者在基线(分别为93.5%和94.6%)以及恢复后(分别为63.6%和64.2%)的心理测试表现(根据HVLT-R判断)相似。
Translation: The cognitive performance of patients in the 2 mg/kg group and 6.5 mg/kg group on psychometric tests (assessed by HVLT-R) was similar at baseline (93.5% vs 94.6%) as well as post-recovery (63.6% vs 64.2%).

Query_Text_cn: 镇静结束时(分别为8.0和3.9)以及操作结束时(分别为8.3和5.0)，6.5mg/kg组的医师满意度评分均值高于2mg/kg组。
Translation: The mean physician satisfaction scores in the 6.5 mg/kg group were higher than those in the 2 mg/kg group at both the conclusion of sedation (8.0 vs. 3.9) and the conclusion of the procedure (8.3 vs. 5.0).

Query_Text_cn: 接受6.5mg/kg磷泊酚治疗患者提供的满意度评分均值为9.5，而接受2mg/kg磷泊酚治疗患者的满意度评分均值为8.7。
Translation: The mean satisfaction scores provided by patients treated with 6.5 mg/kg of propofol were 9.5, while those of patients receiving 2 mg/kg of propofol were 8.7.

Query_Text_cn: 6.5mg/kg组中愿意再次接受磷泊酚治疗的患者比例较高(分别为94.6%和78.2%，P＜0.001)，没有回忆起操作过程中出现觉醒的患者比例也有类似差异(分别为83.3%和55.4%，P＜0.001)(表4)。
Translation: In the 6.5 mg/kg group, a higher proportion of patients were willing to receive propofol treatment again (94.6% vs 78.2%, P<0.001). Similar differences were observed in the proportion of patients who did not recall experiencing awareness during the procedure (83.3% vs 55.4%, P<0.001) (Table 4).

Query_Text_cn: 在随机入组的256例患者中，252例接受1剂或多剂磷泊酚的患者纳入安全性人群中。
Translation: Of the 256 patients who were randomly enrolled, 252 patients who received one or multiple doses of propofol were included in the safety population.

Query_Text_cn: 没有出现导致研究中断或死亡的治疗相关AE。
Translation: No treatment-related AEs leading to study discontinuation or death were observed.

Query_Text_cn: AE大部分AE为自限性和一过性的，严重程度为轻到中度。
Translation: Most adverse events (AEs) are self-limiting and transient, with severity ranging from mild to moderate.

Query_Text_cn: 这些AE包括感觉异常(47.6%)和瘙痒症(14.7%)。
Translation: These AE include paresthesia (47.6%) and pruritus (14.7%).

Query_Text_cn: 6.5mg/kg组的22例患者(14.8%)和2mg/kg组的13例患者(12.6%)在研究期间出现了严重AE。
Translation: Twenty-two patients (14.8%) in the 6.5 mg/kg group and 13 patients (12.6%) in the 2 mg/kg group experienced serious AE during the study period.

Query_Text_cn: 6.5mg/kg组的8例患者(感觉异常5例，低氧血症2例和瘙痒症1例)和2mg/kg组的2例患者(感觉异常1例和瘙痒症1例)出现了与磷泊酚治疗相关的严重AE。
Translation: Eight patients in the 6.5 mg/kg group (5 with paresthesia, 2 with hypoxemia, and 1 with pruritus) and two patients in the 2 mg/kg group (1 with paresthesia and 1 with pruritus) experienced serious adverse events (SAEs) related to propofol treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 这些AE中只有1例(感觉异常，6min内缓解)导致磷泊酚治疗中断。
Translation: Only one case (parasthesia, resolved within 6 minutes) among these AEs led to the discontinuation of propofol treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 最常见的心肺AE为低氧血症(14.3%)和低血压(3.2%)。
Translation: The most common cardiopulmonary AEs were hypoxemia (14.3%) and hypotension (3.2%).

Query_Text_cn: 所有低血压事件(8例)均出现在6.5mg/kg组中，其中2例患者在恢复正常血压过程中需要静脉推注药物。
Translation: All hypotensive events (8 cases) were observed in the 6.5 mg/kg group, with 2 patients requiring intravenous push medications during the process of restoring normal blood pressure.

Query_Text_cn: 亚组人群中的镇静相关AE对不同年龄进行分组，评估镇静相关AE。与＜65岁的患者相比(88例患者中有16例，18.2%)，≥65岁的患者(61例患者中有14例，23%)中发生率增高，但这一差异没有统计学意义(P=0.5355)。
Translation: In subgroup analysis of sedation-related adverse events (AEs), patients were stratified by age to assess sedation-related AEs. Compared with patients younger than 65 years (16 of 88 patients, 18.2%), those aged 65 years or older (14 of 61 patients, 23%) had a higher incidence; however, this difference was not statistically significant (P=0.5355).

Query_Text_cn: 按照患者体重或ASA状况对镇静相关AE进行评估时，没有发现差异［体重＜60kg，27例患者中的6例(22.2%)；60～90kg，80例患者中15例(18.8%)；≥90kg，42例患者中9例(21.4%)；P=0.7804］。ASA患者体格状况分类系统，P1/P2为80例患者中17例，(21.3%)，P3/P4为69例患者中13例(18.8%)，P=0.8283。
Translation: No significant differences were observed when evaluating sedation-related adverse events (AEs) based on patient weight or ASA physical status classification. For weight groups: 6 out of 27 patients (22.2%) in the <60 kg category, 15 out of 80 patients (18.8%) in the 60–90 kg group, and 9 out of 42 patients (21.4%) in the ≥90 kg group, with P = 0.7804. In the ASA physical status classification system: 17 of 80 patients (21.3%) among P1/P2 patients, and 13 of 69 patients (18.8%) among P3/P4 patients, with P = 0.8283.

Query_Text_cn: 气道辅助用磷泊酚6.5mg/kg镇静相关的低氧血症发生率高于应用磷泊酚2.0mg/kg镇静相关的发生率(分别为15.4%和12.6%)。
Translation: The incidence of sedation-related hypoxemia associated with propofol at 6.5 mg/kg for airway assistance was higher than that observed with propofol at 2.0 mg/kg (15.4% vs. 12.6%).

Query_Text_cn: 气道辅助事件的汇总见表5。
Translation: The summary of airway supportive events is presented in Table 5.

Query_Text_cn: 总共有46例患者(18.3%)需要某种形式的气道辅助，其中最常见的是增加氧流量(15.9%)。
Translation: A total of 46 patients (18.3%) required some form of airway assistance, with the most common being an increase in oxygen flow (15.9%).

Query_Text_cn: 研究中共出现了2例严重低氧血症，都在6.5mg/kg组。
Translation: In the study, two cases of severe hypoxemia occurred, both of which were in the 6.5 mg/kg group.

Query_Text_cn: 第1例为78岁患者，有严重COPD、充血性心衰和反复肺炎病史，并接受家庭氧疗(4L/min)。
Translation: Case 1 is a 78-year-old patient with a history of severe COPD, congestive heart failure, and recurrent pneumonias, who is on home oxygen therapy (4 L/min).

Query_Text_cn: 入院时，该患者的氧饱和度为92%，接受磷泊酚6.5mg/kg治疗约32min后氧饱和度下降至72%(退出支气管镜后17min)。
Translation: At admission, the patient's oxygen saturation was 92%. Approximately 32 minutes after receiving Propofol 6.5 mg/kg treatment, the oxygen saturation decreased to 72% (17 minutes after withdrawal from bronchoscopy).

Query_Text_cn: 该患者不需要特殊处理即可恢复。
Translation: The patient can recover without special treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 另1例患者在复位、吸痰、增加氧流量和口头鼓励后恢复。
Translation: Another patient regained consciousness following repositioning,suctioning,increasing oxygen flow rate,and verbal encouragement.

Query_Text_cn: 6.5mg/kg组中，首剂应用磷泊酚14min后出现了一次呼吸暂停/低通气，持续了3.1min。
Translation: In the 6.5 mg/kg group, an episode of respiratory arrest/hypoventilation occurred 14 minutes after the initial administration of phosphofol, lasting for 3.1 minutes.

Query_Text_cn: 抬高下颚并给予触觉刺激后，呼吸暂停/低通气缓解。
Translation: After elevating the jaw and providing tactile stimulation, apnea/hypopnea is relieved.

Query_Text_cn: 没有发生心动过缓。
Translation: Bradycardia did not occur.

Query_Text_cn: 美国和欧洲的大部分指南推荐患者在接受支气管镜操作时予以镇静。
Translation: Most guidelines in the US and Europe recommend administering sedation to patients during bronchoscopy procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 理想的镇静方案应当易于采用，且具有起效快、持续时间短、恢复快、迅速恢复认知等特点，同时具有可预测的药动学/药效学特性。
Translation: The ideal sedation regimen should be easy to adopt, featuring rapid onset, short duration, quick recovery, and prompt restoration of cognitive function, while possessing predictable pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) characteristics.

Query_Text_cn: 最常使用的药物(苯二氮类和阿片类药物)具有前述部分特性，但每种药物又有其局限性。
Translation: The most commonly used drugs (benzodiazepines and opioids) possess some of the aforementioned characteristics, but each of these drugs also has its own limitations.

Query_Text_cn: 磷泊酚与脂质泊酚相比可能具有确切的优势。
Translation: Phospholene may have definite advantages compared with lipid-based propofol.

Query_Text_cn: 由于磷泊酚与内源性酶类接触前不会释放出泊酚，因此磷泊酚产生的血浆浓度与脂质制剂相比峰值浓度更低，而且降低更为缓慢。
Translation: Phospaphol does not release propofol before contact with endogenous enzymes, therefore generating plasma concentrations with lower peak levels compared to lipid-based formulations, and declining at a slower rate.

Query_Text_cn: 由于泊酚相关的心肺作用与其浓度相关，而磷泊酚能够达到的峰值浓度较低，因此从药动学理论上看产生的心肺抑制作用较小(即治疗指数较宽)。
Translation: Since the cardiopulmonary effects of propofol are concentration-dependent and phenpropofol achieves lower peak concentrations, it results in lesser cardiopulmonary depression from a pharmacokinetic perspective (i.e., a wider therapeutic index).

Query_Text_cn: 本项研究证实，磷泊酚能逐步起效，达到中等深度和持续时间的镇静作用，且安全性良好。
Translation: This study confirms that propofol achieves a gradual onset of moderate-depth sedation with sustained duration and demonstrates good safety.

Query_Text_cn: 对于主要终点(镇静的成功率)，两个剂量组之间均有统计学意义上的显著差异并有临床意义。
Translation: For the primary endpoint (sedation success rate), there were statistically significant and clinically meaningful differences between the two dose groups.

Query_Text_cn: 次要终点(即治疗成功、愿意接受再次治疗以及没有回想起操作期间有觉醒发生)评估结果也利于6.5mg/kg组。
Translation: The results for secondary endpoints (i.e., treatment success, willingness to undergo retreatment, and no recall of awakening during the procedure) also favored the 6.5 mg/kg group.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然磷泊酚与常规使用的咪唑安定/芬太尼组合之间尚未进行直接比较，但是既往研究已经报道咪唑安定/阿片类药物使用时完全恢复觉醒状态的时间介于20～120min，而应用磷泊酚时相应的时间为16min。
Translation: Although propofol has not yet been directly compared with the conventionally used midazolam/fentanyl combination, previous studies have reported that the time for patients to fully regain consciousness after using midazolam/opioids ranges from 20 to 120 minutes, while the corresponding time with propofol is 16 minutes.

Query_Text_cn: 这一差异非常有意义，因为延长镇静时间可能会导致恢复时间延长，流量下降。
Translation: This difference is significant, as prolonging sedation time may lead to prolonged recovery time and reduced flow.

Query_Text_cn: 采用6.5mg/kg磷泊酚能显著降低替代性镇静治疗方案的需要，因此能避免多重药物治疗相关的潜在协同作用。
Translation: The use of 6.5 mg/kg propofol can significantly reduce the need for alternative sedation regimens, thereby avoiding potential synergistic effects associated with multidrug therapy.

Query_Text_cn: 镇静用药方案相关的主要安全性问题是镇静过深和持续时间过长，导致呼吸暂停、低氧血症、低血压和心动过缓。
Translation: The main safety issues related to the sedation regimen are excessive sedation and prolonged duration, which lead to apnea, hypoxemia, hypotension, and bradycardia.

Query_Text_cn: 此类人群中，磷泊酚的安全性与常规使用的镇静药物类似。
Translation: The safety profile of propofol is comparable to that of conventionally used sedative agents in this population.

Query_Text_cn: 大部分AE的严重程度为轻中度，给予轻度干预处理后即可缓解。
Translation: Most AE have a mild to moderate severity, which can resolve with mild intervention.

Query_Text_cn: 本项研究中的患者通常为老年人(41%患者≥65岁)，合并有重要的疾病(43%患者的ASA体格状况分级系统评分为3或4)。
Translation: In this study, the patients were typically older adults (41% of patients were aged ≥65 years) and had significant comorbidities (43% of patients had an ASA Physical Status Classification System score of 3 or 4).

Query_Text_cn: 低氧血症为最常见的镇静相关事件(14.3%)，但大部分患者在提高氧流量后低氧血症缓解。
Translation: Hypoxemia was the most common sedation-related event (14.3%), but hypoxemia resolved in most patients after increasing the oxygen flow rate.

Query_Text_cn: 本项研究中低氧血症的发生率与应用咪唑安定和芬太尼用于类似患者人群的其他研究类似(据报道发生率为24%～32%)。
Translation: The incidence of hypoxemia in this study was comparable to that reported in other studies using midazolam and fentanyl in similar patient populations (with reported rates of 24% to 32%).

Query_Text_cn: 脂质泊酚的不良反应使得部分医院要求在ICU外使用脂质泊酚时实施麻醉学监测。
Translation: The adverse reactions of lipid emulsion propofol have led some hospitals to require anesthesia monitoring when using the drug outside the ICU.

Query_Text_cn: 而磷泊酚这一药物不是全身麻醉药物，而是用于适度镇静的药物，因此本项研究可以由呼吸科专职人员实施，不需要麻醉学监测，安全性良好。
Translation: Phosphadiol is not a general anesthetic but a drug used for moderate sedation. Therefore, this study can be conducted by respiratory medicine specialists without anesthesia monitoring, with good safety profiles.

Query_Text_cn: 值得注意的是，本项研究存在两点局限性。
Translation: It is worth noting that this study has two limitations.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，磷泊酚的相对有效性和安全性是推断得到的，而不是直接判定的，今后需要前瞻性比较试验。
Translation: Therefore, the relative efficacy and safety of propofol have been inferred rather than directly established, and future prospective comparative trials are required.

Query_Text_cn: 另一个局限性是操作前给予单剂芬太尼与磷泊酚联合使用可能有叠加效应。
Translation: Another limitation is that the co-administration of a single dose of fentanyl and propofol prior to the procedure may have synergistic effects.

Query_Text_cn: 为了避免叠加效应，需要进一步实施不含芬太尼的研究。
Translation: To avoid the synergistic effects, further research without fentanyl needs to be conducted.

Query_Text_cn: 本项研究的长处在于健全的研究设计(前瞻性、设盲、随机以及多种心)、频繁接受支气管镜操作的患者人群以及探究与患者、医师及实践获益相关的研究终点数量。
Translation: The strength of this study lies in its robust study design (prospective, blinded, randomized, and multiple endpoints), patient population frequently undergoing bronchoscopy procedures, and the number of study endpoints related to benefits for patients, physicians, and clinical practice.

Query_Text_cn: 迄今为止，我们尚未发现任何采集到如此广泛数据以评估支气管镜操作中适度镇静的有效性和安全性的研究。
Translation: To date, we have not yet identified any studies that have collected such extensive data to evaluate the efficacy and safety of moderate sedation during bronchoscopy procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 本项研究应用的数据采集方法可以为目前使用的镇静药物和处于研发中的镇静药物提供评估的基础。
Translation: The data collection methods applied in this study can serve as a foundation for evaluating currently used sedative drugs and those under development.

Query_Text_cn: 总言之，磷泊酚是一种有效的镇静药物，在接受纤维支气管镜操作的患者中能产生适度镇静作用，且安全性良好。
Translation: In summary, phosphophol is an effective sedative drug that can induce moderate sedation in patients undergoing fiberoptic bronchoscopy with a good safety profile.

Query_Text_cn: 这是近20多年来首个作为纤维支气管镜操作过程中的清醒镇静剂接受评估的药物。
Translation: This is the first drug in over two decades to be evaluated as a conscious sedative during a fiberoptic bronchoscopy procedure.

Query_Text_cn: 今后临床试验的焦点是对磷泊酚与目前这一常规操作所使用的镇静方案进行直接比较。
Translation: The focus of future clinical trials will be to directly compare propofol with the sedation regimen currently used in standard practice.

Query_Text_cn: 理想而言，一项临床试验结果不仅能够帮助改善治疗效果，而且能提升对疾病的理解。
Translation: Ideally, the results of a clinical trial can not only help improve treatment outcomes but also enhance understanding of diseases.

Query_Text_cn: 而有时，在获得主要结果的同时，临床试验会使我们重新审视先前看似十分可靠的结沦。
Translation: Sometimes, alongside the primary results, clinical trials lead us to re-examine conclusions that were previously considered highly reliable.

Query_Text_cn: 本期Lancet中刊登的INTEREST研究便是这样一项试验，该研究是由Kim及其同事负责的一项大型、组织完善的临床试验。
Translation: The INTEREST study published in the current issue of The Lancet is precisely such a trial, a large-scale, well-organized clinical trial led by Kim and colleagues.

Query_Text_cn: INTEREST研究指出，对于既往接受过治疗的非小细胞肺癌患者，经表皮生长因子受体(EGFR)酪氨酸激酶抑制剂吉非替尼治疗后，其存活情况并不劣于多西紫杉醇治疗患者，且具有治疗毒性反应低和生存质量高的优势。
Translation: The INTEREST study indicated that for previously treated non-small cell lung cancer patients, the survival outcomes after gefitinib treatment were non-inferior to those receiving docetaxel, with the advantages of lower treatment-related toxicity and higher quality of life.

Query_Text_cn: 在一些非随机或安慰剂对照研究中，利用临床和生物学手段识别了某些非小细胞肺癌患者应用吉非替尼疗效优于多西紫杉醇，或者反之；在此基础上，希望INTEREST研究能通过强化对疾病的认知来指导临床用药。
Translation: In some non-randomized or placebo-controlled studies, clinical and biological methods identified certain non-small cell lung cancer patients who had better efficacy with gefitinib than docetaxel, or vice versa; based on this, the INTEREST study aims to enhance understanding of the disease to guide clinical treatment decisions.

Query_Text_cn: 这样的发现使得我们可以为不同亚组类型的患者选择最佳的治疗方案。
Translation: Such findings enable us to select the optimal treatment regimens for patients of different subgroup types.

Query_Text_cn: 无吸烟史的患者、东南亚裔患者以及腺癌患者在应用EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（吉非替尼和厄罗替尼）治疗后，其存活情况要优于终生吸烟患者、非东南亚裔患者以及鳞状细胞癌患者。
Translation: Patients without smoking history, Southeast Asian patients, and adenocarcinoma patients have better survival outcomes when treated with EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (gefitinib and erlotinib) compared to lifelong smokers, non-Southeast Asian patients, and squamous cell carcinoma patients.

Query_Text_cn: 同时，有证据证明，女性对此类抑制剂的反应率要高于男性，尽管两者的存活率可能没有差异。
Translation: Meanwhile, there is evidence showing that women have a higher response rate to such inhibitors than men, although their survival rates may not differ.

Query_Text_cn: 出乎意料的是，INTEREST研究表明，尽管无吸烟史患者、女性患者、亚洲裔患者以及腺癌患者的存活期分别长于吸烟患者、非亚洲裔患者以及非腺癌患者，但是经吉非替尼和多西紫杉醇治疗后，其存活时间是相似的。
Translation: Surprisingly, the INTEREST study found that never-smokers, women, Asian patients, and adenocarcinoma patients had longer survival periods than ever-smokers, non-Asian patients, and non-adenocarcinoma patients respectively. However, after treatment with gefitinib and docetaxel, their survival times were similar.

Query_Text_cn: 这一结果提示，这些分组标准是与治疗无关的预后因子，或者是预示对截然不同的干预具有高敏感性的非特异性因素。
Translation: This result suggests that these grouping criteria are either treatment-independent prognostic factors or nonspecific factors predictive of high sensitivity to distinct interventions.

Query_Text_cn: 更加令人困惑的是来自INTEREST研究中对协同主要生物标记物终点的分析结果。
Translation: The more confusing aspect is the analysis results from the INTEREST study on the synergistic primary biomarker endpoint.

Query_Text_cn: EGFR基因拷贝数升高已被证实可以预测EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂的生存效应，INTEREST研究在设计上具有合理的预期：高EGFR基因拷贝数的患者经吉非替尼治疗后，其生存情况会优于多西紫杉醇治疗患者。
Translation: The elevation of EGFR gene copy number has been confirmed to predict survival benefits from EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors. The INTEREST study was designed with a rationale expectation: patients with high EGFR gene copy numbers would have a survival outcome superior to docetaxel-treated patients when treated with gefitinib.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这种差异并不存在。
Translation: However, this difference does not exist.

Query_Text_cn: 相似的是，EGFR表达和突变（大量的研究报道称，EGFR表达和突变是EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂治疗反应或生存受益的预测因子）并不能预测吉非替尼相对于多西紫杉醇的生存优势。
Translation: Similarly, EGFR expression and mutations (numerous studies have reported that EGFR expression and mutations are predictors of treatment response or survival benefit to EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors) cannot predict the survival advantage of gefitinib relative to docetaxel.

Query_Text_cn: INTEREST试验的研究人员声称，利用原确诊归档组织标本对生物标记物进行了分析，而这些变量可能随着时间的推移发生改变，并且可能受到了一线化疗方案的影响。
Translation: Researchers stated that the biomarkers were analyzed using archived tissue samples from original diagnoses, while these variables may have changed over time and could have been influenced by first-line chemotherapy regimens.

Query_Text_cn: 最近，在非小细胞肺癌患者的循环细胞中检出了基因突变，这支持存在此类差异性的观点。
Translation: Recently, genetic mutations were detected in the circulating cells of non-small cell lung cancer patients, supporting the view that such heterogeneity exists.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，得出有关生物标记物和EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂的假说的非随机化和安慰剂对照研究，也利用相似的归档组织标本进行。
Translation: However, non-randomized and placebo-controlled studies leading to hypotheses regarding biomarkers and EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors also utilized similar archived tissue specimens.

Query_Text_cn: 另外，INVITE研究——尽管样本置较小——比较了吉非替尼与化疗在非小细胞肺癌中的疗效，并未发现EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂对于高EGFR拷贝数患者会更加有效。
Translation: Additionally, the INVITE study - despite its small sample size - compared the efficacy of gefitinib versus chemotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer, and did not demonstrate that EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors are more effective in patients with high EGFR copy numbers.

Query_Text_cn: 在不适合接受以铂类药物为基础的联合化疗的老年患者中所进行的此项一线治疗临床研究表明，高拷贝数患者经长春瑞滨治疗后，其无进展存活期要长于吉非替尼治疗患者。
Translation: In a first-line treatment clinical study conducted among elderly patients ineligible for platinum-based combination chemotherapy, patients with high copy number who were treated with vinorelbine had a longer progression-free survival than those treated with gefitinib.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，两项临床研究在非小细胞肺癌患者中对某种EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂与化疗进行了比较，并且两项研究均对有关特定预测因子的广为认知的概念提出了挑战。
Translation: Therefore, two clinical studies compared a certain EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor with chemotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer patients, and both studies challenged the widely held concepts related to specific predictive factors.

Query_Text_cn: 研究专家已经建议，在根据EGFR突变选用一线EGFR酪氨酸激酶抑制剂时，应持谨慎态度。
Translation: Experts have recommended exercising caution when selecting first-line EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors based on EGFR mutations.

Query_Text_cn: 而且，根据INTEREST研究的结果，在一线化疗后会有不止一种的治疗选择提供给患者。
Translation: Moreover, based on the results of the INTEREST study, more than one treatment option will be available to patients after first-line chemotherapy.

Query_Text_cn: 随着对预测性生物标记物理解的不断发展，用药选择很可能会受到患者意见、体力状况以及既往不良反应的影响。
Translation: As the understanding of predictive biomarkers continues to evolve, drug selection is likely to be influenced by patient preferences, performance status, and previous adverse reactions.

Query_Text_cn: 这些研究经验给我们带来了重要的启发。
Translation: These research experiences have provided us with significant insights.

Query_Text_cn: 首先，尽管根据患者的个体特点以及肿瘤生物学来调整治疗方案的做法十分流行，但是不能仅仅为了迎合支持新型靶向药物的设计和研发的科学基金会，就贸然得出关于特定预测因子的结论。
Translation: Although it is popular to adjust treatment plans based on patients' individual characteristics and tumor biology, it would be premature to draw hasty conclusions about specific predictive factors solely to cater to scientific foundations advocating for the design and development of novel targeted therapies.

Query_Text_cn: 其次，仅仅根据小样本临床研究（TAX317;55例患者接受了更加安全的75mg/m2剂量多西紫杉醇治疗）便把多西紫杉醇认定为标准二线治疗方案，并允许检测化疗相对于最佳支持治疗获准的预测因子，显得过于草率。
Translation: designating docetaxel as the standard second-line treatment regimen based solely on a small-sample clinical study (TAX317; 55 patients received the safer 75 mg/m² dose of docetaxel) and permitting the evaluation of chemotherapy's predictive biomarkers relative to best supportive care appears overly hasty and premature.

Query_Text_cn: 目前，尚不存在能够完全替代具有重要临床和生物结果以及良好设计的大样本随机临床试验的研究方法。
Translation: At present, there does not exist a research methodology that can completely replace large-sample, well-designed randomized clinical trials with important clinical and biological outcomes.

Query_Text_cn: 归根结底，此类临床研究最有可能改变我们的临床做法以及我们对于疾病的认识。
Translation: Ultimately, such clinical studies are most likely to transform our clinical practices and our understanding of diseases.

Query_Text_cn: 2008年4月，一27岁女性因持续3周眩晕、食欲不振及阵发性呕吐到当地医院急诊科就诊。
Translation: In April 2008, a 27-year-old woman presented to the emergency department of a local hospital due to persistent dizziness, loss of appetite and episodic vomiting lasting three weeks.

Query_Text_cn: 2个月前，患者曾接受腹腔镜下单纯近端胃旁路手术治疗肥胖症；出院时医生建议其服用复合维生素和兰索拉唑。
Translation: Two months ago, the patient underwent laparoscopic proximal gastric bypass surgery for obesity treatment. Upon discharge, the doctor prescribed multivitamins and lansoprazole.

Query_Text_cn: 转入作者所在医院行食管胃十二指肠镜检查未见异常。
Translation: The patient was transferred to the author's hospital for esophagogastroduodenoscopy, which revealed no abnormalities.

Query_Text_cn: 血清钠、尿素和肌酐浓度分别为155mmol/L、10.4mmol/L、155μmol/L，提示有脱水迹象。
Translation: The serum sodium, urea, and creatinine concentrations are 155 mmol/L, 10.4 mmol/L, and 155 μmol/L, respectively, indicating signs of dehydration.

Query_Text_cn: 行减肥手术后患者体重降低了18.9kg。
Translation: The patient lost 18.9 kilograms in weight after undergoing weight-loss surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 因此给予静脉补液（包括5%葡萄糖）。
Translation: Therefore, administer intravenous fluids, including 5% dextrose solution.

Query_Text_cn: 此外还给予了高糖能量合剂。
Translation: Additionally, a high-sugar energy compound was also administered.

Query_Text_cn: 次日，患者自述头晕，并且在进行淋浴时晕倒。
Translation: The next day, the patient reported dizziness and fainted while taking a shower.

Query_Text_cn: 检查发现患者有严重的直立性低血压（仰卧位血压122/79mmHg，直立位血压73/35mmHg，1mmHg≈0.133kPa）、双侧踝关节水肿。
Translation: On examination, the patient was noted to have severe orthostatic hypotension (blood pressure of 122/79 mmHg in the supine position and 73/35 mmHg upright; 1 mmHg ≈ 0.133 kPa) and bilateral ankle edema.

Query_Text_cn: 心电图(ECG)显示窦性心律，侧壁导联T波倒置（附图）；血清肌钙蛋白T浓度为0.23μg/L（正常值小于0.01μg/L）。
Translation: The electrocardiogram (ECG) demonstrates sinus rhythm with T wave inversions in the lateral leads (see attached figure); the serum troponin T concentration is reported at 0.23 μg/L (normal range <0.01 μg/L).

Query_Text_cn: 诊断为维生素B1缺乏症，静脉给予维生素B1（500mg，每8h一次）。
Translation: Diagnosed with thiamine deficiency, administered thiamine intravenously (500 mg every 8 hours).

Query_Text_cn: 超声心动图显示左室(LV)射血分数为32%，LV收缩功能、舒张功能中度至重度障碍，广泛而显著的心肌运动减弱。
Translation: Echocardiography reveals a left ventricular (LV) ejection fraction of 32%, with moderate to severe impairment in LV systolic and diastolic function, and widespread and marked myocardial wall motion abnormalities.

Query_Text_cn: 经维生素B1治疗24h后，复视、眼球震颤、直立性低血压及T波倒置现象消失。
Translation: After 24 hours of vitamin B1 treatment, diplopia, nystagmus, orthostatic hypotension, and T-wave inversion had disappeared.

Query_Text_cn: 继续静脉给予维生素B1并持续3d，随后口服维生素B1（100mg，每8h一次）。
Translation: Continue intravenous administration of vitamin B1 for 3 days, followed by oral vitamin B1 (100 mg every 8 hours).

Query_Text_cn: 治疗开始前，经高效液相色谱法测定血液中硫胺素焦磷酸(TPP)浓度为41nmol/L(正常值66~200nmol/L)。
Translation: Prior to the initiation of treatment, the blood thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP) concentration was determined by high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) to be 41 nmol/L (normal range: 66-200 nmol/L).

Query_Text_cn: 患者承认其在减肥手术后未按要求服用复合维生素。
Translation: The patient admitted that they had failed to take the multivitamin as required after the weight-loss surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 因此要求其出院后继续服用维生素B1和复合维生素。
Translation: Therefore, it is required that the patient continue taking vitamin B1 and multivitamins after discharge.

Query_Text_cn: 4周后，超声心动图显示LV射血分数已升至63%，LV收缩功能、舒张功能也恢复正常，血中维生素B1浓度为218nmol/L。
Translation: After 4 weeks, the echocardiogram showed that the LV ejection fraction (LVEF) had increased to 63%, with normalization of LV systolic and diastolic functions. The serum vitamin B1 (thiamine) concentration was 218 nmol/L.

Query_Text_cn: 2008年8月末次随访时，患者身体状况良好，体重指数为25.2kg/m2，坚持服用复合维生素。
Translation: At the time of the last follow-up in late August 2008, the patient was in good general condition with a Body Mass Index (BMI) of 25.2 kg/m² and remained adherent to multivitamin supplementation.

Query_Text_cn: 维生素B1在肝脏中可转化为TPP，而TPP是碳水化合物代谢中必备的辅助因子。
Translation: Vitamin B1 can be converted into TPP in the liver, which is an essential cofactor in carbohydrate metabolism.

Query_Text_cn: 中枢神经系统(CNS)需要维生素B1维持髓磷脂，并合成乙酰胆碱、γ氨基丁酸以及谷氨酸。
Translation: The central nervous system (CNS) requires vitamin B1 to maintain myelin and synthesize acetylcholine, gamma-aminobutyric acid, and glutamic acid.

Query_Text_cn: 全身维生素B1的存储量可维持18~60d；有关肥胖患者体内维生素B1存储量的资料较少。
Translation: The body stores of vitamin B1 can last for 18 to 60 days; however, limited data are available on vitamin B1 storage in obese individuals.

Query_Text_cn: 维生素B1缺乏可引起湿型脚气病（其特征为心血管功能障碍）、干燥型脚气病（其特征为外周神经病变）以及Wernicke脑病。Wernicke脑病是一种以眼球震颤、复视、眼肌麻痹、共济失调和意识错乱为特征的急性神经病变，但只有约16%的患者出现上述3种眼部症状。
Translation: Vitamin B1 deficiency can cause wet beriberi (characterized by cardiovascular dysfunction), dry beriberi (characterized by peripheral neuropathy), and Wernicke encephalopathy. Wernicke encephalopathy is an acute neurological disorder characterized by nystagmus, diplopia, ophthalmoplegia, ataxia, and confusion; however, only approximately 16% of patients exhibit the three ocular symptoms mentioned above.

Query_Text_cn: 全世界范围内开展的维生素B1强化计划已经使维生素B1缺乏症的发病率大大降低；然而，在难民人群中仍有可能暴发维生素B1缺乏症。
Translation: The globally implemented vitamin B1 fortification programs have significantly reduced the incidence of vitamin B1 deficiency; however, there remains a possibility of an outbreak among refugee populations.

Query_Text_cn: 在经济发达国家，维生素B1缺乏症通常与慢性酒精中毒有关，但也可见于习惯性限制饮食、妊娠剧吐、胃肠功能紊乱、恶性肿瘤、AIDS、重症感染、肾脏疾病及减肥手术后。
Translation: In economically developed countries, vitamin B1 deficiency is typically associated with chronic alcoholism but may also occur in cases of habitual dietary restrictions, hyperemesis gravidarum, gastrointestinal dysfunction, malignant tumors, AIDS, severe infections, renal diseases, and post-bariatric surgery scenarios.

Query_Text_cn: Wernicke脑病通常发生于手术后4~12周，主要见于体重减轻7kg/月的患者。
Translation: Wernicke's encephalopathy typically occurs 4 to 12 weeks following surgery and is primarily observed in patients with a weight loss of 7 kg per month.

Query_Text_cn: 给予葡萄糖后，因维生素B1储备耗竭而引起维生素B1缺乏的急症表现。
Translation: After administration of glucose, acute manifestations of vitamin B1 deficiency occur due to depletion of vitamin B1 reserves.

Query_Text_cn: 如果有疑似维生素B1缺乏的情况，应在给予患者输注葡萄糖之前补充维生素B1。
Translation: If there is suspected vitamin B1 deficiency, vitamin B1 should be supplemented before administering glucose infusion to the patient.

Query_Text_cn: 就诊时，患者表现为窦性心动过速和脱水，拟诊断为幽门梗阻。
Translation: During the consultation, the patient presented with sinus tachycardia and dehydration, with a provisional diagnosis of pyloric obstruction.

Query_Text_cn: 患者迅速发展为侧向凝视的眼球震颤、中心凝视性复视、上肢反射亢进、下肢无力、局部感觉减退，无共济失调或意识不清。
Translation: The patient rapidly progressed to horizontal gaze nystagmus, central gaze diplopia, hyperreflexia in the upper extremities, weakness in the lower extremities, localized sensory deficits, without ataxia or impaired consciousness.

Query_Text_cn: 1.1国际民用航空组织（ICAO）是联合国的专门机构，随着1944年12月7日在芝加哥签署《国际民用航空公约》而创建。
Translation: 1.1 The International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations, established upon the signing of the Convention on International Civil Aviation in Chicago on December 7, 1944.

Query_Text_cn: 1.2国际民航组织的成员包括191个成员国。
Translation: 1.2 The International Civil Aviation Organization comprises 191 member states.

Query_Text_cn: 大会由所有成员国的代表组成，每三年举行一次会议，详细回顾本组织的整体工作、制定今后几年的政策并批准上次大会发布的财务报表。
Translation: The conference is composed of representatives from all member states and held every three years to conduct a thorough review of the organization's overall work, formulate policies for the coming years, and approve the financial statements issued by the previous conference.

Query_Text_cn: 各地区办事处在总部秘书长指导下工作，主要负责与所属地区各国以及其他有关组织、地区民用航空机构和联合国各地区经济委员会联系。
Translation: The regional offices operate under the guidance of the Secretary-General of the headquarters and are primarily responsible for maintaining communication and coordination with countries within their respective regions, as well as relevant organizations, regional civil aviation authorities, and the regional economic commissions of the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 地区办事处推动国际民航组织的政策、决定、标准和建议措施（SARPs）以及地区空中航行计划的实施，并提供必要的技术援助。
Translation: Regional offices facilitate the implementation of policies, decisions, standards and recommended measures (SARPs), and regional air navigation plans of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and provide necessary technical assistance.

Query_Text_cn: 1.6按照《财务条例》第12.4条，我谨荣幸地呈报国际民航组织2012年12月31日终止年度的财务报表，供理事会审议并向大会提出建议。
Translation: 1.6 In accordance with Article 12.4 of the Financial Regulations, I have the honour to submit the financial statements of the International Civil Aviation Organization for the year ended 31 December 2012 for the consideration of the Council and to make recommendations to the Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 按照《财务条例》第13条的规定，外部审计员的意见及其对2012年财务报表的报告以及我就此发表的意见（反映在秘书长的评论中），也将向理事会和大会呈报。
Translation: Pursuant to Article 13 of the Financial Regulations, the opinion of the external auditor on the 2012 financial statements and my comments thereon (as reflected in the comments of the Secretary-General) will also be submitted to the Council and the General Assembly.

Query_Text_cn: 1.7除非另有说明，财务报表和构成本财务报表组成部分的附注披露及本报告以千加元（CAD）列报。
Translation: 1.7 Unless otherwise stated, the financial statements, the notes and disclosures that form part of the financial statements, and the report are presented in thousands of Canadian dollars (CAD).

Query_Text_cn: 2.1按照财务报表附注1报告，国际民航组织于2012年继续全面采用国际公共部门会计准则。
Translation: As reported in Note 1 to the financial statements, the International Civil Aviation Organization continued to fully adopt the International Public Sector Accounting Standards in 2012.

Query_Text_cn: 联合国各组织已采用这些标准来代替联合国系统会计标准（UNSAS）。
Translation: United Nations organizations have adopted these standards to replace the United Nations System Accounting Standards (UNSAS).

Query_Text_cn: 国际公共部门会计准则包括详细的要求与指导，它支持财务报表保持一致性及相互对照。
Translation: International Public Sector Accounting Standards include detailed requirements and guidance that support financial statements in maintaining consistency and comparability.

Query_Text_cn: 2.2国际民航组织采用了国际公共部门会计准则委员会颁布的所有适用标准。
Translation: The International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) has adopted all applicable standards issued by the International Public Sector Accounting Standards Board (IPSASB).

Query_Text_cn: 报表V：预算和实际收支对照。
Translation: Report V: Budget and Actual Income and Expenditures Comparison

Query_Text_cn: 两个分部被纳入经审计的财务报表。
Translation: Two segments were included in the audited financial statements.

Query_Text_cn: 第一分部包括本组织正在进行的经常活动，如经常方案、创收活动以及技术合作方案的管理和支持。
Translation: The first division includes the ongoing regular activities of this organization, such as regular programmes, revenue-generating activities, and the management and support of technical cooperation programmes.

Query_Text_cn: 2.6下述各段概述了本组织2012年财务状况及执行情况的重点信息。
Translation: 2.6 The following paragraphs summarize the key information regarding the Organization's financial situation and implementation status for the year 2012.

Query_Text_cn: 2012年12月31日2.792亿加元的资产总额主要包括总额2.464亿加元的现金及约当现金和2470万加元摊款和其他应收款项。
Translation: On December 31, 2012, the total assets of CAD 279.2 million mainly consisted of CAD 246.4 million in cash and cash equivalents, as well as CAD 24.7 million in contributions payable and other receivables.

Query_Text_cn: 负债总额3.24亿加元，其中2.088亿加元属技术合作项目的预收款，以及自2010年采用国际公共部门会计准则以来，在报表中认列的9020万加元职工福利的长期负债。
Translation: The total liabilities amounted to CAD 324 million, comprising CAD 208.8 million in advance payments for technical cooperation projects and CAD 90.2 million in long-term liabilities for employee benefits recognized in the financial statements since the adoption of International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS) in 2010.

Query_Text_cn: 2.8这份报表还列报了根据国际公共部门会计准则需要记入职工福利负债导致出现4480万加元的累积亏损。
Translation: This report also reported employee benefit liabilities required under the International Public Sector Accounting Standards, resulting in a cumulative loss of 44.8 million Canadian dollars.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，因为流动资产超过流动负债3390万加元，未预见需要短期追加资金以填补累积亏损。
Translation: However, given that current assets exceed current liabilities by 33.9 million Canadian dollars, there is no anticipation of the need for short-term additional funding to address accumulated losses.

Query_Text_cn: 2.9报表II介绍了2012年的财务执行情况。
Translation: Section 2.9 Report II outlines the financial execution for the year 2012.

Query_Text_cn: 自2010年以来对本报表做了重大改动以便符合国际公共部门会计准则。
Translation: Since 2010, this report has undergone major revisions to comply with the International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS).

Query_Text_cn: 2012年还对分摊会费收入作出30万加元的临时调整，以便考虑到按照国际公共部门会计准则要求，按公允值认列长期应收款的影响。
Translation: In 2012, a temporary adjustment of CAD 300,000 was made to the assessed contribution revenue to account for the impact of recognizing long-term receivables at fair value in accordance with the requirements of the International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS).

Query_Text_cn: 2012年赤字总额达750万加元。
Translation: The total deficit in 2012 reached 7.5 million Canadian dollars.

Query_Text_cn: 费用包括记入循环基金的730万加元，藉以在应计制基础上认列职工福利开支（离职后健康保险、年假和回国补助金）。
Translation: The fees include 73 million Canadian dollars allocated to the revolving fund, to recognize employee welfare expenses (post-employment health insurance, annual leave, and home leave allowances) on an accrual basis.

Query_Text_cn: 2012年，为这些福利共支付270万加元，这笔款项按照从其他基金来源的资金在循环基金中列报。
Translation: In 2012, CAD 2.7 million was paid for these benefits. This amount was reported in the revolving fund as funds from other sources.

Query_Text_cn: 产生的福利与支付的福利之间460万加元的差额列入该基金的年度赤字。
Translation: The CAD 4.6 million difference between the generated and paid benefits was included in the annual deficit of the fund.

Query_Text_cn: 下文对经常方案普通基金财务结果和亏损（242万加元）与行政和业务服务费用基金的盈余（120万加元）做了解释。
Translation: The text provides an explanation of the financial results and a deficit (CAD2.42 million) for the Ordinary Fund of the Regular Programme, and a surplus (CAD1.2 million) for the Administrative and Programmatic Services Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 2.10至于其他基金净亏损（190万加元），主要原因是辅助创收基金亏损170万加元（详情见以下3.21段）以及认列收入与支出时间的差异。
Translation: The net loss of other funds (1.9 million Canadian dollars) was primarily due to a loss of 1.7 million Canadian dollars from the auxiliary revenue-generating fund (as detailed in section 3.21 below) and timing differences in the recognition of income and expenditures.

Query_Text_cn: 2012年经常活动部分其他基金的亏损由前些年认列的盈余供资，因此不需要追加资金。
Translation: The losses of other funds in the regular activities in 2012 were funded by surpluses recognized in previous years, thus requiring no additional funding.

Query_Text_cn: 2.11关于技术合作项目部分，2012年没有出现年度盈余或赤字，因为收入是按照项目完成阶段认列，通常是在每个项目发生费用的基础上确定。
Translation: There was no annual surplus or deficit in 2012 because revenue was recognized based on the project's progress stages, typically determined on the basis of expenses incurred for each project.

Query_Text_cn: 在2011年和2012年，这项进程对价值超过10万美元的项目又进一步更加密切配合其项目完成的百分比。
Translation: In 2011 and 2012, this process further intensified its close coordination with the percentage of project completion for projects worth over $100,000.

Query_Text_cn: 净资产余额包括年初净累积亏损3000万加元的准备金。
Translation: The net asset balance includes a reserve of CAD 30 million for the net accumulated loss at the beginning of the year.

Query_Text_cn: 2012年底的净累积亏损结存为4480万加元。
Translation: The net accumulated loss carryforward as of the end of 2012 stood at CAD 44.8 million.

Query_Text_cn: 2012年的累积亏损的增加主要是由于当年的亏损（750万加元）和离职后健康保险的精算损失（730万加元）引起的。
Translation: The increase in cumulative losses in 2012 was primarily attributable to the loss for the year (CAD 7.5 million) and actuarial losses on post-employment health insurance (CAD 7.3 million).

Query_Text_cn: 2.13报表IV显示了从2011年12月31日1.934亿加元到2012年12月31日2.464亿加元现金流量的变化。
Translation: Report IV in Section 2.13 shows the changes in cash flow from CAD 193.4 million as of December 31, 2011, to CAD 246.4 million as of December 31, 2012.

Query_Text_cn: 2.14报表V列出了预算（经常方案）与实际收支之间的对照。
Translation: Report 2.14-V compares the budget (regular programme) with actual revenues and expenditures.

Query_Text_cn: 3.12010年大会第37届会议根据A37-26号决议C款，表决2011年拨款额度为89495千加元。
Translation: 3. In accordance with Article C of Resolution A37/26, the 37th session of the General Assembly voted the 2011 budget allocation at 894,950,000 Canadian dollars.
3. 2011 Carryover.

Query_Text_cn: 按照《财务条例》第5.6条和5.7条，秘书长从2011年的结余，批准1019.6万加元以追加2012年的拨款，主要用于2012年未编入预算的未支付承付款和强制性及其他关键任务活动。
Translation: Pursuant to Article 5.6 and 5.7 of the Financial Regulations, the Secretary-General approved CAD 10.196 million from the 2011 surplus to allocate as additional funding for 2012, primarily for unpaid contractual obligations not included in the 2012 budget and mandatory and other critical mission-related activities.

Query_Text_cn: 3.42012年未支付的承付款。
Translation: 3.42012 Unpaid contractual payments as of 2012.

Query_Text_cn: 2012年承付但预计在2013年才交付的价值375.2万加元的承付款项。
Translation: The payment commitment of CAD 3.752 million, undertaken in 2012 but expected to be disbursed in 2013.

Query_Text_cn: 主要包括累积假期和离职回国补助金146万加元的雇员应享权利预计在工作人员2013年离开国际民航组织时支付。
Translation: The employee benefits, which include accumulated vacation and repatriation allowance totaling 1.46 million Canadian dollars, are expected to be paid when the staff member left the International Civil Aviation Organization in 2013.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，根据《财务条例》第5.7条，已预留521.2万加元（见图1，列（e））的款项并结转到2013年，以清偿2012年发生的法律义务。
Translation: Therefore, in accordance with Article 5.7 of the Financial Regulations, CAD 5.212 million has been reserved (as shown in Figure 1, column (e)) and carried forward to 2013 to settle the legal obligations incurred in 2012.

Query_Text_cn: 3.5拨款下降。
Translation: A 3.5% decline in funding allocation.

Query_Text_cn: 根据《财务条例》第5.9条，秘书长可以批准从一战略目标（SO）或辅助实施战略（SIS）向另一战略目标或辅助实施战略转拨，但数额不得超过转拨所涉及的每一战略目标或辅助战略年度拨款的10%。
Translation: Pursuant to Article 5.9 of the Financial Regulations, the Secretary-General may approve transfers from one Strategic Objective (SO) or Supporting Implementation Strategy (SIS) to another Strategic Objective or Supporting Implementation Strategy, provided that the amount does not exceed 10% of the annual allocation for each Strategic Objective or Supporting Implementation Strategy involved in the transfer.
Carryforward to 2013: 3.7.

Query_Text_cn: 330.7万加元在此限额之内。
Translation: 3,307,000 Canadian dollars is within this limit.

Query_Text_cn: 结转的款项将主要用于为各项方案活动供资，其次为管理和行政方面的各项活动供资金。
Translation: The carried-over funds will be primarily allocated to finance various program activities and secondarily to fund management and administrative activities.

Query_Text_cn: 供资的方案活动包括航空环保委的额外语文费用、航空运输会议和法律委员会会议、以及环境方案的基于市场的措施。
Translation: The funding program activities include additional language expenses of the Aviation Environmental Protection Committee, Aviation Transport Meetings and Legal Committee Meetings, and market-based measures under environmental programs.

Query_Text_cn: 管理和行政活动包括额外的人力资源员额（根据外部审计员的建议）、评估和审计办公室、道德操守官员以及即将举行的大会的电子表决系统的额外资源。
Translation: Managing and administrative activities include additional human resources staff as recommended by external auditors, the evaluation and audit office, integrity officers, and additional resources for the electronic voting system of the upcoming session of the conference.

Query_Text_cn: 3.8鉴于前款所述的增加和转拨，今年核准订正的最后拨款总额为9417.2万加元。
Translation: In view of the additions and reallocations referred to above, the final approved revised total appropriations for this year amount to CAD 941.72 million.

Query_Text_cn: 3包括由于按1.00美元=1.038美元编制预算的影响产生40万预算兑汇亏损。
Translation: Item 3 includes foreign exchange losses of 400,000 on the budget resulting from its preparation based on the exchange rate of 1.00 USD=1.038 USD.

Query_Text_cn: 4摘自报表V，财务报表：由于AOSC的报销额差异而产生的拨款（预算）下降。
Translation: Item 4, extracted from Report V, financial statements: Grant (budget) decrease resulting from discrepancies in reimbursement amounts for AOSC.

Query_Text_cn: 3.10差异解释——收入。
Translation: 3.10 Explanation of Variance —— Income.

Query_Text_cn: 9305.1万加元的整体预算（图1，（a）栏）代表2012年经常方案预算的五个主要资金来源：分摊的会费、辅助创收基金盈余、杂项收入、行政和业务服务费用基金的偿还款和长期未兑现拖欠账户激励机制转来的款项。
Translation: The overall budget of 93.051 million Canadian dollars (Figure 1,Column (a)) represents the five major funding sources for the 2012 Regular Programme budget: Apportioned membership fees,Auxiliary revenue-generating fund surplus,Miscellaneous income,Repayments from the Administrative and business services fees fund,and Transfers from the incentive mechanism for long-term unclaimed overdue accounts.

Query_Text_cn: 就分摊的会费而言，30万加元的差额涉及到对应收长期会费的贴现款项。
Translation: In terms of the allocated membership fees, the 300,000 Canadian dollar difference relates to the discounted amount of receivable long-term membership fees.

Query_Text_cn: 杂项收入中，低于预期收入80万加元主要是由于利率持续走低，导致所得利息收入大幅下降。
Translation: In miscellaneous income, the shortfall of CAD 800,000 against the expected revenue was primarily due to the sustained low interest rates, which led to a significant decline in interest income earned.

Query_Text_cn: 3.11差异解释——支出。
Translation: 3.11 Explanation of Differences — Expenditure

Query_Text_cn: 10324.8万加元的整体预算（图1，（a）栏）包括2012年原先拨款9305.2万加元和2011年结转的1019.6万加元。
Translation: The overall budget of CAD 103,248,000 (Figure 1, column (a)) comprises CAD 93,052,000 from the original 2012 allocation and CAD 10,196,000 carried over from 2011.

Query_Text_cn: 2012年的节余（未用拨款）将结转到2013年。
Translation: The surplus (unexpended allocations) from 2012 will be carried over to 2013.

Query_Text_cn: 2012年1月1日美元/加元汇率（开具美元发票之日）比编制2012年预算时使用的汇率要低，造成分摊会费总额减少39.9万加元（图1，（c）栏）。
Translation: The exchange rate for USD/CAD on January 1, 2012 (the date invoices were issued in USD) was lower than the rate used when preparing the 2012 budget, resulting in a reduction of CAD 399,000 in the allocated membership fee total (Figure 1, Item (c)).

Query_Text_cn: 以预算汇率重列开支总额列于图1，（d）栏。
Translation: The total expenditures restated at the budget exchange rate are presented in column (d) of Figure 1.

Query_Text_cn: 按照这种方式，预算节余，即预算和实际支出之间的差额，已适当作出调整（降低），显示于图1，（h）栏。
Translation: In this way, the budget surplus—the difference between the budgeted and actual expenditures—has been appropriately adjusted (reduced) and is displayed in Figure 1, column (h).

Query_Text_cn: 3.132008年和2009年各成员国的摊款及其他估计的收入来源是以加元确定。
Translation: 3.13 The assessed contributions from each member state and other estimated revenue sources for 2008 and 2009 were denominated in Canadian dollars.

Query_Text_cn: 美元，但在财务报表中以加元列报。
Translation: The functional currency is the US dollar, but financial statements are reported in Canadian dollars.

Translation: During 2012, the Canadian dollar to US dollar exchange rate started at 1.024 and ended at 0.993.

Translation: In 2012, the total membership fees received amounted to 80,186,000 Canadian dollars. As of the end of the current fiscal year, 3,721,000 Canadian dollars in membership fees for the current year remained unpaid.

Query_Text_cn: 今年年初，各国2011年及以前年度应收款为1378.4万加元，共收到450.4万加元缴款，仍有928万加元未缴余额。
Translation: At the beginning of this year, the receivables for the year 2011 and prior years stood at CAD 137.84 million, with a total of CAD 45.04 million in payments received, leaving an unpaid balance of CAD 92.8 million.

Query_Text_cn: 截至2012年12月31日，所有年度的应收摊款总额为1300.1万加元（包括周转基金）。
Translation: As of December 31, 2012, the total accrued receivables for all years amounted to 13.001 million Canadian dollars (including revolving funds).

Query_Text_cn: 过去四年，收到会费与分摊会费的平均比例为95％。
Translation: Over the past four years, the average ratio of received fees to allocated fees was 95%.

Query_Text_cn: 图2显示了自2006年以来每年年底应收分摊会费的状况。
Translation: Figure 2 illustrates the status of outstanding assessed contributions at the end of each year since 2006.

Query_Text_cn: 3.15截至2012年12月31日未缴纳的1300.1万加元会费总额中（扣除周转基金为1299.6万加元），21.8万加元属理事会成员国未缴纳的会费。
Translation: As of December 31, 2012, the total amount of unpaid membership fees was CAD 13,001,000 (after deducting the revolving fund of CAD 12,996,000), with CAD 218,000 belonging to unpaid fees from member states of the Council.

Query_Text_cn: 3.16截至2012年12月31日，有14个国家缔结了以若干年为期清偿欠款的协议。
Translation: 3.16 As of December 31, 2012, 14 countries had concluded agreements to repay their debts over a period of several years.

Query_Text_cn: 协议规定这些国家除缴纳当年会费之外，还须每年分期偿还以前各年的欠款。
Translation: The agreement stipulates that these countries, in addition to paying the annual membership fees for the current year, must also make annual installment repayments of outstanding dues from previous years.

Query_Text_cn: 本文件第IV部分附表C的附注列出了截止到2012年12月31日尚未遵守其协议条款的国家。
Translation: The footnote in Annex C of Part IV of this document lists the countries that have not complied with the terms of their agreements as of December 31, 2012.

Query_Text_cn: 3.19按本文件第IV部分附表A所示，截至2012年12月31日，扣除经常方案预算净资产准备金的累积盈余为1040万加元。
Translation: 3.19 As shown in Appendix A of Part IV of this document, the accumulated surplus after deducting the net asset reserve under the regular program budget as of December 31, 2012, was CAD 10.4 million.

Query_Text_cn: 减去周转基金结余600万加元和应收成员国摊款1300万加元，截至2012年12月31日累积盈余出现860万加元现金赤字，但注意到其中850万加元作为支付2012年未付承付款和结转到2013年的拨款的保留盈余认列。
Translation: After deducting the revolving fund surplus of CAD 6.0 million and receivables from member states' assessments of CAD 13.0 million, the accumulated surplus resulted in a cash deficit of CAD 8.6 million as of December 31, 2012. However, it should be noted that CAD 8.5 million of this amount was classified as a restricted surplus to cover unpaid commitments for 2012 and carry-over grants to 2013.

Translation: The Auxiliary Revenue-Generating Fund generated a surplus of 3,966,000 Canadian dollars in 2012.

Query_Text_cn: 这尚未扣除要求向经常方案捐助的468.8万加元，以及为包括开发电子商务平台在内的经常性活动进一步供资而需要从累积盈余中支付的97.7万加元。
Translation: This amount does not yet deduct the required contributions of CAD4.688 million to regular programs, as well as the CAD0.977 million needed to be paid from accumulated surplus to further finance recurrent activities including developing an e-commerce platform.

Translation: In accordance with Article 9.5 of the Financial Regulations, the Secretary-General submitted an updated budget (expenditures) for 2012 to the Council through working paper C-WP/13883.

Translation: In 2012, the revised expenditure estimate was CAD 7.875 million, with estimated revenue of CAD 7.976 million.

Query_Text_cn: 3.26行政和业务服务费用收入与预算相比出现80万加元结余，主要是因为对2012年执行的1.309亿美元的技术合作项目收取的平均支助费率略有增加。
Translation: Administrative and business service fee revenue had a C$800,000 surplus compared to the budget, primarily due to a slight increase in the average support rate charged for the $130.9 million technical cooperation project implemented in 2012.

Query_Text_cn: 在支出方面，员工费用节余40万加元，导致收入和支出出现120万加元总正差额。
Translation: In terms of expenditures, savings of CAD 400,000 on employee expenses resulted in a total positive difference of CAD 1,200,000 between income and expenditures.

Query_Text_cn: 3.27下图报告了过去10年年度盈余/（亏空）的走势（以百万加元计）。
Translation: Figure 3.27 below shows the trend of annual surplus/(deficit) over the past decade in millions of Canadian dollars.

Query_Text_cn: 理事会审议了这个问题，并根据一项时间调查，批准在2011年—2013年三年期的剩余期间（即2012年和2013年），经常方案每年从AOSC基金收回1202117加元，作为与项目直接有关的经常方案支助费用。
Translation: The Council reviewed this matter and, based on a time survey, approved that during the remaining period of the three-year term from 2011 to 2013 (i.e., 2012 and 2013), the regular programme would recover CAD 1,202,117 annually from the AOSC Fund as support expenses directly related to the project.

Query_Text_cn: 技术合作局（TCB）管理技术合作（TC）方案，按照大会A36-17号决议所述，它是国际民航组织的一项永久的优先活动，它通过支持成员国执行国际民航组织的法规、政策和程序，对经常方案的作用予以补充。
Translation: The Technical Cooperation Bureau (TCB) manages the Technical Cooperation (TC) Programme, which, as outlined in Assembly Resolution A36-17, constitutes a permanent priority activity of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO). It supplements the role of the regular programme by supporting Member States in implementing ICAO's regulations, policies, and procedures.

Query_Text_cn: 国际民航组织通过这一方案提供广泛的服务，包括协助各国审查国家民航机构的组织和结构、更新机场的基础设施和服务、促进技术转让与能力建设、推动国际民航组织的标准和建议措施（SARPs）、空中航行计划（ANPs）、支持普遍安全监督审计计划（USOAP）和普遍保安审计计划（USAP）产生的改正行动。
Translation: The International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) provides extensive services, including assisting countries in reviewing the organizational structures of their national civil aviation authorities, upgrading airport infrastructure and services, promoting technology transfer and capacity building, advocating the implementation of ICAO Standards and Recommended Practices (SARPs) and Aeronautical Navigation Plans (ANPs), and supporting corrective actions arising from the Universal Safety Oversight Audit Programme (USOAP) and Universal Security Audit Programme (USAP).

Query_Text_cn: 从2011年开始，技术合作局在其采购科实施ISO9001认证，2013年，其外勤业务科和业务支助股正在认证过程当中。
Translation: Starting from 2011, the Procurement Division of the Technology Cooperation Bureau implemented ISO 9001 certification. In 2013, its Field Operations Division and Business Support Division were undergoing certification.

Query_Text_cn: 经改进的流程为2012年技术合作方案效绩的长足进展和AOSC基金的成果作出了贡献。
Translation: The improved process contributed to the significant progress in the performance of the 2012 Technical Cooperation Programme and the achievements of the AOSC Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 3.31在与技术合作委员会密切协调下，为技术合作局编制了2012年至2014年的管理计划，确定了本期间内的目标与战略，旨在改进国际民航组织技术合作方案活动的治理、效率和质量。
Translation: 3.31 In close coordination with the Technical Cooperation Committee (TCC), the Technical Cooperation Bureau (TCB) drafted the management plan for the period from 2012 to 2014, establishing the objectives and strategies for the period aimed at enhancing the governance, efficiency, and quality of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) technical cooperation programme activities.

Query_Text_cn: 随后，作出了持续的努力，通过对技术合作局的组织结构、人员编制、节约成本和提高效率的措施进行审查，确保持续改善行政和业务服务费用基金的财政状况。
Translation: Subsequently, sustained efforts were made through a review of the organizational structure, staffing, and cost-saving and efficiency-enhancing measures of the Technical Cooperation Agency to ensure the continued improvement of the financial condition of the Administrative and Business Services Expenses Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 项目经费由政府和其他捐助方提供，2012年，进出资金总额为1.054亿加元。
Translation: The project funding is provided by the government and other donors. In 2012, the total funds amounted to 105.4 million Canadian dollars.

Query_Text_cn: 本文件第IV部分附表D至附表F介绍了这些项目的有关细节，以下数字以百万加元计做了概述。
Translation: The details of these projects are provided in Appendices D to F of Part IV of this document. The figures below are summarized in millions of Canadian dollars.

Query_Text_cn: 国际民航组织（ICAO）的财务报表是根据国际公共部门会计准则（IPSAS）在应计制会计基础上编制的。
Translation: The financial statements of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) are prepared in accordance with the International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS) on an accrual basis.

Query_Text_cn: 这些标准自2010年起适用。
Translation: These standards have been in effect since 2010.

Query_Text_cn: 按照最初采用国际公共部门会计准则时所规定，过渡性条款已经用于包括2010年1月1日以前以融资租赁获得的财产、厂房和设备（PP＆E）的原始认列（国际公共部门会计准则第17条）。
Translation: In accordance with the transitional provisions set when initially adopting the International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS), the initial recognition of property, plant, and equipment (PP&E) acquired through finance leases on or before January 1, 2010 is addressed under IPSAS 17.

Query_Text_cn: 下列会计标准和财务工具在其被要求执行日期之前已被采用：列报（国际公共部门会计准则第28条）、确认和计量（国际公共部门会计准则第29条）和披露（国际公共部门会计准则第30条）。
Translation: The following accounting standards and financial instruments had been adopted before the required effective date: Presentation (IPSAS 28), Recognition and Measurement (IPSAS 29), and Disclosure (IPSAS 30).

Query_Text_cn: 因为这些标准的生效日期是2013年，因此，并不要求国际民航组织采用。
Translation: Since the effective date of these standards was set for 2013, there is thus no requirement for the International Civil Aviation Organization to adopt them.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，为了提高问责制，在生效日期前就采用了这些标准。
Translation: However, in order to enhance accountability, these standards were adopted prior to the effective date.

Query_Text_cn: 除上述报表另有列明之外，编制财务报表采用的计量基准是摊销后成本。
Translation: Unless otherwise disclosed in the aforementioned reports, the measurement basis adopted in the preparation of the financial statements is amortized cost.

Query_Text_cn: 现金流量表（附表IV）是采用间接法编制。
Translation: The Cash Flow Statement (Supplemental Schedule IV) is prepared using the indirect method.

Query_Text_cn: 国际民航组织的报告货币是加拿大元（加元）。
Translation: The reporting currency of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) is the Canadian dollar (CAD).

Query_Text_cn: 鉴于技术合作项目（TCP）活动通常使用美元执行，因此其功能货币是美元（USD）。
Translation: Given that Technical Cooperation Programme (TCP) activities are typically conducted in US dollars, its functional currency is therefore the US dollar (USD).

Query_Text_cn: 账目往来中使用加元之外和技术合作项目使用美元之外的其他货币，在账目往来时均按现行联合国业务汇率（UNORE）折算。
Translation: For accounting transactions other than those using Canadian dollars and technical cooperation projects using US dollars, all other currencies shall be converted in accordance with the current United Nations Official Rates (UNORE).

Query_Text_cn: 所得收益或亏损记入财务执行情况报表，但为列报财务报表之目的，技术合作项目活动折算加元时产生的差额除外，它反映在财务状况报表准备金项下。
Translation: The gains or losses are recorded in the financial execution report. However, for the purpose of presenting the financial statements, the difference arising from the conversion of technical cooperation project activities into Canadian dollars is excluded and reflected under the reserves section of the financial position statement.

Query_Text_cn: 现金及约当现金包括库存现金、银行现金及短期存款。
Translation: Cash and cash equivalents include cash on hand, bank deposits and short-term deposits.

Query_Text_cn: 产生利息收入时予以认列，并考虑到实际收益率。
Translation: Interest income is recognized when generated, taking into account the actual yield.

Query_Text_cn: 财务单据在国际民航组织成为单据合同规定的缔约方时予以认列，直至从这些资产（负债）实收（支付）现金流量的权利（或义务）过期或被转让（结清）时为止。
Translation: Financial instruments are recognized when the International Civil Aviation Organization becomes a contracting party to the instrument, until the rights (or obligations) to the cash flows from these assets (liabilities) for receipt (payment) expire or are transferred (discharged).

Query_Text_cn: 应收款是未经活跃市场报价的固定或可确定支付的非衍生金融资产。
Translation: A receivable is a non-derivative financial asset with fixed or determinable payments not quoted on an active market.

Query_Text_cn: 除预收的分摊会费之外，所有负债均产生于交换交易。
Translation: Except for the prepaid allocated membership fees, all liabilities arise from exchange transactions.

Query_Text_cn: 财政期结束时的出版物库存及小卖部商品作为存货记账。
Translation: At the end of the fiscal period, the inventory of publications and the merchandise of the convenience store are recorded as inventory.

Query_Text_cn: 出版物成本包括采购成本及将出版物送至销售或分发国家发生的所有其他费用。
Translation: Publication costs comprise procurement costs and all other expenses incurred in shipping the publications to the sales or distribution countries.

Query_Text_cn: 制作出版物和其他内部使用文件列作支出。
Translation: The production of publications and other internal documents should be categorized as expenditures.

Query_Text_cn: 分摊的会费是成员国的法律义务。
Translation: The assessed contributions constitute a legal obligation of the member states.

Query_Text_cn: 这些会费是征收摊款当年年初认列的非交换交易的收入。
Translation: These membership fees are recognized as revenue from non-exchange transactions at the beginning of the year in which they are levied.

Query_Text_cn: 技术合作项目（TCP）活动的捐款是根据国际民航组织和捐助者签订的协定确认的交换交易的收入，它按项目完成阶段交付货物或提供服务确定，在有些情况下，国际民航组织可能认为最好的估计方式是依照项目的适用合同分阶段支付。
Translation: Donations for Technical Cooperation Programme (TCP) activities are recognized as revenue from exchange transactions under agreements between the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and donors. Such revenue is determined based on the delivery of goods or provision of services at project completion stages. In some cases, ICAO may consider the most appropriate estimation method to be staged payments in accordance with applicable contracts for the project.

Query_Text_cn: 从技术合作项目回收的管理费按照行政和业务服务费用（AOSC）基金的收入以及各个项目的支出列报。
Translation: Management fees recovered from technical cooperation projects are reported under the income of the Administrative and Operational Services Costs (AOSC) Fund and the expenditures of individual projects.

Query_Text_cn: 2011年作出了分享利息收入的新安排。根据这项安排，国际民航组织对月平均加权结存超过10万美元的项目基金存款保留获得的利息的50%。
Translation: In 2011, ICAO introduced a new arrangement for sharing interest income. Under this arrangement, ICAO retains 50% of the interest earned on project fund deposits with a monthly weighted average balance exceeding $100,000.

Query_Text_cn: 其他收入是交换交易，应收结余款项按应收款及预付款列报。
Translation: Other income is derived from exchange transactions, and receivable surplus amounts are reported under accounts receivable and advance payments.

Query_Text_cn: 这些应收款是使用有效利息方法以摊销后（贴现）成本列示，因此，是按累积贴现的净额显示。
Translation: These receivables are presented at amortized cost using the effective interest method, thus shown at the net amount after cumulative discounting.

Query_Text_cn: 实物捐助按公允价值列报。
Translation: In-kind donations are reported at fair value.

Query_Text_cn: 财产、厂房和设备（PP＆E）按历史成本减去累计折旧及任何减值损失列报。
Translation: Property, plant, and equipment (PP&E) are reported at historical cost minus accumulated depreciation and any impairment losses.

Query_Text_cn: 财产、厂房和设备如果其成本超过或等于设定为3000加元的阈值限制，租赁物业装修超过或等于设定为25000加元的阈值限制时，其改列为资本。
Translation: Property, plant, and equipment are capitalized if their costs equal to or exceed the threshold set at CAD 3,000, and leasehold improvements on leased properties are capitalized if their costs equal to or exceed the threshold set at CAD 25,000.

Query_Text_cn: 每年须至少对全部财产、厂房和设备进行减值审查，任何减值损失均须在财务执行情况报表中认列。
Translation: All property, plant, and equipment must undergo at least one impairment review annually, and any impairment losses must be recognized in the financial statements.

Query_Text_cn: 无形资产按历史成本减去累计摊销及任何减值损失列报。
Translation: Intangible assets are reported at historical cost minus accumulated amortization and any impairment losses.

Query_Text_cn: 无形资产的认列需要符合可辨认、在国际民航组织控制之下和促进未来经济效益或服务潜力且能够可靠衡量的严格标准。
Translation: The recognition of intangible assets must meet strict criteria, including being identifiable, under the control of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), promoting future economic benefits or service potential, and capable of reliable measurement.

Query_Text_cn: 使用直线法对预期使用年限摊销。
Translation: Amortize using the straight-line method over the expected useful life.

Query_Text_cn: 许可证、权利和版权按许可证、权利和版权期限摊销。
Translation: Licenses, rights, and copyrights are amortized over the terms of their respective licenses, rights, and copyrights.

Query_Text_cn: 减值指标包括无形资产陈旧与老化，以及利用无形资产从商业活动创收时产生的现金流量。
Translation: Impairment indicators include obsolescence and aging of intangible assets, as well as the cash flows generated when using intangible assets to generate revenue from commercial activities.

Query_Text_cn: 执行技术合作项目之前收到的自愿捐款作为预收款项记录。
Translation: Voluntary contributions received prior to the implementation of technical cooperation projects are recorded as advance receipts.

Query_Text_cn: 当捐款人的要求得到履行时，通常是在国际民航组织提供了服务时，或按照捐款人与本组织的协议条件交付货物时，认列收入。
Translation: When the donor’s requirements are fulfilled, typically when the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) has provided the services or delivered the goods in accordance with the terms of the agreement between the donor and the Organization, revenue is recognized.

Query_Text_cn: 有待汇兑给捐款人的未用捐款余额，以及提供服务之前或者货物由国际民航组织交付给第三方之前收到的资金，均包括在预收款项中。
Translation: Unused donation balances to be remitted to donors, and funds received prior to the provision of services or prior to the delivery of goods by ICAO to a third party, are included in prepayments.

Query_Text_cn: 从成员国收到的相关年份之前的摊款在预收款项下列示。
Translation: Contributions received from member states prior to the relevant year are recorded under the category of advance payments.

Query_Text_cn: 终止服务福利。
Translation: Termination of service benefits.

Query_Text_cn: 国际民航组织是参加联合国合办工作人员养恤基金（UNJSPF）的成员组织，该基金是由联合国大会为雇员提供退休、死亡、残障和有关福利而设立的。
Translation: The International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) is a participating member organization of the United Nations Joint Staff Pension Fund (UNJSPF), which was established by the United Nations General Assembly to provide retirement, death, disability, and related benefits for its staff.

Query_Text_cn: 养恤基金一项由多个雇主界定的注资福利计划。
Translation: A pension fund is a defined contribution benefit plan established by multiple employers.

Query_Text_cn: 根据基金条例第3条(b)款的规定，基金的成员资格向专门机构和参加联合国及专门机构的共同薪金、补贴制度和其他服务条件的任何其他国际性的政府间组织开放。
Translation: In accordance with Article 3(b) of the Fund Regulations, membership is open to specialized agencies and any other international intergovernmental organizations participating in the common salary, allowance system and other service conditions of the United Nations and the specialized agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 该计划使参与的各组织承受着与其他参与该基金的各组织的现任和前任雇员有关的保险精算风险，导致没有连贯一致和可靠的依据来向参与该计划的各个组织划拨承付款项、计划资产和费用。
Translation: The plan exposes participating organizations to actuarial risks associated with current and former employees of the fund's participating entities, resulting in the lack of a consistent and reliable basis for allocating settlement payments, plan assets, and expenses among the organizations involved in the program.

Query_Text_cn: 国际民航组织和养恤基金及其他参与基金的各组织无法为会计之目的，以充分可靠的方式来确定国际民航组织在所规定的福利承付款项、计划资产和与计划有关的费用当中的合乎比例的份额。
Translation: The International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), pension funds, and other participating organizations are unable to determine, for accounting purposes, ICAO’s proportional share of the specified benefit liabilities, plan assets, and related expenses under the plan in a sufficiently reliable manner.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，根据国际公共部门会计准则第25条的要求，国际民航组织把该计划假定视为一个界定的缴款计划。
Translation: Therefore, in accordance with the requirements of International Public Sector Accounting Standard 25, the International Civil Aviation Organization considers the plan to be a defined contribution plan.

Query_Text_cn: 在财务表现的报表中，国际民航组织在财政期向计划的缴款被认列为支出。
Translation: In the financial performance report, the contributions made by the International Civil Aviation Organization to its programs during the fiscal period are recognized as expenses.

Query_Text_cn: 国际民航组织在准备金帐户中认列与离职后健康保险福利（ASHI）有关的保险精算损益。
Translation: The International Civil Aviation Organization recognizes actuarial gains and losses related to post-employment health insurance benefits (ASHI) in its provision account.

Query_Text_cn: 根据国际公共部门会计准则第25条，雇佣期之后的福利保险精算损益可以随着时间的推移使用准备金的做法来认列。
Translation: Under International Public Sector Accounting Standard (IPSAS) 25, actuarial gains and losses on post-employment benefit insurance may be recognized over time using the approach of recognizing through reserves.

Query_Text_cn: 按照准备金的做法，保险精算损益列示在净资产项下，而不认列为收入或支出，以便考虑到随着时间的推移将会修订损益的这种合理的可能性。
Translation: Under reserving practices, actuarial gains or losses are recognized in the equity section rather than as revenue or expenses to account for the reasonable possibility that these gains or losses may be revised over time.

Query_Text_cn: 至于其他与离职有关的福利，如年假和归国福利，保险精算损益会立即认列，并反映在财务表现的报表中。
Translation: Regarding other departure-related benefits, such as annual leave and repatriation benefits, the actuarial gains or losses will be immediately recognized and reflected in the financial performance statements.

Query_Text_cn: 当国际民航组织可能将来被要求履行义务，并且数额可以可靠地估算时，为未来的负债和指控编列有经费，以便应付国际民航组织因过去事件负有现行的法律或推定义务。
Translation: When the International Civil Aviation Organization may be required to fulfill obligations in the future and the amount can be reliably estimated, funds are allocated for future liabilities and charges to meet its current legal or constructive obligations arising from past events.

Query_Text_cn: 不符合负债认列标准的其他承付款，只有当国际民航组织内部无法完全控制的一个或多个发生或未发生的不确定未来事件对其存在予以确认之时，方在财务报表附注中披露。
Translation: Obligations that do not meet the liability recognition criteria are disclosed in the notes to the financial statements only when their existence is confirmed by one or more uncertain future events that the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) cannot fully control, whether such events have occurred or not.

Query_Text_cn: 分部是一组活动可分辨的群体，其财务信息单独报告，以便评估一个实体为实现其目标以往的业绩并对未来资源分配作出决定。
Translation: Segment is a group of distinguishable activities whose financial information is reported separately to evaluate an entity's past performance in achieving its objectives and to make decisions regarding future resource allocation.

Query_Text_cn: 国际民航组织将所有项目、业务和基金活动分为两个分部：i）经常活动；和ii）技术合作项目活动。
Translation: The International Civil Aviation Organization categorizes all its projects, programmes and fund activities into two divisions: (i) regular activities; and (ii) technical cooperation project activities.

Query_Text_cn: 基金是一个自动平衡的会计实体，设立用来记入与特定目的或目标有关的账目往来。
Translation: A fund is a self-balancing accounting entity established to record transactions related to specific purposes or objectives.

Query_Text_cn: 财务报表是按基金会计基础编制，显示国际民航组织所有基金在这一时期结束时的综合状况。
Translation: The financial statements are prepared in accordance with fund accounting principles and present the comprehensive status of all funds under the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) at the end of this period.

Query_Text_cn: 基金余额代表收入和支出的累计剩余。
Translation: The fund balance represents the cumulative surplus of revenues and expenditures.

Query_Text_cn: 经常活动部分包括普通基金和经常方案的周转基金、特别帐户和为航空安全、保安、环境及本组织的其他支助活动管理的基金。
Translation: The recurrent activities include ordinary funds and revolving funds under the regular programme, special accounts, and funds managed for the administration of aviation safety, security, environmental management, and other support activities of this Organization.

Query_Text_cn: 经常预算基金包括普通基金，根据大会所定分摊比额表由成员国分摊的会费、杂项收入、辅助创收基金（ARGF）盈余和从大会设立的周转基金拨出的垫款提供资金，周转基金的作用是在收到成员国会费和在特殊情况下收到其他基金之前根据需要向普通基金先行垫付（偿还）预算拨款。
Translation: The regular budget fund includes the general fund, which is financed by assessed contributions from Member States according to the scale established by the General Assembly, miscellaneous income, surplus from the Auxiliary Revenue Generating Fund (ARGF), and advances from a revolving fund established by the General Assembly. The revolving fund serves to provide advance budgetary allocations (to be repaid) to the general fund prior to receiving member State contributions and, in exceptional cases, other funds as needed.

Query_Text_cn: 资本基金，设立用来记录为经常活动购置的财产、厂房和设备及无形资产。
Translation: Capital Fund, established to record the acquisition of property, plant, equipment, and intangible assets for ongoing operations.

Query_Text_cn: 循环基金，设立用来记录离职后健康保险福利（ASHI）的账目往来，包括没有着落的负债及其他特殊负债，以便在经常活动部分中将这些账目往来单独列报。
Translation: A revolving fund is established to record accounting transactions related to the Accumulated Sick-Leave Health Insurance (ASHI) program, including unresolved liabilities and other special liabilities, so that these accounting transactions can be reported separately in the current operations section.

Query_Text_cn: 辅助创收基金（ARGF），设立用来将创收和成本回收活动合并在一项基金之中。
Translation: The Auxiliary Revenue Generation Fund (ARGF) is established to consolidate revenue-generating and cost-recovery activities into a single fund.

Query_Text_cn: 行政和业务服务费用基金（AOSC），根据《财务条例》第9.4条设立的基金。
Translation: The Administrative and Operational Services Charges Fund (AOSC), established under Article 9.4 of the Financial Regulations.

Query_Text_cn: 航空保安（AVSEC）行动计划（ASAP），它包含为反映理事会批准航空保安行动计划（ASAP）设立的各项专用基金及特别账户，其中包括拟由航空保安信托基金之内的基金供资的项目。
Translation: The Aviation Security (AVSEC) Action Plan (ASAP) includes dedicated funds and special accounts established to reflect the Council-approved Aviation Security Action Plan (ASAP), which includes projects proposed to be funded by funds within the Aviation Security Trust Fund.

Query_Text_cn: 非洲航空安全全面地区实施计划（AFI计划），设立用于提高国际民航组织在整个非印地区方案协调和管理方面的领导能力和问责制，并确保有效实施，以纠正安全与基础设施方面的缺陷。
Translation: The African Aviation Safety Comprehensive Regional Implementation Plan (AFI Plan) was established to enhance the leadership capacity and accountability of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) in coordinating and managing programs across the African and Indian Ocean region, ensuring effective implementation to address deficiencies in safety and infrastructure.

Query_Text_cn: 丹麦和冰岛合资联营协议的联合融资基金，用以反映所设立基金的账目往来，以报告国际民航组织监督冰岛政府以及丹麦政府在格陵兰提供空中航行服务的运行情况，有关费用由服务提供者通过使用费和向缔约国政府摊款回收。
Translation: The joint financing fund under the Denmark-Iceland joint venture agreement is established to account for the financial transactions of the fund and report the operational status of air navigation services provided by the governments of Iceland and Denmark in Greenland to the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO). The related costs are recovered through user fees and allocations from contracting governments.

Query_Text_cn: 同时还包括北大西洋高度监视系统基金（HMU），以记录北大西洋高度监视系统联营安排各项规定之下的账目往来。
Translation: The North Atlantic High Monitoring Unit Fund (HMU) is also included to record the account transactions under the provisions of the joint venture arrangements for the North Atlantic High Monitoring Unit.

Query_Text_cn: 奖励清偿长期欠款帐户，设立用以将缔约国缴纳的拖欠会费的部分款项在一个单独帐户中列报，以便为本组织的特定活动提供资金。
Translation: Establish an incentive account for clearing long-term arrears and set up a separate account to report portions of overdue contributions paid by contracting states to fund specific activities of the organization.

Query_Text_cn: ·信息和通信技术（ICT）基金，设立用于为改善本组织的信息和通讯系统提供资金。
Translation: The Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Fund, established to provide funding for improving the Organization's information and communication systems.

Query_Text_cn: ·公钥簿（PKD）基金，理事会设立的一个成本回收基金，用于报告支持电子增强型机读护照可互用性项目的各项活动。
Translation: The PKD (Public Key Directory) Fund, a cost-recovery fund established by the Council, is used for reporting and supporting various activities under the interoperability project of electronically enhanced machine-readable passports.

Query_Text_cn: 这些行动由自愿捐款供资，按照协议，该基金的结余作为应付参加国款项记帐。
Translation: These actions are funded by voluntary contributions. According to the agreement, the surplus of the fund is accounted for as payable to participating countries.

Query_Text_cn: 头颈部癌症多为鳞状细胞癌，常为暴露于烟草、酒精等致癌物后发生于上呼吸道或上消化道上皮。
Translation: Head and neck cancers are primarily squamous cell carcinomas, often occurring as a result of exposure to carcinogens such as tobacco and alcohol, arising in the epithelium of the upper respiratory tract or upper digestive tract.

Query_Text_cn: 人乳头瘤病毒更是其某些亚型的致病因素。
Translation: Human Papillomavirus (HPV) is a pathogenic factor for certain subtypes of itself.

Query_Text_cn: 头颈癌累及的部位解剖结构复杂、生理功能极其重要，因此其治疗目标不仅是要提高患者的存活率，而且要保全相应器官的功能。
Translation: The anatomical structures involved in head and neck cancer are complex, and the physiological functions are critically important. Therefore, the treatment goals aim not only to improve patient survival rates but also to preserve the corresponding organ functions.

Query_Text_cn: 目前，头颈癌治疗的主要进展体现在外科手术与放疗分割模式方面。
Translation: Currently, the major advancements in the treatment of head and neck cancer are reflected in surgical procedures and radiotherapy fractionation regimens.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，包括化疗与分子靶向药物（即表皮生长因子受体抑制剂）治疗在内的系统治疗，已经成功整合入局部晚期头颈鳞状细胞癌的治疗方案中。
Translation: Systemic treatments, including chemotherapy and molecular targeted drugs (i.e., epidermal growth factor receptor inhibitors), have been successfully integrated into the treatment regimens for locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

Query_Text_cn: 在选择个体化的治疗策略时，需重点考虑的因素包括：器官功能的预期结果、治疗耐受性以及伴发疾病等。
Translation: When selecting individualized treatment strategies, key considerations include the expected outcomes for organ function, treatment tolerance, and comorbidities.

Query_Text_cn: 优化评估与治疗决策的关键是开展更多的专业合作。
Translation: The key to optimizing assessments and treatment decisions lies in fostering greater specialized collaboration.

Query_Text_cn: 本文对头颈部鳞状细胞癌的流行病学、分子发病机制、诊断与分期，以及最新的多模式治疗等进行回顾。
Translation: This article reviews the epidemiology, molecular pathogenesis, diagnosis and staging, as well as the latest multimodal therapies for head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

Query_Text_cn: 其绝大多数为头颈部鳞状细胞癌(SCCHN)，烟草和酒精是最重要的致病危险因素。
Translation: The majority of these cases are head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (SCCHN), with tobacco and alcohol being the most important etiologic risk factors.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，越来越多的证据表明，人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)是引起某些SCCHN亚型的原因。
Translation: However, increasing evidence suggests that human papillomavirus (HPV) is the cause of certain subtypes of SCCHN.

Query_Text_cn: 而远处转移在初次就诊时并不常见，仅见于约10%的患者。
Translation: Distant metastasis is not common at initial diagnosis and is observed in only approximately 10% of patients.

Query_Text_cn: SCCHN的治疗通常较为复杂，需头颈外科、肿瘤内科、肿瘤放射科、影像科、整形外科及口腔科等诸多学科专家的参与。
Translation: The treatment of SCCHN is typically complex and requires the involvement of experts from various disciplines, including head and neck surgery, medical oncology, radiation oncology, radiology, plastic surgery, and oral medicine.

Query_Text_cn: 正确的治疗通常取决于肿瘤的原发部位、分期、可治愈性及患者因素等，后者则包括患者的吞咽和气道状况、对器官保留的预期及伴随疾病等。
Translation: The appropriate treatment typically depends on the primary site of the tumor, its stage, curability, and patient factors, the latter including the patient's swallowing and airway conditions, expectations regarding organ preservation, and comorbidities.

Query_Text_cn: 手术与放疗一直是主要治疗手段。
Translation: Surgery and radiotherapy have remained the primary treatment options.

Query_Text_cn: 改进手术与放疗方式、将全身性药物加入治疗方案中可有效改善临床结局。
Translation: Improving surgical and radiotherapy approaches and incorporating systemic medications into treatment regimens can effectively enhance clinical outcomes.

Query_Text_cn: 一种新的药物，即表皮生长因子受体(EGFR)抑制剂，已经显示出对SCCHN的临床益处。
Translation: A new drug, namely the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) inhibitors, has demonstrated clinical benefits for SCCHN.

Query_Text_cn: SCCHN幸存者还面临着死于心脏病、呼吸系统疾病以及通常与吸烟有关的第二原发肿瘤的终生风险。
Translation: SCCHN survivors also face a lifelong risk of dying from cardiovascular diseases, respiratory system diseases, and second primary tumors typically associated with smoking.

Query_Text_cn: 第二原发肿瘤的年发病率达3%~5%，可累及全呼吸道或消化道。
Translation: The annual incidence rate of second primary tumors reaches 3%–5%, affecting the entire respiratory tract or digestive tract.

Query_Text_cn: 目前，尚无可确定的生物标记物和循证影像学证据用于患者监测，亦无临床证实有效的化学预防药物问世。
Translation: There are no confirmed biomarkers or evidence-based imaging evidence for patient monitoring,nor have any clinically proven effective chemopreventive drugs been developed.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管早期研究结果令人鼓舞，但一些设计良好的旨在评估类视黄醇类药物化学预防效果的随机试验却为阴性结果。
