Translation: The main difference between the aforementioned criteria and the Elston and Ellis criteria lies in the latter's use of a semi-quantitative method to evaluate tubule formation, and more precisely specifies how to conduct mitotic counting.

Query_Text_cn: 肿瘤被分为3个组织学类型：导管癌(如无其他特殊说明，则包括顶浆分泌、混合粘液性和非典型髓样癌)、小叶癌(不同程度的浸润性小叶癌)和特殊组织学类型(管状、髓样、筛状、乳头样和纯粘液癌)。
Translation: Tumors are classified into three histological types: ductal carcinoma (including apocrine secretion, mixed mucinous, and atypical medullary carcinoma unless otherwise specified), lobular carcinoma (invasive lobular carcinoma to varying degrees), and special histological types (tubular, medullary, cribriform, papillary, and pure mucinous carcinoma).

Query_Text_cn: 在诊断时有50余位病理学家进行组织学分类和分级。
Translation: During the diagnostic process, over 50 pathologists conducted histological classification and grading.

Query_Text_cn: 从病理报告(69％)、手术或乳腺X线报告中摘取原发肿瘤的最大直径值。
Translation: Extract the maximum diameter of the primary tumor from pathology reports (69%), surgical reports, or mammography reports.

Query_Text_cn: 在多发浸润性肿瘤病例(n=192，10％)中记录最大病灶的直径。
Translation: In cases of multifocal infiltrating tumors (n=192,10%), the diameter of the largest lesion was recorded.

Query_Text_cn: 雌、孕激素受体情况通过免疫组化法(分别占60％和62％)或右旋糖苷包被活性炭法确定，分为阳性和阴性。
Translation: The status of estrogen and progesterone receptors was determined by immunohistochemical methods (60% and 62% respectively) or dextran-coated charcoal assays, categorized into positive and negative groups.

Query_Text_cn: 制备组织微矩阵时，应用经福尔马林固定、石蜡包埋的肿瘤标本。
Translation: When preparing tissue microarrays, use tumor specimens that have been formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded.

Query_Text_cn: 首先从苏木精-伊红染色的切片中确定具有代表性的肿瘤区域，进行标记。
Translation: First, representative tumor regions are identified from hematoxylin-eosin stained sections for marking.

Query_Text_cn: 从瘤块内具有组织学代表性的区域打1个0.6mm的圆柱体制备肿瘤组织矩阵块，然后应用一种特殊装置将其插入到一个空的受体组织矩阵石蜡块中筠。
Translation: Take a 0.6mm cylindrical sample from a histologically representative area within the tumor mass to prepare a tumor tissue matrix block, then use a specialized device to insert it into an empty recipient tissue matrix paraffin block.

Query_Text_cn: 每个矩阵块包括50~144个肿瘤标本。
Translation: Each matrix block contains 50~144 tumor specimens.

Query_Text_cn: 做5岬切片行免疫组化和色原原位杂交。
Translation: Perform immunohistochemistry and chromogenic in situ hybridization (CISH) on the 5-ALA sections.

Query_Text_cn: 借助于一个由计算机控制的、安装在Bx50显微镜上(Olympus，Tokyo，Japan)的机动标本载物台(EcoDrive，MarzhauserInc，Wetzlar，Germany)对组织微矩阵切片进行分析。
Translation: The analysis of tissue microarray sections was conducted using a computer-controlled motorized specimen stage (EcoDrive, Marzhauser Inc, Wetzlar, Germany) mounted on a Bx50 microscope (Olympus, Tokyo, Japan).

Query_Text_cn: 为了给ERBB2染色，切片脱蜡后进行抗原修复(10mM、pH6.0枸橼酸钠缓冲液、高压锅加热2分钟至121℃)。
Translation: For ERBB2 staining, after deparaffinization of the sections, antigen retrieval was performed using a 10 mM, pH 6.0 sodium citrate buffer heated in a pressure cooker for 2 minutes to reach 121°C.

Query_Text_cn: 原始抗体(CB11，NovocastraLaboratories，Newcastle，England)以1：200稀释于抗小鼠过氧化物酶聚合体封闭溶液中(Powervision，ImunovisionInc，DalyCity，Calif)，4℃孵育过夜。
Translation: The primary antibody (CB11, Novocastra Laboratories, Newcastle, England) was diluted at a 1:200 ratio in anti-mouse peroxidase polymer blocking solution (Powervision, Imunovision Inc, Daly City, Calif) and incubated overnight at 4°C.

Query_Text_cn: 对抗小鼠过氧化物酶聚合体(Imuno-vision；室温30分钟)和联苯二胺染色进行观察。
Translation: Observations were made using anti-mouse peroxidase polymer (Imuno-vision; room temperature for 30 minutes) and benzidine staining.

Query_Text_cn: 切片经苏木精反向染色并包埋。
Translation: The sections were stained with hematoxylin in reverse and embedded.

Query_Text_cn: 每批染色均包括阳性和阴性对照标本(原位杂交荧光显色时肿瘤有无ERBB2扩增)。
Translation: Each batch of staining includes positive and negative control specimens (during fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH), the presence or absence of ERBB2 amplification in the tumor).

Query_Text_cn: 采用20倍物镜评价免疫组化结果。
Translation: The immunohistochemical results were evaluated using a 20x objective lens.

Query_Text_cn: 只有在大部分肿瘤细胞膜均存在强染色时(3+)才视为ERBB2阳性。
Translation: Only when the majority of tumor cell membranes exhibit strong staining (3+) is the result considered ERBB2-positive.

Query_Text_cn: TP53蛋白用DO7/抗体(NovocastraLaboratories)按1:500的稀释度进行免疫染色；MK167蛋白(Ki-67)则用MM-1抗体(NovocastraLaboratories，1:1000稀释)进行免疫染色。
Translation: Immunostaining of the TP53 protein was performed using the DO7 antibody (Novocastra Laboratories) at a 1:500 dilution; the MK167 protein (Ki-67) was stained with the MM-1 antibody (Novocastra Laboratories, 1:1000 dilution).

Query_Text_cn: 当肿瘤细胞核染色区域>20％时便认为MK167和TP53蛋白染色阳性。
Translation: When the stained area in tumor cell nuclei exceeds 20%, the staining of MK167 and TP53 proteins is considered positive.

Query_Text_cn: 简而言之，微矩阵切片脱蜡，在92℃的0.1M盐酸Tris液(pH，7.3)内孵育10分钟，然后室温冷却20分钟。
Translation: In brief, microtome section deparaffinization involves incubation in 0.1 M Tris-HCl solution (pH 7.3) at 92°C for 10 minutes, followed by cooling to room temperature for 20 minutes.

Query_Text_cn: 在切片上加100L消化酶进行消化(Dogest-AllIII溶液，ZymedInc，SanFrancisco，Calif)。
Translation: Add 100 L of digestive enzyme (Dogest-All III Solution, Zymed Inc., San Francisco, Calif.) for digestion.

Query_Text_cn: 脱水后，在切片上加入地高辛标记的ERBB2DNA探针(ZymedInc)。
Translation: After dehydration, the digoxigenin-labeled ERBB2 DNA probe (Zymed Inc.) was added to the tissue sections.

Query_Text_cn: 切片在热平皿上进行变性，37℃杂交过夜。
Translation: The slides were denatured on a hot plate and hybridized overnight at 37°C.

Query_Text_cn: 用小鼠抗地高辛(1：300稀释；RocheBiochemicals，Mannheim，Germany)、抗小鼠过氧化物酶聚合体(ImmunovisionInc)和联苯二胺染色原进行依次孵育，以检测制备好的地高辛标记ERBB2探针。
Translation: The prepared digoxigenin-labeled ERBB2 probe was detected by sequential incubation with mouse anti-digoxigenin antibody (1:300 dilution; Roche Biochemicals, Mannheim, Germany), anti-mouse peroxidase polymer conjugate (Immunovision Inc), and BCIP/NBT chromogen substrate.

Query_Text_cn: 组织切片用苏木精轻微反向染色并包埋。
Translation: The tissue sections were lightly counterstained with hematoxylin and embedded.

Query_Text_cn: 每批杂交时均包括阳性和阴性对照标本(原位杂交荧光显色时肿瘤有无ERBB2扩增)。
Translation: Each batch of hybridization includes positive and negative control specimens (during fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) to indicate the presence or absence of ERBB2 amplification in tumors).

Query_Text_cn: 采用40倍物镜对切片进行分析。
Translation: Analyze the section using a 40x objective.

Query_Text_cn: 当50％以上的肿瘤细胞细胞核有≥6个信号或当看到大量基因复制团块时便确定出现扩增。
Translation: Amplification is confirmed when more than 50% of tumor cell nuclei exhibit ≥6 signals or when significant gene replication clusters are observed.

Query_Text_cn: 应用X2检验分析频率量表。
Translation: Apply the chi-square test to analyze frequency scales.

Query_Text_cn: 按照Kaplan-Meier法计算寿命表。
Translation: Calculate the life table using the Kaplan-Meier method.

Query_Text_cn: 根据从诊断到其他区域出现转移的时间或从诊断到死于乳腺癌的时间计算远期无病生存时间。
Translation: Long-term disease-free survival time is calculated based on the time from diagnosis to metastasis in other regions or the time from diagnosis to death from breast cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 用log-rank检验对时间一事件分布情况进行比较，我们预期它随时间的变化呈随机分布。
Translation: We used the log-rank test to compare the time-to-event distribution and expect it to follow a random distribution pattern over time.

Query_Text_cn: 采用肿瘤检测法(乳腺X线筛查，0；其他方法，1)、肿瘤分级(分化良好，0；中度分化或分化不良，1)、雌孕激素受体情况(阳性或临界，0；阴性，1)、ERBB2蛋白免疫染色(阴性，0；阳性，1)、ERBB2扩增情况(无扩增，0；扩增，1)、组织学类型(小叶型或特殊类型，0；导管型，1)、确诊年龄(对年龄进行分组是为了阐述年龄引发的非线性患病危险)进行多变量生存分析。
Translation: Multivariable survival analysis was conducted using tumor detection methods (mammography screening, 0; other methods, 1), tumor grade (well-differentiated, 0; moderately or poorly differentiated, 1), estrogen and progesterone receptor status (positive or borderline, 0; negative, 1), ERBB2 protein immunostaining (negative, 0; positive, 1), ERBB2 amplification status (no amplification, 0; amplified, 1), histological type (lobular or special type, 0; ductal, 1), and age at diagnosis (age grouping was performed to illustrate the nonlinear risk of disease incidence associated with age).

Query_Text_cn: 肿瘤大小(cm)和腋窝淋巴结转移数目作为连续变量纳入多变量模型。
Translation: Tumor size (cm) and the number of axillary lymph node metastases were included as continuous variables in the multivariable model.

Query_Text_cn: 应用反向Cox逐级比例风险回归建立最终的多变量模型船，以P值等于0.05作为协变量入选标准。
Translation: The final multivariate model was established using backward stepwise Cox proportional hazards regression, with a P-value cutoff of 0.05 as the inclusion criterion for covariates.

Query_Text_cn: 所有P值均为双侧。
Translation: All P values are two-sided.

Query_Text_cn: 我们采用了Statview统计软件(5.0版，SASInstituteInc，Cary，NC)。
Translation: We used StatView statistical software (Version 5.0, SAS Institute Inc., Cary, NC).

Query_Text_cn: 乳腺X线筛查出的乳腺癌最常见于50~59岁和60~69岁年龄组患者。
Translation: Breast cancers detected through mammography screening are most commonly found in patients aged 50-59 and 60-69.

Query_Text_cn: 在50~69岁队列中，379名妇女(41％)经乳腺X线筛查诊断出患有乳腺癌，其中50~59岁组占53％，60~69岁组占26％。
Translation: Among the 50-69 age cohort, 379 women (41%) were diagnosed with breast cancer through mammography screening, with 53% in the 50-59 age group and 26% in the 60-69 age group.

Query_Text_cn: 这些直径≤10mm的肿瘤通常较少出现腋窝淋巴结转移(21％比35％；P小于0.001，表1)。
Translation: Tumors with a diameter ≤10 mm are less likely to develop axillary lymph node metastasis (21% vs. 35%; P < 0.001, Table 1).

Query_Text_cn: 乳腺X线筛查出的肿瘤往往具有某些特殊组织学类型(13％比9％；P=0.04)，较少表达MK167抗原(17％比25％；P=0.04)。
Translation: Tumors detected through mammography screening often exhibit certain specific histological types (13% versus 9%; P=0.04) and are less likely to express MK167 antigen (17% versus 25%; P=0.04).

Query_Text_cn: 乳腺X线筛查出的肿瘤中31％组织学分化良好(1级)，而其他方法检出的1级肿瘤仅占16％(P小于0.001)。
Translation: Among tumors detected by mammography screening, 31% were well-differentiated histologically (Grade 1), while those detected by other methods accounted for only 16% (P<0.001).

Query_Text_cn: 总的来说，若仅对50~69岁队列进行比较，则上述差异相似(表1)。乳腺X线筛查出的肿瘤患者多处于该年龄组(86％)。
Translation: Overall, when comparing solely the 50–69 age cohort, the aforementioned differences are similar (Table 1). Most patients with tumors detected by mammography were in this age group (86%).

Query_Text_cn: 第一轮筛查出的女性乳腺癌患者与第二轮或较晚筛查出的女性乳腺癌患者预后相似(P=0.96)。
Translation: The prognosis of women with breast cancer detected in the first round of screening was similar to that of those detected in the second or later rounds (P=0.96).

Query_Text_cn: 为此，在进行深入分析时，我们将所有筛查出的女性乳腺癌患者的预后与其他方法检出的女性乳腺癌患者的预后进行了比较。
Translation: In conducting an in-depth analysis, we compared the prognoses of all screened female breast cancer patients with those detected by other methods.

Query_Text_cn: 在大小各异的肿瘤中(≤10mm、11~20mm、21~30mm、>30mm，附图)，乳腺X线筛查出的女性乳腺癌患者均比其他方法检出的女性乳腺癌患者具有更好的远期无病生存情况。
Translation: In tumors of various sizes (≤10 mm, 11–20 mm, 21–30 mm, and >30 mm, as shown in the supplementary figures), women with breast cancer detected through mammography screening had significantly better long-term disease-free survival than those diagnosed by other methods.

Query_Text_cn: 总的来说，筛查出肿瘤直径为11~30mm的妇女其预后与其他方法检出的直径≤10mm的肿瘤患者相同(表2)。
Translation: In general, the prognosis of women with tumors screened out at a diameter of 11–30 mm is the same as that of patients with tumors detected through other methods at ≤10 mm (Table 2).

Query_Text_cn: 对单发大肿瘤组进行比较时也发现类似的预后差异(队列年龄为50~69岁，淋巴结阴性)。
Translation: Similar prognostic differences were also observed when comparing the single large tumor group (age group of 50-69 years, lymph node-negative).

Query_Text_cn: 对于肿瘤≥30mm的患者而言，乳腺X线筛查与其他方法在预后方面无明显差异，但其中可供分析的筛查组乳腺癌患者很少(n=25)。
Translation: For patients with tumors ≥30 mm, mammography screening showed no significant difference in prognosis compared to other methods, but the number of breast cancer patients in the screening group available for analysis was small (n=25).

Query_Text_cn: 在筛查组淋巴结阳的90例女性患者中，仅19例(21％)有远期复发。
Translation: Among the 90 lymph node-positive female patients in the screening group, only 19 (21%) had distant recurrence.

Query_Text_cn: 由于筛查组50~59岁年龄队列(53％)所占比例比其他年龄组(40~49岁，1l％；60~69岁，26％；70~79岁，3％)高，所以确诊年龄应视为一种混淆因素。
Translation: Since the 50–59 age cohort accounted for a higher proportion (53%) compared to other age groups (40–49 years, 11%; 60–69 years, 26%; 70–79 years, 3%), diagnosis age should be considered a confounding factor.

Query_Text_cn: 不管确诊年龄如何，乳腺X线筛查组患者的生存情况均优于其他方法检出的肿瘤患者。
Translation: The survival outcomes of patients in the mammography screening group were superior to those detected by other methods, regardless of age at diagnosis.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管筛查组和其他方法组患者预后存在巨大差异，但是各年龄队列之间远期无病生存率的差异很小(表3)。
Translation: Although there were substantial differences in prognosis between the screening group and other intervention groups, the differences in long-term disease-free survival rates among different age cohorts were minimal (Table 3).

Query_Text_cn: 值得注意的是，尽管50~59岁队列多通过乳腺X线筛查出肿瘤，但是该年龄段借助其他方法发现肿瘤的患者10年远期无病生存率(73％)却与非筛查组其他年龄队列大体相同(40~49岁，72％；60~69岁，69％；I>70岁，67％)。
Translation: It is worth noting that although the 50–59 age group largely detects tumors through mammography screening, the 10-year disease-free survival rate (73%) among patients in this age group who were diagnosed with tumors through methods other than screening is comparable to non-screening cohorts in other age groups (40–49 years: 72%; 60–69 years: 69%; >70 years: 67%).

Query_Text_cn: 由于筛查组肿瘤患者的年龄分布与其他方法组不同，由于筛查出的肿瘤分化好、孕激素受体表达多、MK167蛋白染色显示细胞增殖率较低，因此，我们进行了一个多变量分析以明确筛查发现肿瘤是否为其独立预后因素。
Translation: Due to differing age distributions of tumor patients in the screening group compared to other method groups, and given that tumors detected through screening were well-differentiated, exhibited high progesterone receptor expression, and showed low cell proliferation rates as indicated by MK167 protein staining, we conducted a multivariate analysis to determine whether screening detection constitutes an independent prognostic factor.

Query_Text_cn: 肿瘤直径每增加1cm，则远期转移的HR增加1.20(95％，CI，1.10～1.31)。
Translation: For each 1 cm increase in tumor diameter, the hazard ratio for distant metastasis increased by 1.20 (95% CI, 1.10–1.31).

Query_Text_cn: 在选择乳腺癌特异性生存率(HR，2.11；95％，CI，1.16~3.85)或总生存率(HR，1.63；95％，CI，1.02～2.60)而不是远期无病生存率作为终点时，其他方法发现乳腺癌仍是一个独立的不良预后变量。
Translation: When selecting breast cancer-specific survival (HR, 2.11; 95% CI, 1.16–3.85) or overall survival (HR, 1.63; 95% CI, 1.02–2.60) rather than long-term disease-free survival as endpoints, other methods identified breast cancer as an independent adverse prognostic factor.

Query_Text_cn: 同样，若仅根据医院病历记录筛查发现肿瘤但在芬兰国家乳腺X线肿瘤筛查登记处未登记(占筛查发现病例的30％)，并将这些妇女从分析中去除，则肿瘤检出方式仍然是不良预后变量。
Translation: If tumors were detected through hospital medical records screening but not registered in the Finnish National Breast Cancer Screening Registry (accounting for 30% of screen-detected cases), and these women were excluded from the analysis, the method of tumor detection remained a poor prognostic variable.

Query_Text_cn: 在模型中，通过乳腺X线筛查发现肿瘤的HR变化很小(2.09；95％CI，1.13～3.85)。
Translation: In the model, the change in HR for tumors detected through mammography screening remained relatively small (2.09; 95% CI, 1.13-3.85).

Query_Text_cn: 在肿瘤淋巴结阴性的患者中(确诊年龄为50～69岁，未接受辅助治疗，n=430)，乳腺X线筛查仍独立于肿瘤大小和肿瘤组织学分级而与预后较好相关。
Translation: Among patients with lymph node-negative tumors (aged 50–69 years at diagnosis, who did not receive adjuvant therapy, n=430), mammography screening remains independently associated with better prognosis, independent of tumor size and tumor histological grade.

Query_Text_cn: 与其他方法确诊的乳腺癌患者相比，乳腺X线筛查检出的肿瘤患者预后一般更好，这可能是由于筛查发现的肿瘤平均体积较小或其生物学特性较好。
Translation: Compared to breast cancer patients diagnosed through other methods, those with tumors detected by mammography screening generally have better prognoses, which may be attributed to the smaller average tumor volume or their better biological characteristics.

Query_Text_cn: 与其他研究一致，本队列乳腺X线筛查出的肿瘤比其他方法发现的肿瘤体积小。
Translation: Consistent with other studies, the tumors detected by mammography in this cohort are smaller in size than those identified by other methods.

Query_Text_cn: 筛查出的肿瘤较少出现腋窝淋巴结转移，分化较好，常表现为某些特殊组织学类型，MK167抗原免疫染色分析显示细胞增殖率较低，ERBB2扩增常为阴性而孕激素受体常为阳性。
Translation: Tumors identified through screening are less likely to exhibit axillary lymph node metastasis, and are well-differentiated, often presenting as specific histological subtypes. MK167 antigen immunohistochemical analysis shows a low cell proliferation rate, ERBB2 amplification is often negative, while progesterone receptor is frequently positive.

Query_Text_cn: 但是，这些特点并不能完全解释为何乳腺X线筛查出的肿瘤预后普遍较好，原因是在多变量分析中肿瘤检测方法是一个独立的预后变量。
Translation: However, these characteristics cannot fully account for the generally better prognosis of tumors detected through mammography screening, as the method of tumor detection serves as an independent prognostic variable in multivariate analysis.

Query_Text_cn: 在本队列中，筛查出的肿瘤多见于50～59岁和60～69岁年龄组患者，这是因为大城市很少组织50岁以下和70岁以上的妇女进行筛查。
Translation: In this cohort, the detected tumors were most commonly found in patients aged 50–59 and 60–69, as major cities rarely organize screening programs for women under 50 and over 70.

Query_Text_cn: 乳腺X线筛查组患者的年龄分布差异也不大可能解释为何其预后较好，因为与各年龄组其他妇女相比，前者生存率更高。
Translation: The difference in age distribution between the mammography screening group and others is also unlikely to account for their better prognosis, as the former demonstrates higher survival rates compared to women in other groups across all age categories.

Query_Text_cn: 包括年龄在内的多变量分析显示，乳腺X线筛查诊断肿瘤是一个独立的预后变量。
Translation: Multivariable analysis including age as a covariate demonstrated that mammography screening for diagnosing tumors is an independent prognostic variable.

Query_Text_cn: 这种良好预后不能归因于实施的治疗，因为筛查组妇女比其他方法组妇女接受系统治疗的机会少。
Translation: This favorable prognosis cannot be attributed to the implemented treatments, as women in the screening group had fewer opportunities to receive systematic treatment compared to those in the other methods group.

Query_Text_cn: 在原发肿瘤大小相同的情况下，其他方法组妇女较筛查组妇女远期无病生存率高。
Translation: Under the same primary tumor size, women in the other methods group have a higher long-term disease-free survival rate than those in the screening group.

Query_Text_cn: 由于本研究样量本相对较大，因此我们可以对肿瘤直径进行相对较窄的分层后加以评价。
Translation: Given that the sample size of this study is relatively large, we can evaluate the tumor diameter through relatively narrow stratification.

Query_Text_cn: 这一点很重要，因为筛查出的肿瘤通常比其他肿瘤体积小得多，此时若对较宽的肿瘤大小层面进行比较就会发生偏倚。
Translation: This is important because screen-detected tumors are typically much smaller in size than tumors detected through other means, so comparing across a broader range of tumor sizes would introduce bias.

Query_Text_cn: 我们发现，既往没有研究在大小相近的肿瘤中比较筛查和其他方法对预后的影响。但是，本研究结果与2项小规模研究一致。这2项研究根据肿瘤淋巴结转移情况对筛查发现的肿瘤与其他肿瘤进行了比较。
Translation: We found that no previous studies have compared the impact of screening versus other methods on prognosis among tumors of similar size. However, the findings of this study align with those of two smaller-scale studies, which compared tumors detected through screening with other tumors based on lymph node metastasis status.

Query_Text_cn: 这两项研究得出结论认为：在校正肿瘤大小后，乳腺X线筛查出的女性肿瘤患者较其他妇女预后更好。
Translation: These two studies concluded that, after adjusting for tumor size, women with breast cancer detected through mammography screening have better prognoses compared to those detected otherwise.

Query_Text_cn: 我们发现肿瘤检出方法对患者预后的影响相当大。
Translation: We have found that tumor detection methods have a significant impact on patient prognosis.

Query_Text_cn: 例如，经乳腺X线筛查出的直径为11～30mm的女性肿瘤患者其生存率与其他方法检出的直径≤10mm的女性患者大致相同。
Translation: For example, the survival rate of female patients with tumors detected through mammography screening, with diameters of 11–30 mm, is roughly comparable to that of those detected by other methods with diameters ≤10 mm.

Query_Text_cn: 对大小相近的肿瘤进行比较可减少研究时间偏倚对预后比较的影响。
Translation: Comparing tumors of similar size can reduce the impact of study duration bias on prognostic comparisons.

Query_Text_cn: 对这项全国范围的研究而言，选择性偏倚不可能产生主要影响。
Translation: For this nationwide study, selection bias is unlikely to have a major impact.

Query_Text_cn: 乳腺X线筛查出的肿瘤可能具有不同于其他肿瘤的生物学特点，因此，时间偏倚(生长缓慢的肿瘤通过筛查发现)可能是其预后一般较好的重要因素。
Translation: Tumors detected through mammography screening may have distinct biological characteristics compared to other tumors. Therefore, lead-time bias (slow-growing tumors detected through screening) may be an important factor contributing to their generally better prognosis.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，除了组织学分级，我们研究的各种肿瘤生物学因素无一与肿瘤检测方法强相关。
Translation: However, except for histological grading, none of the tumor biological factors we studied were strongly associated with tumor detection methods.

Query_Text_cn: 在以组织学分级和某些肿瘤生物学因素为协变量的多变量生存分析中，肿瘤检测法是一个独立的预后变量。
Translation: In a multivariate survival analysis with histological grading and certain tumor biological factors as covariates, tumor detection method is an independent prognostic variable.

Query_Text_cn: 与其他方法检出的肿瘤相比，筛查发现的肿瘤患者较少出现乳房肿痛、胸部压迫感、乳头溢液等症状、体征。
Translation: Compared to tumors detected by other methods, patients with tumors identified through screening are less likely to exhibit symptoms and signs such as breast pain, chest pressure, and nipple discharge.

Query_Text_cn: 这些症状可能与肿瘤浸润相关，如神经或神经周围镜下浸润(引起疼痛)、水肿(有压迫感)、血管浸润、导管堵塞或浸润(乳头溢液、疼痛、压迫感)。
Translation: These symptoms may be associated with tumor infiltration, such as microscopic infiltration of nerves or perineural areas (causing pain), edema (causing a sense of compression), vascular infiltration, or ductal obstruction/infiltration (nipple discharge, pain, and a sense of compression).

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究未对这些因素进行观察，这在定程度上可以解释为何其他方法组肿瘤患者预后较差。
Translation: Our study did not observe these factors, which to some extent accounts for why patients in the other method groups had a poorer prognosis.

Query_Text_cn: 导致肿瘤血管生成、转移的其他因素也可能很重要，有待进一步研究。
Translation: Other factors contributing to tumor angiogenesis and metastasis may also be significant and warrant further investigation.

Query_Text_cn: 一些通过乳腺X线筛查发现的肿瘤可能生长缓慢；惰性肿瘤可能在妇女一生中都不会显露出来。
Translation: Some tumors detected through mammography screening may grow slowly; indolent tumors may never manifest during a woman's lifetime.

Query_Text_cn: 某些尸检研究发现，在普通人群中有相当比例的女性患有隐性乳腺肿瘤。
Translation: Some autopsy studies have found that a significant proportion of women in the general population have undiagnosed breast tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 这些研究显示，4.3％～18％的女性患有隐性原位癌。在一组法医尸检研究中，浸润性乳腺癌占1.8％。
Translation: These studies show that 4.3% to 18% of women have occult carcinoma in situ. In a series of forensic autopsy studies, invasive breast cancer accounted for 1.8%.

Query_Text_cn: 有人在一组拒绝手术的早期乳腺癌患者中观察了未经治疗的乳腺癌患者的生物学行为。
Translation: A study observed the biological behavior of untreated breast cancer patients in a cohort of early-stage breast cancer patients who refused surgery.

Query_Text_cn: 许多未接受治疗的妇女存活时间比预期长(从出现症状到死亡的平均生存期为30～40.5个月)弱，一些患I、Ⅱ、Ⅲ期乳腺癌但拒绝治疗的妇女存活了5年弘。
Translation: Many women who did not receive treatment lived longer than expected (the average survival period from symptom onset to death was 30 to 40.5 months), however, some women with stage I, II, or III breast cancer who refused treatment survived for five years.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，患者自身发现的肿瘤大多具有侵袭性，并且通常在随诊l0年内出现远期转移，在随诊l5年后发生转移者极为罕见。
Translation: However, most tumors detected by patients themselves are aggressive, and distant metastasis typically occurs within the first 10 years of follow-up. Metastasis after 15 years of follow-up is extremely rare.

Query_Text_cn: 本文所述的肿瘤检出方式以现有的医院病历记录资料为基础。
Translation: The tumor detection methods described in this article are based on existing hospital medical records data.

Query_Text_cn: 我们还研究了芬兰国家乳腺X线登记处采用的肿瘤检出方式。
Translation: We also studied the tumor detection methods adopted by the Finnish National Mammography Registry.

Query_Text_cn: 通过筛查发现的女性肿瘤患者(以医院病历记录资料为据)中有70％在筛查登记处有备案。
Translation: Of the female cancer patients identified through screening (based on hospital medical record data), 70% were registered in the screening registry.

Query_Text_cn: 其余30％在登记处无备案的妇女也可能是通过筛查发现肿瘤的。
Translation: The remaining 30% of unregistered women at the registration office may also have had their tumors detected through screening.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，由于登记资料不完全，这一点无法证实。
Translation: However, due to incomplete registration records, this cannot be verified.

Query_Text_cn: 仅以医院记录为依据，从队列中去除通过乳腺X线筛查发现的女性肿瘤患者，对多变量模型中与筛查相关的远期复发的HR几乎没有影响。
Translation: Excluding female breast cancer patients identified through mammography screening based solely on hospital records had little effect on the hazard ratio (HR) associated with screening for distant recurrence in the multivariable model.

Query_Text_cn: 因为肿瘤筛查轮次对预后无明显影响(P=0.96)，加之有些妇女没有筛查轮次的资料，所以我们在进一步分析中将各轮筛查发现的女性肿瘤患者合并。
Translation: Given that tumor screening rounds had no significant impact on prognosis (P=0.96) and some women lacked screening round data, we pooled the female tumor patients identified across all screening rounds in further analysis.

Query_Text_cn: 其他方法组由患者自身发现肿瘤、未参加筛查但发现肿瘤以及在乳腺X线筛查问期发现肿瘤的妇女组成。
Translation: Other groups consist of women who detected their tumors themselves, those who did not participate in screening but were diagnosed with tumors, and those diagnosed during the interval period of breast cancer screening.

Query_Text_cn: 有意思的是，在这些肿瘤患者中，50~59岁组与其他组生存率几乎相同，但是由于对50~59岁组进行了更深入的筛查，使该年龄组自我发现肿瘤的相对比例比其他年龄组低。
Translation: Interestingly, the 50–59 age group had survival rates almost identical to other groups, but due to more thorough screening of the 50–59 age group, the relative proportion of self-detected tumors in this age group was lower compared to other age groups.

Query_Text_cn: 其他一些研究也发现，在乳腺X线筛查问期发现的女性肿瘤患者与其他方法发现的女性肿瘤患者预后大致相同，我们的结果与上述研究一致。
Translation: Other studies have also found that breast cancer patients identified during mammography screening have similar prognoses to those detected through other methods, and our findings are consistent with these studies.

Query_Text_cn: 绝经前妇女和应用激素替代治疗的妇女似乎更易在乳腺X线筛查问期发现肿瘤，这可能是由于她们的乳腺实质更为致密，而乳腺X线的技术含量和放射科医生的技能可能也很重要。
Translation: Premenopausal women and those undergoing hormone replacement therapy (HRT) appear more likely to have tumors detected during the interval between breast X-ray screenings, which may be due to their denser breast parenchyma, and the technical aspects of mammography along with radiologists' expertise may also play important roles.

Query_Text_cn: 乳腺X线筛查问期发现的肿瘤的假阴性率为10％30％，但是回顾性地将乳X线筛查问期发现的肿瘤分为真正的间期肿瘤和漏诊的肿瘤是非常必要的，但在常规临床实践却很少进行。
Translation: The false-negative rate for tumors detected during the interval between mammographic screenings ranges from 10% to 30%. However, retrospectively categorizing interval tumors identified during mammographic screening into true interval tumors and missed diagnoses is necessary but rarely conducted in routine clinical practice.

Query_Text_cn: 因为上述原因，加之全国范围研究的诸多管理问题，我们未尝试将其他方面发现的肿瘤进一步分类。
Translation: Due to the aforementioned reasons, coupled with the numerous management issues associated with nationwide studies, we did not attempt to further classify the tumors identified in other areas.

Query_Text_cn: 任何乳腺X线筛查发现的女性肿瘤队列均有可能包含一些有症状的患者，因为有些妇女可能在等待筛查通知而不是主动就医。
Translation: Any tumor cohorts identified through mammography screening may include symptomatic patients, as some women may be awaiting screening notifications rather than actively seeking medical care.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，筛查队列有利的生存差异可能比我们所观察到的更大，因为筛查队列中包含了一些有肿瘤症状的妇女。
Translation: Therefore, the favorable survival difference in the screening cohort may be greater than what we observed, as the cohort included some women with tumor symptoms.

Query_Text_cn: 另一方面，其他方法组可能包括了拒绝筛查、与参加筛查的妇女相比预后可能不佳的妇女柏。
Translation: On the other hand, the other method group may have included women who refused screening and those with a poorer prognosis compared to women who participated in screening.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，在芬兰拒绝参加乳腺X线筛查的妇女所占比例很小。
Translation: However, the proportion of women in Finland who refuse to participate in breast X-ray screening is relatively small.

Query_Text_cn: 在40~49岁、60~69岁和I>70岁组，参加筛查者的比例主要由提供乳腺X线筛查的市政府决定。
Translation: Among the 40–49, 60–69, and ≥70 age groups, the proportion of participants in the screening is primarily determined by the municipalities providing mammography services.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的结论是，乳腺X线筛查发现的女性肿瘤患者比肿瘤直径大致相同的其他妇女预后更好。
Translation: Our conclusion is that women with tumors detected by mammography screening have better prognoses than other women with tumors of similar size.

Query_Text_cn: 通过乳腺X线筛查发现肿瘤是有益的是独立于腋窝淋巴结数目、原发肿瘤大小、确诊年龄和组织学分级的预后变量。
Translation: The detection of tumors through mammography screening is a beneficial prognostic factor independent of the number of axillary lymph nodes, primary tumor size, age at diagnosis, and histological grade.

Query_Text_cn: 组织病理学和肿瘤生物学因素均不能解释筛查发现肿瘤对远期复发危险的影响。
Translation: Histopathological and tumor biological factors cannot explain the impact of screen-detected tumors on long-term recurrence risk.

Query_Text_cn: 我们需要进步研究肿瘤浸润和转移形成的相关因素。
Translation: We need to further study the associated factors of tumor infiltration and metastasis formation.

Query_Text_cn: 对通过乳腺X线筛查检出的女性肿瘤患者，必须将肿瘤检测法纳入风险评估，否则就有可能高估其发生远期转移的危险。
Translation: For female tumor patients detected through mammography screening, tumor detection methods must be incorporated into risk assessment; otherwise, there is a risk of overestimating their long-term risk of distant metastasis.

Query_Text_cn: 背景：了解结直肠肿瘤的危险因素能够为无症状个体制定降低发病风险策略提供信息。
Translation: Understanding the risk factors for colorectal tumors can inform the development of strategies to reduce the risk of disease onset in asymptomatic individuals.

Query_Text_cn: 目前评价无症状个体罹患进展期结直肠肿瘤危险因素的研究、对比有无息肉个体危险因素的研究或在多变量分析中纳入最有意义危险因素的研究甚少。
Translation: There are few studies evaluating risk factors for advanced colorectal neoplasia in asymptomatic individuals, comparing risk factors between individuals with or without polyps, or incorporating the most significant risk factors into multivariable analysis.

Query_Text_cn: 目的：在一个完成全结肠镜检的无症状患者队列中确定与进展期结直肠肿瘤相关的危险因素。
Translation: Objective: To identify risk factors associated with advanced colorectal neoplasia in a cohort of asymptomatic patients who underwent complete colonoscopy.

Query_Text_cn: 设计、地点和参试者：1994年2月至1997年1月，于3121例无症状患者中进行前瞻性横断面研究。患者来自13个退伍军人医疗中心，年龄50～75岁。
Translation: Design, Setting, and Participants: A prospective cross-sectional study was conducted from February 1994 to January 1997 among 3,121 asymptomatic patients enrolled from 13 Veterans Affairs Medical Centers, aged 50 to 75 years.

Query_Text_cn: 所有入组患者都接受了结肠镜检以确定进展期肿瘤的发生。进展期肿瘤定义为直径≥10mm的腺瘤，绒毛状腺瘤(至少25％的绒毛成分)，伴重度非典型增生的腺瘤，或者浸润癌。
Translation: All enrolled patients underwent colonoscopy to identify advanced neoplasia, defined as adenomas with diameter ≥10mm, villous adenoma (at least 25% villous component), adenoma with severe dysplasia, or invasive carcinoma.

Query_Text_cn: 检测的变量包括罹患结直肠癌一级亲属病史，既往胆囊切除史，血清胆固醇水平，体力活动水平，吸烟情况，饮酒情况和饮食因素。
Translation: The variables under examination include family history of first-degree relatives with colorectal cancer, history of gallbladder removal, serum cholesterol levels, level of physical activity, smoking status, alcohol consumption, and dietary factors.

Query_Text_cn: 主要观察指标：对每个变量均进行年龄校正分析，以便与没有息肉的患者比较，计算其发生进展期肿瘤的优势比(ORs)和95％可信区间(CLs)。
Translation: Primary outcome measures: Age-adjusted analyses were conducted for each variable to compare with patients without polyps, and the odds ratios (ORs) and 95% confidence limits (CLs) for the occurrence of advanced tumors were calculated.

Query_Text_cn: 我们建立了一个多变量logistic回归模型以便对有关危险因素做出鉴定。
Translation: We established a multivariate logistic regression model to identify the associated risk factors.

Query_Text_cn: 二级分析检查增生性息肉的危险因素，与无息肉以及有进展期肿瘤的患者比较。
Translation: The secondary analysis examines the risk factors for hyperplastic polyps, compared to patients without polyps and those with advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 结果：329例入组患者有进展期肿瘤，1441例没有息肉。
Translation: Of the enrolled patients, 329 had advanced-stage tumors, and 1,441 had no polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 在多变量分析中，我们发现一级亲属结直肠癌病史(OR，1.66；95％CI，1.16～2.35)、目前吸烟(OR，1.85；95％CI，1.33～2.58)以及目前中至大量饮酒(OR，1.02；95％CI，1.01～1.03)与之呈正相关关系。
Translation: In multivariate analysis, we found that family history of colorectal cancer among first-degree relatives (OR, 1.66; 95% CI, 1.16-2.35), current smoking (OR, 1.85; 95% CI, 1.33-2.58), and current moderate-to-heavy alcohol consumption (OR, 1.02; 95% CI, 1.01-1.03) were positively associated with the outcome.
Grain fiber (OR, 0.95; 95% CI, 0.91–0.99), vitamin D (OR, 1.66; 95% CI, 1.16–2.35) intake, and nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) use (OR, 0.66; 95% CI, 0.48–0.91) were inversely associated.

Query_Text_cn: 在单变量分析中，存在负相关的因素包括谷物纤维摄入大于4.2g/d，维生素D的摄入大于645IU/d以及每日应用非甾体抗炎药。
Translation: In the univariate analysis, factors with negative correlations included a daily intake of cereal fiber greater than 4.2 g/d, a daily intake of vitamin D exceeding 645 IU/d, and the daily use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs).

Query_Text_cn: 临界因素包括体力活动，每日服用多种维生素，钙的摄入以及红肉脂肪获取量。
Translation: The critical factors include physical activity, daily intake of multivitamins, calcium intake, and consumption of red meat fat.

Query_Text_cn: 没有相关性的因素包括体重指数、既往胆囊切除和血清胆固醇水平。
Translation: Factors with no association include Body Mass Index, previous cholecystectomy, and serum cholesterol levels.

Query_Text_cn: 结肠镜检发现391例最严重的病变为增生性息肉。
Translation: Colonoscopy identified that among the 391 cases, the most severe lesions were hyperplastic polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 除既往和目前吸烟与发生增生性息肉的危险增高相关外，其他危险变量结果与没有息肉的患者类似。
Translation: Apart from former and current smoking being associated with an increased risk of developing hyperplastic polyps, the results of other risk variables were similar to those without polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 结论：我们的研究数据证实了进展期结肠肿瘤的一些重要的危险因素，并为降低危险策略提供了一定依据。
Translation: The findings of our study confirmed the key risk factors associated with advanced colorectal tumors and provided a basis for strategies aimed at reducing such risks.

Query_Text_cn: 尚需进一步的研究以确定改变生活方式是否可以降低结肠癌的危险。
Translation: Further research is needed to determine whether lifestyle changes can reduce the risk of colorectal cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 在北美，结直肠癌位居癌症死亡的第二位。
Translation: In North America,colorectal cancer is the second leading cause of cancer-related deaths.

Query_Text_cn: 有证据表明，对50岁以上的无症状人群进行普查可以降低结直肠癌的死亡率。结肠腺瘤切除可减少结直肠癌的发生率。
Translation: There is evidence that screening asymptomatic populations aged 50 and older can lower colorectal cancer mortality. The removal of colorectal adenomas can reduce the incidence of colorectal cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 明确导致息肉恶变的重要危险因素可以为危险分层以及降低危险策略的制定提供准确的信息。
Translation: The identification of key risk factors associated with the malignant transformation of polyps can provide accurate information for risk stratification and the formulation of risk-reduction strategies.

Query_Text_cn: 许多结直肠息肉的潜在危险因素以前已有研究。
Translation: Many potential risk factors for colorectal polyps have been previously studied.

Query_Text_cn: 但是在无症状个体评估进展期结直肠癌危险因素的研究，在伴或不伴息肉个体比较危险因素的研究，或者在多变量分析中纳入最有意义危险因素的研究甚少。
Translation: However, few studies have examined risk factors for advanced colorectal cancer in asymptomatic individuals, compared risk factors between individuals with or without polyps, or incorporated the most significant risk factors into multivariate analysis.

Query_Text_cn: 我们在接受结肠镜筛检的无症状个体进行了横断面研究以确定进展期结肠癌的危险因素。
Translation: We conducted a cross-sectional study among asymptomatic individuals undergoing colonoscopy screening to determine the risk factors for advanced colorectal cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 该研究的独特之处在于：(1)纳入结肠镜检查结肠无息肉的个体作为对照组，与有进展期肿瘤的患者比较；(2)样本量足以满足在多变量分析中对最重要的变量进行分析。
Translation: The uniqueness of this study lies in: (1) including individuals without polyps detected by colonoscopy as the control group, compared to patients with advanced neoplasia; (2) the sample size was sufficient to allow analysis of the key variables in multivariable analysis.

Query_Text_cn: 根据以往研究发现的联系以及生物学推理，还选择了一些可疑的危险因素。
Translation: Based on the associations identified in previous research and biological reasoning, some suspected risk factors were also selected.

Query_Text_cn: 我们研究的潜在危险因素包括：结直肠癌家族史、饮食、吸烟、饮酒、体重指数、非甾体抗炎药的应用、血清胆固醇水平、胆囊切除、体力活动。
Translation: We examined potential risk factors including: family history of colorectal cancer,diet,smoking,alcohol consumption,body mass index,use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs),serum cholesterol levels,cholecystectomy,physical activity.

Query_Text_cn: 我们对最坏结肠病灶为一或多个增生性息肉的患者进行了二级分析。
Translation: We conducted a secondary analysis on patients whose worst colorectal lesions were one or more hyperplastic polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 增生性息肉属良性病变，而且临床常见。
Translation: Hyperplastic polyps are classified as benign lesions and are commonly encountered in clinical practice.

Query_Text_cn: 目前的指南建议增生性息肉的治疗与无息肉患者类似。
Translation: The current guidelines recommend that the treatment for hyperplastic polyps is similar to that for patients without polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 先前并无研究评估增生性息肉患者的危险因素，因此无法确定他们是否与无息肉患者类似。
Translation: There have been no prior studies assessing the risk factors of patients with hyperplastic polyps, thus making it unclear whether they are similar to patients without polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 与无息肉患者和进展期肿瘤患者比较，我们的研究为确定增生性息肉患者的危险因素提供了一个机会。
Translation: Compared with patients without polyps and those with advanced-stage tumors, our study provides an opportunity to determine the risk factors for patients with hyperplastic polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 患者于1994年2月至1997年1月收集自13个退伍军人医疗中心，年龄50～75岁，没有下消化道症状。
Translation: Patients were enrolled from 13 Veterans Affairs Medical Centers between February 1994 and January 1997, aged 50 to 75 years, without lower gastrointestinal symptoms.

Query_Text_cn: 研究计划得到了一个中心人权委员会以及各参试中心机构审查委员会的批准，所有参试者均提供了书面的知情同意。
Translation: The research plan was approved by a central human rights committee as well as the institutional review boards of the participating centers, and all participants provided written informed consent.

Query_Text_cn: 患者需完成一项临床调查以确定其入组资格。
Translation: Patients need to complete a clinical assessment to determine their eligibility for enrollment.

Query_Text_cn: 如果患者报告有下消化道疾病症状，则将其排除。这些症状包括直肠出血(此前6个月内≥1次)、大便习惯明显改变、下腹部疼痛需进行临床评估。
Translation: If a patient reports symptoms of lower gastrointestinal disease, they should be excluded. These symptoms include rectal bleeding (≥1 episode within the past 6 months), significant change in bowel habits, and lower abdominal pain requiring clinical evaluation.

Query_Text_cn: 其他的排除条件包括参加其他研究，有结肠疾病史(如结肠炎、息肉或癌)，既往结肠手术，10年内曾行结肠检查(如乙状结肠镜、结肠镜、钡灌肠)，存在可增加结肠镜检危险或不能从结肠镜筛查(癌症或任何终末期疾病)获益的医学问题，安装有人工心脏瓣膜，接受抗凝治疗，以及其他非医学问题(精神疾病，缺少运输工具，无家可归或缺少家庭支持以及过量饮酒)，或是在接受结肠镜检时需要特殊的预防措施(如预防性抗生素)。
Translation: Other exclusion criteria include participation in other studies, history of colorectal diseases (e.g., colitis, polyps, or cancer), prior colorectal surgery, having undergone colorectal examinations within the past 10 years (e.g., sigmoidoscopy, colonoscopy, barium enema), presence of medical conditions that increase the risk of colonoscopy or would not benefit from colonoscopy screening (cancer or any end-stage disease), having artificial heart valves, undergoing anticoagulation therapy, or non-medical issues (psychiatric conditions, lack of transportation, homelessness, lack of family support, excessive alcohol consumption), or requiring special preventive measures (e.g., prophylactic antibiotics) during colonoscopy.

Query_Text_cn: 可能怀孕的女性亦予排除。
Translation: Women who may be pregnant are also excluded.

Query_Text_cn: 2346例患者拒绝临床调查。
Translation: 2,346 patients refused to participate in the clinical investigation.

Query_Text_cn: 最常见的排除原因为10年内曾行结肠检查(n=6486)、结肠疾病史(n=2221)、严重的医学问题(n=1052)和接受抗凝治疗(n=712)。
Translation: The most common exclusion reasons were prior history of colonoscopy within 10 years (n=6486), history of colon disease (n=2221), severe medical conditions (n=1052), and use of anticoagulant therapy (n=712).

Query_Text_cn: 符合入组标准的患者中，1463例患者(31.4％)拒绝参加，3196例符合条件的患者入组。
Translation: Of the patients who met the inclusion criteria, 1,463 (31.4%) declined to participate. A total of 3,196 eligible patients were enrolled.

Query_Text_cn: 完成结肠镜检查的患者纳入分析(n=3121)。
Translation: Patients who underwent colonoscopy were included in the analysis (n=3121).

Query_Text_cn: 对于关键危险因素，我们确定的样本量有足够的把握度(>90％)检出具有临床重要意义的双倍危险。
Translation: For key risk factors, the sample size we determined has sufficient power (>90%) to detect a clinically significant doubling of risk.

Query_Text_cn: 我们分析研究了329例进展期肿瘤患者和1441例无息肉患者(n=1770)。
Translation: We analyzed 329 patients with advanced-stage tumors and 1,441 patients without polyps (n=1770).

Query_Text_cn: 结肠镜检和组织学评估步骤此前已有描述。
Translation: Colonoscopy and histological evaluation steps have been previously described.

Query_Text_cn: 进展期结肠肿瘤的定义为≥10mm的腺瘤，绒毛状腺瘤(至少25％的绒毛)，腺瘤伴重度非典型增生，或浸润癌。
Translation: Advanced colorectal neoplasia is defined as adenomas ≥10mm, villous adenoma (with at least 25% villous component), adenomas with severe dysplasia, or invasive carcinoma.

Query_Text_cn: 病理学证实粘膜内癌或原位癌的患者被分人重度非典型增生组。
Translation: Patients pathologically confirmed to have intraepithelial carcinoma or carcinoma in situ are classified into the severe dysplasia group.

Query_Text_cn: 癌症的定义为恶性细胞浸润超过粘膜肌层。
Translation: Cancer is defined as malignant cell infiltration penetrating beyond the mucosal muscular layer.

Query_Text_cn: 患者的分类根据组织学最高为进展期病灶进行。
Translation: The classification of patients is based on the highest histological grade of advanced-stage lesions.

Query_Text_cn: 二级队列患者最严重的结肠病灶为增生性息肉，对他们进行研究分析以确定其危险因素是否不同于息肉患者或进展期肿瘤患者。
Translation: Patients in the secondary cohort whose most severe colorectal lesions were hyperplastic polyps were studied and analyzed to determine whether their risk factors differed from those of polyp patients or advanced tumor patients.

Query_Text_cn: 如果患者未填项目超过70个或者报告之总能量摄人值过高或过低，都将其排除。
Translation: If a patient had more than 70 unfilled items or the reported total energy intake was too high or too low, such cases were excluded.

Query_Text_cn: 根据调查表，每例患者应测定以下项目：总能量摄人；总脂肪；从牛肉、猪肉或羊肉获得的脂肪；总饮食纤维；谷类纤维、水果纤维及蔬菜纤维；钙摄人总量；叶酸摄人总量；维生素D；以及每日多种维生素的应用。
Translation: According to the survey form, the following items shall be measured for each patient: total energy intake; total fat; fat derived from beef, pork, or mutton; total dietary fiber; grain fiber, fruit fiber, and vegetable fiber; total calcium intake; total folate intake; vitamin D; and daily use of multivitamins.

Query_Text_cn: 体力活动指数来自Framingham研究报告。
Translation: The physical activity index is derived from the Framingham Study.

Query_Text_cn: 研究给患者提供了在家中、工作以及娱乐活动中有关很轻体力活动、轻体力活动、中度体力活动和重体力活动的标准，记录患者每类活动花费的时问从而获得一个24小时评分。
Translation: The study provides patients with standards regarding very light physical activity, light physical activity, moderate physical activity, and vigorous physical activity across various settings such as at home, work, and leisure activities. Patients record the time spent on each activity category to obtain a 24-hour score.

Query_Text_cn: 第二种评估方法是计算代谢当量，这是一种切实有效的评估特定中至重体力活动能量消耗的方法，表达为每周代谢当量。
Translation: The second assessment method involves calculating metabolic equivalents (METs), which is a reliable and effective approach for evaluating energy expenditure in specific moderate-to-heavy physical activities, expressed as weekly metabolic equivalents.

Query_Text_cn: 两种评分系统反映了体力活动的不同方面。
Translation: Two scoring systems reflect different aspects of physical activity.

Query_Text_cn: 就体力活动指数而言，一个每日从事数小时轻微活动的个体其评分可能与每日进行短时间激烈活动的个体相似。
Translation: With regard to the physical activity index, an individual engaged in several hours of light activity daily may have similar scores to another individual who engages in short periods of vigorous activity daily.

Query_Text_cn: 与之相对，代谢当量评分则可鉴别从事中和重体力活动的个体；从事数小时轻微体力活动的个体其评分要低于短时间重体力活动的个体。
Translation: In contrast, metabolic equivalent scores can distinguish individuals engaged in moderate and heavy physical activities; individuals who perform hours of light physical activity have lower scores than those engaged in short periods of heavy physical activity.

Query_Text_cn: 询问患者目前吸烟情况、每日吸烟量及吸烟年限。
Translation: Inquire about the patient's current smoking status, daily cigarette consumption, and duration of smoking.

Query_Text_cn: 对于既往吸烟者，确定其戒烟年份、吸烟年限以及每日吸烟量。
Translation: For former smokers, determine the year of quitting smoking, duration of smoking, and daily cigarette consumption.

Query_Text_cn: 既往和目前饮酒通过每周饮酒次数计算，定义为葡萄酒(每杯4盎司)、啤酒(每罐或每瓶12盎司)或白酒(每口1盎司)，以上均相当于每次饮用11g酒精。
Translation: Past and current alcohol consumption was calculated based on weekly drinking frequency, defined as wine (4 ounces per glass), beer (12 ounces per can/bottle), or spirits (1 ounce per shot), all equivalent to 11 grams of alcohol per serving.

Query_Text_cn: 阿斯匹林或其他非甾体抗炎药的使用通过询问卷确定，包括各种已知的非甾体抗炎药。
Translation: The use of aspirin or other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs was determined through a survey questionnaire, including various known nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs.

Query_Text_cn: 因为新药投入使用，研究期问问卷清单亦需不断升级修订。
Translation: Due to the deployment of new drugs, the questionnaire checklist during the research period also requires constant updates and revisions.

Query_Text_cn: 患者需填写使用的具体药物、每日剂量、使用时间(年为单位)。
Translation: Patients are required to provide the specific medications used, daily dosage, and duration of use (in years).

Query_Text_cn: 根据目前使用情况(从不使用比偶尔使用或每日使用)和使用时间对资料进行分析。
Translation: Analyze the data based on current usage patterns (never used, occasionally used, or used daily) and usage duration.

Query_Text_cn: 既往胆囊切除病史以及手术时间亦予确定。
Translation: The patient's history of cholecystectomy and the timing of the surgery were confirmed.

Query_Text_cn: 血清胆固醇用空腹血标本测量。
Translation: Serum cholesterol is measured using fasting blood samples.

Query_Text_cn: 研究数据库的管理和所有统计学分析均采用SAS软件，6.12版(SASInstituteInc，Carry，NC)。
Translation: The management of the research database and all statistical analyses were conducted using SAS software, version 6.12 (SAS Institute Inc, Cary, NC).

Query_Text_cn: 描述性统计学分析包括分类数据率和比例的计算，以及连续数据均值和SEs的计算。
Translation: Descriptive statistical analysis includes the calculation of rates and proportions of categorical data, as well as the calculation of means and SEs of continuous data.

Query_Text_cn: 采用标准的logistic回归法将相对危险计算为优势比和95％可信区间。
Translation: The relative risk was calculated as odds ratios and 95% confidence intervals using standard logistic regression.

Query_Text_cn: 在分析饮食和其他连续变量时，参试者按最低至最高5分位分组，以最低5分位作为参照组。
Translation: When analyzing dietary intake and other continuous variables, participants were grouped into quintiles based on the lowest to highest values, with the lowest quintile serving as the reference group.

Query_Text_cn: 饮食变量首先校正年龄，然后是年龄加总能量摄人和病史因素(家族史、体重指数、吸烟、饮酒、体力活动指数和非甾体抗炎药的使用)。
Translation: The dietary variables were first adjusted for age, then for age combined with total energy intake and medical history factors, including family history, body mass index, smoking, alcohol consumption, physical activity index, and use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs.

Query_Text_cn: 非饮食危险因素校正年龄。
Translation: Non-dietary risk factors for age adjustment.

Query_Text_cn: 研究的基本目的是，在一个多变量模型中评估有关危险因素的相对重要性。
Translation: The fundamental objective of the study is to assess the relative importance of relevant risk factors in a multivariate model.

Query_Text_cn: 这些因素可分成几类，其中包括多个测量指标。
Translation: These factors can be categorized into several categories, which include multiple measurement indicators.

Query_Text_cn: 多变量模型的建立要求变量选择以避免冗余和过度专一问题。
Translation: The establishment of a multivariate model requires variable selection to avoid redundancy and over-specialization.

Query_Text_cn: 如果结果不明确，则采用一种逐步回归统计过程在各类因素间选择最具统计学关联的变量。
Translation: If the results are inconclusive, a stepwise regression statistical process is employed to select the variable with the most statistically significant association among various factors.

Query_Text_cn: 多变量模型包括以下变量：家族史(≥1个一级亲属患结直肠癌比没有组)；体重指数(连续变量，按5单位增量)；体力活动指数(连续变量，按5单位增量)；吸烟(目前吸烟比从不吸烟或既往吸烟)；饮酒(连续变量，以每周饮酒数为单位)；非甾体抗炎药的使用(用过一种比从未使用)；牛肉、猪肉、羊肉作为主餐(连续变量，作为总能量摄人百分数)，代表饮食因素之脂肪摄入水平；谷物纤维(连续变量，按1g增量)作为纤维变量；维生素D(连续变量，按100IU增量)。
Translation: The multivariable model included the following variables: family history (≥1 first-degree relative with colorectal cancer vs. none); body mass index (continuous variable, per 5-unit increment); physical activity index (continuous variable, per 5-unit increment); smoking (current vs. never or former smokers); alcohol consumption (continuous variable, per number of drinks per week); use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (ever vs. never); beef, pork, or lamb as main meals (continuous variable, as percentage of total energy intake), representing dietary fat intake levels; grain fiber (continuous variable, per 1-g increment) as a fiber variable; vitamin D (continuous variable, per 100-IU increment).

Query_Text_cn: 对于所有分析均以P小于0.05作为具有统计显著性的标准。
Translation: For all analyses,a P value less than 0.05 was used as the criterion for statistical significance.

Query_Text_cn: 总共3121例患者接受了直到盲肠的全结肠镜检。
Translation: A total of 3,121 patients underwent total colonoscopy up to the cecum.

Query_Text_cn: 男性患者占该队列的96.8％，所以该结果不适用于女性。
Translation: Male patients accounted for 96.8% of the cohort, so the findings are not applicable to females.

Query_Text_cn: 根据发现之最坏的结肠组织学病灶对患者进行分类。
Translation: Classify patients based on the worst colonic histological lesions identified.

Query_Text_cn: 1441例患者无结肠息肉，118例(3.8％)患者有非腺瘤病灶，391例(12.5％)有增生性息肉，842例(27.0％)有1或1个以上直径小于1厘米的管状腺瘤。
Translation: 1,441 patients had no colonic polyps, 118 patients (3.8%) had non-adenomatous lesions, 391 patients (12.5%) had hyperplastic polyps, and 842 patients (27.0%) had one or more tubular adenomas measuring less than 1 centimeter in diameter.

Query_Text_cn: 作为分析的内容，329(10.5％)例患者至少有一个进展期肿瘤。
Translation: In the analysis, 329 (10.5%) patients had at least one advanced-stage tumor.

Query_Text_cn: 将这些患者与1441例无结肠息肉生长的患者进行比较。
Translation: These patients were compared with 1,441 patients without colorectal polyp growth.

Query_Text_cn: 所有患者均获得完整的病史信息。
Translation: All patients were provided with complete medical histories.

Query_Text_cn: 312例进展期肿瘤患者(94.8％)和1359例没有肿瘤的患者(94.3％)获得完整的饮食信息。
Translation: Complete dietary information was available for 312 patients with advanced-stage tumors (94.8%) and 1,359 patients without tumors (94.3%).

Query_Text_cn: 进展期肿瘤患者的年龄大于无肿瘤患者(65.1岁比62.7岁；P小于0.001)。
Translation: The age of patients with advanced-stage tumors was greater than that of non-tumor patients (65.1 years vs. 62.7 years; P < 0.001).

Query_Text_cn: 所有的优势比均校正了年龄。
Translation: All odds ratios were adjusted for age.

Query_Text_cn: 我们总结了病史危险因素的年龄校正分析结果。
Translation: We summarized the age-adjusted analysis results of medical history risk factors.

Query_Text_cn: 一级亲属至少有1人患结直肠癌的患者罹患进展期肿瘤的危险增加(OR，1.68；95％CI，1.21～2.31)，若有2位一级亲属患结直肠癌其危险性更高。
Translation: Patients with at least one first-degree relative affected by colorectal cancer have an increased risk of developing advanced-stage tumors (OR, 1.68; 95% CI, 1.21 to 2.31). The risk is even higher if two first-degree relatives are affected.

Query_Text_cn: 白人与黑人和西班牙裔患者比较，罹患进展期肿瘤的危险并无显著差异。
Translation: There is no significant difference in the risk of developing advanced-stage tumors between white patients and Black and Hispanic patients.

Query_Text_cn: 体重指数与罹患进展期肿瘤的危险并无相关性。
Translation: There is no correlation between body mass index and the risk of developing advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 体力活动指数大于36与罹患进展期肿瘤危险降低相关(OR，0.67；95％CI，0.49～0.93)。
Translation: A physical activity index greater than 36 is associated with a reduced risk of developing advanced-stage tumors (OR, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.49–0.93).

Query_Text_cn: 每周代谢当量与罹患风险无相关性。
Translation: There is no correlation between weekly metabolic equivalent and the risk of developing the disease.

Query_Text_cn: 罹患进展期肿瘤的患者与无瘤患者血清胆固醇水平或胆囊切除率无差异。
Translation: There was no significant difference in serum cholesterol levels or cholecystectomy rates between patients with advanced-stage tumors and those without tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 目前吸烟与危险增加明显相关(OR，2.12；95％CI，1.49～3.01)。
Translation: Currently, smoking is significantly associated with an increased danger (OR, 2.12; 95% CI, 1.49-3.01).

Query_Text_cn: 吸烟超过25包一年的目前吸烟者以及戒烟前吸烟超过49包年的过去吸烟者危险也增加。
Translation: The risk also increases for current smokers who have smoked more than 25 pack-years and former smokers who smoked more than 49 pack-years before quitting.

Query_Text_cn: 如果患者每日平均饮酒超过一杯，那么目前酒精消费也与危险增加相关(OR，2.12；96％CI，1.44～3.14)。
Translation: If patients consume more than one drink per day on average, current alcohol consumption is also associated with an increased risk (OR, 2.12; 96% CI, 1.44–3.14).

Query_Text_cn: 偶尔使用或每日使用非甾体抗炎药与罹患进展期肿瘤的危险减少相关。
Translation: The occasional or daily use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs is associated with a reduced risk of developing advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 以非甾体抗炎药的使用时间作为一个连续变量进行分析，进展期肿瘤的年龄校正优势比与使用时间的增加明显相关(OR，使用10年者为0.83；95％CI，0.73～0.95)。
Translation: When analyzed as a continuous variable, the age-adjusted odds ratio for advanced-stage tumors was significantly associated with increased duration of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug use (OR, 0.83 for 10 years of use; 95% CI, 0.73–0.95).

Query_Text_cn: 饮食变量通过年龄、总能量摄人和病史危险因素加以校正。
Translation: The dietary variables are adjusted for age, total energy intake, and medical history risk factors.

Query_Text_cn: 总动物脂肪摄取与进展期肿瘤呈不显著的弱相关关系。
Translation: Total animal fat intake showed a non-significant weak correlation with advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 红肉脂肪摄取量在最高5分位者与危险明显相关。
Translation: The highest quintile of red meat fat intake is significantly associated with increased risk.

Query_Text_cn: 以牛肉、猪肉或羊肉作为主食每周进食≥5次的患者与未消费这类食物的患者相比，罹患进展期肿瘤的相对危险增加(OR，2.73；95％CI，1.05～3.63)。
Translation: Patients who consumed beef, pork, or lamb as a staple food at least five times per week had an increased relative risk of developing advanced-stage tumors compared to those who did not consume these foods (OR, 2.73; 95% CI, 1.05–3.63).

Query_Text_cn: 在摄人的所有纤维成分中，只有谷物纤维与进展期肿瘤危险降低相关。
Translation: Among all dietary fiber components, only grain fiber is associated with a reduced risk of advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 总钙摄人量、总叶酸摄人量和维生素D摄人量在最高5分位的患者，与摄人量在最低5分位的患者比较，罹患进展期肿瘤的相对危险显著降低。
Translation: Patients with the highest quintile of total calcium intake,folate intake,and vitamin D intake had a significantly lower relative risk of developing advanced-stage tumors compared to those in the lowest quintile.

Query_Text_cn: 日常多种维生素的消耗也与危险降低明显相关(OR，0.75；95％CI，0.56～0.99)。
Translation: The consumption of daily multivitamins was also significantly associated with a reduced risk (OR, 0.75; 95% CI, 0.56-0.99).

Query_Text_cn: 除目前吸烟和既往吸烟外，两组不存在其他具有明显区别的危险变量。
Translation: Except for current and former smoking, there are no other risk variables with significant differences between the two groups.

Query_Text_cn: 与无息肉的对照组相比，既往(OR，1.65；95％CI，1.23～2.23)和目前吸烟者(OR，2.71；95％CI，1.93～3.81)发生增生性息肉的危险明显增加。
Translation: Compared with the control group without polyps, former smokers (OR, 1.65; 95% CI, 1.23-2.23) and current smokers (OR, 2.71; 95% CI, 1.93-3.81) had a significantly increased risk of developing hyperplastic polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 每日应用非甾体抗炎药与发生增生性息肉的优势比降低有关(OR，0.75；95％CI，0.56～0.99)。
Translation: Daily use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs was associated with a reduced odds ratio for the occurrence of hyperplastic polyps (OR, 0.75; 95% CI, 0.56-0.99).

Query_Text_cn: 将增生性息肉患者的危险变量与进展期肿瘤患者比较，其结果与无息肉患者基本相同。
Translation: When comparing the risk variables of hyperplastic polyp patients with those of patients with advanced-stage tumors, the results are essentially the same as those of patients without polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 年龄增加患进展期肿瘤的危险亦增加，而维生素D和多种维生素的摄入增加则与危险降低相关。
Translation: With increasing age, the risk of developing advanced-stage tumors also increases, while higher intake of vitamin D and multivitamins was associated with a lower risk.

Query_Text_cn: 其余关系无统计学显著性。
Translation: The remaining relationships are not statistically significant.

Query_Text_cn: 研究建立了包括每个病史因素和每个饮食组一个因素的多变量模型。
Translation: The study established a multivariable model that included each medical history factor and one factor for each dietary group.

Query_Text_cn: 饮食变量是通过组内逐步回归法进行选择的。
Translation: The dietary variables were selected through the group-wise stepwise regression method.

Query_Text_cn: 分析将谷物纤维维生素D以及以牛、羊、猪肉为主的饮食(根据总能量摄入百分比)确定为模型的最佳侯选变量。
Translation: The analysis identified cereal fiber, vitamin D, and a diet primarily composed of beef, lamb, and pork (based on the percentage of total energy intake) as the optimal candidate variables for the model.

Query_Text_cn: 在多变量分析中，与进展期肿瘤危险增加明显相关的因素包括家族史、目前吸烟、中到大量饮酒。
Translation: In multivariable analysis, factors significantly associated with an increased risk of advanced-stage tumors included family history, current smoking, and moderate-to-heavy alcohol consumption.

Query_Text_cn: 与进展期肿瘤危险降低明显相关的因素包括非甾体抗炎药的应用、谷物纤维的摄入和维生素D。
Translation: Factors significantly associated with a reduced risk of advanced-stage tumors include the use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, cereal fiber consumption, and vitamin D.

Query_Text_cn: 在多变量分析中，维生素D的摄入较总钙和总叶酸的摄入更为重要。
Translation: In multivariate analysis, vitamin D intake is more important than total calcium and total folate intake.

Query_Text_cn: 体力活动水平较高与危险降低存在临界的无统计学显著性的相关性。
Translation: Higher levels of physical activity were associated with a borderline, non-statistically significant correlation with reduced risk.

Query_Text_cn: 这项研究首次在无症状的接受全结肠检查的个体对进展期结肠肿瘤的诸多危险因素进行了横断面研究。
Translation: This study is the first cross-sectional analysis to examine multiple risk factors for advanced colorectal tumors in asymptomatic individuals undergoing complete colonoscopy examinations.

Query_Text_cn: 我们选择进展期结肠癌作为研究的终点是为了在最有可能发生结肠癌的患者明确相关的危险因素其目标是建立相应的预防策略。
Translation: We chose advanced colorectal cancer as the study endpoint to identify the associated risk factors in patients most likely to develop the disease, with the aim of establishing corresponding preventive strategies.

Query_Text_cn: 由于很多进展期肿瘤患者在其终生并不发生结肠癌，因此该研究终点受到一定的限制。
Translation: Since many patients with advanced-stage tumors do not develop colorectal cancer throughout their lifetimes,the study endpoint is subject to certain limitations.

Query_Text_cn: 有几种危险因素以往并无相关资料。
Translation: There are several risk factors with no prior documentation.

Query_Text_cn: 以前的研究发现体重指数、血清胆固醇水平以及既往胆囊切除与结直肠肿瘤仅有很弱的相关性。
Translation: Previous studies have found that body mass index, serum cholesterol levels, and previous cholecystectomy have only a weak correlation with colorectal tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 在本研究，这些变量与进展期结肠肿瘤并无显著关联，但是亦不能排除中度相关性。
Translation: In this study, these variables were not significantly associated with advanced colorectal tumors; however, a moderate association cannot be ruled out.

Query_Text_cn: 本文两种评估体力活动的方法所获结果相互矛盾。
Translation: The results obtained from the two methods for assessing physical activity in this article contradict each other.

Query_Text_cn: 体力活动指数记分较高的患者，或者为较长时间轻微体力活动或者为短时间剧烈活动，罹患进展期结肠肿瘤的年龄校正危险较低。
Translation: Patients with higher physical activity index scores, either engaging in longer periods of light physical activity or shorter periods of vigorous activity, had a lower age-adjusted risk of developing advanced colon tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 不同代谢当量记分5分位患者罹患进展期结肠肿瘤的危险并无差异。
Translation: There was no significant difference in the risk of developing advanced colorectal tumors among patients across the five metabolic equivalent (MET) score quintiles.

Query_Text_cn: 这表明，个体有可能从长期轻微体力活动获益，就像从短时间剧烈体力活动获益一样。
Translation: This suggests that individuals may benefit from long-term light physical activity just as they do from short-term intense physical activity.

Query_Text_cn: 在多变量分析中，体力活动仅有临界的没有统计学显著性的获益。
Translation: In multivariate analysis, physical activity was associated with only marginal, non-statistically significant benefits.

Query_Text_cn: 饮食脂肪和纤维素食物与进展期肿瘤的关系并不肯定。
Translation: The relationship between dietary fat, fiber-rich foods, and advanced tumors remains unclear.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的分析发现，与总脂肪摄入相关的发生进展期结肠肿瘤的危险并无显著增加，与从红肉脂肪摄取相关的危险增高则呈临界性，没有统计学显著性。
Translation: Our analysis found no significant increase in the risk of developing advanced colorectal tumors associated with total fat intake. The borderline increase in risk linked to red meat fat consumption was not statistically significant.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然我们未发现脂肪摄入与进展期结肠肿瘤显著相关，但是我们也不能排除脂肪摄入可以促进有先兆的腺瘤恶变从而导致结肠癌发病率增高的可能性。
Translation: Although we found no significant association between fat intake and advanced colorectal tumors, we cannot exclude the possibility that fat intake may promote the malignant transformation of precancerous adenomas, which could lead to an increase in colorectal cancer incidence.

Query_Text_cn: 现有资料显示在单因素分析模型中，谷物纤维摄入在最高5分位的患者发生进展期结肠肿瘤的危险较低，而且在校正后的多变量模型中这种关系仍然存在。
Translation: The available data indicate that patients in the highest fifth quintile of dietary fiber intake from grains had a lower risk of developing advanced colorectal neoplasia in univariate analysis models, and this association remained significant in adjusted multivariate models.

Query_Text_cn: 之前的干预研究在3~4年的研究期间未能证明纤维饮食的保护作用。
Translation: Previous intervention studies failed to demonstrate the protective effect of a fiber-rich diet over a 3- to 4-year study period.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，这些研究采用(大或小)腺瘤作为研究终点，评价的是短期干预的效果。
Translation: However, these studies use adenoma (large or small) as the study endpoint and assess the effect of short-term interventions.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究结果与这些研究结论并不矛盾。
Translation: Our research findings do not contradict these study conclusions.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的资料表明，大量长期摄入谷物纤维可阻止进展期肿瘤的发展。
Translation: Our data indicates that a high long-term intake of dietary fiber from grains can prevent the progression of advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 维生素D是一种重要的保护因素。
Translation: Vitamin D is an important protective factor.

Query_Text_cn: 以往已有几项研究显示，在体外实验，维生素D，特别是其活性形式(1,25-羟基维生素D)对结肠粘膜细胞有抗增殖作用，几项临床研究也证实其有益效应。
Translation: Previous studies have shown that in vitro experiments demonstrate an anti-proliferative effect of vitamin D, particularly its active form (1,25-hydroxyvitamin D), on colonic mucosal cells, and several clinical studies have also confirmed its beneficial effects.

Query_Text_cn: 之前已有一些研究发现补充钙对预防腺瘤发生具有临界性益处。
Translation: Previous studies have found that calcium supplementation has a marginal benefit in preventing the occurrence of adenomas.

Query_Text_cn: 在我们的多变量分析中，左右钙摄取的饮食维生素D是一种有益的因素。
Translation: In our multivariate analysis, dietary vitamin D affecting calcium intake is a beneficial factor.

Query_Text_cn: 我们未测量日光浴的作用。日光浴能影响25-羟基维生素D水平。
Translation: We did not measure the effect of sunbathing. Sunbathing can affect 25-hydroxyvitamin D levels.

Query_Text_cn: 这些数据提示，维生素D可能是一种重要的保护因素。应进一步研究确定饮食和日光浴的相对作用。
Translation: These data indicate that vitamin D may be an important protective factor. Further research is needed to determine the relative roles of diet and sun exposure.

Query_Text_cn: 总叶酸摄入量与多种维生素摄人的影响在分析中难于分开；在单变量分析中两者都有一定保护作用。
Translation: The effects of total folate intake and multivitamin intake are difficult to disentangle in analyses; both showed some protective effects in univariate analysis.

Query_Text_cn: 我们发现1或多个一级亲属结直肠癌病史与进展期肿瘤显著相关，这一点在许多其他研究也得到证实。
Translation: We found that a history of colorectal cancer in one or more first-degree relatives is significantly associated with advanced-stage tumors, a finding corroborated in numerous other studies.

Query_Text_cn: 我们对家族成员在60岁之前或之后诊断癌症的参试者发生进展期肿瘤的危险进行了比较，结果未见显著差异。
Translation: We compared the risk of developing advanced-stage tumors between participants whose family members were diagnosed with cancer before or after the age of 60, and found no significant difference in the results.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，我们的结果对下述建议提供了支持：所有一级亲属有结直肠癌的患者应作为高危人群，并为之提供结肠镜筛查。
Translation: Therefore, our findings support the following recommendation: patients with first-degree relatives affected by colorectal cancer should be classified as a high-risk population and offered colonoscopy screening.

Query_Text_cn: 与以前的研究一致，目前吸烟以及每周饮酒7杯以上与危险增加强烈相关。
Translation: Consistent with previous studies, current smoking and consuming more than 7 drinks per week are strongly associated with increased risk.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管其机制尚不明确，但这些数据为提倡戒烟以及减少饮酒提供了进一步的理由。
Translation: Although the underlying mechanisms remain unclear, these data provide further grounds for advocating smoking cessation and reducing alcohol consumption.

Query_Text_cn: 与不使用非甾体抗炎药的患者相比，常规应用非甾体抗炎药的患者发生进展期肿瘤的危险较低，此点亦与以往许多研究相符。
Translation: Compared to patients not using nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), those who routinely used NSAIDs had a lower risk of developing advanced-stage tumors, a finding consistent with many previous studies.

Query_Text_cn: 药物使用时间与危险降低明显相关。
Translation: The duration of drug use is significantly associated with a reduction in risk.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究提出COX-2抑制药物的应用问题。研究显示，这种药物可以减缓家族性息肉病患者腺瘤的进展。
Translation: This study raises concerns regarding the application of COX-2 inhibitors. Research indicates these drugs can slow the progression of adenomas in familial adenomatous polyposis patients.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究超过80％的受试者已经使用阿斯匹林作为预防心血管疾病的药物，或使用其他非甾体抗炎药治疗关节炎和疼痛。
Translation: Over 80% of the participants had used aspirin as a preventive medication for cardiovascular disease or used other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs to treat arthritis and pain.

Query_Text_cn: 并且可能还有潜在的危害。
Translation: And there may also involve potential risks.

Query_Text_cn: 这些药物有引发消化道溃疡、胃肠道出血及其他副作用的危险，必须权衡其利弊。
Translation: These drugs pose a risk of causing gastrointestinal ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, and other side effects; their benefits and risks must be carefully weighed.

Query_Text_cn: 所以对单独应用阿斯匹林或其他非甾体抗炎药预防结肠肿瘤仍需进一步研究。
Translation: Thus, the use alone of aspirin or other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) in preventing colorectal tumors still requires further research.

Query_Text_cn: 在二级分析研究中，我们对最重病变为1或多个增生性息肉患者的危险因素进行了研究。
Translation: In a secondary analysis study, we investigated the risk factors for patients whose most severe lesion was 1 or multiple hyperplastic polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 多数指南均将增生性息肉看作一种良性病变，并有几项大规模筛查研究发现远端增生性息肉并不是近端肿瘤的危险因素。
Translation: Most guidelines regard hyperplastic polyps as benign lesions, and several large-scale screening studies have found that distal hyperplastic polyps are not a risk factor for proximal tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 我们假设如果增生性息肉是偶发的，且无肿瘤增殖成分，那么增生性息肉患者应该与无息肉患者非常相似。
Translation: We hypothesize that if hyperplastic polyps are incidental and contain no neoplastic proliferative components, then hyperplastic polyp patients should be very similar to patients without polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 以前并无研究评价增生性息肉是否存在可资鉴别危险的变量。
Translation: There has been no previous research evaluating whether variables exist to discriminate the risk of hyperplastic polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究表明单纯增生性息肉患者的结果与无息肉对照组近似。
Translation: "Our study found that the outcomes of patients with hyperplastic polyps were similar to those of the control group without polyps."

Query_Text_cn: 只有既往或目前吸烟者是具有重要意义的危险因素。
Translation: Only former or current smokers are significant risk factors.

Query_Text_cn: 有趣的是，吸烟是仅有的既与增生性息肉又与进展期肿瘤相关的危险因素。
Translation: Interestingly, smoking is the only risk factor associated with both hyperplastic polyps and advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 吸烟可以促进DNA过甲基化，进展期腺瘤的进展则可能取决于甲基四氢叶酸还原酶表型。
Translation: Smoking can promote DNA hypermethylation, and the progression of advanced adenoma may depend on the phenotype of methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase.

Query_Text_cn: 当我们将进展期肿瘤队列与增生性息肉组患者比较时，结果发现维生素D和多种维生素摄人量较高与进展期肿瘤危险降低相关。
Translation: When comparing the advanced-stage tumor cohort with patients with hyperplastic polyps, higher intake of vitamin D and multivitamins was associated with a reduced risk of advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 其他差异无统计学显著性。
Translation: Other differences were not statistically significant.

Query_Text_cn: 因为这属于二级分析结论，所以我们的研究结论不足以检出这种差异。
Translation: Since this falls under the category of secondary analysis conclusions, our research conclusions are insufficient to detect this difference.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，进展期肿瘤组患者也可能同时罹患增生性息肉，因此两组可能有一定重叠。
Translation: Additionally, patients with advanced-stage tumors may also develop hyperplastic polyps, therefore, there may be some overlap between the two groups.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究也有几个重要的局限性。
Translation: Our study also has several significant limitations.

Query_Text_cn: 首先，这是一项横断面研究。
Translation: First,this is a cross-sectional study.

Query_Text_cn: 研究设置的某些危险因素可能与进展期肿瘤的发生并无相关性，但却可能为其他继发病灶危险因素。
Translation: Certain risk factors identified in the study setup may be unrelated to the occurrence of advanced-stage tumors, while they may still serve as risk factors for other secondary lesions.

Query_Text_cn: 研究设计了对这组人群的随访。
Translation: The study designed a follow-up for this cohort.

Query_Text_cn: 研究的重点在于进展期肿瘤高危人群的危险因素。
Translation: The focus of the study is on the risk factors of high-risk populations with advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 在这组人群，癌症的进展并非不可避免，并且其他因素也可能促进进展期肿瘤向癌症的转化。
Translation: In this population, the progression of cancer is not inevitable, and other factors may also facilitate the transformation of advanced-stage tumors into cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 第二，某些研究结果可能会遭受记忆偏差因素的影响。
Translation: Second,some research findings may be subject to the influence of memory bias factors.

Query_Text_cn: 饮食频率调查在很多研究均是有效的，但是该调查并未测量饮食习惯在研究期间是否发生变化。
Translation: Dietary frequency surveys have been effective in many studies, but they did not assess whether dietary habits changed during the study period.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究有38.7％的患者报告过去l0年饮食结构发生了重大变化。
Translation: In this study, 38.7% of the patients reported that their dietary patterns had undergone significant changes over the past 10 years.

Query_Text_cn: 在进展期肿瘤患者和非进展期肿瘤患者，饮食结构的变化率近似。
Translation: Among advanced-stage tumor patients and non-advanced-stage tumor patients, the rate of change in dietary structure is similar.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，我们不能排除继往饮食习惯影响目前进展期肿瘤危险的可能性。
Translation: Therefore, we cannot rule out the possibility that past dietary habits may affect the risk of current advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 第三，我们的结果只适用于男性人群；对女性的危险因素还需进一步研究。
Translation: Third, our findings apply only to men; the risk factors for women require further study.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，退伍军人亦可能不同于美国其他男性人群。
Translation: In addition, veterans may also differ from other male populations in the United States.

Query_Text_cn: 最后，我们也认识到混淆变量分析的复杂性。
Translation: Finally,werecognizethecomplexityofconfoundingvariableanalysis.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，这项研究的一个显著特点就是包括了所有的重要病史和饮食危险因素。
Translation: Therefore, a notable feature of this study is that it encompasses all important medical history and diet-related risk factors.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究的一项重要举措是所有无症状患者均进行了完全的结肠镜检查，以确定有危险的人群，这减少了错误分类的可能性。
Translation: A key measure in this study was that all asymptomatic patients underwent full colonoscopy to identify high-risk populations,minimizing the possibility of misclassification.

Query_Text_cn: 研究有足够的把握度对诸多潜在混淆危险变量进行检测。
Translation: The study has sufficient power to detect numerous potential confounding risk variables.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究是首次确定维生素D为保护因素的研究之一。
Translation: This study is one of the first to identify vitamin D as a protective factor.

Query_Text_cn: 因为维生素D和钙是混合分析的，所以只有研究样本量足够大才能检测两种物质各自的相对受益。
Translation: Since vitamin D and calcium are analyzed together, only a sufficiently large sample size can detect the respective relative benefits of the two substances.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究能够检测肥胖和体力活动的相对危险和受益。
Translation: Our study can assess the relative risks and benefits of obesity and physical activity.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的结论是肥胖本身并不是个有意义的危险因素，而常规体力锻炼则具有保护作用。
Translation: Our conclusion is that obesity itself is not a meaningful risk factor, while regular physical exercise has a protective effect.

Query_Text_cn: 以往曾有许多研究提及高脂饮食或高纤维饮食的危险和受益。
Translation: Previous studies have highlighted the risks and benefits of high-fat and high-fiber diets.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的资料显示，大量谷物纤维具有保护作用，而从肉类纤维大量摄取脂肪则可增加进展期肿瘤的危险。
Translation: Our data shows that a high intake of cereal fiber has a protective effect,while consuming large amounts of fat from meat fibers increases the risk of advanced-stage tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 吸烟和饮酒的危险性现在已有一项大型多变量分析证实。
Translation: The dangers of smoking and drinking have been confirmed by a large-scale multivariate analysis.

Query_Text_cn: 此前曾有许多研究分析了这些变量，但未考虑其他危险因素。
Translation: Previously, there have been many studies that analyzed these variables but did not take into account other risk factors.

Query_Text_cn: 最后，我们发现最重病变为增生性息肉的患者其结果与无息肉的对照非常类似。
Translation: Finally, we found that patients whose most severe lesion was a hyperplastic polyp had outcomes very similar to those of the control group without polyps.

Query_Text_cn: 对于增生性息肉，过去或目前吸烟是仅有的具有显著意义的危险因素。
Translation: For hyperplastic polyps, past or current smoking is the only statistically significant risk factor.

Query_Text_cn: 这些新的信息与临床应将增生性息肉当作无意义结肠病灶对待的建议相符。
Translation: The new findings align with the recommendation that clinical practice should treat hyperplastic polyps as clinically insignificant colorectal lesions.

Query_Text_cn: 总之，这些结果表明，有几种危险因素与进展期结肠肿瘤的发生正相关。包括：结直肠癌家族史、目前吸烟以及目前中到大量饮酒。
Translation: These findings suggest that several risk factors are positively associated with the occurrence of advanced colorectal tumors, including family history of colorectal cancer, current smoking, and current moderate-to-heavy alcohol consumption.

Query_Text_cn: 存在负相关的因素包括非甾体抗炎药的使用，高水平谷物纤维和维生素D的摄取。
Translation: Factors with negative correlation include the use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, high intake of cereal fiber, and vitamin D intake.

Query_Text_cn: 临界的、无统计学显著性的保护因素包括：适当的体力活动、总钙摄取量以及总叶酸摄取量和多种维生素摄取。
Translation: Marginally significant protective factors included appropriate physical activity,total calcium intake,total folate intake,and multivitamin intake.

Query_Text_cn: 我们的研究并不是为证明调整危险因素可改变结肠肿瘤危险而设计的。
Translation: Our study was not designed to prove that modifying risk factors can alter the risk of colorectal tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管如此，我们仍谨慎建议，将戒烟、减少饮酒、日常体力锻炼作为健康维持措施的一部分。
Translation: Nevertheless, we still cautiously recommend including quitting smoking, reducing alcohol consumption, and daily physical exercise as part of health maintenance measures.

Query_Text_cn: 服用维生素D加钙或者规律食用奶制品是对患者有益的方案。
Translation: A regimen of taking vitamin D and calcium or regularly consuming dairy products is beneficial for patients.

Query_Text_cn: 每日服用多种维生素是否有益仍不确定，还需要进一步研究证实，但是它与危险很低相关。
Translation: Whether taking a multivitamin daily is beneficial remains uncertain and requires further research to confirm, but it is associated with very low risk.

Query_Text_cn: 与结直肠癌家族史的明显相关性，对目前提出的有关开展结肠镜筛查的建议提供了支持。
Translation: The evident correlation with a family history of colorectal cancer provides support for the current recommendations to conduct colonoscopy screening.

Query_Text_cn: 必需仔细权衡非甾体抗炎药的潜在保护作用及其危险。
Translation: It is essential to carefully balance the potential protective effects of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and their associated risks.

Query_Text_cn: 仍需进一步的研究以便确定基线结肠镜检查是否可以预测进展期肿瘤的发生或复发。
Translation: Further research is still needed to determine whether baseline colonoscopy can predict the occurrence or recurrence of advanced tumors.

Query_Text_cn: 饮食：饮食因素评估用半定量食物频率调查表进行，以往研究已证实其可靠性。
Translation: Dietary factor assessment was conducted using a semi-quantitative food frequency questionnaire (FFQ), the reliability of which has been confirmed by previous studies.

Query_Text_cn: 体力活动：用两种方法评定日常体力活动以及偶尔发生的大运动量体力活动。
Translation: Physical activity: Two methods are used to assess daily physical activity and occasional high-intensity physical activities.

Query_Text_cn: 饮酒、吸烟和非甾体抗炎药：确定患者既往及目前吸烟情况。
Translation: Alcohol consumption, Tobacco use, and Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs: Assess patients' past and current tobacco use.

Query_Text_cn: 其他因素：体重指数计算为体重(kg)/身高(m2)。
Translation: Other factors: Body Mass Index (BMI) is calculated as weight (kg) divided by height (m²).

Query_Text_cn: 背景一些大型观察性研究、小型前瞻性研究以及随机临床试验的事后分析已经表明，他汀类药物时慢性心力衰竭患者有益。
Translation: Some large observational studies, small prospective studies, and post-hoc analyses of randomized clinical trials have suggested that statins are beneficial for patients with chronic heart failure.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，以前的研究在方法学上说服力较弱。
Translation: However, previous studies lacked methodological persuasiveness.

Query_Text_cn: 作者对瑞舒伐他汀在心力衰竭患者中的有效性与安全性进行了观察。
Translation: The author conducted an observation on the efficacy and safety of rosuvastatin in heart failure patients.

Query_Text_cn: 方法在意失利的326个心脏中心和31个内科中心进行了一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验。
Translation: The method conducted a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in the 326 cardiac centers and 31 internal medicine centers in Italy that had failed.

Query_Text_cn: 在不限定患者病因以及左室射血分数的情况下，纳入年龄≥18岁、纽约心脏协会(NYHA)心功能分级为Ⅱ~Ⅳ级的慢性心力衰竭患者作为研究对象，利用隐蔽设计的计算机控制电话随机分组系统将患者随机分组，分别给予瑞舒伐他汀10mg/d(n=2285)或安慰剂(n=2289)治疗。
Translation: Patients aged ≥18 years with chronic heart failure (NYHA class II to IV) regardless of etiology and left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) were enrolled. Participants were randomized via a computer-generated centralized telephonic randomization system with concealed allocation to receive rosuvastatin 10 mg/day (n=2285) or placebo (n=2289).

Query_Text_cn: 试验中对患者进行了中位期为3.9年(IQR3.0~4.4)的随访。
Translation: Patients were followed up for a median duration of 3.9 years (IQR 3.0–4.4) in the trial.

Query_Text_cn: 主要终点包括至死亡发生的时间以及至死亡或因心血管原因住院的时间。
Translation: The primary endpoints include time to death and time to death or cardiovascular-related hospitalization.

Query_Text_cn: 本研究已在ClinicaITrials.gov注册，编码为NCT00336336。
Translation: The study has been registered on ClinicaITrials.gov with the identifier NCT00336336.
The all-cause mortality rate was 29% (657) in the rosuvastatin group and 28% (644) in the placebo group (adjusted HR 1.00, 95.5% CI 0.898-1.122, p=0.943).

Query_Text_cn: 瑞舒伐他汀组中1305例(57%)患者发生死亡或因心血管原因住院，安慰剂组中则为1283例(56%)（校正HR1.01，99%CI0.908~1.112，p=0.903）。
Translation: In the rosuvastatin group, 1,305 (57%) patients experienced death or hospitalization due to cardiovascular causes, compared to 1,283 (56%) in the placebo group (adjusted HR 1.01, 99% CI 0.908 to 1.112, p=0.903).

Query_Text_cn: 胃肠道反应是两组共同的最常见不良反应［瑞舒伐他汀组34例(1%)vs安慰剂组44例(2%)］。
Translation: Gastrointestinal reactions were the most common adverse reaction shared by both groups [rosuvastatin group: 34 cases (1%) vs. placebo group: 44 cases (2%)].

Query_Text_cn: 结论瑞舒伐他汀10mg/d的治疗对任何原因所致慢性心力衰竭患者的临床结果无影响，在这些患者中该药物治疗安全性良好。
Translation: The treatment with rosuvastatin 10 mg/day had no effect on clinical outcomes in patients with chronic heart failure regardless of etiology, and demonstrated a favorable safety profile in these patients.

Query_Text_cn: 基金意大利SocietaProdottiAntibiotici(SPA)公司、辉瑞制药公司、意大利SigmaTau公司和阿斯利康制药公司。
Translation: Italian Società Prodotti Antibiotici (SPA), Pfizer Inc., Sigma-Tau Pharmaceuticals, and AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals.

Query_Text_cn: 对于动脉粥样硬化血栓形成的一级和二级预防，羟甲基二酰辅酶A(HMG-CoA)还原酶抑制剂（即他汀类药物）是过去数十年里被研发并运用于临床实践的最成功药物之一。
Translation: For the primary and secondary prevention of atherosclerotic thrombosis, hydroxymethylglutaryl coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase inhibitors (i.e., statins) are among the most successful drugs developed and applied in clinical practice over the past decades.
