Translation: Regarding this ability, we can cite numerous examples; some of which appear almost supernatural.

Query_Text_cn: 这种能力使我父亲没有结交过一个不可靠的朋友（这里有一个例外，但是这人的性格很快地就被发现了）。
Translation: This ability prevented my father from ever befriending an unreliable person (there was one exception, but the person's true nature was quickly uncovered).

Query_Text_cn: 每个人都拜访了他，同时有很多人曾请他到家中来。
Translation: Everyone visited him, and many people had invited him to their homes.

Query_Text_cn: 因为他确信这个人是不可靠的。
Translation: Because he was certain that the person was unreliable.

Query_Text_cn: 几个月以后他忽然逃走了，欠下了很多的债，人们发现他比一个惯常的骗子好不了多少。
Translation: Months later, he suddenly fled, accumulating substantial debts. People found him not much better than a habitual con artist.

Query_Text_cn: 有一个例子说明了他对别人的信任，很少有人敢这样做。
Translation: There is an example that illustrates his trust in others, and few dare to do so.

Query_Text_cn: —位完全陌生的爱尔兰绅士有一天来拜访我的父亲，他说他失去了他的钱袋同时在士鲁兹巴利等待爱尔兰寄钱来对他是一种严重的不便。
Translation: One day, a complete stranger from Ireland called on my father. He said he had lost his purse, and waiting in Sligo for money to be sent from Ireland had been a severe inconvenience for him.

Query_Text_cn: 于是他请我父亲借给他二十镑，我父亲立刻借给他了，因为他确信他所说的是实话口。
Translation: He then asked my father to lend him twenty pounds, and my father immediately did so because he was certain that what he said was the truth.

Query_Text_cn: 一俟爱尔兰的信件能够到达的时候，我父亲接到了一封充满感激的信，写信的人说内附英伦银行的一张二十镑的钞票，但是信中并没有附来钞票。
Translation: When letters from Ireland could reach us, my father received a grateful letter in which the sender mentioned enclosing a £20 Bank of England note, but the note was not actually included in the letter.

Query_Text_cn: 我问我父亲这件事是否令他感到了不安，但是他回答道‘一点也没有、第二天又来了一封信，写信的人连连道歉，因为他忘记了，（像是一个真正的爱尔兰人）把钞票放到昨天的那封信中。
Translation: I asked my father if this matter had upset him, but he replied, "Not at all." The next day another letter arrived, in which the writer repeatedly apologized for having forgotten (like a true Irishman) to include the bills in yesterday's envelope.

Query_Text_cn: 这位青年的疯瘫症使他指控自己犯了世界上一切的罪。
Translation: The youth's psychosis led him to accuse himself of every sin in the world.

Query_Text_cn: 后来，我父亲同他的叔父谈论了这件事，我父亲说，‘我准知道令侄确是犯过……一种大罪。
Translation: Later, my father discussed this matter with his uncle. My father said, "I am certain that your nephew has indeed committed... a grave sin."

Query_Text_cn: 我们以为除了我们自己以外没有人知道这件事。
Translation: We thought that no one else besides ourselves knew about this matter.

Query_Text_cn: 他说他无法解释，这就说明了我父亲的特性。
Translation: He said he was unable to explain, which demonstrates my father's characteristic.

Query_Text_cn: “下面的故事指出了我父亲的猜测是如何的准确。
Translation: The following story demonstrates how accurate my father's guess was.

Query_Text_cn: 谢尔班伯爵——后来是第一代的兰斯唐候爵——的闻名是由于他熟知欧洲的事情（麦考莱在某处说过这样的话），因此他感到非常得意。
Translation: Earl of Sherban—later the First Marquess of Lansdowne—was renowned for his knowledge of European affairs (as Macaulay once remarked), and thus took great pride in this fact.

Query_Text_cn: 有一次他来看病，后来便对我父亲大谈荷兰的事情。
Translation: Once, he came to see my father for treatment and later talked at length to him about the Netherlands.

Query_Text_cn: 我父亲曾在莱丁读过医学；当他在那里的时候，有一天他同朋友作了一次长距离的散步，到了乡间后，这位朋友把他带到了一个牧师的家中（我们可以称他为甲牧师，因为我忘记了他的姓名），牧师的妻子是一个英国妇人。
Translation: My father once studied medicine in Leighton. During his time there, one day he took a lengthy walk with a friend. After reaching the countryside, this friend brought him to the home of a clergyman (we may refer to him as Reverend A, as I have forgotten his name). The clergyman's wife was an Englishwoman.

Query_Text_cn: 当时我父亲很饿，但是除了奶酪以外，那里没有什么可以当作午餐的东西，而我父亲是从来不能吃乳酪的。
Translation: At that time, my father was very hungry, but there was nothing else to have for lunch except cheese, and my father could never eat cheese.

Query_Text_cn: 这件事使那位老妇人感到了惊奇和顾虑；同时她向我父亲保证地说，这是很好的乳酪，是由宝坞——即谢尔班伯爵的乡间别墅——寄来给她的。
Translation: This incident filled the old woman with surprise and concern; at the same time, she assured my father that it was excellent cheese, sent to her from Baud (i.e., Count Sherban's country villa).

Query_Text_cn: 我父亲感到了奇怪，为什么宝坞会送乳酪给她；但是他再也没有多想这件事；直到许多年后当谢尔班伯爵谈起荷兰的时候，他才忽然想起了这件事。
Translation: My father wondered why Bawu had sent cheese to her; he never thought about it again until many years later, when Count Sherban spoke of Holland, and he suddenly recalled the incident.

Query_Text_cn: 所以他回答道：‘根据我所看到的，我认为甲牧师是一个很有才干的人，同时他非常熟悉荷兰的事情’。
Translation: "So he replied, 'Based on what I have seen, I consider Pastor Jia to be a highly capable individual and he is also well-versed in Dutch affairs.'"

Query_Text_cn: 我父亲看到他显出了非常吃惊的样子，伯爵立即改变了谈话的题目。
Translation: When my father saw him looking extremely surprised, the count immediately changed the subject.

Query_Text_cn: 第二天早晨我父亲接到了伯爵的一封信，信中说他已展期开始他的旅行，并且特别希望见一见我父亲。
Translation: The next morning, my father received a letter from the Earl, which stated that he had postponed the commencement of his journey and expressed a particular wish to meet my father.

Query_Text_cn: 当他前去拜访的时候，伯爵说：‘达尔文医生，你怎样发现了供给我有关荷兰数据的人是甲牧师，我需要知道这点，因为这对我和甲牧师是非常重要的’。
Translation: When he went to visit, the Earl said, "Dr. Darwin, how did you discover that the person who provided me with the Dutch data was Pastor Jia? I need to know this because it is of great importance to both me and Pastor Jia."

Query_Text_cn: 所以我父亲必须说明事情的经过，同时他认为他在猜测中所表现的外交技巧引起了谢尔班伯爵的极大注意；因为在以后的许多年中，伯爵通过了不同的朋友给他带来了许多亲切的信息。
Translation: My father had to explain the circumstances, and he believed that the diplomatic skill he displayed in his speculation had attracted the notice of Prince Scherbatchef; for in the many years that followed, the prince sent him many kind messages through various friends.

Query_Text_cn: 因为许多年前赖亦尔爵士曾问过我；为什么兰斯唐侯爵（第一代侯爵的儿子或孙子）这样关心我和我的家人，但是他从来没有看到过我。
Translation: Sir Leyell had once asked me many years ago why Marquess of Lanstoun (the son or grandson of the first Marquess) took such an interest in me and my family, even though he had never seen me.

Query_Text_cn: 我没有请求过任何人，但是兰斯唐侯爵提出了我的名字，并且使我入选了。
Translation: I have never requested anyone, but the Marquess of Lansdowne proposed my name and secured my selection.

Query_Text_cn: 如果我的假定是正确的，那么五十年前我父亲在荷兰不吃奶酪的结果使我当选为英国科学协会的会员，这两件事情的关连是奇异的。
Translation: If my assumption is correct, the fact that my father not eating cheese in the Netherlands five decades ago resulted in my election as a Fellow of the British Science Association is a singular connection between these two events.

Query_Text_cn: 我父亲的敏锐观察使他能以卓越的技巧预测任何疾病的发展，同时他暗示了无穷的、使人安心的细节。
Translation: His father's keen observational skills enabled him to predict the progression of any disease with remarkable expertise, while he imparted an infinite amount of reassuring details.

Query_Text_cn: 有人曾告诉我说，士鲁兹巴利的一个年轻医生不喜欢我父亲，他常说我父亲是完全不合乎科学的，但他承认一点，对于一种疾病的结局，我父亲的预测能力是无匹的。
Translation: Someone once told me that a young doctor from Shiruzhabali did not like my father. He often said that my father was completely unscientific, but he acknowledged one thing: my father's predictive ability regarding the outcome of a disease was unmatched.

Query_Text_cn: 从前他认为我应当做一个医生，那时他对我讲了许多关于他那些病人的事。
Translation: He once believed I should become a doctor and at that time told me a lot about his patients.

Query_Text_cn: 如果我自己得了病的话，他劝我只可让医生放极少量的血，再多是不行的。
Translation: If I were to fall ill, he advised me to only allow the doctor to draw a minimal amount of blood, as anything more was impermissible.

Query_Text_cn: 在人们发现伤寒的性质并确定这种病症的很久以前，我父亲曾对我说：人们把两种完全不间的疾病混乱地加上了伤寒症的名称。
Translation: Long before the nature of typhoid was understood and the disease properly identified, my father once told me: "People have indiscriminately labeled two entirely unrelated diseases under the name of typhoid."

Query_Text_cn: 他严厉地反对喝酒，他相信经常地饮酒可以产生直接性的和遗传性的害处；即使饮量适度，绝大多数的情形仍是如此。
Translation: He vigorously opposes drinking, believing that regular alcohol consumption can lead to direct and genetic harm; even when consumption is moderate, this remains true in most cases.

Query_Text_cn: 但是他承认了并且提出了一些例子，有些人一生大都是饮酒的，但没有明显地遭受到任何害处；他相信他常能事先指出哪种人会这样做而不受害。
Translation: However, he acknowledged and cited examples of individuals who drank alcohol for most of their lives yet did not notably suffer any harm; he believed he could often predict in advance which individuals could do so without being harmed.

Query_Text_cn: 他自己从未喝过一滴任何种的酒。
Translation: He himself has never consumed even a single drop of any alcoholic beverage.

Query_Text_cn: 这句话使我想起了一件事，它说明处在最有利情况下的一个证人如何会是完全错误的。
Translation: This statement reminds me of an incident that illustrates how a witness in the most favorable circumstances could be entirely mistaken.

Query_Text_cn: 因为你劝我是为我的好处，但这样是不行的，因为我知道每次晚饭后你都要喝很大一杯热杜松子酒加水’。
Translation: "Because you advise me for my own good, but this won’t work, because I know every time after dinner you have a large glass of hot gin and water."

Query_Text_cn: 所以我父亲问他如何知道这件事。
Translation: So my father asked him how he knew about it.

Query_Text_cn: 那个人回答说：‘我的厨师从前在你那里做过两三年的女帮厨，她看到男仆每天都对一杯杜松子酒加水然后送给你’。
Translation: He answered, "My chef previously worked as a female kitchen hand at your place for two or three years, and she saw that the male servant diluted a glass of gin with water and sent it to you every day."

Query_Text_cn: 男仆常在杯中先放些冷水，然后从厨房的水炉中取开水注满，女帮厨误把冷水当成了杜松子酒。
Translation: The male servant often first placed some cold water in the cup, then topped it up with boiling water from the kitchen kettle. The maid mistakenly took the cold water for gin.

Query_Text_cn: 我父亲常告诉我许多小事，他发现在诊病时这些是有用处的。
Translation: My father often told me many small things, which he found useful when diagnosing patients.

Query_Text_cn: 例如妇女们在诉说她们的烦恼常是哭得很厉害，因而使他损失了很多宝贵的时间，他很快地发现了一点：请她们控制和抑制自己常使她们哭得更厉害，所以后来他总是鼓励她们哭下去，他说这比任何事更能使她们得到安慰；结果，她们总是很快地停止了啼哭；于是他可以听取她们所说的话，然后提出他的诊断。
Translation: When women recounted their troubles, they often cried profusely, which wasted much of his valuable time. He soon realized that asking them to restrain themselves often made them cry even more intensely. Consequently, he began encouraging them to let it out, explaining that this was the most effective way for them to find comfort; paradoxically, they would then quickly stop crying. This allowed him to listen to their accounts and proceed with his diagnosis.

Query_Text_cn: 但如果他们回答他们听说这种食物曾对别人发生了良好的影响，那么我父亲就会坚决地拒绝表示同意。
Translation: But if they responded that they had heard this food had a positive effect on others, my father would firmly refuse to agree.

Query_Text_cn: 有一天，他谈到了一件刻画人性的奇怪小事。
Translation: One day, he spoke of a strange little incident that revealed human nature.

Query_Text_cn: 当他很年轻的时候，士洛普郡的一位很有地位的绅士得了病，于是请我父亲去和那家的特约医生会诊。
Translation: When he was quite young, a prominent gentleman in Sloppshire fell ill and requested my father to consult with the family’s attending physician.

Query_Text_cn: 那位年老的医生对病人的妻子说，这种疾病的性质是这样的，得到它的人必死。
Translation: The elderly doctor told the patient's wife that the nature of this disease is such that those who contract it will certainly die.

Query_Text_cn: 我父亲的看法不同，他坚持病人会复元的；后来证明他在各方面都完全错了（我想是解剖了尸体），于是我父亲承认了他的错误。
Translation: My father held a different view; he insisted that the patient would fully recover. Later, it turned out that he was completely wrong in every aspect (I believe an autopsy was performed on the body), so my father admitted his mistake.

Query_Text_cn: 但是死者的妻子在几个月以后又把他请了因为他们已辞了那位年老的特约医生。
Translation: But the deceased's wife reinstated him several months later because they had dismissed the elderly contract physician.

Query_Text_cn: 在另一个情形中，我父亲对一位妇人说她的丈夫—定会死。
Translation: In another situation, my father told a woman that her husband would certainly die.

Query_Text_cn: 几个月以后他遇到了死者的妻子）她是一个很敏感的妇人；她说，‘你是一个很年轻的人，准许我劝告你一点：关于看护病人的近亲，总是要尽你可能地延长他们的希望。
Translation: Months later, he encountered the wife of the deceased. She was a very sensitive woman; she said, "You are a young man; allow me to give you a piece of advice: regarding the relatives of the patient, always do your utmost to prolong their hopes."

Query_Text_cn: 你曾使我感到了灰心，从那时起我就失去了力量’。
Translation: "You made me lose heart, and since then I have lost my strength."

Query_Text_cn: 我父亲说，自此以后他时常看到一件事情的极端重要性，即为了病人的缘故，我们要维持担任看护者的希望，有了希望才有力量。
Translation: My father said that since then, he has frequently recognized the extreme importance of maintaining the hope of those who serve as caregivers for the sake of the patients, for there is strength in hope.

Query_Text_cn: 有时他感到这样做而又要符合实际是一件困难的事。
Translation: Sometimes he finds it difficult to do so while keeping it in line with reality.

Query_Text_cn: 无论如何，有一位老绅士没有使他陷入这种进退两难的境地。
Translation: No matter what, there was an elderly gentleman who spared him from such a dilemma.

Query_Text_cn: 某先生请他去看病并且对他说：‘根据我所看到和听到的关于你的事，我相信你是那种愿意说实话的人；如果我问，你会把我的死期告诉我。
Translation: Mr. So-and-So asked him to come for a medical consultation and told him: "Based on what I have seen and heard about you, I believe you are a truthful person; if I were to ask, you would tell me the time of my death."

Query_Text_cn: 我确是很想请你给我看病，不过你要答应一件事：不论我讲什么，你总要说我将不会死去’。
Translation: I do want you to treat me, but you must promise me one thing: no matter what I say, you must always say that I will not die.

Query_Text_cn: 我父亲表示了同意，但有一种默契，即他的话实际上将是没有意义的。
Translation: My father expressed his consent, but there was an unspoken understanding that his words would be meaningless in reality.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，他时常想起许多朋友们的死亡。
Translation: Therefore, he often recalls the deaths of many friends.

Query_Text_cn: 由于他的记忆力强，他知道无数奇怪的故事，他喜欢讲述这些，因为他是一个善于说话的人。
Translation: Due to his strong memory, he knows countless strange stories and enjoys telling them because he is an eloquent speaker.

Query_Text_cn: 但是他有使每个人严格服从他的艺术。
Translation: He has the art of compelling everyone to strictly adhere to his authority.

Query_Text_cn: 有许多人很怕他。
Translation: Many people are deeply afraid of him.

Query_Text_cn: 别人告诉他说，某女士曾对每个人这样讲，她要拜访并且‘很清楚地’告诉‘那位肥胖的老医生她对他的看法’。
Translation: Someone told him that a certain lady had told everyone she would go to see and "very clearly" tell "that overweight old doctor her opinion of him".

Query_Text_cn: 实际上她已经来过，但是她失去了勇气，所以她的态度是再客气、再友善也没有了。
Translation: In reality, she had already come before. But she had lost her courage, so her attitude had become so unfriendly and unkind that there was no trace of politeness or kindness left.

Query_Text_cn: 当那位可怜的女人一看到我的时候，她显出了一副我所看到过的最悲惨的恐惧神情，她痛苦地哭着并且屡次地问我：‘你父亲要来么？’，但是她很快地就平静下来了。
Translation: When the poor woman saw me, she showed the most pitifully terrified expression I had ever seen, crying painfully and repeatedly asking me, 'Is your father coming?' However, she soon calmed herself.

Query_Text_cn: 在她那漫长的余生中，这句话最十分有效的。
Translation: In the long remainder of her life, this statement proved to be highly effective.

Query_Text_cn: 我父亲是很敏感的，所以有许多小事使他感到了极大的烦恼或痛苦。
Translation: My father is a sensitive person, so many small matters cause him extreme distress or anguish.

Query_Text_cn: 他回答道：‘士鲁兹巴利外边的每条道路都会使我联想到某种痛苦的事情’。
Translation: He replied, "Every road outside Suluzhabali reminds me of a painful memory."

Query_Text_cn: 但通常他总是高兴的。
Translation: But he is usually cheerful.

Query_Text_cn: 他容易大发雷霆，但他的慈蔼是无限的。
Translation: He is quick to anger, but his compassion is boundless.

Query_Text_cn: 他受到了广泛和深切的爱戴。
Translation: He was widely and deeply respected and admired.

Query_Text_cn: 他是一个谨慎而卓越的经营事业人，所以他从没有因投资而赔过钱，同时他给他的孩子们留下了很大的一份财产。
Translation: He was a cautious and outstanding entrepreneur, so he never lost money on investments and left his children a substantial fortune.

Query_Text_cn: 我记得一个故事，它说明了完全错误的信念很容易发生，同时也很容易传播出去。
Translation: I recall a story that illustrates how entirely erroneous beliefs can easily arise and spread rapidly.

Query_Text_cn: 某先生是士洛普郡最老家族之一的一位乡绅，同时也是一家银行的首要股东，有一天他自杀了。
Translation: Mr. Someone was a country gentleman from one of the oldest families in Suffolk County and also a principal shareholder of a bank. He committed suicide one day.

Query_Text_cn: 我父亲照例地被请了去，他发现这位乡绅已经死了。
Translation: My father was summoned as a matter of routine; he found the gentleman had died.

Query_Text_cn: 说到这里，我可以解释一下旧时处理这种事情的方式：因为某先生是一个颇有地位的人并且受到了普遍的尊敬，所以当时并没有验尸。
Translation: Speaking of this, I can explain the way such matters were handled in the past: since a certain gentleman was a man of considerable standing and widely respected, no autopsy was conducted at the time.

Query_Text_cn: 回到家中以后，我父亲认为应该到银行去（他在这家银行开有账户）把这件事告诉给管理银行的那几个股东；因为这件事可能产生挤兑的情形。
Translation: After returning home, my father thought it necessary to go to the bank (where he had an account) to inform the several shareholders who managed the bank about this matter; as this incident might lead to a bank run situation.

Query_Text_cn: 啊，一个故事便因此广泛地传播开来了；它说我父亲到了银行，取出了他的全部存款，离开了银行，并且再度回来说：‘我可以肯定地告诉你们，某先生已经自杀了’，然后就走了。
Translation: Ah, a story spread widely that my father went to the bank, withdrew all his savings, left the bank, and then returned to say: "I can confidently assure you all that Mr. So-and-So has committed suicide," before leaving again.

Query_Text_cn: 当时的人们似乎都有这样的一种信念：直到一个人走出了银行的门口以后，他由银行中取出来的款才算安全。
Translation: People at the time seemed to share the belief that the money withdrawn from the bank was only considered safe once the individual had exited the bank's premises.

Query_Text_cn: 过了一些时候以后我父亲方才听到了这个故事；当时一位管理银行的股东说，他违反了一条不可更改的行规，即永不能使一个人看到另一人的账；他曾把记载我父亲的账目的一本分类账给几个人看了，因为这样可以证明我父亲在那天没有支取过一个便土。
Translation: It was some time later that my father finally heard the story. A bank director stated that he had violated an unbreakable rule: no one should ever see another person's account. He had shown a ledger detailing my father's accounts to several people, as this could prove that my father had not withdrawn a single penny that day.

Query_Text_cn: 如果我父亲为其私人利益而利用了由业务中得来的消息，那么他的行为会是卑鄙的。
Translation: If my father had exploited messages obtained through business dealings for his personal gain, his actions would be despicable.

Query_Text_cn: 但是他为发生的几乎每件事都创立了一种理论。
Translation: But he formulated a theory for almost every event that occurred.

Query_Text_cn: 但是他所树立的榜样应该对他所有的孩子们起过很大道德上的作用。
Translation: However, the example he set must have had a significant moral influence on all his children.

Query_Text_cn: 他的金科玉律之一是这样的（这是很难遵守的一条）：‘如果一个人不能使你尊敬他，永不要和他做朋友’。
Translation: One of his golden rules is as follows (which is difficult to follow): 'Never become friends with someone who does not earn your respect.'

Query_Text_cn: 凯德琳，后嫁给了查理士·郎顿牧师。
Translation: Cathleen later married Reverend Charles Langton.

Query_Text_cn: 长子伊拉司马斯生于1804年，终身未娶，享年七十七岁。
Translation: Eldest son Elias Massey was born in 1804, never married, and died at the age of seventy-seven.

Query_Text_cn: 同他的弟弟一样，他先在士鲁兹巴利学校读书，后来进了剑桥的某督学院。
Translation: Like his brother, he first attended Shiluzhabali School and later entered a college in Cambridge.

Query_Text_cn: 他曾在爱丁堡和伦敦读过医学，并且在剑桥取得了医学学士的学位，他一向是直言不讳地声称他不想行医；离开剑桥以后，他在伦敦安静地过了一生。
Translation: He studied medicine in Edinburgh and London and obtained a Bachelor of Medicine degree from Cambridge. He has always bluntly stated that he did not want to practice medicine. After leaving Cambridge, he lived a quiet life in London all his life.

Query_Text_cn: 对于他的哥哥伊拉司马斯，查理士·达尔文所表现的敬爱是有些怜悯成分的，他好像总是惦记着他的孤独生活、他那感人的耐心和温柔的性情。
Translation: For his brother Erasmus, Charles Darwin's reverence was mingled with compassion, as he was always mindful of his solitary life, touching patience, and gentle disposition.

Query_Text_cn: 他时常称他哥哥为“可怜的拉司”或是“可怜而可爱的费罗斯”———当初，他们会在士鲁兹巴利的工具室中研究过化学，每逢回忆起这个时期的时候，他总是感到愉快；所以我猜想费罗斯（哲学家）这种称呼是对那个时期的一种纪念。
Translation: He often referred to his brother as "poor Lass" or "poor and dear Fellow"—during their time in the workshop at Sruzhabali when they studied chemistry, whenever he recalled this period, he always felt pleased; so I surmised that the title "Fellow" (the philosopher) was a tribute to that period.

Query_Text_cn: 伊拉司马斯比查理士·达尔文大四岁多，所以他们在剑桥相处的时间不长；但是从前在爱丁堡的时候，他们住在同一个寄宿舍内；在航海归来以后，他们在大马尔勃罗街伊拉司马知的家中间住了一个时期。
Translation: Erasmus was more than four years older than Charles Darwin, so they spent little time together at Cambridge; however, when they were in Edinburgh previously, they lived in the same boarding house; after his voyage, they stayed at Erasmus's home on Great Marlborough Street for a period.

Query_Text_cn: 在这个时候写给福克司的信中，他也时常以极大的敬爱心谈到了伊拉司马斯·达尔文，他首用过“我那位亲爱的好哥哥”这类的字句。
Translation: In the letters he wrote to Fox at this time, he also frequently spoke of Erasmus Darwin with great respect and affection, using phrases such as "my dear good brother."

Query_Text_cn: 在以后的年月中，伊拉司马斯·达永文偶尔到唐恩来，或是同他弟弟一家人共度夏季的假日。
Translation: In the years that followed, Erasmus Daryongwen occasionally paid visits to Dongen or spent summer holidays with his brother's family.

Query_Text_cn: 但是他的疾病逐渐地使他无法下决心离开伦敦，于是他们只能在一种时候彼此见面，即查理士·达尔文有时到安妮皇后街他哥哥的家中住一个星期。
Translation: However, his illness gradually prevented him from making up his mind to leave London, so they could only meet at certain times when Charles Darwin would sometimes stay at his brother's house on Queen Anne Street for a week.

Query_Text_cn: “我哥哥伊拉司马斯有一个异常清楚的头脑；在文学上、美术上、甚至在科学上，他的爱好和知识是广泛的和多方面的。
Translation: "My brother Elimas has an exceptionally clear mind; in literature, art, and even science, his interests and knowledge are broad and multifaceted."

Query_Text_cn: 在太阳镜上装个摄像机，再与计算机相连，就可以使62岁的盲人杰里学会很好地识别物体，并且独自在纽约巾地铁各线行走。
Translation: Equipping sunglasses with a camera and connecting it to a computer enabled 62-year-old blind man Jerry to learn to effectively identify objects and navigate the subway lines in New York City independently.

Query_Text_cn: 从1978年杰里开始出现视力问题，纽约杜贝尔研究所的医生就在他的脑内视皮层区表面植入了68个电极，视皮层处理来自眼睛的信号。
Translation: Since 1978 when Jerry began experiencing vision problems, doctors at the Dubler Institute in New York implanted 68 electrodes on the surface of his visual cortex, which processes signals from the eyes.

Query_Text_cn: 医生希望用电刺激视皮层区，使杰里恢复部分视力。
Translation: Doctors hope to use electrical stimulation on the visual cortex to help Jerry regain partial vision.

Query_Text_cn: 正常情况下，脑不能把磷苯图像转化成可识别的物像。
Translation: Under normal circumstances, the brain cannot convert phosphine images into recognizable images.

Query_Text_cn: 现在，杰里的太阳镜装配上了一台微型视觉摄像机，这台摄像机能捕捉住由袖珍移动计算机处理过的图像。
Translation: Jerry's sunglasses have been fitted with a miniature visual camera, which captures images processed by a compact mobile computer.

Query_Text_cn: 当杰里扫描物体时，他看见磷苯的图型，计算机计算系统放大图形边缘，这样会出现物体的轮廓。
Translation: When Jerry scans an object, he sees the phosphine patterns. The computer computing system enhances the edges of the graphics, resulting in the outline of the object.

Query_Text_cn: 杜贝力系统的主要好处是，它能帮助大约110万美国盲人。这些盲人由许多原因致盲，并不只是由于视网膜损伤造成的。
Translation: The primary benefit of the Dubeli system is that it can assist approximately 1.1 million visually impaired individuals in the United States. These individuals are blind due to a variety of causes and not solely due to retinal damage.

Query_Text_cn: 它覆盖两英寸宽__UNDEF__8英寸长手臂所及的范围，只能给杰里一条隧道式的视野。
Translation: It covered a two-inch wide and eight-inch long area within the reach of his arm, leaving Jerry with only a tunnel-like field of view.

Query_Text_cn: 该系统的商业则将克服这种不足并在今年年底大量上市，这种类型系统的特点是拥有512个电极。
Translation: The commercial version of the system will overcome these shortcomings and be mass-launched by the end of this year. A key feature of this type of system is its 512 electrodes.

Query_Text_cn: 在妻子“没完没了的严厉催促”之下，W·桑普森才去做了常规体检，结果发现了前列腺癌。
Translation: Under his wife's incessant stern urging, W. Sampson only agreed to undergo a routine medical checkup, which led to the discovery of prostate cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 加上癌病灶很小，这位57岁的起重机手可以选择不那么令人精疲力竭的治疗方法。
Translation: Given that the cancerous lesion is small, this 57-year-old crane operator can opt for less physically taxing treatment options.

Query_Text_cn: 桑普森接受的不是以外科手术为主加几周放射治疗的疗法，而是选择了越来越受欢迎的门诊治疗，他接受的疗法是将小剂量放射性“种子”植入前列腺，当天晚上就可回家。
Translation: Sampson did not opt for a therapy combining surgery-based treatment with several weeks of radiation therapy, but instead chose an increasingly popular outpatient treatment, in which low-dose radioactive "seeds" are implanted into the prostate, allowing him to go home that evening.

Query_Text_cn: 那些米粒大小的弹丸将永久留在前列腺内，对肿瘤进行放射治疗。
Translation: The rice-grain-sized seeds will remain permanently within the prostate to deliver radiation therapy to the tumor.

Query_Text_cn: 不过是不是真那么好，还得过许多年后才能确定。
Translation: However, whether it is truly as good as claimed can only be confirmed after many years have passed.

Query_Text_cn: 不像其他大多数类型的癌症，前列腺癌在十年后，或许时间还会更长些仍可能复发。
Translation: Unlike most other types of cancer, prostate cancer may still recur even after a decade, or even longer.

Query_Text_cn: 当前的医疗状况下，在各种前列腺癌治疗方法中做出选择，是件很困难的事，每年有成千上万的男性面临这种困境。
Translation: In the current medical landscape, choosing among various treatment options for prostate cancer is a challenging task, with tens of thousands of men facing this dilemma each year.

Query_Text_cn: 这种癌症是仅次于肺癌导致男性死亡的第二大杀手。不吸烟，可以明显地减少前列腺癌发病的危险。
Translation: This cancer is the second leading cause of death among men after lung cancer. Not smoking can significantly reduce the risk of developing prostate cancer.

Query_Text_cn: 美国癌症协会和国家综合癌症网于1999年发表的前列腺癌治疗指南中说，“不是所有的前列腺癌病人都应该接受同一种方法的治疗，在某些病例中，‘不治疗’也许是最佳选择。
Translation: The American Cancer Society and the National Comprehensive Cancer Network stated in their prostate cancer treatment guidelines published in 1999 that "not all prostate cancer patients should be treated with the same approach, and in some cases, 'not treating' may be the best option."

Query_Text_cn: 由于大多数前列腺肿瘤发展很慢，还有的人年纪太大或由于患其他疾病，有可能活不到从治疗中受益的时间；还有些年轻患者在发现小肿瘤的情况下，可能会采取“等等看”的办法。
Translation: Given that most prostate tumors develop slowly, some elderly individuals or those with other health conditions may not live long enough to derive a benefit from treatment. Additionally, younger patients with small tumors may opt for a "watchful waiting" approach in such cases.

Query_Text_cn: 胚胎发育最早阶段形成的干细胞，具有培养成任何组织或器官的潜能，因为它们含有原始“未编程序的”DNA。
Translation: Stem cells formed during the earliest stages of embryonic development have the potential to differentiate into any tissue or organ because they contain primitive "unprogrammed" DNA.

Query_Text_cn: 干细胞有可能成为解决英国供体危机的关键途径。
Translation: Stem cells could become a key pathway to resolving the donor crisis in the UK.

Query_Text_cn: 有些科学家认为应该马上着手收集干细胞，因为这种细胞可以被深度冷冻并能无损伤地存活数十年。
Translation: Some scientists argue that we should immediately begin collecting stem cells because these cells can be cryopreserved and survive undamaged for decades.

Query_Text_cn: 为避免伤害免疫系统，研究人员正在设计一种方法，即通过遗传工程改变细胞，使其缓时在体内产生不同的疫苗。
Translation: To avoid harming the immune system, researchers are designing a method by genetically engineering cells to slowly produce different vaccines within the body.

Query_Text_cn: 科学家首先在骨髓间叶干细胞内插入不同疫苗的基因。
Translation: Scientists first inserted the genes of different vaccines into bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells.

Query_Text_cn: 这些基因按顺序给细胞下指令生产表面抗原蛋白质。通过防御细胞可以鉴别到这些蛋白质。
Translation: These genes sequentially direct cells to produce surface antigen proteins. Defensive cells can identify these proteins.

Query_Text_cn: 这是一本关乎远古历史和现代科学的书。
Translation: This is a book concerning ancient history and modern science.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然它的主题并不是希腊神话，但其目的却可以理解为是要描述特耳西科瑞——司舞蹈与韵律的缪斯——对我们生活的广泛影响，以及科学是如何通过“伽利略的钟摆”成功地驯服了被欧里庇得斯称为“无法测量又狂放不羁”的时间。
Translation: Although its subject is not Greek mythology, its purpose can be understood as describing the widespread influence of Terpsikhore—the Muse of dance and rhythm—on our lives, and how science successfully tamed time, which Euripides called "unmeasurable and unrestrained," through "Galileo's pendulum."

Query_Text_cn: 钟摆摆锤的周期性运动对现代科学和数学的发展产生了非同寻常的影响。
Translation: The periodic motion of the pendulum bob had an extraordinary impact on the development of modern science and mathematics.

Query_Text_cn: 这种影响最终不仅扩散到了我们对所有随时间变化的自然现象的理解，而且改变了科学对于整个物质世界存在的认知观点——组成我们所能触摸到的物质的粒子，以及我们赖以感受到周围环境的声与光。
Translation: This influence eventually spread not only to our understanding of all natural phenomena that change over time but also altered science's cognitive perspective on the existence of the entire material world—the particles composing the tangible matter we can touch and the sound and light through which we perceive our surroundings.

Query_Text_cn: 当特耳西科瑞借助科学的力量，最终颠覆了她的父亲——宇宙的主宰，强大的宙斯——的时候，希腊神话才臻于完美。
Translation: When Tercikere, wielding the power of science, finally overthrew her father—the sovereign of the cosmos, the mighty Zeus—Greek mythology reached its perfection.

Query_Text_cn: 我要感谢两位生物学家戴维˙基欧和阿瑟˙科克，感谢他们对生物学领域相关问题的探讨，以及给予我的宝贵建议。作为一名物理学家，我对这些知识一无所知。
Translation: I would like to thank the two biologists David Kieu and Arthur Kirk for their discussions on issues related to the field of biology and the valuable advice they provided. As a physicist, I had no prior knowledge of these subjects.

Query_Text_cn: 如果该书的相关领域依然存在这样或那样的不足，那肯定是我自己的过错所造成的，而绝非他们的原因。
Translation: If there remain any shortcomings in the relevant fields of this book, they are certainly due to my own fault and by no means their responsibility.

Query_Text_cn: 当然，我还要感谢我的妻子露丝，她在该书的编辑上给予了我慷慨的协助。
Translation: Of course, I would also like to thank my wife Ruth, who generously assisted me in the editing of this book.

Query_Text_cn: 他那时只有17岁，早已厌倦了比萨大教堂庆祝活动的弥撒曲。
Translation: He was only 17 at the time and had already grown weary of the motets at Pisa Cathedral's celebratory events.

Query_Text_cn: 这名年轻的医学院学生正在寻找一些可以吸引其注意力的东西，这时，他的目光停在了高悬于天花板下的树枝形吊灯上。吊灯挂在一条长长的细链上，在和煦的春风里轻轻地来回摆动着。
Translation: The young medical student was searching for something to capture his attention when his gaze fell upon a branch-shaped chandelier suspended below the ceiling. The chandelier hung from a long, slender chain, swaying gently back and forth in the gentle spring breeze.

Query_Text_cn: 年轻人的好奇心被触动了，他想知道吊灯来回摆动一次的间隔会是多久，于是，他开始用自己的脉搏为吊灯的摆动计时。
Translation: The young man's curiosity was piqued; he wanted to determine the duration of a full swing of the chandelier, so he began timing its oscillations using his own pulse.

Query_Text_cn: 他惊奇地发现，无论是处于几乎纹丝不动的状态，还是在春风的吹拂下产生大幅度摆动的情况下，吊灯完成一次来回摆动所经历的脉搏跳动次数竟然是一样的。
Translation: To his surprise, he discovered that whether the chandelier was almost completely stationary or swinging widely in the spring breeze, the number of heartbeats it took to complete a full swing remained the same.

Query_Text_cn: 这位具有敏锐观察力的年轻人注定了会为人类带来更多的重大发现，他的名字就叫伽利略。
Translation: This young man of keen observation was destined to bring humanity more groundbreaking discoveries. His name was Galileo.

Query_Text_cn: 正如其传记作者文森罗˙维维亚尼所说，关于伽利略是如何发现简单钟摆的等时性的传说无疑是杜撰的，但无论是他发现了这种特性的事实，还是这种发现在此后几个世纪里对我们的文明所产生的深远影响，都是我们无可否认的。
Translation: As noted by his biographer Vincenzo Viviani, the legend of how Galileo discovered the isochronism of the pendulum is undoubtedly fabricated. However, both the fact that he discovered this property and the profound impact this discovery has had on our civilization over the subsequent centuries are undeniable.

Query_Text_cn: 这是一本关于时间节律的书，它向我们讲述了时间节律最终是如何通过伽利略的钟摆得以校准的，阐述了钟摆的摆动如何影响了我们对上述节律的认知，以及这种摆动后来是如何被发现存在于许多其他自然现象之中的。
Translation: This book explores how temporal rhythms were ultimately calibrated through Galileo's pendulum, elucidating how the pendulum's swing shaped our understanding of such rhythms and how this oscillation was later discovered to exist in numerous other natural phenomena.

Query_Text_cn: 前三章奠定了全书的基础，描述了在钟摆的稳定摆动出现之前就已经存在的时间节律：生命有机体关于日夜更迭的早期印记、各种文明试图理顺阴历和阳历周期关系的历法演变过程，以及直到中世纪才出现的更短的时间间隔计算方式。
Translation: The first three chapters lay the foundation of the book, describing the temporal rhythms that existed before the steady swing of the pendulum: the early imprints of living organisms on day-night cycles, the evolution of calendars as civilizations sought to harmonize lunar and solar cycles, and the emergence during the Middle Ages of methods for measuring shorter time intervals.

Query_Text_cn: 无论是大自然用来把节律植入生物体的生理机制，还是人类发明的各种用于记录上帝赋予我们的时间周期的方法，都不会是稳定和精确的。
Translation: Neither the physiological mechanisms that nature uses to embed rhythms into organisms nor the various methods devised by humans to record the time cycles endowed to us by God are stable or precise.

Query_Text_cn: 但前者足以让它们获得一种适者生存的优势，使它们成为一个遍布地球的特殊生命形式，至于后者，则亘古以来就恰当地满足了人类的各种需要。
Translation: But the former has been sufficient to grant them an adaptive advantage, enabling them to become a unique life form ubiquitous across the Earth. As for the latter, it has adequately met human needs since time immemorial.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，到了文艺复兴之后，商业和科学的飞速发展带来了巨大的压力，人们需要更精确地测量时间。如果人类从来没有发明出一种稳固可靠的时钟，那么西方文明的发展进程将会遭遇严重的阻碍。
Translation: Following the Renaissance, however, the rapid development of commerce and science created a significant demand for more precise time measurement. Had humanity never invented reliable timekeeping mechanisms, the progress of Western civilization would have encountered severe obstacles.

Query_Text_cn: 这种时钟对于大型海上导航和现代科学的发展都是必需的。
Translation: This type of clock is essential for large-scale maritime navigation and the development of modern science.

Query_Text_cn: 钟摆以及后来出现的其他类似的机械装置都很好地满足了这一需求。
Translation: Pendulums and other similar mechanical devices developed later effectively fulfilled this need.

Query_Text_cn: 令人惊奇的是，谐振器——也就是伽利略的钟摆——的物理学原理虽然使得对时间流动的调谐成为可能，但其应用并没有仅仅局限于制造精确的时钟装置。
Translation: It is surprising that the physical principles of resonators - namely Galileo's pendulum - made it possible to calibrate the flow of time, yet their applications were not limited solely to the creation of precise timekeeping devices.

Query_Text_cn: 人们发现它不仅仅构成了我们所听到的乐声和所看到的光线颜色的基础，而且也是我们借助量子理论所理解的宇宙结构的基础。
Translation: People have discovered that it not only constitutes the foundation of the musical sounds we hear and the colors of light we see, but also the foundation of the cosmic structure we understand through quantum theory.

Query_Text_cn: 如果没有了谐振器，就不会有粒子的存在：没有了可以呼吸的气体，没有了维系生命的液体，没有了构成土地的固体。
Translation: If there were no resonator, there would be no existence of particles: no breathable gas, no liquid sustaining life, no solid composing the land.

Query_Text_cn: 该书讲述的就是大自然中最简单、但也是最基础的物理系统的故事，你也可以从该书中了解到这种物理系统是如何与时间节律以及我们的真实物质存在紧密地连接在一起的。
Translation: The book tells the story of the simplest yet most fundamental physical systems in nature, and explains how these systems are intricately connected to temporal rhythms and our real material existence.

Query_Text_cn: 一块巨石呼啸着，在宇宙中永无休止地飞驰。
Translation: A massive stone roars, ceaselessly hurtling through the cosmos.

Query_Text_cn: 它既不围绕某颗恒星公转，也没有自身固有的自转轴。当然，也没有绕其旋转的卫星（先别担心这样的一个世界是否缺少维系生命存在的光和热）。这只是一个单调的世界，暂时没有任何变化，没有清晨和夜晚的更迭，也没有春夏秋冬的变迁。
Translation: It neither orbits a star nor possesses an inherent axis of rotation. Nor does it have satellites orbitting it (do not worry yet about whether such a world lacks the light and heat necessary to sustain life). This is a monotonous world, currently devoid of any change, with no transition between dawn and night, nor the shifting of seasons.

Query_Text_cn: 答案很可能会是否定的。
Translation: The answer is likely to be negative.

Query_Text_cn: 我们关于时间流逝的全部想法都是基于对周期性变化的感知，基于永恒重复的日夜更迭（从旭日东升到日薄西山的一段时间形成了白天，而月悬苍穹是夜晚的标志），基于往复呈现的季节变迁。
Translation: All our conceptions of the passage of time are rooted in our perception of periodic changes, based on the eternally recurring alternation between day and night (the time from sunrise to sunset constitutes daytime, while the moon hanging in the sky marks nighttime), and grounded in the cyclical progression of seasonal transformations.

Query_Text_cn: 节律是时间的天性，而周期性是我们自身存在不可分割的一部分。
Translation: Rhythm is the innate nature of time, and periodicity is an indispensable part of our very existence.

Query_Text_cn: 1931年，美国著名飞行家威利˙波斯特独自驾驶单引擎飞机温妮˙梅向西飞行，创下环游世界的壮举。波斯特也因此成为了探寻和记录飞行时差感的第一人，这种令人烦恼的现象现在已经广为人知。
Translation: In 1931, American prominent aviator Wiley Post made the feat of circumnavigating the globe westward by solo piloting a single-engine aircraft named Winnie Mae. Post thus became the first person to explore and document the phenomenon of flight-related jet lag, an annoying condition now widely recognized.

Query_Text_cn: 作为飞行员，他注意到了在不同地理经度上的时间改变所带来的影响，据说他发现了人类身体每天所能够适应的时区变化范围不超过两小时。
Translation: As a pilot, he noticed the impact of time changes across different geographical longitudes, and it is said that he discovered the range of time zones the human body can adapt to in a day does not exceed two hours.

Query_Text_cn: 至于他的这种经历在多大程度上是飞行疲劳所导致的后果，我们就不得而知了。
Translation: As for the extent to which his experiences resulted from flight fatigue, we cannot know.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然人体的生理机制并不能对现代时钟的精确性和稳定性起多大作用，但对时间及其节律的感知的确成为了人体机能的重要组成部分。
Translation: Although human physiological mechanisms do not contribute much to the precision and stability of modern clocks, the perception of time and its rhythms has indeed become an integral component of human physiological functions.

Query_Text_cn: 其中我们最为熟悉的莫过于心脏的搏动了，这种有规律的体内节律就与时钟类似。
Translation: Among these, none is more familiar than the rhythmic beat of the heart. This regular internal rhythm is similar to a clock.

Query_Text_cn: 如果传说可靠的话，伽利略就是借助自己脉搏的跳动发现了钟摆定律。这种定律对其后所有的时间测量装置都产生了意义深远的影响。
Translation: If the legend is reliable, Galileo discovered the pendulum law using the beat of his own pulse. This law had a profound impact on all subsequent timekeeping devices.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，还有其他的生理计时装置在我们的生活中扮演着至关重要的角色，而且它们的周期要更长一些。
Translation: However, other biological timing mechanisms play a crucial role in our lives, and their cycles are longer.

Query_Text_cn: 所有这些体内计时装置的前行速率虽然各不相同，但它们之间的有机协作却完全是自动完成的。我们现在知道，经过几天时间后，我们体内的生物钟就可以通过重置与一个变化的节律实现完美同步。
Translation: All these internal timing mechanisms, though varying in their progression rates, collaborate organically in a completely automatic manner. We now understand that after a few days, the biological clocks within our bodies can reset to align with a changing rhythm for perfect synchronization.

Query_Text_cn: 即便是经历一次从大西洋到太平洋的长途飞行，我们体内生物钟与当地时间的差异也会慢慢消失。
Translation: Even after a long flight from the Atlantic to the Pacific, the difference between our internal circadian rhythms and local time will gradually disappear.

Query_Text_cn: 1959年，出现了—个专有名词“昼夜节律系统”，用来描述即使在没有外部暗示的情况下，也能以24小时为一个周期记录时间流逝的体内生物钟。在拉丁语中，circa是“大概、差不多”的意思，dies则代表“一天”，由于这种生物钟的周期大概是24小时，所以用这两个单词合成了circadian这个术语。
Translation: In 1959, the technical term "circadian system" emerged to describe an internal biological clock capable of tracking the passage of time in roughly 24-hour cycles even without external cues. In Latin, "circa" means "approximately," and "dies" signifies "day." As this biological clock operates on a cycle approximately equal to 24 hours, the term "circadian" was formed by combining these two words.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然在过去200多年的时间里，生物学家对这种生物钟和其他生物钟多少有所了解，但比较深入透彻的研究却集中在过去的半个世纪里。
Translation: Although biologists have had some understanding of this biological clock and others over the past two centuries, more in-depth and thorough research has been concentrated in the past half-century.

Query_Text_cn: 在所有受昼夜节律控制的人类生理变量中，科学家首先观察到的是脉搏和体温。
Translation: Among all human physiological variables regulated by circadian rhythms, scientists first observed pulse and body temperature.

Query_Text_cn: 即便是不吃不喝，静静地躺在床上，一个人的深层体温在早晚也会存在约1°C的差异，清晨时体温较低，而下午时相对较高。
Translation: Even when not eating or drinking and lying quietly in bed, a person's core body temperature can vary by approximately 1°C between morning and evening, with lower levels in the early morning and relatively higher levels in the afternoon.

Query_Text_cn: 早在150多年前，人们就发现肾脏分泌物的数量在一天之中也会有升有降，这种分泌物可以对血液中一些必需物质的浓度进行调节，比如盐分。
Translation: Over 150 years ago, it was discovered that the quantity of renal secretions fluctuates throughout the day. These secretions can regulate the concentration of certain essential substances in the blood, such as salt.

Query_Text_cn: 这种以24小时为周期的类似生理和心理变量另外还有100多个。
Translation: There are more than 100 other similar physiological and psychological variables, such as those operating on a 24-hour cycle.

Query_Text_cn: 比如说，儿童的数字计算速度在清晨时最低，在中午之前较高，在下午的晚些时候降至最低，到了下午6点钟左右达到顶峰，然后到了晚上又开始下降。这期间的速度差距大约为10%。
Translation: For example, a child's numerical calculation speed reaches its lowest point in the early morning, increases to a higher level before midday, drops to a lower point again later in the afternoon, peaks around 6 p.m., and then begins to decline in the evening. The speed difference between the lowest and peak times is approximately 10%.

Query_Text_cn: 对于儿童计算速度的测量最早是在1907年进行的，50年之后又重复了一次，两次测量的结果基本一致。
Translation: The measurement of children's calculation speed was first conducted in 1907 and was repeated 50 years later; the results of both measurements remained largely consistent.

Query_Text_cn: 要得到这个问题的答案绝没有那么简单。
Translation: It is by no means straightforward to find the answer to this question.

Query_Text_cn: 在某些情况下，来自外部信号的影响作用是很值得怀疑的，但也是非常难以捉摸的，比如在一天之中时刻变化的电场所可能带来的干扰。尽管如此，在很多科学实验室内，针对人类和非人类物体所进行的严谨实验都得出了一个非常肯定的结论：我们的体内存在一个自动的计时装置。
Translation: In certain cases, the influence of external signals is highly questionable yet also elusive, such as the potential interference from electromagnetic fields that fluctuate constantly throughout the day. Nevertheless, rigorous experiments conducted in many scientific laboratories on both human and non-human objects have yielded a definitive conclusion: there exists an automatic timing mechanism within our bodies.

Query_Text_cn: 一些志愿者对得出这个答案做出了贡献，他们被人为地长期置于一个与世隔绝的环境中，有时会被关闭在隐蔽的洞穴里，没有任何可以暗示时间的物质存在。
Translation: Some volunteers contributed to arriving at this answer. They were artificially placed in an isolated environment for prolonged periods and sometimes confined in hidden caves, devoid of any material cues indicating time.

Query_Text_cn: 大约30年后，一名法国洞穴学者在阿尔卑斯山脉一个位于地下375英尺的阴冷洞穴里呆了两个月。
Translation: Approximately 30 years later, a French speleologist spent two months in a chilly cave located 375 feet underground in the Alps.

Query_Text_cn: 每当进食、人睡和苏醒时他都会通过电话告诉地面的支持者。这名法国学者详细记录了自己在洞穴中对于时间流逝的想法和印象。
Translation: Whenever he ate, fell asleep, or woke up, he would inform his support team on the surface via telephone. The French scholar kept detailed records of his thoughts and impressions regarding the passage of time while in the cave.

Query_Text_cn: 所有这些探险家都发现他们难以摆脱体内时间信号的控制。
Translation: All these explorers discovered they struggled to shake off the control of the time signals within their bodies.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，测量得出的结果却表明，他们身体变量的周期（所有变量之间的协调都非常完美）以及他们对一天时间周期的主观印象、他们睡眠和苏醒的时间间隔都要稍微多于25个小时。
Translation: However, the results of the measurements indicate that the cycles of their body variables (with all variables perfectly coordinated), their subjective perception of the daily time cycle, and the interval between their sleep and wake times are all slightly longer than 25 hours.

Query_Text_cn: 当他们从长期的隔离状态回到现实中时，他们体内的生物钟与外部24小时时钟的差距已经长达数个小时了。
Translation: When they returned to reality from long-term isolation, the discrepancy between their internal biological clocks and the external 24-hour clock had already stretched to several hours.

Query_Text_cn: 这里有两个问题必须区分清楚：一个是生物钟前行的“速度”（节律周期的决定性因素），另一个是在给定时间内生物钟节律的“相位”。
Translation: There are two issues that must be clearly distinguished: one is the "speed" of the biological clock's progression (the decisive factor determining the circadian period), and the other is the "phase" of the circadian rhythm within a given timeframe.

Query_Text_cn: 在从纽约到洛杉矶的飞行中，即便戴的是一块非常精准的手表，在到达目的地后也会出现三个小时的相位变化，所以必须重新设置时间。
Translation: During the flight from New York to Los Angeles, even if one wears a very precise watch, a three-hour time difference will still occur upon arrival, so the time must be reset.

Query_Text_cn: 由于其节律周期要比精准参照时钟的周期长，所以要让其正确地显示时间，必须不时地对其进行重新设置。
Translation: Since its rhythmic cycle is longer than that of a precise reference clock, it must be periodically reset to accurately display the correct time.

Query_Text_cn: 人们一般认为心理上的激发响应反应不会随时间的变化而变化，但在某些情况下，未知昼夜节律的存在会对用于测量激发响应反应的实验造成妨碍。
Translation: People generally assume that psychological excitatory responses remain constant over time. However, the presence of unknown circadian rhythms can interfere with experiments designed to measure such responses.

Query_Text_cn: 另外，由于内生节律的周期多少与24小时有一定的差距，所以要察觉这种妨碍并不总是那么容易：即便是在每天同一时间重复相同的实验，也并不必然能够消除系统误差的存在，该误差是由实验对象的反应变化所带来的，而其反应则取决于一天内进行实验的特定时间。
Translation: The detection of such disruptions is not always straightforward, as the inherent cycle of endogenous rhythms differs slightly from a 24-hour period. Even when repeating the same experiment at the exact same time each day, systematic errors arising from variations in the subjects' responses - which depend on the specific time of day the experiment is conducted - cannot necessarily be eliminated.

Query_Text_cn: 如果有超过一个的节律在起作用（外部信号以及其他略微不同的昼夜节律），实验结果可能会变得非常令人迷惑不解。
Translation: If more than one rhythm is at play (external signals and other slightly different circadian rhythms), the experimental results may become extremely confusing.

Query_Text_cn: 现在，生物钟具有自主性已是不争的事实。
Translation: Now, the autonomy of the biological clock is an established fact.

Query_Text_cn: 在与外部环境信号隔绝的情况下，一个人的昼夜节律系统会以均速前行，而且其节律周期会比以24小时为周期的一天长一些。
Translation: When isolated from external environmental signals, a person's circadian rhythm system proceeds at a constant rate, and its rhythmic cycle is longer than a 24-hour day.

Query_Text_cn: 如果未处于隔绝状态，人体的昼夜节律系统会随着环境变量一一主要是光的强度一一持续调整，以便与太阳的循环周期保持同步。
Translation: If not in an isolated state, the human circadian rhythm system constantly adjusts in response to environmental variables, primarily light intensity, to maintain synchronization with the solar cycle.

Query_Text_cn: 换句话说，虽然遵循着一个稳定的速度，但我们体内的生物钟每天都会慢一个小时左右。不过由于生物钟能够随着光线明暗的变换周期持续重置，所以在正常状态下，这种时间的丢失并不会累加，我们体内的生物钟也因此得以与太阳的节律保持一致。
Translation: In other words, although following a consistent pace, our internal biological clock slows by approximately one hour each day. However, since the biological clock can be continuously reset in response to cyclical changes in light, under normal circumstances this time loss does not accumulate, allowing our internal biological clock to remain synchronized with the sun's rhythm.

Query_Text_cn: 当然了，人类只是大自然中的物种之一，昼夜节律也只是生物节律中的一种。
Translation: Certainly, humans are simply one of the species in nature, and circadian rhythm is merely one of the biological rhythms.

Query_Text_cn: 除了心脏的搏动之外，还有一些体内计时装置的周期要更短一些，它们被称为次昼夜节律，比如说脑电图描记器（EEG)所测量的大脑电场活动的周期仅为0.1秒。
Translation: In addition to the heartbeat, there are some internal timing mechanisms with even shorter cycles, known as ultradian rhythms, such as the brain's electrical activity measured by EEG (electroencephalogram), which has cycles as short as 0.1 seconds.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，也有一些节律的周期要比昼夜节律长，比如说女人的月经周期为28天，调节狗熊冬眠的近年节律则接近一年，我们可以推测，另外一些体内生物钟的周期有可能还要更长一些。
Translation: However, some rhythms have longer cycles than circadian rhythms. For example, the menstrual cycle in women lasts about 28 days, and the annual rhythms governing bears' hibernation are close to a year. We can speculate that some other internal biological clock cycles might have even longer periods.

Query_Text_cn: 看起来有节律的行为应该是大部分生物系统所共有的特性。
Translation: Rhythmic behaviors should be a common characteristic of most biological systems.

Query_Text_cn: 萤火虫的同步闪光周期比较短（一般为1秒钟左右，但不同的种类可能会略有不同）。
Translation: The synchronized flashing cycle of fireflies is relatively short (typically around 1 second, but may vary slightly among different species).

Query_Text_cn: 生活在马来西亚和新几内亚的雄性萤火虫常成千上万地聚集在树丛中，它们会非常有节律地同时发出闪烁的光亮，场面相当壮观。
Translation: Male fireflies in Malaysia and Papua New Guinea often gather in tree clusters in the thousands, rhythmically flashing their lights in unison, creating a truly spectacular sight.

Query_Text_cn: 人们发现它们各自都有独特的内在次昼夜闪光周期，但当它们大量聚集到一起的时候，所有的萤火虫就会自动把闪光周期调整为同步。
Translation: It was found that each of them has its own unique intrinsic subdaily flashing rhythm, but when they gather in large numbers, all fireflies automatically synchronize their flashing cycles.

Query_Text_cn: (用闪烁的手电筒也可以引发这些萤火虫的同步闪光。
Translation: Using a flashing flashlight can also trigger the synchronized flashing of these fireflies.

Query_Text_cn: 在有些情况下，某些行为看起来需要周期较长的计时装置，但事实上需要的仅仅是一个昼夜节律系统而已。
Translation: In some cases, certain behaviors may appear to require longer-term timing mechanisms, but in reality, all that is needed is a circadian rhythm system.

Query_Text_cn: 以加拿大的雪靴兔为例，其皮毛在夏天呈棕色，在冬天则呈白色。为了形成一种保护性伪装，雪靴兔通常会在第一场雪飘落之前开始改变皮毛的颜色。
Translation: As exemplified by Canada's snowshoe hares, their fur is brown in summer and turns white in winter. To form a protective camouflage, they typically begin changing their fur color before the first snowfall.

Query_Text_cn: 但雪靴兔判断夏天来临所依据的并不是近年节律生物钟，而是一种昼夜节律计时系统，雪靴兔通过该系统记录白天和黑夜的相对数量，从而判断出夏天是否到了。
Translation: Snowshoe hares do not rely on annual biological rhythms to determine the arrival of summer but instead use a circadian timing system that tracks the relative lengths of day and night to ascertain whether summer has arrived.

Query_Text_cn: 如果在七月份白天的一段时间内把它们的眼睛蒙上，其皮毛变色的开始时间就会提前。
Translation: If their eyes are kept covered during a period of daylight in July, the onset time of their coat color change would be advanced.

Query_Text_cn: 其他哺乳动物也会利用近年节律和昼夜节律生物钟来调节新陈代谢和生殖周期，以便在体内积累足够的脂肪抵御冬天的严寒，也能保证幼崽出生在一个比较舒适的季节，而且有充足的食物来源。
Translation: Other mammals also utilize annual rhythms and circadian clocks to regulate their metabolism and reproductive cycles, so as to accumulate sufficient fat reserves within their bodies to survive the harsh winter cold, while ensuring that offspring are born during a relatively favorable season with ample food sources.

Query_Text_cn: 在上述情况下，白天的长度也有助于生物节律发挥作用，即使这些节律的周期要比24小时长很多。
Translation: In such circumstances, the duration of daylight also aids in the functioning of biological rhythms, even though their cycles are far longer than 24 hours.

Query_Text_cn: 生活在沿海水域中的某些螃蟹内生有潮汐节律生物钟，可以帮助它们了解极为重要的环境节律——潮汐。
Translation: Certain crabs living in coastal waters possess an innate tide-related biological clock, enabling them to comprehend the crucial environmental rhythm—the tide.

Query_Text_cn: 还有一些海洋动物的产卵期和繁殖期也会受到体内生物钟的控制，而其生物节律则直接受到月亮圆缺的影响。
Translation: The spawning periods and reproductive cycles of some marine animals are regulated by their internal biological clocks, and their biological rhythms are directly influenced by lunar phases.

Query_Text_cn: 1910年，瑞士医生奥古斯特˙福雷尔的一个偶然发现揭开了昼夜节律计时系统严肃研究的序幕。
Translation: In 1910, a serendipitous discovery by Swiss physician Auguste Forel marked the beginning of serious study into the circadian timing system.

Query_Text_cn: 医生到自己位于阿尔卑斯山地区的房子避暑，他通常在房子外的露天阳台上吃早饭，不久他就留意到桌子上打开的果酱罐吸引了附近一个蜂房的几只蜜蜂光临。
Translation: The doctor retreated to his summer home in the Alpine region. He usually had breakfast on the open-air terrace outside his house. Soon he noticed that an open jam jar on the table was attracting a few bees from a nearby hive.

Query_Text_cn: 医生并没有太在意，但在接下来的几个早晨，他好奇地发现在早饭准备好之前这些蜜蜂就已经聚集在餐桌旁了，看起来它们在殷切地盼望医生奉上果酱。
Translation: The doctor didn’t pay much attention at first, but in the following mornings he curiously noticed that before breakfast was ready, the bees had already gathered around the dining table, as if they were eagerly awaiting the doctor to serve them jam.

Query_Text_cn: 为了免受这些不速之客的骚扰，医生决定转到房内进餐。奇怪的是，这些蜜蜂依然会在每天的同一时间如期而至，在外面的餐桌旁寻找食物。
Translation: To avoid being harassed by these uninvited guests, the doctor decided to move indoors to eat. Strangely, the bees still arrived at the same time each day, searching for food around the outdoor table.

Query_Text_cn: 由于这些蜜蜂从来没有在其他时间造访过他的房子，所以医生得出了一个结论：蜜蜂肯定“对时间有记忆力”。
Translation: Since these bees had never visited his house at any other time, the doctor concluded that bees must have "a memory of time".

Query_Text_cn: 大约20年后，个体生态学家英格堡˙贝林和卡尔˙冯˙弗里希对进行了个别标记的蜜蜂展开了系统的观测，他们在几天之中的固定时间为这些蜜蜂在固定的地点提供糖水。
Translation: About two decades later, the ecologists Ingeborg Beling and Karl von Frisch conducted systematic observations on individually marked bees, providing them with sugar water at fixed times and locations over several days.

Query_Text_cn: 在进行观测的日子里，他们会把糖水拿走，结果这些研究者发现每一只做有标记的蜜蜂都在原来的地点出现了，并且平时的“训练”时间是蜜蜂出现的高峰阶段（有些蜜蜂选择稍微早那么一点点飞过来）。
Translation: During the observation period, the researchers removed the sugar water and found that every marked bee reappeared at its original location. The "training" period was the peak time for their appearance, as some bees chose to arrive slightly earlier than the designated time.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，这种“时间训练”只有在进食间隔为24小时或接近24小时的情况下才会成功，如果间隔改为19小时或者48小时，训练就会以失败告终。
Translation: However, this "time training" only succeeds when feeding intervals are 24 hours or around 24 hours. If the intervals are changed to 19 hours or 48 hours, the training would fail.

Query_Text_cn: 为了确保这些蜜蜂不会察觉到一些实验者忽略的外部线索，贝林将一些实验地点选在了位于地下深处的岩盐坑里。
Translation: To ensure that these bees would not detect some external cues overlooked by experimenters, Bering selected some experimental sites in deep underground rock-salt pits.

Query_Text_cn: 马克斯伦纳曾在自己位于法国的实验室里训练了一些蜜蜂，让它们习惯于在晚上八点一刻享用食物，而在第二天乘飞机来到大西洋彼岸的纽约市继续实验。
Translation: Max Renner once trained some bees in his laboratory in France, getting them accustomed to feeding at 8:45 PM, and then flew to New York City across the Atlantic the next day to continue the experiment.

Query_Text_cn: 结果这些蜜蜂仍然会像往常一样出来寻觅它们的美味佳肴，不同的是它们会在法国时间的晚上八点一刻左右出现。
Translation: However, these bees still go out to forage for their favorite foods as usual. The difference is that they appear around 8:15 PM French time.

Query_Text_cn: 事实证明，仓鼠和其他啮齿类动物对于研究哺乳动物的昼夜节律非常有用。
Translation: It has been proven that hamsters and other rodents are very useful for studying the circadian rhythm of mammals.

Query_Text_cn: 把它们关在有稳定光源照明的笼子里，不提供任何有关昼夜变化的线索。笼子里放置一个可以用来锻炼的轮子，它们可以自由地嬉戏玩耍。
Translation: They were kept in consistently lit cages without any cues indicating circadian rhythms. The cages contained a running wheel for exercise, allowing them to play and move freely.

Query_Text_cn: 另外，它们进食和喝水的时间也同样是非常规律的。
Translation: Additionally, their eating and drinking times are also just as regular.

Query_Text_cn: 这些实验表明：在没有外部线索干扰的情况下，很多昼夜节律“习惯”会持续相当长的一段时间，甚至会陪伴动物的一生，当然也有一些“习惯”会比较早地慢慢消失。
Translation: These experiments indicate that, in the absence of external cues, many circadian rhythm "habits" can persist for an extended period, even an entire lifetime, though some "habits" may gradually fade earlier.

Query_Text_cn: 在20世纪中期以前，长途迁徙的鸟类那非凡的识途能力一直被认为是一个伟大的奇迹。
Translation: Before the mid-20th century, the remarkable navigational abilities of migratory birds that travel long distances were considered to be a great marvel.

Query_Text_cn: 现在我们知道这些能力至少部分是基于它们的昼夜节律系统。
Translation: Now we know that these abilities are at least in part based on their circadian systems.

Query_Text_cn: 太平洋金斑鹆鸟每年秋天都会跨越2，000多英里从阿留申群岛飞到夏威夷过冬，然后在第二年的春天再飞回阿留申群岛。
Translation: The Pacific Golden-Plover migrates over 2,000 miles from the Aleutian Islands to Hawaii each autumn to spend the winter and returns to the Aleutian Islands the following spring.

Query_Text_cn: 到了中午，则让太阳位于身体的右边。
Translation: At noon, the sun should be positioned to the right of the body.

Query_Text_cn: 鸟类可以依据一天时间的变化确定太阳所处的位置，第一个通过实验证明鸟类具有这一能力的是动物学家古斯塔夫˙克雷默。
Translation: Birds can determine the position of the sun based on the time of day. The first zoologist to experimentally demonstrate this ability was Gustav Kramer.

Query_Text_cn: 他在一个圆形的鸟舍里养了一些八哥，太阳光通过墙上的开口照射到鸟舍内，每到迁徙的季节，绝大部分的八哥都会把栖息的地方对着一个固定的方向，也就是如果没有鸟舍的束缚，它们的迁徙之旅将会遵循的方向。
Translation: He keeps a number of mynas in a round aviary where sunlight streams through openings in the walls into the enclosure. Every migratory season, the majority of the mynas position themselves facing a fixed direction - the same direction their migratory journey would follow if not confined by the aviary.

Query_Text_cn: 当通过一面镜子突然改变阳光照射的方向时，八哥们也会相应地改变栖息地的朝向，这就说明它们是在借助太阳导航。
Translation: When the direction of sunlight is suddenly altered using a mirror, mynah birds will also adjust the orientation of their perching positions, demonstrating that they navigate by relying on the sun.

Query_Text_cn: 但如果是在一天的时间内非常缓慢地变换阳光的照射方向，镜子就不会对它们产生影响了，它们体内的昼夜节律生物钟能够帮助它们感觉到太阳的位置移动。
Translation: However, if the direction of sunlight is altered very slowly over the course of a day, the mirrors would not affect them, as their circadian rhythm biological clocks enable them to sense the movement of the sun's position.

Query_Text_cn: 还有一些迁徙的鸟类不仅可以通过太阳导航，甚至还能够在夜晚借助星辰辨别方向，当然，也是依靠其体内的生物钟发挥作用。
Translation: Some migratory birds can not only navigate using the sun but also determine direction by stars at night, and this ability is also made possible by their internal biological clocks.

Query_Text_cn: 白喉莺就是依靠这种生物钟每年秋天从北欧飞越亚得里亚海和地中海去埃及过冬的，然后每年春天再飞回北欧。
Translation: The white-throated warbler relies on its biological clock to migrate every autumn from Northern Europe across the Adriatic and Mediterranean Seas to Egypt for wintering, then returns to Northern Europe every spring.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，如果不巧遇到阴天多云的夜晚，白喉莺就会变得手足无措了。
Translation: However, if unfortunately faced with overcast and cloudy nights, the reed warbler becomes flustered.

Query_Text_cn: 还有人发现某些特定类型的蚂蚁也可以借助太阳的方向和体内的昼夜节律生物钟每天到相同的地点觅食。
Translation: Some have also observed that certain species of ants can utilize the direction of the sun and their internal circadian rhythm biological clocks to forage at the same location daily.

Query_Text_cn: 但如果把它们关在一个不透光的箱子里，这些蚂蚁就会迷失方向，再次打开箱子把它们放到阳光可以照射到的地方，它们却能够很快地找到原来的方向，继续向前奔赴觅食地点，即使在它们被关起来时太阳已经移动了方向，也并不会影响它们重返征程。
Translation: If placed in a lightproof box, these ants will lose their way. However, when the box is reopened and placed in an area exposed to sunlight, they can quickly regain their original direction and continue their journey toward the food source. This ability remains unaffected even when the sun has shifted position during their confinement.

Query_Text_cn: 植物体内同样也存在着计时系统。
Translation: Within plants, timing systems also exist.

Query_Text_cn: 很久以前，人们就已经知道很多植物的叶子或者花朵会在一天的特定时间开放或者闭合。
Translation: A long time ago, people already knew that the leaves or flowers of many plants would open or close at specific times during the day.

Query_Text_cn: 安德斯塞恩斯是亚历山大大帝手下的一名将军，在远征印度的途中，他发现并记录了如下的现象：罗望子树的叶子会在清晨张开，而到了晚上就会合拢起来。
Translation: Anders Sains was a general under Alexander the Great. During the expedition to India, he discovered and documented the following phenomenon: the leaves of the tamarind tree would spread open in the early morning and close at night.

Query_Text_cn: 很多园丁都注意到了有些花朵的花瓣会在夜晚闭合，到了次日的黎明或者更晚的时候又会重新张开；而金针花每天清晨都会绽放一朵美丽的小花。
Translation: Many gardeners have observed that the petals of some flowers close at night and reopen at the following dawn or later; the daylily, however, produces a beautiful small flower each morning.

Query_Text_cn: 18世纪伟大的植物学家卡罗勒斯˙林尼厄斯曾经设计了一个计时花床，把在一天中不同的特定时间开花的花朵有规律地排列起来组成了一个巨大的时钟（参见图1)。
Translation: In the 18th century, the great botanist Carolus Linnaeus designed a timing flower bed, arranging flowers that bloom at specific times during the day in a regular pattern to form a large clock (see Figure 1).

Query_Text_cn: 当不同的花朵开放的时候，据推测与花朵共同进化的蜜蜂能够依靠其体内的昼夜节律计时器感触到它们喜欢的花朵，于是它们可以在特定的时间飞来采蜜，而不用浪费时间在不必要的徒劳侦査上了。
Translation: When different flowers bloom, it is speculated that the co-evolved bees can detect their preferred blossoms by relying on their internal circadian clock, thus enabling them to fly to collect nectar at specific times without wasting time on unnecessary, futile reconnaissance.

Query_Text_cn: 为了找到问题的答案，法国天文学家德梅朗对含羞草进行了研究，就像印度的罗望子树一样，含羞草的叶子也会在夜晚闭合，而到了第二天早晨又重新展开。
Translation: To find the answer, French astronomer De Méricourt studied the sensitive plant. Like the Indian siris tree, its leaves also close at night and reopen in the morning.

Query_Text_cn: 即便是在一片漆黑的情况下（他曾经长时间地把含羞草放置在一个黑暗的房间里），它的叶子仍然会有节奏地开合，而且开合的时间大体上会与客观的昼夜变化保持同步。
Translation: Even in complete darkness (he once kept a sensitive plant in a dark room for an extended period), its leaves continue to rhythmically open and close, and their movements generally synchronize with the objective day-night cycle.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然这种行为并不能完全独立于外部的昼夜循环，但植物在逐渐成熟的过程中，的确会对白天阳光的变幻进行某种记忆，至少在一段时间内如此。
Translation: Although this behavior cannot be entirely independent of the external light-dark cycle, plants do indeed retain a memory of daytime sunlight variations, at least for a period of time.

Query_Text_cn: 在19世纪，植物学家弗朗西斯˙达尔文（査尔斯˙达尔文的第三个儿子）、威廉˙普费弗、朱利叶斯˙冯˙萨克斯（后两者均为德国人）以及他们的学生和同事都对叶子在白天的活动进行了研究。
Translation: In the 19th century, botanists Francis Darwin (the third son of Charles Darwin), Wilhelm Pfeffer and Julius von Sachs (the latter two being German), along with their students and colleagues, conducted research on the activities of leaves during the day.

Query_Text_cn: 在很长的一段时期内，和动物体内的生物钟一样，植物体内的昼夜节律生物钟也被认为是一种非常神秘的现象，但在过去的半个世纪里，以德国植物学家欧文˙邦宁为开路先锋的科学家开展了大量的研究实验，现在，人们已经公认植物体内是存在这种昼夜节律生物钟的，而且人们已经能够对这种生物钟的很多“零件”进行独立研究了。
Translation: For a long time, just as the biological clocks in animals were considered mysterious, the circadian rhythm biological clock in plants was also regarded as a highly enigmatic phenomenon. However, over the past half-century, scientists led by German botanist Erwin Bünning conducted extensive research experiments. Now, it is widely accepted that plants do possess such a circadian rhythm biological clock, and scientists are now able to independently study many of its "components".

Query_Text_cn: 和动物一样，植物体内也存在着长短不一的生理周期。
Translation: As in animals, plants also have physiological cycles of varying lengths.

Query_Text_cn: 举例来说，很多植物体内的近年节律生物钟能够预感到寒冷季节的到来，此时体内的细胞会开始硬化，以应付即将来临的冬季和可能突然造访的霜冻。
Translation: For example, the circadian clocks within many plants can anticipate the arrival of cold seasons, at which point their cells begin to harden in preparation for the approaching winter and possible sudden frosts.

Query_Text_cn: 和雪靴兔类似，植物体内的这种近年节律计时系统实际上是对白天长度的一种反应。该系统依靠一个昼夜节律生物钟测量白天的长度变化。
Translation: Like the snowshoe hare, the photoperiodic timing system in plants essentially reacts to the length of daylight. This system relies on a circadian clock to track variations in daylight duration.

Query_Text_cn: 植物体内的这种生理节律要么是遗传下来的，要么就是在对外部刺激的反应过程中逐渐形成的。即便外部的刺激被人为地消除了，植物体内的这种节律依然会存在或多或少的一段时间，而且这种节律不会随植物周围的温度变化而变化。
Translation: The physiological rhythms within plants are either genetically inherited or gradually developed in response to external stimuli. Even if such stimuli are artificially eliminated, these rhythms will persist for a certain period, albeit to varying degrees, and remain unaffected by fluctuations in ambient temperature.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，为了与外部世界的大环境保持同步，植物体内的生物钟也必须依据光线变化提供的线索进行有规律的调整和重置。
Translation: However, to remain synchronized with the broader external environment, the circadian clocks within plants must also adjust and reset regularly based on the cues provided by light changes.

Query_Text_cn: 在某些情况下，有节律的温度变化也会成为生物钟调整的外部线索，但对大部分的生物钟来说，起作用的外部线索——生理学者把这些刺激称为zeitgebere(德语，意为“给时者”——译者注)一—看起来是光线强度的变化。
Translation: In certain cases, rhythmic temperature changes can also serve as external cues for adjusting the biological clock. However, for most biological clocks, the effective external cues—the stimuli that physiologists refer to as "zeitgebers" (German, meaning "time giver" – translator's note)—appear to be changes in light intensity.

Query_Text_cn: 外部的客观环境必然会对生物体内的计时系统演变发挥关键的作用，这当然没有什么奇怪的，因为我们得以维系生命的昼夜节律就根源于对昼夜更迭的体验。
Translation: The external objective environment inevitably plays a crucial role in the evolution of an organism's internal timing system. This is hardly surprising, as the circadian rhythms that sustain life are rooted in the organism's experience of the daily alternation between day and night.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，生物钟的调整过程并不一定是一次突然的、不连续的重置。
Translation: However, the adjustment process of the biological clock is not necessarily a sudden and discontinuous reset.

Query_Text_cn: 在很多情况下，这种调整过程会在瞬间开始，然后就会逐渐地从一个旧的阶段过渡到一个新的阶段，就像我们对时钟进行调整一样，我们只是在瞬间通过外部介质慢慢地转动时钟的指针，而这并不会改变其固有的转动周期，也就是说，在完成调整的那一刻起，该时钟指针的转动既不会加快，也不会变慢。
Translation: In many cases, this adjustment process begins instantly and then gradually transitions from an old stage to a new one, just as when we adjust a clock, we merely slowly turn its hands through an external medium in an instant, which does not alter its inherent rotational cycle. That is to say, once the adjustment is completed, the movement of the clock's hands will neither speed up nor slow down.

Query_Text_cn: 令人非常惊奇的是，昼夜节律甚至会存在于最为简单的生物有机体内，比如单细胞的青绿色藻类（藻青菌），这种藻类内生有一个以24小时为周期的生物钟，能够与固氮作用和光合作用保持同步。
Translation: It is highly surprising that circadian rhythms exist even in the simplest biological organisms, such as single-celled green algae (cyanobacteria), which have an internal 24-hour biological clock that synchronizes with nitrogen fixation and photosynthesis.

Query_Text_cn: 这种生理周期能够及时地把这两种过程分离开来，而这对于藻青菌生理机能的正确发挥至关重要，因为氧气——光合作用的一种产物——的存在会对固氮作用产生干扰。
Translation: This physiological cycle effectively separates these two processes in a timely manner, which is crucial for the proper functioning of cyanobacteria's physiological mechanisms, as oxygen—a byproduct of photosynthesis—interferes with nitrogen fixation.

Query_Text_cn: 多边膝沟藻是一种单细胞的海生腰鞭毛虫，这种能够发光的海藻大量存在于北美洲西海岸的沿海水域中。
Translation: Pyrocystis fusiformis is a single-celled marine dinoflagellate. This bioluminescent algae is abundant in the coastal waters along the western coast of North America.

Query_Text_cn: 生物体的发光是一个化学过程，一个荧光素分子会在荧光素酶的催化作用下氧化，产生一个新的高能态分子，随后该高能态分子会恢复到基态，同时释放出一个光量子。
Translation: Bioluminescence in organisms is a chemical process where a luciferin molecule is oxidized under the catalytic action of luciferase, producing a new high-energy-state molecule. This high-energy molecule subsequently returns to its ground state while releasing a photon.

Query_Text_cn: 膝沟藻能够发出两种不同的光：一种是有节奏变幻的稳定而柔和的光，在接近黎明的时候达到最亮；另一种是亮度明显大很多的有节奏的闪光，在接近午夜的时候达到顶峰，不过这需要外部的诱因来引发。
Translation: Noctiluca emits two distinct types of light: one is a steady, soft glow with rhythmic variations, reaching its peak brightness as dawn approaches; the other is a significantly brighter rhythmic flashing light that peaks around midnight, though this requires an external trigger to initiate.

Query_Text_cn: 另外，膝沟藻体内还存在着其他的生理节律，其中包括一个可以在黎明时分突然阻止细胞分裂的节律，还包括一个能够使其光合能力在固定的时间暂时丧失的节律。
Translation: Additionally, Ostreococcus cells also harbor other physiological rhythms, including one that can suddenly halt cell division at dawn, and another that can temporarily render its photosynthetic capacity inactive at a fixed time.

Query_Text_cn: 但在正常的情况下，其白天的光合作用则具有非常明显的周期性，如果持续提供稳定的弱光照射膝沟藻，其所有的生理节律能够在几个星期内都保持不变。
Translation: Under normal circumstances, the daytime photosynthesis of Aphanizomenon exhibits a very distinct periodicity. If continuously exposed to stable weak light, all its physiological rhythms can remain unchanged for several weeks.

Query_Text_cn: 如果是在一片漆黑的情况下，膝沟藻的光合作用就会完全停止，其所有的生理节律都会瞬间丧失。不过，短暂的强烈闪光能够让膝沟藻的光合作用恢复正常，从而使其重新获得生理节律，并能保证与此前的节律同步。
Translation: In complete darkness, the photosynthesis of Nitzschia comes to a complete halt, and all its physiological rhythms immediately cease. However, brief intense flashes of light can restore the algae's photosynthetic function, allowing it to reacquire its physiological rhythms and maintain synchronization with its previous cycles.

Query_Text_cn: 这看起来可能有些不可思议，如此简单的生物体，仅仅有一个细胞，却能保有很多独立的昼夜节律和其他的生理节律。
Translation: It may seem incredible that such a simple organism, consisting of a single cell, can maintain numerous independent circadian rhythms and other physiological rhythms.

Query_Text_cn: 事实上，有证据表明单个细胞内的计时器甚至能够左C大而复杂的器官的生理周期，比如人类的心脏，而正是心脏的节律性跳动让我们人类能够在这个星球上繁衍生息。
Translation: There is evidence suggesting that the internal timers within individual cells can regulate the physiological cycles of large and complex organs, such as the human heart, and it is precisely the rhythmic beating of the heart that allows humans to thrive and sustain life on this planet.

Query_Text_cn: 大约40年前，洛杉肌加州大学的艾萨克˙哈拉里发明了一种方法，能够把老鼠心脏的细胞进行分离，让它们在营养培养基中独自存活。
Translation: About four decades ago, Isaac Harari from the University of California, Los Angeles, invented a method that could separate the cells of a mouse heart and allow them to survive individually in a nutrient culture medium.

Query_Text_cn: 他通过显微镜对这些细胞进行观察，发现其中某些单独的细胞依然保持着原有的搏动节律，而且完全是在独自进行。
Translation: He observed these cells under a microscope and discovered that certain individual cells still maintained their original rhythmic contractions, entirely acting independently.

Query_Text_cn: 最令人惊奇的或许是一些单细胞的细菌，它们每隔16个小时分裂繁殖一次，但却依然能够将与24小时的生物钟周期几乎完全相同的生理节律信息传递给后代，而且这些节律能够与其分裂繁殖的16小时周期非常协调地发挥作用。
Translation: The most astonishing aspect may be that some single-celled bacteria, which divide every 16 hours, can still transmit physiological rhythm information almost perfectly aligned with the 24-hour circadian rhythm cycle to their offspring, and these rhythms function in seamless coordination with their 16-hour reproductive cycle.

Query_Text_cn: 在这些有机体内，几乎所有的基因都处于其昼夜节律系统的掌控之中。
Translation: In these organisms,almost all genes are under the control of their circadian rhythm system.

Query_Text_cn: 对于很多鸟类来说，其昼夜节律似乎是由脑部的松果体控制的，法国哲学家笛卡尔曾认为松果体是人类灵魂的居所。
Translation: For many bird species, their circadian rhythms seem to be controlled by the pineal gland in the brain. French philosopher René Descartes once believed the pineal gland was the seat of the human soul.

Query_Text_cn: 这种具有感光功能的器官能够有节律地产生降黑素，这种激素可以把腺体的活动信号传递到机体的其他部位，即便是在体外的试管环境下也是如此。
Translation: This light-sensitive organ can rhythmically produce melatonin, a hormone that transmits signals of glandular activity to other parts of the body, even in vitro.

Query_Text_cn: 首先将松果腺组织置于一个光照和黑暗每隔12小时更迭一次的环境中，然后将其转移到一个具有恒定光照的环境，在接下来的几天中，松果腺组织依然会有节律地释放数量不等的降黑素。
Translation: First, the pineal gland tissue is placed in an environment with a light-dark cycle alternating every 12 hours. It is then transferred to a constant light environment. Over the following days, the tissue continues to rhythmically release varying amounts of melatonin.

Query_Text_cn: 更有甚者，如果把松果腺组织从一种鸟移植到另一种松果腺已被切除的鸟的体内，后者不仅能够重新获得此前已经消失的昼夜节律，而且其新获取的节律与“捐赠者”的原有节律会保持同步：接受者的行为让其看起来好像生活在捐赠者的时区中。
Translation: More strikingly, if pineal gland tissue is transplanted from one bird into another whose pineal glands had been surgically removed, the latter not only regains the previously lost circadian rhythm but also synchronizes its newly acquired rhythm with the donor's original cycle: the recipient's behavior appears as though it were living in the donor's time zone.

Query_Text_cn: 即便是试管中的腺体部分，也会在一定的时间内节律性地继续产生降黑素。
Translation: Even when placed in a test tube, the glandular portion will continue to rhythmically produce melatonin within a certain period of time.

Query_Text_cn: 另一方面，对于哺乳动物来说，包括人类，绝大部分（虽然不是全部）生理节律最核心的中枢起搏点是被称为视交叉上核（SCN)的两团神经细胞体，视交叉上核位于视网膜后视交叉上部的下丘脑内。
Translation: On the other hand, for mammals, including humans, the vast majority (though not all) of the core central pacemaker governing physiological rhythms consists of two clusters of nerve cell bodies known as the suprachiasmatic nuclei (SCN), located in the hypothalamus above the optic chiasm, posterior to the retina.

Query_Text_cn: 视交叉上核能够完全独立地产生节律，而无须任何外部的光线线索。
Translation: The suprachiasmatic nucleus can generate rhythms completely independently without any external light cues.

Query_Text_cn: 举例来说，即便把新生的幼鼠置于完全黑暗的环境中，它们也会在生命的第一天展示出非常明显的昼夜节律。
Translation: For example, even if placed in complete darkness, newborn mice will exhibit a very pronounced circadian rhythm on the first day of their lives.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，在正常情况下，视交叉上核会与其周围的昼夜更迭保持同步，其调整的路径即是直接来自视网膜的视觉影像。
Translation: However, under normal circumstances, the suprachiasmatic nucleus synchronizes with the circadian rhythms of its surrounding environment, and its adjustment pathway is the direct visual signals from the retina.

Query_Text_cn: 事实上，最近人们才发现眼睛里包含有直接与视交叉上核相连的特殊图像传感器，这些传感器并不用于视觉，所以即便是盲人也可以借助它们调整自己的昼夜节律。另外，下丘脑还包含有另外一个截然不同的次昼夜节律生物钟——以每小时为周期调整促卵泡激素的分泌。
Translation: In fact, it was only recently discovered that the eyes contain specialized photoreceptors directly linked to the suprachiasmatic nucleus (SCN), which are not involved in visual processing—allowing even those who are blind to use them to regulate their circadian rhythms. Additionally, the hypothalamus houses another distinctly different subcircadian biological clock that adjusts the secretion of follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) on an hourly basis.

Query_Text_cn: 目前已经发现，很多独立的昼夜节律振荡器遍布哺乳动物的全身，以用来调整其行为和生理机能在特定区域的节律。
Translation: It has been found that many independent circadian oscillators are distributed throughout the entire body of mammals to regulate the rhythms of their behavior and physiological functions in specific regions.

Query_Text_cn: 这些计时器仅能在有限的几天时间内保持自身的节律，并需要经常性地接受来自核心生物钟视交叉上核的信号进行必要的调整。
Translation: These oscillators can only maintain their own rhythms for a limited number of days and require periodic signals from the central biological clock, the suprachiasmatic nucleus, to undergo necessary adjustments.

Query_Text_cn: 在生物体内发现的生物钟节律到底是来源于生命早期外部的信号刺激还是由遗传基因决定的呢？通过更为细致入微的实验，特别是针对无处不在的果蝇进行的实验，如今该问题已经有了答案。
Translation: The question of whether the circadian rhythms observed in living organisms originate from external signals in the early stages of life or are determined by genetic factors has now been answered through more meticulous experiments, especially those targeting the ubiquitous fruit fly.

Query_Text_cn: 黑腹果蝇有两个互为关联的稳定节律系统，一种用来控制其活动和休息的周期，另一种用来调整其幼虫在一天中破蛹而出的时间。
Translation: The black腹果蝇 has two interconnected circadian rhythm systems, one regulating their activity and rest cycles, the other adjusting the time when their larvae emerge from pupae throughout the day.

Query_Text_cn: 1979年，R.J.科诺普卡培养出了根本没有周期性节律系统的变种果蝇以及节奏周期分别为较短的19小时和较长的28小时的变种果蝇。
Translation: In 1979, R.J. Koepka cultivated mutant fruit flies with no circadian rhythm system at all, those with a shorter rhythm cycle of 19 hours, and those with a longer rhythm cycle of 28 hours.

Query_Text_cn: 通过对标准实验室果蝇（“野生型”）的一个特定基因（因此也是变种命名的依据）的变异，对三个变种加以区分。
Translation: By inducing mutations in a specific gene (which also serves as the basis for naming the variants), three variants of the standard laboratory fruit fly ("wild-type") can be distinguished.

Query_Text_cn: 遗传学家还对粗糙脉孢菌进行了研究，该菌类产生孢子的行为是经由一种昼夜节律系统控制的。
Translation: Geneticists have also studied Neurospora crassa, whose spore production is regulated by a circadian rhythm system.

Query_Text_cn: 该菌类的变种呈现出不同的节律周期，如果把不同变种的细胞和野生型的细胞混合，那么混合物的节律周期会因含有突变基因的细胞核的多少相应地发生变化。
Translation: The variants of this fungal species exhibit different rhythmic cycles. If the cells of different variants are mixed with wild-type cells, the rhythmic cycle of the mixture will vary in accordance with the number of mutant gene-containing nuclei present.

Query_Text_cn: 上述实验表明，一个种群的节律周期长短并不是由特定的遗传基因所决定的。
Translation: The aforementioned experiments indicate that the duration of a population's rhythmic cycle is not determined by specific genetic genes.

Query_Text_cn: 1950年，俄国化学家鲍里斯˙贝洛索夫发现了现在被称为贝洛索夫-恰鲍廷斯基反应（BZ反应）的振荡化学反应，该反应能够节律性地产生变化的振荡波，从而把不同颜色的反应产物区分开来（参见图2)。从那时起，我们就已经知道仅仅依靠化学性质就可以产生节律性的行为。
Translation: In 1950, Russian chemist Boris Belousov discovered the oscillating chemical reaction now known as the Belousov-Zhabotinsky reaction (BZ reaction), which rhythmically generates oscillating waves, thereby distinguishing between reaction products of different colors (see Figure 2). Since then, it has been known that rhythmic behavior can be generated solely through chemical properties.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，就植物来说，其生物钟机制应该也具备类似的纯生物化学性质。
Translation: Therefore, in the case of plants, their circadian clock mechanisms should also possess a similar purely biochemical nature.

Query_Text_cn: 事实上，悬浮发酵酵母细胞的能量代谢实验表明：当定态代谢受到随后添加的发酵基质干扰时，其发酵能量的产生过程——称为糖酵解——就会以几分钟为一个周期开始振荡，随后就可以在无细胞的试管环境下对糖酵解过程中不同周期的振荡进行研究，此时它们除了化学反应就再没有其他激发因素了。
Translation: The experimental results on energy metabolism of suspended fermentation yeast cells show that when the steady-state metabolism is disrupted by subsequently added fermentation substrates, the energy production process of fermentation - known as glycolysis - begins to oscillate in cycles of minutes. Subsequently, such oscillations in different cycles of the glycolysis process can be studied in a cell-free test tube environment, where there are no other stimuli except the chemical reactions themselves.

Query_Text_cn: 观察到的振荡行为是工程师们所称的反馈机制的典型后果，催化糖酵解过程、将果糖-6-磷酸（F-6-P)转化为果糖二磷酸钠（FDP)的酶本身也是被FDP激活的。
Translation: The observed oscillatory behavior is a typical consequence of what engineers refer to as a feedback mechanism, as the enzyme catalyzing the glycolysis process and converting fructose-6-phosphate (F-6-P) into fructose diphosphate (FDP) is itself activated by FDP.

Query_Text_cn: 因此，当糖酵解开始产生FDP时，催化酶被激活并且开始加速，原始F-6-P的浓度开始不断缩小，并因此抑制FDP的进一步产生并减缓糖酵解过程，这会持续一段较长的时间，直到消耗的F-6-P重新得以补充为止。
Translation: Therefore, when glycolysis begins to produce FDP, the catalytic enzymes are activated and the process accelerates, gradually decreasing the original concentration of F-6-P. This, in turn, inhibits further FDP production and slows down glycolysis. This state persists for an extended period until the depleted F-6-P is replenished.

Query_Text_cn: 在合适的浓度和代谢速度下，F-6-P和FDP的浓度最终会进入一个节律性变化的过程，两者周期相同，步伐各异，此多彼少，互为消长。
Translation: Under appropriate concentrations and metabolic rates, the concentrations of F-6-P and FDP will eventually enter a rhythmic fluctuation process, both sharing the same cycle but differing in phases, with one increasing as the other decreases, maintaining a balance between them.

Query_Text_cn: （相对于没有时间延迟的情况下迅速进入均衡状态，上述过程中生物化学进程的放缓所造成的时间延迟对于产生节律性的变化是至关重要的。）通过在一个没有任何细胞的系统中选择适当的催化酶、物质浓度和流动速率，生物学家已经可以实现周期为24小时的代谢振荡——也就是单纯通过化学性质实现的昼夜节律。
Translation: Compared to the rapid attainment of equilibrium in the absence of time delay, the time delay caused by the slowdown of biochemical processes in the aforementioned process is critical for generating rhythmic variations. By selecting appropriate catalytic enzymes, substrate concentrations, and flow rates in a system devoid of cells, biologists have already achieved 24-hour metabolic oscillations—that is, circadian rhythms realized purely through chemical properties.

Query_Text_cn: 同样的反馈机制还被用在果蝇身上产生昼夜节律，唯一不同的是F-6-P和FDP的位置被以下物质取代了：生物节律基因（pergene)产生的效率比（测量蛋白质完全性的指标。——译者注）不同的蛋白质（PERpmtehi)以及其合成的信使核糖核酸，还有其他一些蛋白质。
Translation: The same feedback mechanism is applied to fruit flies to produce circadian rhythms, with the only difference being that the positions of F-6-P and FDP are replaced by the following substances: the efficiency ratio generated by the circadian rhythm gene (per gene) (a metric measuring protein integrity—the translator's note), different proteins (PERpmtehi), and the messenger RNA synthesized through its production, as well as other proteins.

Query_Text_cn: （虽然机制的原理相同，但在藻青菌中产生生物钟的蛋白质和在果蝇体内产生生物钟的蛋甴质却大为不同，从这一点我们或许可以总结说：节律系统看起来不太可能是从一个唯一的共同祖先进化而来的。
Translation: Although the underlying mechanism is the same, the circadian clock proteins produced in Cyanobacteria and those in fruit flies are markedly different. From this, we might conclude that the rhythmic system seems unlikely to have evolved from a single common ancestor.

Query_Text_cn: 此类反馈的结果通常被描述为一个极限环，无论反应是何时发生的，两种反应物数量的对比图最终会越来越趋向于一个相同的闭合曲线（参见图3)。
Translation: The results of such feedback are typically described as a limit cycle, and regardless of when the reaction occurs, the comparison plot of the quantities of the two reactants will eventually converge toward the same closed curve (see Figure 3).

Query_Text_cn: 此时两种物质的浓度开始跳舞，每一个都是按照固定的节律从高往低舞动。
Translation: At this moment, the concentrations of the two substances began to dance, each following a fixed rhythm descending from high to low.

Query_Text_cn: 至于是什么机制导致了结构更为复杂繁琐的器官产生周期性的行为，比如视交叉上核，目前的了解还相对有限，这依然是接下来需要研究的一个重要课题。
